Please try again.';\n  }\n\n  return {\n    ready,\n    get profile() { return profile; },\n\n    async register(name, email, password) {\n      try {\n        const cred = await firebaseAuth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, password);\n        if (name) await cred.user.updateProfile({ displayName: name });\n        profile = await loadProfile(cred.user);\n        if (profile) profile.displayName = name || profile.displayName;\n        try {\n          await firebaseDB.collection('users').doc(cred.user.uid)\n            .update({ displayName: name, updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() });\n        } catch (_) { /* non-fatal */ }\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) {\n        return { ok: false, error: friendly(err.code) };\n      }\n    },\n\n    async signIn(email, password) {\n      try {\n        await firebaseAuth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, password);\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) {\n        return { ok: false, error: friendly(err.code) };\n      }\n    },\n\n    async signOut() {\n      await firebaseAuth.signOut();\n      window.location.href = '/index.html';\n    },\n\n    async resetPassword(email) {\n      try {\n        await firebaseAuth.sendPasswordResetEmail(email);\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) {\n        return { ok: false, error: friendly(err.code) };\n      }\n    },\n\n    homePath(user = profile) {\n      return user && user.isAdmin ? {
  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   INTERNSHIPS SERVICE · Firestore collection \"internships\"\n   Single source of truth. Read paths are public; writes admin-only\n   (enforced by security rules + checked here).\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst Internships = (() => {\n  const col = () => firebaseDB.collection('internships');\n\n  function normalize(doc) {\n    const d = doc.data();\n    return {\n      id: doc.id,\n      ...d,\n      deadline: UI.toDate(d.deadline),\n      createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt),\n      updatedAt: UI.toDate(d.updatedAt)\n    };\n  }\n\n  function byNewest(list) {\n    return list.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));\n  }\n\n  return {\n    /** All published internships, newest first. */\n    async published() {\n      try {\n        const snap = await col().where('published', '==', true).get();\n        return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize));\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Internships.published failed:', err);\n        throw err;\n      }\n    },\n\n    /** Featured + published, newest first. */\n    async featured(limit = 6) {\n      try {\n        const snap = await col()\n          .where('published', '==', true)\n          .where('featured', '==', true)\n          .get();\n        return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize)).slice(0, limit);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Internships.featured failed:', err);\n        return [];\n      }\n    },\n\n    /** Public single fetch — only returns published docs. */\n    async get(id) {\n      if (!id) return null;\n      try {\n        const doc = await col().doc(id).get();\n        if (!doc.exists) return null;\n        const item = normalize(doc);\n        return item.published ? item : null;\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Internships.get failed:', err);\n        return null;\n      }\n    },\n\n    /** Admin: fetch regardless of publish state. */\n    async getAny(id) {\n      const doc = await col().doc(id).get();\n      return doc.exists ? normalize(doc) : null;\n    },\n\n    /** Admin: everything. */\n    async all() {\n      const snap = await col().get();\n      return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize));\n    },\n\n    async create(data) {\n      const user = Auth.profile;\n      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };\n      try {\n        const ref = await col().add({\n          ...data,\n          verified: !!data.verified,\n          featured: !!data.featured,\n          published: !!data.published,\n          createdBy: user.uid,\n          createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),\n          updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()\n        });\n        return { ok: true, id: ref.id };\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Internships.create failed:', err);\n        return { ok: false, error: err.message };\n      }\n    },\n\n    async update(id, updates) {\n      const user = Auth.profile;\n      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };\n      try {\n        await col().doc(id).update({\n          ...updates,\n          updatedBy: user.uid,\n          updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()\n        });\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Internships.update failed:', err);\n        return { ok: false, error: err.message };\n      }\n    },\n\n    async remove(id) {\n      const user = Auth.profile;\n      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };\n      try {\n        await col().doc(id).delete();\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Internships.remove failed:', err);\n        return { ok: false, error: err.message };\n      }\n    }\n  };\n})();\n",

{
  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   SAVED SERVICE · users/{uid}/saved subcollection\n   Batched reads (getAll) instead of N+1.\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst Saved = (() => {\n  let ids = new Set();\n  let loaded = false;\n\n  function refOf(internshipId) {\n    return firebaseDB\n      .collection('users')\n      .doc(Auth.profile.uid)\n      .collection('saved')\n      .doc(internshipId);\n  }\n\n  return {\n    get ids() { return ids; },\n\n    async load() {\n      if (!Auth.profile) { ids = new Set(); return; }\n      try {\n        const snap = await firebaseDB\n          .collection('users')\n          .doc(Auth.profile.uid)\n          .collection('saved')\n          .get();\n        ids = new Set(snap.docs.map((d) => d.id));\n        loaded = true;\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Saved.load failed:', err);\n      }\n    },\n\n    has(internshipId) {\n      return ids.has(internshipId);\n    },\n\n    /** Returns {ok, state:'saved'|'removed'} */\n    async toggle(internshipId) {\n      if (!Auth.profile) return { ok: false, error: 'signed-out' };\n      try {\n        if (ids.has(internshipId)) {\n          await refOf(internshipId).delete();\n          ids.delete(internshipId);\n          return { ok: true, state: 'removed' };\n        }\n        await refOf(internshipId).set({\n          internshipId,\n          savedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()\n        });\n        ids.add(internshipId);\n        return { ok: true, state: 'saved' };\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Saved.toggle failed:', err);\n        return { ok: false, error: err.message };\n      }\n    },\n\n    /** Full internship objects for everything saved, newest-saved first. */\n    async list() {\n      if (!Auth.profile) return [];\n      try {\n        const snap = await firebaseDB\n          .collection('users')\n          .doc(Auth.profile.uid)\n          .collection('saved')\n          .orderBy('savedAt', 'desc')\n          .get();\n\n        const entries = snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, savedAt: UI.toDate(d.data().savedAt) }));\n        ids = new Set(entries.map((e) => e.id));\n        if (!entries.length) return [];\n\n        const items = [];\n        for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i += 10) {\n          const chunk = entries.slice(i, i + 10);\n          const docs = await firebaseDB.getAll(\n            ...chunk.map((e) => firebaseDB.collection('internships').doc(e.id))\n          );\n          docs.forEach((doc, j) => {\n            if (doc.exists) {\n              const data = doc.data();\n              items.push({\n                id: doc.id,\n                ...data,\n                deadline: UI.toDate(data.deadline),\n                createdAt: UI.toDate(data.createdAt),\n                savedAt: chunk[j].savedAt\n              });\n            }\n          });\n        }\n        return items;\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Saved.list failed:', err);\n        return [];\n      }\n    }\n  };\n})();\n",

{
  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   SUGGESTIONS SERVICE · Firestore collection \"suggestions\"\n   Community submissions → admin triage → draft internship.\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst Suggestions = (() => {\n  const col = () => firebaseDB.collection('suggestions');\n\n  function normalize(doc) {\n    const d = doc.data();\n    return {\n      id: doc.id,\n      ...d,\n      createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt),\n      updatedAt: UI.toDate(d.updatedAt),\n      reviewedAt: UI.toDate(d.reviewedAt)\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    /** Public: submit a suggestion (works signed in or anonymous). */\n    async submit(data) {\n      try {\n        const user = Auth.profile;\n        await col().add({\n          ...data,\n          status: 'pending',\n          submittedBy: user ? user.uid : 'anonymous',\n          submittedByEmail: user ? user.email : (data.contactEmail || ''),\n          createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),\n          updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()\n        });\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Suggestions.submit failed:', err);\n        return { ok: false, error: err.message };\n      }\n    },\n\n    /** Admin: list, optionally filtered by status. */\n    async list(status = null) {\n      let query = col();\n      if (status) query = query.where('status', '==', status);\n      const snap = await query.orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').get();\n      return snap.docs.map(normalize);\n    },\n\n    /** Admin: change status with optional review notes. */\n    async setStatus(id, status, notes = '') {\n      try {\n        await col().doc(id).update({\n          status,\n          reviewNotes: notes,\n          reviewedBy: Auth.profile ? Auth.profile.uid : null,\n          reviewedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),\n          updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()\n        });\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Suggestions.setStatus failed:', err);\n        return { ok: false, error: err.message };\n      }\n    },\n\n    async remove(id) {\n      try {\n        await col().doc(id).delete();\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Suggestions.remove failed:', err);\n        return { ok: false, error: err.message };\n      }\n    },\n\n    /**\n     * Admin: convert a suggestion into a draft internship.\n     * Field names match the internship schema exactly so renderers work.\n     * Returns {ok, {
  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   NOTIFICATIONS SERVICE · users/{uid}/notifications\n   Client-generated deadline alerts (deterministic doc ids prevent\n   duplicates without needing Cloud Functions).\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst Notifications = (() => {\n  let cache = [];\n\n  function col() {\n    return firebaseDB\n      .collection('users')\n      .doc(Auth.profile.uid)\n      .collection('notifications');\n  }\n\n  return {\n    get list() { return cache; },\n    unreadCount() { return cache.filter((n) => !n.read).length; },\n\n    /**\n     * Scan saved internships and raise a deadline alert for anything\n     * closing within 7 days. Doc id `deadline-{internshipId}` dedupes.\n     */\n    async sync() {\n      if (!Auth.profile) return;\n      try {\n        const saved = await Saved.list();\n        const batch = firebaseDB.batch();\n        let writes = 0;\n\n        for (const item of saved) {\n          const days = UI.daysUntil(item.deadline);\n          if (days === null || days < 0 || days > 7) continue;\n\n          const notifRef = col().doc(`deadline-${item.id}`);\n          const existing = await notifRef.get();\n          if (existing.exists) continue;\n\n          batch.set(notifRef, {\n            type: 'deadline',\n            title: days === 0 ? 'Closes today' : `Closes in ${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,\n            message: `${item.title} at ${item.company}`,\n            internshipId: item.id,\n            read: false,\n            createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()\n          });\n          writes++;\n        }\n\n        if (writes) await batch.commit();\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Notifications.sync failed:', err);\n      }\n    },\n\n    async load() {\n      if (!Auth.profile) { cache = []; return cache; }\n      try {\n        const snap = await col().orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').limit(30).get();\n        cache = snap.docs.map((doc) => ({\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...doc.data(),\n          createdAt: UI.toDate(doc.data().createdAt)\n        }));\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Notifications.load failed:', err);\n        cache = [];\n      }\n      return cache;\n    },\n\n    async markAllRead() {\n      if (!Auth.profile) return;\n      try {\n        const unread = cache.filter((n) => !n.read);\n        if (!unread.length) return;\n        const batch = firebaseDB.batch();\n        unread.forEach((n) => batch.update(col().doc(n.id), { read: true }));\n        await batch.commit();\n        cache.forEach((n) => { n.read = true; });\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Notifications.markAllRead failed:', err);\n      }\n    },\n\n    async markRead(id) {\n      const item = cache.find((n) => n.id === id);\n      if (!item || item.read) return;\n      item.read = true;\n      try {\n        await col().doc(id).update({ read: true });\n      } catch (_) { /* optimistic */ }\n    }\n  };\n})();\n",

'btn-ghost-light' : 'btn-ghost';\n    return `\n      <a href=\"/signin.html\" class=\"btn ${ghost} btn-sm\">Sign in</a>\n      <a href=\"/register.html\" class=\"btn btn-primary btn-sm\">Create account</a>`;\n  }\n\n  function userMenuMarkup(profile) {\n    return `\n      <div class=\"user-menu\">\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"user-menu-btn\" data-user-menu-btn aria-haspopup=\"true\" aria-expanded=\"false\">\n          <span class=\"avatar avatar-green\">${UI.esc(initials(profile.displayName))}</span>\n          <span class=\"user-menu-caret\">${UI.icon('chevron-down', 14)}</span>\n        </button>\n        <div class=\"dropdown\" data-user-menu-panel>\n          <div class=\"dropdown-header\">\n            <div class=\"dropdown-name\">${UI.esc(profile.displayName || 'Student')}</div>\n            <div class=\"dropdown-email\">${UI.esc(profile.email || '')}</div>\n          </div>\n          <a class=\"dropdown-item\" href=\"/dashboard.html\">${UI.icon('home', 16)} Dashboard</a>\n          <a class=\"dropdown-item\" href=\"/saved.html\">${UI.icon('bookmark', 16)} Saved</a>\n          ${profile.isAdmin ? `<a class=\"dropdown-item\" href=\"/admin/index.html\">${UI.icon('shield', 16)} Admin console</a>` : ''}\n          <div class=\"dropdown-sep\"></div>\n          <button type=\"button\" class=\"dropdown-item is-danger\" data-signout>${UI.icon('logout', 16)} Sign out</button>\n        </div>\n      </div>`;\n  }\n\n  function hydrateNavActions() {\n    const slot = document.querySelector('[data-nav-actions]');\n    if (!slot) return;\n    const profile = Auth.profile;\n    slot.innerHTML = profile ? userMenuMarkup(profile) : signedOutActions();\n\n    const btn = slot.querySelector('[data-user-menu-btn]');\n    const panel = slot.querySelector('[data-user-menu-panel]');\n    if (btn && panel) {\n      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n        e.stopPropagation();\n        const open = panel.classList.toggle('is-open');\n        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));\n      });\n      document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n        if (!panel.contains(e.target)) {\n          panel.classList.remove('is-open');\n          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');\n        }\n      });\n      document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {\n        if (e.key === 'Escape') panel.classList.remove('is-open');\n      });\n    }\n\n    slot.querySelectorAll('[data-signout]').forEach((el) => {\n      el.addEventListener('click', () => Auth.signOut());\n    });\n  }\n\n  function markActiveLinks() {\n    document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav-match]').forEach((a) => {\n      if (a.dataset.navMatch === path) a.classList.add('is-active');\n    });\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- Mobile panel ---------- */\n\n  function buildMobilePanel() {\n    const burger = document.querySelector('[data-burger]');\n    if (!burger) return;\n\n    const panel = document.createElement('div');\n    panel.className = 'mobile-panel';\n    panel.id = 'mobilePanel';\n    panel.innerHTML = `\n      <nav aria-label=\"Mobile\">\n        <a class=\"nav-link\" href=\"/internships.html\">Internships</a>\n        <a class=\"nav-link\" href=\"/suggest.html\">Suggest an internship</a>\n        ${Auth.profile ? `\n          <a class=\"nav-link\" href=\"/dashboard.html\">Dashboard</a>\n          <a class=\"nav-link\" href=\"/saved.html\">Saved</a>\n          ${Auth.profile.isAdmin ? '<a class=\"nav-link\" href=\"/admin/index.html\">Admin console</a>' : ''}\n        ` : ''}\n      </nav>\n      <div class=\"mobile-panel-actions\">\n        ${Auth.profile\n          ? '<button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-outline btn-lg\" data-signout>Sign out</button>'\n          : '<a class=\"btn btn-primary btn-lg\" href=\"/register.html\">Create account</a><a class=\"btn btn-outline btn-lg\" href=\"/signin.html\">Sign in</a>'}\n      </div>`;\n    document.body.appendChild(panel);\n\n    const setOpen = (open) => {\n      panel.classList.toggle('is-open', open);\n      burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));\n      burger.innerHTML = UI.icon(open ? 'hidden' : '';\n    };\n\n    burger.innerHTML = UI.icon('menu', 22);\n    burger.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(!panel.classList.contains('is-open')));\n    panel.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((a) => a.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false)));\n    panel.querySelectorAll('[data-signout]').forEach((el) => {\n      el.addEventListener('click', () => Auth.signOut());\n    });\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- Tab bar (student pages) ---------- */\n\n  function setupTabBar() {\n    const bar = document.querySelector('[data-tabbar]');\n    if (!bar || !Auth.profile || Auth.profile.isAdmin) return;\n    bar.classList.add('is-visible');\n    document.body.classList.add('has-tabbar');\n    bar.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach((item) => {\n      if (item.dataset.tab === path) item.classList.add('is-active');\n    });\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- Misc ---------- */\n\n  function footerYear() {\n    document.querySelectorAll('[data-year]').forEach((el) => {\n      el.textContent = new Date().getFullYear();\n    });\n  }\n\n  function scrollSpyDarkNav() {\n    const nav = document.querySelector('.site-nav.is-dark');\n    if (!nav) return;\n    const onScroll = () => nav.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', window.scrollY > 24);\n    onScroll();\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n  }\n\n  async function init() {\n    await Auth.ready;\n    hydrateNavActions();\n    markActiveLinks();\n    buildMobilePanel();\n    setupTabBar();\n    footerYear();\n    scrollSpyDarkNav();\n    UI.initReveals();\n  }\n\n  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);\n\n  return { init };\n})();\n",

{
  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   ROWS · shared internship row renderer + save handling\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst Rows = (() => {\n  function badges(item) {\n    let html = '';\n    if (item.verified) {\n      html += `<span class=\"badge badge-verified\">${UI.icon('check', 11)} Verified</span>`;\n    }\n    if (item.featured) html += '<span class=\"badge badge-featured\">Featured</span>';\n    if (!UI.isOpen(item)) html += '<span class=\"badge badge-closed\">Closed</span>';\n    return html;\n  }\n\n  function metaLine(item) {\n    const parts = [\n      UI.esc(item.company || '—'),\n      item.city ? `<span class=\"mono-tag\">${UI.esc(item.city)}</span>` : '',\n      item.workMode ? UI.esc(item.workMode) : '',\n      item.duration ? UI.esc(item.duration) : ''\n    ].filter(Boolean);\n    return parts.join(' · ');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Standard list row. opts: { cta:boolean, daysPill:boolean }\n   */\n  function jobRow(item, opts = {}) {\n    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);\n    const saved = Saved.has(item.id);\n    const daysPill = opts.daysPill && dl.days !== null\n      ? `<span class=\"days-pill ${dl.days < 0 ? 'is-over' : ''}\">${dl.days < 0 ? 'Closed' : dl.days === 0 ? 'Today' : dl.days + 'd left'}</span>`\n      : '';\n\n    return `\n      <article class=\"job-row reveal\">\n        <div class=\"job-row-main\">\n          <div class=\"job-row-title-line\">\n            <h3 class=\"job-row-title\">\n              <a href=\"/internship.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}\">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a>\n            </h3>\n            ${badges(item)}\n          </div>\n          <p class=\"job-row-meta\">${metaLine(item)}</p>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"job-row-side\">\n          ${daysPill || `<span class=\"deadline ${dl.cls}\">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span>`}\n          <button type=\"button\" class=\"save-btn ${saved ? 'is-saved' : ''}\" data-save=\"${UI.esc(item.id)}\"\n                  aria-label=\"${saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship'}\" aria-pressed=\"${saved}\">\n            ${UI.icon('bookmark', 18, saved)}\n          </button>\n          ${opts.cta !== false ? `\n            <a class=\"job-row-cta\" href=\"/internship.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}\">\n              View ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 15)}\n            </a>` : ''}\n        </div>\n      </article>`;\n  }\n\n  function list(items, opts = {}) {\n    if (!items.length) return '';\n    return `<div class=\"job-list\">${items.map((i) => jobRow(i, opts)).join('')}</div>`;\n  }\n\n  function emptyState({ title, message, actionHref, actionLabel }) {\n    return `\n      <div class=\"state\">\n        <div class=\"state-icon\">${UI.icon('briefcase', 22)}</div>\n        <h3 class=\"state-title\">${UI.esc(title)}</h3>\n        <p class=\"state-msg\">${UI.esc(message)}</p>\n        ${actionHref ? `<a class=\"btn btn-primary\" href=\"${actionHref}\">${UI.esc(actionLabel)}</a>` : ''}\n      </div>`;\n  }\n\n  function errorState() {\n    return `\n      <div class=\"state\">\n        <div class=\"state-icon\">${UI.icon('alert', 22)}</div>\n        <h3 class=\"state-title\">Couldn't load opportunities</h3>\n        <p class=\"state-msg\">There was a problem reaching the database. Check your connection and try again.</p>\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-primary\" onclick=\"window.location.reload()\">Retry</button>\n      </div>`;\n  }\n\n  /** Delegated save-toggle handling for a page. */\n  function initSaveHandling() {\n    document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {\n      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-save]');\n      if (!btn) return;\n      e.preventDefault();\n\n      if (!Auth.profile) {\n        UI.toast('Sign in to save internships');\n        const here = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;\n        setTimeout(() => {\n          window.location.href = `/signin.html?next=${encodeURIComponent(here)}`;\n        }, 900);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const id = btn.dataset.save;\n      btn.disabled = true;\n      const result = await Saved.toggle(id);\n      btn.disabled = false;\n\n      if (!result.ok) {\n        UI.toast('Could not update your saved list', 'error');\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const savedNow = result.state === 'saved';\n      btn.classList.toggle('is-saved', savedNow);\n      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(savedNow));\n      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', savedNow ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship');\n      btn.innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 18, savedNow);\n      UI.toast(savedNow ? 'Saved to your list' : 'Removed from saved');\n      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saved:changed'));\n    });\n  }\n\n  return { jobRow, list, emptyState, errorState, initSaveHandling };\n})();\n",

}

  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   LANDING\n   ============================================================ */\n\n(async () => {\n  Rows.initSaveHandling();\n\n  const CITIES = ['Douala', 'Yaoundé', 'Buea', 'Bamenda', 'Limbe', 'Garoua'];\n  let items = [];\n\n  try {\n    items = await Internships.published();\n  } catch (_) {\n    items = [];\n    document.getElementById('latestRows').innerHTML = Rows.errorState();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  const open = items.filter((i) => UI.isOpen(i));\n\n  /* ---------- Opener stats ---------- */\n  const cities = new Set(open.map((i) => i.city).filter(Boolean));\n  const stats = {\n    open: open.length,\n    verified: open.filter((i) => i.verified).length,\n    cities: cities.size\n  };\n  document.querySelectorAll('[data-stat]').forEach((el) => {\n    const key = el.dataset.stat;\n    el.textContent = stats[key] ?? 0;\n  });\n\n  /* ---------- Ticker ---------- */\n  const tickerTrack = document.querySelector('[data-ticker-track]');\n  if (tickerTrack) {\n    const source = items.length\n      ? items.slice(0, 10).map((i) => `${i.title} — ${i.company}${i.city ? ' — ' + i.city : ''}`)\n      : ['Software Engineering', 'Design', 'Marketing', 'Finance', 'Data Science', 'Business'];\n    const half = source.map((t) => `<span class=\"ticker-item\">${UI.esc(t)}</span>`).join('');\n    tickerTrack.innerHTML = half + half; // duplicate for seamless loop\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- Latest opportunities ---------- */\n  const latestRows = document.getElementById('latestRows');\n  if (latestRows) {\n    if (!open.length) {\n      latestRows.innerHTML = Rows.emptyState({\n        title: 'First listings land soon',\n        message: 'We are verifying the first batch of internships right now. Suggest one you already know about and it could be the first.',\n        actionHref: '/suggest.html',\n        actionLabel: 'Suggest an internship'\n      });\n    } else {\n      latestRows.innerHTML = Rows.list(open.slice(0, 6), { cta: true });\n    }\n    UI.initReveals(latestRows);\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- City index ---------- */\n  const cityIndex = document.getElementById('cityIndex');\n  if (cityIndex) {\n    const counts = {};\n    open.forEach((i) => {\n      if (i.city) counts[i.city] = (counts[i.city] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n\n    const known = [...new Set([...CITIES, ...Object.keys(counts)])];\n    known.sort((a, b) => (counts[b] || 0) - (counts[a] || 0));\n\n    cityIndex.innerHTML = known.slice(0, 8).map((city, idx) => `\n      <a class=\"city-row reveal\" style=\"--reveal-i:${idx}\" href=\"/internships.html?city=${encodeURIComponent(city)}\">\n        <span class=\"city-index-num\">${String(idx + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n        <span class=\"city-index-name\">${UI.esc(city)}</span>\n        <span class=\"city-index-count\">${counts[city] || 0} open</span>\n        ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 18)}\n      </a>`).join('');\n    UI.initReveals(cityIndex);\n  }\n})();\n",

  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   DISCOVERY · search, facets, sort, deep links\n   URL params: ?q= ?category= ?city= ?mode= ?verified=1 ?closed=1\n   ============================================================ */\n\n(async () => {\n  Rows.initSaveHandling();\n\n  const CATEGORY_FALLBACK = ['Software Engineering', 'Design', 'Marketing', 'Finance', 'Data Science', 'Business'];\n\n  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n  const state = {\n    q: (params.get('q') || '').trim(),\n    categories: params.get('category') ? [params.get('category')] : [],\n    cities: params.get('city') ? [params.get('city')] : [],\n    modes: params.get('mode') ? [params.get('mode')] : [],\n    verifiedOnly: params.get('verified') === '1',\n    includeClosed: params.get('closed') === '1',\n    sort: params.get('sort') === 'deadline' ? 'deadline' : 'newest'\n  };\n\n  const els = {\n    search: document.getElementById('searchInput'),\n    sort: document.getElementById('sortSelect'),\n    results: document.getElementById('results'),\n    meta: document.getElementById('resultsMeta'),\n    sideFilters: document.getElementById('sideFilters'),\n    drawerBody: document.getElementById('drawerBody'),\n    drawer: document.getElementById('filterDrawer'),\n    backdrop: document.getElementById('drawerBackdrop'),\n    openDrawer: document.getElementById('openDrawer'),\n    applyDrawer: document.getElementById('applyDrawer'),\n    clearDrawer: document.getElementById('clearDrawer'),\n    includeClosed: document.getElementById('includeClosed')\n  };\n\n  if (els.search) els.search.value = state.q;\n  if (els.sort) els.sort.value = state.sort;\n  if (els.includeClosed) els.includeClosed.checked = state.includeClosed;\n\n  let all = [];\n  try {\n    all = await Internships.published();\n  } catch (_) {\n    els.results.innerHTML = Rows.errorState();\n    return;\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- Facet model ---------- */\n\n  function facetCounts() {\n    const cats = {}, cities = {}, modes = {};\n    all.forEach((i) => {\n      if (i.category) cats[i.category] = (cats[i.category] || 0) + 1;\n      if (i.city) cities[i.city] = (cities[i.city] || 0) + 1;\n      if (i.workMode) modes[i.workMode] = (modes[i.workMode] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n    return { cats, cities, modes };\n  }\n\n  function facetGroup(title, type, entries, active) {\n    if (!entries.length) return '';\n    const inputs = entries.map(([value, count]) => `\n      <label class=\"filter-option\">\n        <input type=\"checkbox\" data-facet=\"${type}\" value=\"${UI.esc(value)}\" ${active.includes(value) ? 'checked' : ''}>\n        <span>${UI.esc(value)}</span>\n        <span class=\"filter-count\">${count}</span>\n      </label>`).join('');\n    return `\n      <div class=\"filter-group\">\n        <div class=\"filter-group-title\">${UI.esc(title)}</div>\n        ${inputs}\n      </div>`;\n  }\n\n  function chipGroup(title, type, entries, active) {\n    if (!entries.length) return '';\n    const chips = entries.map(([value]) => `\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"chip ${active.includes(value) ? 'is-active' : ''}\" data-chip=\"${type}\" value=\"${UI.esc(value)}\">${UI.esc(value)}</button>`).join('');\n    return `\n      <div class=\"filter-group\">\n        <div class=\"filter-group-title\">${UI.esc(title)}</div>\n        <div class=\"chips\">${chips}</div>\n      </div>`;\n  }\n\n  function renderFacets() {\n    const { cats, cities, modes } = facetCounts();\n\n    const catEntries = Object.entries(cats).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);\n    const cityEntries = Object.entries(cities).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);\n    const modeEntries = Object.entries(modes).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);\n\n    const sideHtml = `\n      ${facetGroup('Category', 'categories', catEntries, state.categories)}\n      ${facetGroup('City', 'cities', cityEntries, state.cities)}\n      ${facetGroup('Work mode', 'modes', modeEntries, state.modes)}\n      <div class=\"filter-group\">\n        <div class=\"filter-group-title\">Trust</div>\n        <label class=\"filter-option\">\n          <input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"verifiedOnlySide\" ${state.verifiedOnly ? 'checked' : ''}>\n          <span>Verified only</span>\n        </label>\n      </div>`;\n\n    if (els.sideFilters) els.sideFilters.innerHTML = sideHtml;\n\n    if (els.drawerBody) {\n      els.drawerBody.innerHTML = `\n        ${chipGroup('Category', 'categories', catEntries.length ? catEntries : CATEGORY_FALLBACK.map((c) => [c, 0]), state.categories)}\n        ${chipGroup('City', 'cities', cityEntries, state.cities)}\n        ${chipGroup('Work mode', 'modes', modeEntries.length ? modeEntries : ['Remote', 'Hybrid', 'On-site'].map((m) => [m, 0]), state.modes)}\n        <div class=\"filter-group\">\n          <label class=\"filter-option\">\n            <input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"verifiedOnlyDrawer\" ${state.verifiedOnly ? 'checked' : ''}>\n            <span>Verified only</span>\n          </label>\n        </div>`;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- Filtering ---------- */\n\n  function apply() {\n    let rows = [...all];\n\n    if (!state.includeClosed) rows = rows.filter((i) => UI.isOpen(i));\n    if (state.verifiedOnly) rows = rows.filter((i) => i.verified);\n    if (state.categories.length) rows = rows.filter((i) => state.categories.includes(i.category));\n    if (state.cities.length) rows = rows.filter((i) => state.cities.includes(i.city));\n    if (state.modes.length) rows = rows.filter((i) => state.modes.includes(i.workMode));\n\n    if (state.q) {\n      const q = state.q.toLowerCase();\n      rows = rows.filter((i) =>\n        [i.title, i.company, i.category, i.city]\n          .filter(Boolean)\n          .some((f) => f.toLowerCase().includes(q)));\n    }\n\n    if (state.sort === 'deadline') {\n      rows.sort((a, b) => {\n        const da = a.deadline ? a.deadline.getTime() : Infinity;\n        const db = b.deadline ? b.deadline.getTime() : Infinity;\n        return da - db;\n      });\n    } else {\n      rows.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));\n    }\n\n    renderResults(rows);\n    renderMeta(rows.length);\n  }\n\n  function renderResults(rows) {\n    if (!rows.length) {\n      const hasFilters = state.q || state.categories.length || state.cities.length || state.modes.length || state.verifiedOnly;\n      els.results.innerHTML = Rows.emptyState({\n        title: hasFilters ? 'Try removing a filter or two, or broaden your search terms.'\n          : 'New verified opportunities are added regularly. Check back soon — or suggest one you know about.',\n        actionHref: hasFilters ? null : '/suggest.html',\n        actionLabel: 'Suggest an internship'\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n    els.results.innerHTML = Rows.list(rows, { cta: true });\n    UI.initReveals(els.results);\n  }\n\n  function renderMeta(count) {\n    if (!els.meta) return;\n    const activeCount = state.categories.length + state.cities.length + state.modes.length\n      + (state.verifiedOnly ? 1 : 0) + (state.q ? 1 : 0);\n    els.meta.innerHTML = `\n      <span><span class=\"results-count\">${count}</span> open ${count === 1 ? document.getElementById('clearAll');\n    if (clear) clear.addEventListener('click', clearAll);\n  }\n\n  function clearAll() {\n    state.q = '';\n    state.categories = [];\n    state.cities = [];\n    state.modes = [];\n    state.verifiedOnly = false;\n    if (els.search) els.search.value = '';\n    syncControls();\n    apply();\n    window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/internships.html');\n  }\n\n  function syncControls() {\n    document.querySelectorAll('[data-facet]').forEach((input) => {\n      const arr = state[input.dataset.facet];\n      input.checked = arr.includes(input.value);\n    });\n    document.querySelectorAll('[data-chip]').forEach((chip) => {\n      const arr = state[chip.dataset.chip];\n      chip.classList.toggle('is-active', arr.includes(chip.value));\n    });\n    const vSide = document.getElementById('verifiedOnlySide');\n    const vDrawer = document.getElementById('verifiedOnlyDrawer');\n    if (vSide) vSide.checked = state.verifiedOnly;\n    if (vDrawer) vDrawer.checked = state.verifiedOnly;\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- Events ---------- */\n\n  if (els.search) {\n    let t;\n    els.search.addEventListener('input', () => {\n      clearTimeout(t);\n      t = setTimeout(() => {\n        state.q = els.search.value.trim();\n        apply();\n      }, 250);\n    });\n  }\n\n  if (els.sort) {\n    els.sort.addEventListener('change', () => {\n      state.sort = els.sort.value;\n      apply();\n    });\n  }\n\n  if (els.includeClosed) {\n    els.includeClosed.addEventListener('change', () => {\n      state.includeClosed = els.includeClosed.checked;\n      apply();\n    });\n  }\n\n  document.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n    const facetInput = e.target.closest('[data-facet]');\n    if (facetInput) {\n      const arr =   "content": "/* ============================================================\n   AUTH PAGES · sign in / register / reset\n   ============================================================ */\n\n(async () => {\n  await Auth.ready;\n\n  const form = document.querySelector('[data-auth-form]');\n  if (!form) return;\n\n  const kind = form.dataset.authForm; // signin | register | reset\n  const banner = document.getElementById('authBanner');\n  const submitBtn = form.querySelector('[type=\"submit\"]');\n\n  // Already signed in? Straight to their home.\n  if (Auth.profile && kind !== 'reset') {\n    window.location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath());\n    return;\n  }\n\n  function showBanner(type, html) {\n    banner.className = `banner banner-${type}`;\n    banner.innerHTML = html;\n    banner.classList.remove('hidden');\n  }\n\n  function setLoading(on) {\n    submitBtn.disabled = on;\n    submitBtn.classList.toggle('is-loading', on);\n  }\n\n  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    banner.classList.add('hidden');\n\n    const email = form.email ? form.email.value.trim() : '';\n    const password = form.password ? form.password.value : '';\n\n    if (kind === 'signin') {\n      if (!email || !password) return showBanner('error', 'Enter your email and password.');\n      setLoading(true);\n      const result = await Auth.signIn(email, password);\n      if (!result.ok) {\n        setLoading(false);\n        return showBanner('error', UI.esc(result.error));\n      }\n      submitBtn.textContent = 'Signed in';\n      window.location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath());\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (kind === 'register') {\n      const name = form.name.value.trim();\n      const confirm = form.confirm.value;\n      const terms = form.terms.checked;\n\n      if (!name) return showBanner('error', 'Please enter your full name.');\n      if (!email) return showBanner('error', 'Please enter your email address.');\n      if (password.length < 6) return showBanner('error', 'Password must be at least 6 characters.');\n      if (password !== confirm) return showBanner('error', 'Passwords do not match.');\n      if (!terms) return showBanner('error', 'Please accept the terms to continue.');\n\n      setLoading(true);\n      const result = await Auth.register(name, email, password);\n      if (!result.ok) {\n        setLoading(false);\n        return showBanner('error', UI.esc(result.error));\n      }\n      window.location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath());\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (kind === 'reset') {\n      if (!email) return showBanner('error', 'Enter the email you registered with.');\n      setLoading(true);\n      const result = await Auth.resetPassword(email);\n      setLoading(false);\n      if (result.ok) {\n        showBanner('success', `Reset link sent to <strong>${UI.esc(email)}</strong>. Check your inbox.`);\n        submitBtn.disabled = true;\n      } else {\n        showBanner('error', UI.esc(result.error));\n      }\n    }\n  });\n})();\n",

'Good morning' : hour < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening';\n  const firstName = (profile.displayName || 'there').split(/\\s+/)[0];\n  document.getElementById('greetTitle').textContent = `${greet}, ${firstName}`;\n  document.getElementById('greetDate').textContent = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {\n    weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric'\n  });\n\n  /* Notifications: generate deadline alerts, then load */\n  await Notifications.sync();\n  const notifications = await Notifications.load();\n  window.renderNotifications && window.renderNotifications(notifications);\n\n  /* Saved list */\n  const saved = await Saved.list();\n  const closing = saved\n    .filter((i) => {\n      const d = UI.daysUntil(i.deadline);\n      return d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= 14;\n    })\n    .sort((a, b) => a.deadline - b.deadline);\n\n  const closingEl = document.getElementById('closingSoon');\n  if (closing.length) {\n    closingEl.innerHTML = Rows.list(closing, { cta: true, daysPill: true });\n  } else {\n    closingEl.innerHTML = Rows.emptyState({\n      title: saved.length ? 'Nothing closing soon' : 'No saved internships yet',\n      message: saved.length\n        ? 'None of your saved internships have deadlines in the next two weeks.'\n        : 'Save internships you like and this space will track their deadlines for you.',\n      actionHref: '/internships.html',\n      actionLabel: 'Browse internships'\n    });\n  }\n\n  /* New this week */\n  let published = [];\n  try {\n    published = await Internships.published();\n  } catch (_) { /* handled below */ }\n\n  const weekAgo = Date.now() - 7 * 86400000;\n  const fresh = published.filter((i) => i.createdAt && i.createdAt.getTime() >= weekAgo).slice(0, 5);\n\n  const freshEl = document.getElementById('newThisWeek');\n  if (fresh.length) {\n    freshEl.innerHTML = Rows.list(fresh, { cta: true });\n  } else {\n    freshEl.innerHTML = Rows.emptyState({\n      title: 'Nothing new this week',\n      message: 'New verified opportunities will appear here as they are published.',\n      actionHref: '/internships.html',\n      actionLabel: 'See everything open'\n    });\n  }\n\n  UI.initReveals(document.querySelector('main'));\n\n  /* Saved count in header */\n  const savedCountEl = document.getElementById('savedCount');\n  if (savedCountEl) savedCountEl.textContent = `${saved.length} saved`;\n})();\n",

  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   NOTIFY UI · bell + panel (used on dashboard)\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst NotifyUI = (() => {\n  function render(items) {\n    const list = document.querySelector('[data-notif-list]');\n    if (!list) return;\n    if (!items.length) {\n      list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"notif-empty\">No notifications yet</div>';\n      return;\n    }\n    list.innerHTML = items.map((n) => `\n      <div class=\"notif-item ${n.read ? '' : 'is-unread'}\" data-notif=\"${UI.esc(n.id)}\" ${n.internshipId ? `data-goto=\"/internship.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(n.internshipId)}\"` : ''}>\n        <div class=\"notif-item-body\">\n          <div class=\"notif-item-title\">${UI.esc(n.title)}</div>\n          <div class=\"notif-item-msg\">${UI.esc(n.message)}</div>\n          <div class=\"notif-item-time\">${UI.esc(UI.timeAgo(n.createdAt))}</div>\n        </div>\n      </div>`).join('');\n  }\n\n  function updateBadge() {\n    const badge = document.querySelector('[data-notif-badge]');\n    if (!badge) return;\n    const n = Notifications.unreadCount();\n    badge.textContent = n > 9 ? '9+' : String(n);\n    badge.style.display = n ? '' : 'none';\n  }\n\n  async function init() {\n    const bell = document.querySelector('[data-bell]');\n    const panel = document.querySelector('[data-notif-panel]');\n    if (!bell || !panel) return;\n\n    render(Notifications.list);\n    updateBadge();\n\n    bell.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n      e.stopPropagation();\n      panel.classList.toggle('is-open');\n    });\n    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n      if (!panel.contains(e.target) && !bell.contains(e.target)) {\n        panel.classList.remove('is-open');\n      }\n    });\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {\n      if (e.key === 'Escape') panel.classList.remove('is-open');\n    });\n\n    const markAll = panel.querySelector('[data-mark-all]');\n    if (markAll) {\n      markAll.addEventListener('click', async () => {\n        await Notifications.markAllRead();\n        render(Notifications.list);\n        updateBadge();\n      });\n    }\n\n    panel.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n      const item = e.target.closest('[data-notif]');\n      if (!item) return;\n      Notifications.markRead(item.dataset.notif);\n      item.classList.remove('is-unread');\n      updateBadge();\n      if (item.dataset.goto) window.location.href = item.dataset.goto;\n    });\n  }\n\n  return { init, render, updateBadge };\n})();\n",

  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   ADMIN · INTERNSHIP MANAGER\n   ============================================================ */\n\n(async () => {\n  const profile = await Auth.requireAdmin();\n  if (!profile) return;\n\n  const tableBody = document.getElementById('tableBody');\n  const tableCard = document.getElementById('tableCard');\n  const searchInput = document.getElementById('adminSearch');\n  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]');\n\n  let all = [];\n  let tab = 'all';\n  let q = '';\n\n  async function load() {\n    tableCard.outerHTML; // noop keep\n    document.getElementById('tableWrap').innerHTML = UI.skeletonRows(4);\n    all = await Internships.all();\n    render();\n  }\n\n  function statusOf(item) {\n    if (!item.published) return 'draft';\n    const d = UI.daysUntil(item.deadline);\n    return d !== null && d < 0 ? 'closed' : 'live';\n  }\n\n  function visible() {\n    let rows = [...all];\n    if (tab === 'published') rows = rows.filter((i) => i.published);\n    if (tab === 'drafts') rows = rows.filter((i) => !i.published);\n    if (tab === 'closed') rows = rows.filter((i) => statusOf(i) === 'closed');\n    if (q) {\n      rows = rows.filter((i) =>\n        [i.title, i.company, i.category, i.city].filter(Boolean)\n          .some((f) => f.toLowerCase().includes(q)));\n    }\n    return rows;\n  }\n\n  function statusBadge(item) {\n    const s = statusOf(item);\n    if (s === 'live') return '<span class=\"badge badge-live\">Live</span>';\n    if (s === 'closed') return '<span class=\"badge badge-closed\">Closed</span>';\n    return '<span class=\"badge badge-draft\">Draft</span>';\n  }\n\n  function render() {\n    const rows = visible();\n\n    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach((t) => {\n      t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.tab === tab);\n      const count = t.querySelector('.tab-count');\n      if (count) {\n        const key = t.dataset.tab;\n        count.textContent = key === 'all' ? all.length\n          : key === 'published' ? all.filter((i) => i.published).length\n          : key === 'drafts' ? all.filter((i) => !i.published).length\n          : all.filter((i) => statusOf(i) === 'closed').length;\n      }\n    });\n\n    const wrap = document.getElementById('tableWrap');\n    if (!rows.length) {\n      wrap.innerHTML = `\n        <div class=\"state\">\n          <div class=\"state-icon\">${UI.icon('briefcase', 22)}</div>\n          <h3 class=\"state-title\">${all.length ? '<span class=\"badge badge-featured\" title=\"Featured\">★</span>' : ''}\n                  </div>\n                </td>\n                <td class=\"cell-muted\" style=\"white-space:nowrap\">${i.deadline ? UI.esc(UI.fmtDate(i.deadline)) : '—'}</td>\n                <td>\n                  <div class=\"row-actions\">\n                    <button type=\"button\" class=\"icon-btn\" data-act=\"verify\" title=\"${i.verified ? 'Remove verification' : 'Mark verified'}\" style=\"${i.verified ? 'color:var(--green-700)' : ''}\">${UI.icon('shield', 16)}</button>\n                    <button type=\"button\" class=\"icon-btn\" data-act=\"feature\" title=\"${i.featured ? 'Remove from featured' : 'Feature on landing'}\" style=\"${i.featured ? 'eye-off' : 'eye', 16)}</button>\n                    <a class=\"icon-btn\" title=\"Edit\" href=\"/admin/editor.html?id=${i.id}\">${UI.icon('pencil', 16)}</a>\n                    <button type=\"button\" class=\"icon-btn\" data-act=\"delete\" title=\"Delete\" style=\"color:var(--red-600)\">${UI.icon('trash', 16)}</button>\n                  </div>\n                </td>\n              </tr>`).join('')}\n          </tbody>\n        </table>\n      </div></div>`;\n\n    wrap.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]').forEach((tr) => {\n      tr.querySelectorAll('[data-act]').forEach((btn) => {\n        btn.addEventListener('click', () => handleAction(tr.dataset.id, btn.dataset.act));\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async function handleAction(id, act) {\n    const item = all.find((i) => i.id === id);\n    if (!item) return;\n\n    if (act === 'delete') {\n      const ok = await UI.confirm({\n        title: 'Delete this internship?',\n        message: `“${item.title}” at ${item.company} will be permanently removed.`,\n        confirmLabel: 'Delete',\n        danger: true\n      });\n      if (!ok) return;\n      const result = await Internships.remove(id);\n      if (result.ok) { UI.toast('Internship deleted'); load(); }\n      else UI.toast(result.error || 'Delete failed', 'error');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const updates =\n      act === 'publish' ?   "content": "/* ============================================================\n   ADMIN · SUGGESTIONS QUEUE\n   ============================================================ */\n\n(async () => {\n  const profile = await Auth.requireAdmin();\n  if (!profile) return;\n\n  const wrap = document.getElementById('suggestionsWrap');\n  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]');\n  let all = [];\n  let tab = 'pending';\n\n  async function load() {\n    wrap.innerHTML = UI.skeletonRows(3);\n    all = await Suggestions.list();\n    render();\n  }\n\n  function visible() {\n    if (tab === 'all') return all;\n    return all.filter((s) => s.status === tab);\n  }\n\n  function statusBadge(s) {\n    if (s.status === 'approved') return '<span class=\"badge badge-approved\">Approved</span>';\n    if (s.status === 'rejected') return '<span class=\"badge badge-rejected\">Rejected</span>';\n    return '<span class=\"badge badge-pending\">Pending</span>';\n  }\n\n  function render() {\n    tabs.forEach((t) => {\n      t.classList.toggle('is-active', t.dataset.tab === tab);\n      const count = t.querySelector('.tab-count');\n      if (count) {\n        count.textContent = t.dataset.tab === 'all'\n          ? all.length\n          : all.filter((s) => s.status === t.dataset.tab).length;\n      }\n    });\n\n    const rows = visible();\n    if (!rows.length) {\n      wrap.innerHTML = `\n        <div class=\"state\">\n          <div class=\"state-icon\">${UI.icon('inbox', 22)}</div>\n          <h3 class=\"state-title\">${all.length ? 'Nothing in this queue' : 'No suggestions yet'}</h3>\n          <p class=\"state-msg\">${all.length ? 'Switch tabs to see other submissions.' : 'When students submit opportunities, they appear here for review.'}</p>\n        </div>`;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    wrap.innerHTML = `\n      <div class=\"table-card\"><div class=\"table-scroll\">\n        <table class=\"data-table\">\n          <thead>\n            <tr><th>Suggestion</th><th>Details</th><th>Source</th><th>Status</th><th style=\"text-align:right\">Actions</th></tr>\n          </thead>\n          <tbody>\n            ${rows.map((s) => `\n              <tr data-id=\"${s.id}\">\n                <td>\n                  <div class=\"cell-strong\">${UI.esc(s.title || 'Untitled')}</div>\n                  <div class=\"cell-muted\" style=\"font-size:var(--fs-xs)\">${UI.esc(s.company || 'Unknown company')} · submitted ${UI.esc(UI.timeAgo(s.createdAt))}</div>\n                  ${s.notes ? `<div class=\"cell-muted\" style=\"font-size:var(--fs-xs);max-width:340px;margin-top:2px\">${UI.esc(s.notes)}</div>` : ''}\n                </td>\n                <td class=\"cell-muted\" style=\"white-space:nowrap\">\n                  ${UI.esc(s.city || '—')}${s.category ? ' · ' + UI.esc(s.category) : ''}${s.workMode ? '<br>' + UI.esc(s.workMode) : ''}\n                </td>\n                <td>\n                  ${UI.safeUrl(s.applicationUrl || s.sourceUrl)\n                    ? `<a class=\"section-link\" href=\"${UI.esc(UI.safeUrl(s.applicationUrl || s.sourceUrl))}\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">${UI.icon('external', 14)} Open</a>`\n                    : '<span class=\"cell-muted\">—</span>'}\n                </td>\n                <td>${statusBadge(s)}</td>\n                <td>\n                  <div class=\"row-actions\">\n                    ${s.status === 'pending' ? `\n                      <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-sm btn-primary\" data-act=\"convert\">Convert to draft</button>\n                      <button type=\"button\" class=\"icon-btn\" data-act=\"reject\" title=\"Reject\">${UI.icon('x', 16)}</button>\n                    ` : `\n                      <button type=\"button\" class=\"icon-btn\" data-act=\"reopen\" title=\"Move back to pending\">${UI.icon('clock', 16)}</button>\n                    `}\n                    <button type=\"button\" class=\"icon-btn\" data-act=\"delete\" title=\"Delete\" style=\"color:var(--red-600)\">${UI.icon('trash', 16)}</button>\n                  </div>\n                </td>\n              </tr>`).join('')}\n          </tbody>\n        </table>\n      </div></div>`;\n\n    wrap.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]').forEach((tr) => {\n      tr.querySelectorAll('[data-act]').forEach((btn) => {\n        btn.addEventListener('click', () => handle(tr.dataset.id, btn.dataset.act, btn));\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async function handle(id, act, btn) {\n    const item = all.find((s) => s.id === id);\n    if (!item) return;\n\n    if (act === 'convert') {\n      btn.disabled = true;\n      btn.classList.add('is-loading');\n      const result = await Suggestions.convert(id);\n      if (result.ok) {\n        UI.toast('Draft created — finish it in the editor');\n        setTimeout(() => { window.location.href = `/admin/editor.html?id=${result.id}`; }, 600);\n      } else {\n        btn.disabled = false;\n        btn.classList.remove('is-loading');\n        UI.toast(result.error || 'Conversion failed', 'error');\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (act === 'reject') {\n      const ok = await UI.confirm({\n        title: 'Reject this suggestion?',\n        message: 'The submitter won’t be notified. You can reopen it later from the Rejected tab.',\n        confirmLabel: 'Reject',\n        danger: true\n      });\n      if (!ok) return;\n      const result = await Suggestions.setStatus(id, 'rejected');\n      if (result.ok) { item.status = 'rejected'; render(); }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (act === 'reopen') {\n      const result = await Suggestions.setStatus(id, 'pending');\n      if (result.ok) { item.status = 'pending'; render(); }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (act === 'delete') {\n      const ok = await UI.confirm({\n        title: 'Delete this suggestion?',\n        message: 'This permanently removes the submission.',\n        confirmLabel: 'Delete',\n        danger: true\n      });\n      if (!ok) return;\n      const result = await Suggestions.remove(id);\n      if (result.ok) { UI.toast('Suggestion deleted'); load(); }\n    }\n  }\n\n  tabs.forEach((t) => t.addEventListener('click', () => { tab = t.dataset.tab; render(); }));\n  await load();\n})();\n",

{
  "content": "rules_version = '2';\nservice cloud.firestore {\n  match /databases/{database}/documents {\n\n    // Helper functions\n    function isAuthenticated() {\n      return request.auth != null;\n    }\n\n    function isAdmin() {\n      return isAuthenticated() && request.auth.token.admin == true;\n    }\n\n    function isOwner(userId) {\n      return isAuthenticated() && request.auth.uid == userId;\n    }\n\n    // Users collection\n    match /users/{userId} {\n      // Profiles are private: only the owner or an admin can read them.\n      allow read: if isOwner(userId) || isAdmin();\n\n      // Users can create their own document\n      allow create: if isAuthenticated() && request.auth.uid == userId;\n\n      // Users can update their own document\n      allow update: if isOwner(userId);\n\n      // Only admins can delete users\n      allow delete: if isAdmin();\n\n      // Saved internships subcollection\n      match /saved/{internshipId} {\n        allow read, write: if isOwner(userId);\n      }\n\n      // Notifications subcollection\n      match /notifications/{notificationId} {\n        allow read, write: if isOwner(userId);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Internships collection\n    match /internships/{internshipId} {\n      // Anyone can read published internships; admins can read everything\n      allow read: if resource.data.published == true || isAdmin();\n\n      // Only admins manage internships\n      allow create, update, delete: if isAdmin();\n    }\n\n    // Suggestions collection\n    match /suggestions/{suggestionId} {\n      // Anyone can create suggestions (even anonymous)\n      allow create: if true;\n\n      // Only admins can read / moderate suggestions\n      allow read, update, delete: if isAdmin();\n    }\n  }\n}\n",

{
  "content": "# InternHub\n\nVerified internship discovery for students in Cameroon. Static multi-page frontend on Firebase (Auth + Firestore).\n\n## Stack\n\n- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no framework\n- Firebase compat SDK v9 (CDN): email/password auth, Firestore, custom claims for admin\n- Design: ink + paper + deep green · Fraunces / Inter / JetBrains Mono\n\n## Run locally\n\n```bash\ncd \"internship system\"\npython -m http.server 8000\n# open http://localhost:8000\n```\n\nThe site must be served over HTTP (absolute paths + Firebase auth). Opening files directly via `file://` will not work.\n\n## Structure\n\n```\nindex.html            Landing — live inventory, city index\ninternships.html      Discovery — search, facets, sort, deep links (?city= ?category= ?q=)\ninternship.html       Detail — ?id=\nsuggest.html          Community submission form\nsignin/register/reset Auth (role-aware redirect; admins land in /admin/)\ndashboard.html        Student workspace — closing soon, new this week, notifications\nsaved.html            Bookmarked internships\n404.html              Not found\nadmin/                Admin console (custom-claim gated): overview, manager, editor, suggestions queue\njs/services/          Firebase services (auth, internships, saved, suggestions, notifications)\njs/lib/               UI kit, shell, rows renderer, notify widget\ncss/                  Tokens → base → shell → components → page styles\n```\n\n## Firebase\n\n- Config: `js/firebase-config.js` (project `interpro-6f20c`)\n- Rules: `firestore.rules` — deploy with `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules`\n- Indexes: `firestore.indexes.json`\n- Hosting: `firebase.json` → `firebase deploy --only hosting`\n\n### Granting admin access\n\nSet the `admin: true` custom claim with the Admin SDK (needs a service-account key,\nkept OUT of the repo):\n\n```bash\nnpm install firebase-admin\n# download serviceAccountKey.json from Firebase console → Settings → Service accounts\nnode tools/make-me-admin.js   # edit the email inside first\n```\n\nThen sign out and back in — the console link appears in the user menu.\n\n## Data model\n\n- `internships/{id}` — title, company, category, city, area, workMode, duration, stipend, deadline (Timestamp/Date), description, requirements, applicationUrl, email, phone, website, image, companyLogo, published, verified, featured\n- `suggestions/{id}` — community submissions, `status: pending|approved|rejected`\n- `users/{uid}` — profile · subcollections `saved/{internshipId}` and `notifications/{id}`\n\nDeadline notifications are generated client-side on dashboard load (deduped doc ids), so no Cloud Functions are required.\n",
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\USER\\Desktop\\internship system\\README.md"
}

Fixed, and you now have your folder. Here's exactly what happened and what's where:

**Why it "wasn't working" when you double-clicked:** the first build used server-style paths (`/css/...`). Double-clicking opens `file://...`, where `/css/...` points at your C: drive — so the HTML loaded but CSS/JS didn't. My mistake; it should have been double-click-safe from the start.

**What I did:**
1. Created **`Desktop\internship universe`** — the full product, with every path converted to relative, so it works **both** ways: double-click `index.html` directly, *or* serve it over HTTP.
2. Verified it in a real browser from `file://`: styles, fonts, navigation, Firebase, empty states, admin gate — all render; zero console errors.
3. Fixed two bugs the rewrite exposed (a JS syntax error and a few leftover absolute links), then syntax-checked every file.
4. Synced the same portable build back into **`Desktop\internship system`**, so both folders are now identical and both work either way.

**How to run it:** just open `internship universe\index.html` by double-clicking. That's it. (One honest note: over `file://`, Firebase sign-in can take a couple of extra seconds to wake up the first time — browsing works immediately.)

And no, not too busy for this 🙂 — the "water" is accepted, the bug is fixed. Next step whenever you're ready: grant yourself admin (`tools/make-me-admin.js`) and add the first real listings — the whole site lights up from live data.

PART 1 — INTERNSHIP CARD VISUAL DIRECTION
==================================================

I want a visually premium, image-first internship card inspired by a modern visual listing card.

IMPORTANT:

Do NOT make a conventional generic job-board card.

Do NOT create:

- a plain white rectangle
- a small logo on the left
- random text stacked vertically
- five unnecessary pills
- a generic Tailwind/SaaS card
- excessive rounded UI elements

Instead, treat every internship opportunity as a visually designed object.

The card should have approximately the visual proportion and density of a premium vertical listing card.

The card should NOT be excessively tall.

It should feel compact enough that multiple opportunities can be browsed comfortably, while still giving the image enough visual importance.

Use the existing project layout intelligently, but establish a clear consistent card width.

For desktop, create a responsive grid where multiple internship cards can appear side-by-side.

The grid must adapt naturally to:

- large desktop
- laptop
- tablet
- mobile

Do not create horizontal scrolling.

Do not make the cards absurdly wide.

Do not make the cards excessively narrow.

Use professional visual judgment to determine the exact CSS dimensions and grid behavior after inspecting the actual rendered page.

==================================================
CARD COMPOSITION
==================================================

Each internship card should contain:

1. VISUAL IMAGE AREA

A meaningful image area near the top of the card.

The image may represent:

- the company
- the company's workplace
- the industry
- the type of work
- a relevant professional environment

Do NOT use random meaningless stock imagery.

The visual should help identify the internship opportunity.

The card should support a provided/uploaded image.

The image must fit reliably into its designated visual area.

Do not distort the image.

For uploaded internship images where the full image should remain visible, use object-fit: contain rather than aggressively zooming/cropping it.

Use an appropriate neutral background behind contained images when necessary.

Do not stretch images.

2. CONTROLLED IMAGE-TO-INFORMATION TRANSITION

The image and the information section should feel visually connected.

Use a sophisticated dark gradient or tonal transition where appropriate so that the visual area flows naturally into the information area.

Do not simply stack:

IMAGE BOX
+
WHITE TEXT BOX
+
BUTTON

The card should feel like one composition.

Do not blindly copy any reference image pixel-for-pixel.

Borrow the DESIGN PRINCIPLES:

- image-first presentation
- strong visual atmosphere
- controlled information density
- integrated image and content
- clear hierarchy
- compact premium proportions

3. INTERNSHIP TITLE

This is one of the most important pieces of information.

Examples:

- Software Engineering Intern
- Frontend Development Internship
- Computer Engineering Intern
- Data Science Internship

The title must have strong hierarchy without becoming oversized.

4. COMPANY NAME

Clearly identify the company.

5. FIELD / CATEGORY

Examples:

- Computer Engineering
- Software Engineering
- Technology
- Data Science
- Cybersecurity

6. LOCATION

Examples:

- Cameroon
- Remote
- Buea
- Douala
- Hybrid

7. OPTIONAL IMPORTANT METADATA

Only display metadata that actually helps the student make a decision.

Examples may include:

- Remote / On-site / Hybrid
- Internship duration
- Deadline

Do not turn every piece of information into a pill.

Use tags only where they genuinely improve scanning.

8. ORIGINAL OPPORTUNITY LINK

Every internship must support an external link.

Include a clear action such as:

View opportunity
Apply on company site
View internship →

When clicked, it should take the student to the original company/internship website.

The action must be clearly interactive.

Do not use a generic oversized button if a more elegant action works better with the card composition.

The external URL must be stored with the internship data.

9. SAVE INTERNSHIP

Students should be able to save/bookmark an internship.

Use a professional bookmark/save interaction.

Avoid a large generic "SAVE" button.

Use an icon or compact interaction with:

- default state
- hover state
- saved state
- accessible label
- keyboard accessibility

```css
.op-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(255px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--s-5);
}
@media (max-width: 560px) { .op-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } /* maybe minmax 210 */
.op-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ink-900);
  border: 1px solid rgba(250,249,246,0.08);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform var(--t-base) var(--ease), border-color, box-shadow;
}
.op-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(250,249,246,0.18); box-shadow: var(--shadow-3); }
.op-card-media {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 16/10;
  background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, var(--op-tint, rgba(20,130,84,0.18)), transparent 60%), var(--ink-950);
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.op-card-media img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  padding: 10%;
  transition: transform var(--t-slow) var(--ease);
}
.op-card:hover .op-card-media img { transform: scale(1.04); }
.op-card-media::after {  /* gradient transition */
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 55%, rgba(19,24,32,0.9) 92%, var(--ink-900) 100%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.op-card-save { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px; z-index: 2; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(11,15,20,0.55); color: rgba(250,249,246,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); display:grid; place-items:center; border: 1px solid rgba(250,249,246,0.14); }
.op-card-save:hover { color: white; background: rgba(11,15,20,0.75); }
.op-card-save.is-saved { color: var(--green-600)? on dark use #35d08e... use var(--green-600) #148254 — visible on dark, yes. }
.op-card-body { padding: 14px 16px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; flex: 1; }
.op-card-title { font-size: 1.0rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--paper); line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; min-height: 2.6em; }
.op-card-company { font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--ink-300); }
.op-card-divider { border-top: 1px solid rgba(250,249,246,0.1); }
.op-card-meta { display:flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--ink-400); }

Card renderer code (rows.js):

```js
const CATEGORY_TINTS = {
  'Software Engineering': 'rgba(20,130,84,0.20)',
  'Design': 'rgba(180,83,9,0.18)',
  'Marketing': 'rgba(207,204,194,0.14)',
  'Finance': 'rgba(91,102,115,0.22)',
  'Data Science': 'rgba(20,130,84,0.14)',
  'Business': 'rgba(207,204,194,0.12)',
};
function tintFor(category) { return CATEGORY_TINTS[category] || 'rgba(20,130,84,0.12)'; }

function card(item) {
  const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
  const saved = Saved.has(item.id);
  const external = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
  const media = item.image
    ? `<img src="${UI.esc(item.image)}" alt="${UI.esc(item.company || '')} internship" loading="lazy">`
    : `<div class="op-card-fallback"><span class="op-card-fallback-initial">${UI.esc((item.company || 'I').charAt(0))}</span><span class="op-card-fallback-cat">${UI.esc(item.category || 'Internship')}</span></div>`;
  return `
  <article class="op-card reveal" style="--op-tint:${tintFor(item.category)}">
    <div class="op-card-media">
      ${media}
      <button type="button" class="op-card-save ${saved ? 'is-saved' : ''}" data-save="${UI.esc(item.id)}" aria-label="${saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship'}" aria-pressed="${saved}">${UI.icon('bookmark', 16, saved)}</button>
      ${item.verified ? '<span class="op-card-verified">' + UI.icon('shield', 12) + ' Verified</span>' : ''}
    </div>
    <div class="op-card-body">
      <h3 class="op-card-title"><a href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
      <p class="op-card-company">${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.category ? ' · ' + UI.esc(item.category) : ''}</p>
      <div class="op-card-divider"></div>
      <div class="op-card-meta">
        <span>${UI.esc(item.city || 'Cameroon')}</span>
        <span>${UI.esc(item.workMode || '—')}</span>
        <span class="${dl.cls === 'is-urgent' ? 'is-urgent' : ''} ${dl.cls === 'is-closed' ? 'is-closed' : ''}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="op-card-foot">
        ${external
          ? `<a class="op-card-link" href="${external}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View opportunity ${UI.icon('external', 13)}</a>`
          : `<a class="op-card-link" href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">View details ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>`}
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>`;
}

function cardGrid(items) {
  if (!items.length) return '';
  return `<div class="op-grid">${items.map(card).join('')}</div>`;
}
```

  /* ---------- Opportunity cards (discovery / saved) ---------- */

  const TINTS = {
    'Software Engineering': 'rgba(20, 130, 84, 0.20)',
    'Design': 'rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.18)',
    'Marketing': 'rgba(207, 204, 194, 0.14)',
    'Finance': 'rgba(91, 102, 115, 0.24)',
    'Data Science': 'rgba(20, 130, 84, 0.13)',
    'Business': 'rgba(207, 204, 194, 0.12)'
  };

  function card(item) {
    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
    const saved = Saved.has(item.id);
    const external = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
    const media = item.image
      ? `<img src="${UI.esc(item.image)}" alt="${UI.esc(item.company || 'Company')} internship" loading="lazy">`
      : `<div class="op-card-fallback">
           <span class="op-card-fallback-initial">${UI.esc((item.company || 'I').charAt(0))}</span>
           <span class="op-card-fallback-cat">${UI.esc(item.category || 'Internship')}</span>
         </div>`;

    return `
      <article class="op-card reveal" style="--op-tint:${TINTS[item.category] || 'rgba(20, 130, 84, 0.12)'}">
        <div class="op-card-media">
          ${media}
          ${item.verified ? `<span class="op-card-verified">${UI.icon('shield', 11)} Verified</span>` : ''}
          <button type="button" class="op-card-save ${saved ? 'is-saved' : ''}" data-save="${UI.esc(item.id)}"
                  aria-label="${saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship'}" aria-pressed="${saved}">
            ${UI.icon('bookmark', 15, saved)}
          </button>
        </div>
        <div class="op-card-body">
          <h3 class="op-card-title">
            <a href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a>
          </h3>
          <p class="op-card-company">${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.category ? ' · ' + UI.esc(item.category) : ''}</p>
          <div class="op-card-divider"></div>
          <div class="op-card-meta">
            <span>${UI.esc(item.city || 'Cameroon')}</span>
            <span>${UI.esc(item.workMode || '')}</span>
            <span class="${dl.cls}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="op-card-foot">
            ${external
              ? `<a class="op-card-link" href="${external}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View opportunity ${UI.icon('external', 13)}</a>`
              : `<a class="op-card-link" href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">View details ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>`}
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>`;
  }

  function cardGrid(items) {
    if (!items.length) return '';
    return `<div class="op-grid">${items.map(card).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  return { jobRow, list, card, cardGrid, emptyState, errorState, initSaveHandling };
})();

  removeImage click → clear.

  compress(file): Promise<string> — via createObjectURL + Image; scale to maxDim 1280; canvas; toDataURL('image/jpeg', .82); if length > 950_000, retry with quality .6.

  submit:
    prevent default; return if submitting; validate required fields + url.
    submitting = true; button loading.
    const payload = {...};
    if (Auth.profile) {
      const res = await Internships.create({ ...payload, image: imageData, published: true, verified: false });
      if (res.ok) → success panel "is live" + link to internships page; return.
      // fall through to queue on denial
    }
    const sres = await Suggestions.submit({ ...payload, image: imageData });
    Success message varies depending on situation.
    Error banner.
    finally submitting=false.
})();

No horizontal scroll, no absurd widths. Comfortable at 20+ cards.\n      </Text>\n\n      <Divider />\n\n      <H2>2 · Discovery page</H2>\n      <Table\n        headers={['Element', 'Decision']}\n        rows={[\n          ['Search', 'Compact 38px field (max-width 360px), 250ms debounce, partial match across title + company + category + city, results re-render in place — no navigation.'],\n          ['New this week', 'Shared rule: published internships with createdAt within 7 days. Shown as its own labeled grid above the full results on discovery (dashboard already has one).'],\n          ['Filters / sort', 'Existing facets, sort, and mobile drawer preserved; results now render as cards.'],\n          ['Empty / loading', 'Skeleton cards while fetching; designed empty states for no-data and no-match.'],\n        ]}\n      />\n\n      <Divider />\n\n      <H2>3 · Suggest page &amp; image upload</H2>\n      <Table\n        headers={['Step', 'Behavior']}\n        rows={[\n          ['Fields', 'Title, company, field, city, work mode, original URL, image (optional), notes (optional). Nothing else.'],\n          ['Upload zone', 'Click opens file picker (image/*); preview uses object-fit: contain on neutral ink; remove button; client-side compress to ≤1280px JPEG ~0.8 so it fits Firestore.'],\n          ['Signed-in submit', 'Creates a real internship doc (published, unverified) → instantly searchable, saveable, eligible for New This Week.'],\n          ['Signed-out / denied', 'Falls back to the suggestions queue with a clear “review” message — never a silent failure.'],\n          ['Feedback', 'Loading state on the button, duplicate-submit lock, success panel with next steps, error banner otherwise.'],\n        ]}\n      />\n\n      <Divider />\n\n      <H2>4 · Data model &amp; rules</H2>\n      <Text tone=\"secondary\">\n        Existing internship schema is kept (title, company, category, city, workMode, duration, deadline,\n        applicationUrl, image, createdAt, published, verified, featured) plus createdBy on student posts.\n        No migration needed — normalize() already tolerates missing fields.\n      </Text>\n      <Code>{`match /internships/{internshipId} {\n  allow read: if resource.data.published == true || isAdmin();\n  allow create: if isAdmin()\n    || (isAuthenticated()\n        && request.resource.data.published == true\n        && request.resource.data.verified == false\n        && request.resource.data.title is string\n        && request.resource.data.company is string);\n  allow update, delete: if isAdmin();\n}`}</Code>\n      <Callout tone=\"warning\" title=\"One-time deploy required\">\n        The student-publish flow activates after `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules`.     const external = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
    const media = item.image
      ? `<img src="${UI.esc(item.image)}" alt="${UI.esc(item.company || 'Company')} internship" loading="lazy">`
      : `<div class="op-card-fallback">
           <span class="op-card-fallback-initial">${UI.esc((item.company || 'I').charAt(0))}</span>
           <span class="op-card-fallback-cat">${UI.esc(item.category || 'Internship')}</span>
         </div>`;

    return `
      <article class="op-card reveal" style="--op-tint:${TINTS[item.category] || 'rgba(20, 130, 84, 0.12)'}">
        <div class="op-card-media">
          ${media}
          ${item.verified ? `<span class="op-card-verified">${UI.icon('shield', 11)} Verified</span>` : ''}
          <button type="button" class="op-card-save ${saved ? 'is-saved' : ''}" data-save="${UI.esc(item.id)}"
                  aria-label="${saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship'}" aria-pressed="${saved}">
            ${UI.icon('bookmark', 15, saved)}
          </button>
        </div>
        <div class="op-card-body">
          <h3 class="op-card-title">
            <a href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a>
          </h3>
          <p class="op-card-company">${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.category ? ' · ' + UI.esc(item.category) : ''}</p>
          <div class="op-card-divider"></div>
          <div class="op-card-meta">
            <span>${UI.esc(item.city || 'Cameroon')}</span>
            <span>${UI.esc(item.workMode || '')}</span>
            <span class="${dl.cls}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="op-card-foot">
            ${external
              ? `<a class="op-card-link" href="${external}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View opportunity ${UI.icon('external', 13)}</a>`
              : `<a class="op-card-link" href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">View details ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>`}
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>`;
  }

  function cardGrid(items) {
    if (!items.length) return '';
    return `<div class="op-grid">${items.map(card).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  return { jobRow, list, card, cardGrid, emptyState, errorState, initSaveHandling };
})();
