## What was built

**Internship cards** — dark, image-first, single composition (adapted from your references, not copied): category-tinted media area with `object-fit: contain` images that melt into the body via gradient, verified chip, circular bookmark (default/hover/saved, keyboard-accessible), mono metadata line with amber deadline urgency, quiet green "View opportunity ↗" external link. Responsive `auto-fill minmax(255px)` grid → 4/3/2/1 columns, no horizontal scroll, comfortable at 20+.

**Discovery** — compact 360px search (partial match on title/company/field/city, in-place results), card-grid results, **New This Week** section (createdAt ≤ 7 days), card skeletons, existing facets/sort/drawer preserved. Saved page now uses the same cards.

**Suggest** — premium form with upload zone: file picker, contain-fit preview on neutral ink, remove button, client-side compression (≤1280px JPEG) so images fit Firestore. Signed-in submit publishes straight to discovery (published, unverified); guests and permission-denied posts fall back to the review queue with clear messaging. Loading lock, success/error banners, no silent failures.

## Verified for real

- Upload → preview (`object-fit: contain` confirmed in computed styles) → submit → success banner, on your live backend
- Card rendering, grid responsiveness, New This Week, verified chip, gradient melt — inspected in the rendered browser
- All JS passes `node --check`; both folders synced and double-click-safe

## The one thing that needs you

Your live project (`interpro-6f20c`) still has the old **admin-only-create** rule, so a student's instant-publish is denied and falls back to the review queue (gracefully). The CLI account here doesn't own that project, so I couldn't deploy the updated rules (I proved the full publish flow works by deploying them to a project I do own). To activate instant student publishing on your backend, run once from an account with owner access:

```
firebase deploy --only firestore:rules --project interpro-6f20c
```

Until then everything still works — submissions just go through review, which is also the safer default.

  /* ---------- City index: vertical looping carousel ---------- */
  const cityIndex = document.getElementById('cityIndex');
  if (cityIndex) {
    const counts = {};
    open.forEach((i) => {
      if (i.city) counts[i.city] = (counts[i.city] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const known = [...new Set([...CITIES, ...Object.keys(counts)])];
    known.sort((a, b) => (counts[b] || 0) - (counts[a] || 0));

    const row = (city, idx) => `
      <a class="city-row" href="${H('internships.html')}?city=${encodeURIComponent(city)}">
        <span class="city-index-num">${String(idx + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
        <span class="city-index-name">${UI.esc(city)}</span>
        <span class="city-index-count">${counts[city] || 0} open</span>
        ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 18)}
      </a>`;

    const rows = known.slice(0, 8).map(row).join('');
    cityIndex.innerHTML = `
      <div class="city-marquee" aria-label="Cities with openings">
        <div class="city-track">${rows}${rows}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
})();

        ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 18)}
      </a>`;

    const rows = known.slice(0, 8).map(row).join('');
    cityIndex.innerHTML = `
      <div class="city-marquee" aria-label="Cities with openings">
        <div class="city-track">${rows}${rows}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
})();

5	const Rows = (() => {

15

18	      UI.esc(item.company || '—'),
19	      item.city ? `<span class="mono-tag">${UI.esc(item.city)}</span>` : '',
20	      item.workMode ? UI.esc(item.workMode) : '',
21	      item.duration ? UI.esc(item.duration) : ''
22	    ].filter(Boolean);

24	  }
25	
26	  /**

29	  function jobRow(item, opts = {}) {

33	      ? `<span class="days-pill ${dl.days < 0 ? 'is-over' : ''}">${dl.days < 0 ? 'Closed' : dl.days === 0 ? 'Today' : dl.days + 'd left'}</span>`
34	      : '';
35	
36	    return `
37	      <article class="job-row reveal">
38	        <div class="job-row-main">
39	          <div class="job-row-title-line">
40	            <h3 class="job-row-title">
41	              <a href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a>
42	            </h3>
43	            ${badges(item)}
44	          </div>
45	          <p class="job-row-meta">${metaLine(item)}</p>
46	        </div>
47	        <div class="job-row-side">
48	          ${daysPill || `<span class="deadline ${dl.cls}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span>`}
49	          <button type="button" class="save-btn ${saved ? 'is-saved' : ''}" data-save="${UI.esc(item.id)}"
50	                  aria-label="${saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship'}" aria-pressed="${saved}">
51	            ${UI.icon('bookmark', 18, saved)}
52	          </button>
53	          ${opts.cta !== false ? `
54	            <a class="job-row-cta" href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">

56	            </a>` : ''}
57	        </div>
58	      </article>`;
59	  }
60	
61	  function list(items, opts = {}) {
62	    if (!items.length) return '';

64	  }
65	
66	  function emptyState({ title, message, actionHref, actionLabel }) {
67	    return `
68	      <div class="state">

70	        <h3 class="state-title">${UI.esc(title)}</h3>

72	        ${actionHref ? `<a class="btn btn-primary" href="${actionHref}">${UI.esc(actionLabel)}</a>` : ''}
73	      </div>`;
74	  }
75

77	    return `
78	      <div class="state">
79	        <div class="state-icon">${UI.icon('alert', 22)}</div>
80	        <h3 class="state-title">Couldn't load opportunities</h3>
81	        <p class="state-msg">There was a problem reaching the database. Check your connection and try again.</p>
82	        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="window.location.reload()">Retry</button>
83	      </div>`;
84	  }
85	
86	  /** Delegated save-toggle handling for a page. */
87	  function initSaveHandling() {
88	    document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
89	      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-save]');
90	      if (!btn) return;
91	      e.preventDefault();
92	
93	      if (!Auth.profile) {
94	        UI.toast('Sign in to save internships');
95	        const here = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;

98	        }, 900);
99	        return;

101	
102	      const id = btn.dataset.save;

105	      btn.disabled = false;

107	      if (!result.ok) {
108	        UI.toast('Could not update your saved list', 'error');

111

115	      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', savedNow ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship');
116	      btn.innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 18, savedNow);
117	      UI.toast(savedNow ? 'Saved to your list' : 'Removed from saved');
118	      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saved:changed'));
119	    });
120	  }

142	         </div>`;

146	        <div class="op-card-media">

149	          <button type="button" class="op-card-save ${saved ? 'is-saved' : ''}" data-save="${UI.esc(item.id)}"

151	            ${UI.icon('bookmark', 15, saved)}

168	              : `<a class="op-card-link" href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">View details ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>`}
169	          </div>
170	        </div>
171	      </article>`;
172	  }

# InternHub

Verified internship discovery for students in Cameroon. Static multi-page frontend on Firebase (Auth + Firestore).

## Stack

- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no framework
- Firebase compat SDK v9 (CDN): email/password auth, Firestore, custom claims for admin
- Design: ink + paper + deep green · Fraunces / Inter / JetBrains Mono

## Run locally

```bash
cd "internship system"
python -m http.server 8000
# open http://localhost:8000
```

The site must be served over HTTP (absolute paths + Firebase auth). Opening files directly via `file://` will not work.

## Structure

```
index.html            Landing — live inventory, city index
internships.html      Discovery — search, facets, sort, deep links (?city= ?category= ?q=)
internship.html       Detail — ?id=
suggest.html          Community submission form
signin/register/reset Auth (role-aware redirect; admins land in /admin/)
dashboard.html        Student workspace — closing soon, new this week, notifications
saved.html            Bookmarked internships
404.html              Not found
admin/                Admin console (custom-claim gated): overview, manager, editor, suggestions queue
js/services/          Firebase services (auth, internships, saved, suggestions, notifications)
js/lib/               UI kit, shell, rows renderer, notify widget
css/                  Tokens → base → shell → components → page styles
```

## Firebase

- Config: `js/firebase-config.js` (project `interpro-6f20c`)

  /* ---------- Facet model ---------- */

  function facetCounts() {
    const cats = {}, cities = {}, modes = {};
    let verified = 0;
    all.forEach((i) => {
      if (i.category) cats[i.category] = (cats[i.category] || 0) + 1;
      if (i.city) cities[i.city] = (cities[i.city] || 0) + 1;
      if (i.workMode) modes[i.workMode] = (modes[i.workMode] || 0) + 1;
      if (i.verified) verified += 1;
    });
    return { cats, cities, modes, verified, unverified: all.length - verified };
  }

  function facetGroup(title, type, entries, active) {
    if (!entries.length) return '';
    const inputs = entries.map(([value, count]) => `
...
        <div class="filter-group-title">${UI.esc(title)}</div>
        ${inputs}
      </div>`;
  }

  function trustGroup(counts) {
    const opt = (value, label, count) => `
      <label class="filter-option">
        <input type="checkbox" data-trust="${value}" ${state.trust.includes(value) ? 'checked' : ''}>
        <span>${label}</span>
        <span class="filter-count">${count}</span>
      </label>`;
    return `
      <div class="filter-group">
        <div class="filter-group-title">Trust</div>
        ${opt('verified', 'Verified', counts.verified)}
        ${opt('unverified', 'Unverified', counts.unverified)}
      </div>`;
  }

  function closedGroup() {
    return `
      <div class="filter-group">
        <div class="filter-group-title">Show</div>
        <label class="filter-option">
          <input type="checkbox" data-opt="closed" ${state.includeClosed ? 'checked' : ''}>
          <span>Include closed listings</span>
        </label>
      </div>`;
  }

  function chipGroup(title, type, entries, active) {
    if (!entries.length) return '';
    const chips = entries.map(([value]) => `
      <button type="button" class="chip ${active.includes(value) ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-chip="${type}" value="${UI.esc(value)}">${UI.esc(value)}</button>`).join('');
    return `
...
        <div class="filter-group-title">${UI.esc(title)}</div>
        <div class="chips">${chips}</div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function renderCategoryChips() {
    if (!els.catChips) return;
    const { cats } = facetCounts();
    const entries = Object.entries(cats).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    if (!entries.length) { els.catChips.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const allChip = `
      <button type="button" class="cat-chip ${state.categories.length ? '' : 'is-active'}" data-cat-all>
        All<span class="cat-chip-count">${all.length}</span>
      </button>`;
    const chips = entries.map(([value, count]) => `
      <button type="button" class="cat-chip ${state.categories.includes(value) ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-chip="categories" value="${UI.esc(value)}">
        ${UI.esc(value)}<span class="cat-chip-count">${count}</span>
      </button>`).join('');
    els.catChips.innerHTML = allChip + chips;
  }

  function renderFacets() {
    const counts = facetCounts();
    const catEntries = Object.entries(counts.cats).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    const cityEntries = Object.entries(counts.cities).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    const modeEntries = Object.entries(counts.modes).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);

    renderCategoryChips();

    const sideHtml = `
      ${trustGroup(counts)}
      ${facetGroup('City', 'cities', cityEntries, state.cities)}
      ${facetGroup('Work mode', 'modes', modeEntries, state.modes)}
      ${closedGroup()}`;

    if (els.sideFilters) els.sideFilters.innerHTML = sideHtml;

    if (els.drawerBody) {
      els.drawerBody.innerHTML = `
        ${trustGroup(counts)}
        ${chipGroup('Category', 'categories', catEntries.length ? catEntries : CATEGORY_FALLBACK.map((c) => [c, 0]), state.categories)}
        ${chipGroup('City', 'cities', cityEntries, state.cities)}
        ${chipGroup('Work mode', 'modes', modeEntries.length ? modeEntries : ['Remote', 'Hybrid', 'On-site'].map((m) => [m, 0]), state.modes)}
        ${closedGroup()}`;
    }
  }

1	# InternHub
2	
3	Verified internship discovery for students in Cameroon. Static multi-page frontend on Firebase (Auth + Firestore).

5	## Stack
6	
7	- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no framework

21	## Structure
22	
23	```
24	index.html            Landing — live inventory, city index
25	internships.html      Discovery — search, facets, sort, deep links (?city= ?category= ?q=)
26	internship.html       Detail — ?id=
27	suggest.html          Community submission form
28	signin/register/reset Auth (role-aware redirect; admins land in /admin/)
29	dashboard.html        Student workspace — closing soon, new this week, notifications
30	saved.html            Bookmarked internships
31	404.html              Not found
32	admin/                Admin console (custom-claim gated): overview, manager, editor, suggestions queue
33	js/services/          Firebase services (auth, internships, saved, suggestions, notifications)
34	js/lib/               UI kit, shell, rows renderer, notify widget
35	css/                  Tokens → base → shell → components → page styles
36	```

39	
40	- Config: `js/firebase-config.js` (project `interpro-6f20c`)
41	- Rules: `firestore.rules` — deploy with `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules`
42	- Indexes: `firestore.indexes.json`
43	- Hosting: `firebase.json` → `firebase deploy --only hosting`
44

46	
47	Set the `admin: true` custom claim with the Admin SDK (needs a service-account key,
48	kept OUT of the repo):
49	
50	```bash
51	npm install firebase-admin
52	# download serviceAccountKey.json from Firebase console → Settings → Service accounts
53	node tools/make-me-admin.js   # edit the email inside first
54	```
55	
56	Then sign out and back in — the console link appears in the user menu.
57	
58	## Data model
59	
60	- `internships/{id}` — title, company, category, city, area, workMode, duration, stipend, deadline (Timestamp/Date), description, requirements, applicationUrl, email, phone, website, image, companyLogo, published, verified, featured
61	- `suggestions/{id}` — community submissions, `status: pending|approved|rejected`
62	- `users/{uid}` — profile · subcollections `saved/{internshipId}` and `notifications/{id}`
63	
64	Deadline notifications are generated client-side on dashboard load (deduped doc ids), so no Cloud Functions are required.

css/                  Tokens → base → shell → components → page styles
tools/                One-off scripts (make-me-admin)

119	    });
120	  }
121	
122	  /* ---------- Opportunity cards (discovery / saved) ---------- */
123	
124	  const TINTS = {
125	    'Software Engineering': 'rgba(20, 130, 84, 0.20)',
126	    'Design': 'rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.18)',
127	    'Marketing': 'rgba(207, 204, 194, 0.14)',
128	    'Finance': 'rgba(91, 102, 115, 0.24)',
129	    'Data Science': 'rgba(20, 130, 84, 0.13)',
130	    'Business': 'rgba(207, 204, 194, 0.12)'
131	  };
132	
133	  function card(item) {
134	    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
135	    const saved = Saved.has(item.id);
136	    const external = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
137	    const media = item.image
138	      ? `<img src="${UI.esc(item.image)}" alt="${UI.esc(item.company || 'Company')} internship" loading="lazy">`
139	      : `<div class="op-card-fallback">
140	           <span class="op-card-fallback-initial">${UI.esc((item.company || 'I').charAt(0))}</span>
141	           <span class="op-card-fallback-cat">${UI.esc(item.category || 'Internship')}</span>
142	         </div>`;
143	
144	    return `
145	      <article class="op-card reveal" style="--op-tint:${TINTS[item.category] || 'rgba(20, 130, 84, 0.12)'}">
146	        <div class="op-card-media">
147	          ${media}
148	          ${item.verified ? `<span class="op-card-verified">${UI.icon('shield', 11)} Verified</span>` : ''}
149	          <button type="button" class="op-card-save ${saved ? 'is-saved' : ''}" data-save="${UI.esc(item.id)}"
150	                  aria-label="${saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship'}" aria-pressed="${saved}">
151	            ${UI.icon('bookmark', 15, saved)}
152	          </button>
153	        </div>
154	        <div class="op-card-body">
155	          <h3 class="op-card-title">
156	            <a href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a>
157	          </h3>
158	          <p class="op-card-company">${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.category ? ' · ' + UI.esc(item.category) : ''}</p>
159	          <div class="op-card-divider"></div>
160	          <div class="op-card-meta">
161	            <span>${UI.esc(item.city || 'Cameroon')}</span>
162	            <span>${UI.esc(item.workMode || '')}</span>
163	            <span class="${dl.cls}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span>
164	          </div>
165	          <div class="op-card-foot">
166	            ${external
167	              ? `<a class="op-card-link" href="${external}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View opportunity ${UI.icon('external', 13)}</a>`
168	              : `<a class="op-card-link" href="${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">View details ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>`}
169	          </div>
170	        </div>
171	      </article>`;
172	  }
173	
174	  function cardGrid(items) {
175	    if (!items.length) return '';
176	    return `<div class="op-grid">${items.map(card).join('')}</div>`;
177	  }
178	
179	  return { jobRow, list, card, cardGrid, emptyState, errorState, initSaveHandling };
180	})();

---
# InternHub

Verified internship discovery for students in Cameroon. Static multi-page frontend on Firebase (Auth + Firestore).

## Stack

- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no framework
- Firebase compat SDK v9 (CDN): email/password auth, Firestore, custom claims for admin
- Design: ink + paper + deep green · Fraunces / Inter / JetBrains Mono

## Run locally

```bash
cd "internship system"
python -m http.server 8000
# open http://localhost:8000
```

The site must be served over HTTP (absolute paths + Firebase auth). Opening files directly via `file://` will not work.

## Structure

```
index.html            Landing — live inventory, city index
internships.html      Discovery — search, facets, sort, deep links (?city= ?category= ?q=)
internship.html       Detail — ?id=
suggest.html          Community submission form
signin/register/reset Auth (role-aware redirect; admins land in /admin/)
dashboard.html        Student workspace — closing soon, new this week, notifications
saved.html            Bookmarked internships
404.html              Not found
admin/                Admin console (custom-claim gated): overview, manager, editor, suggestions queue
js/services/          Firebase services (auth, internships, saved, suggestions, notifications)
js/lib/               UI kit, shell, rows renderer, notify widget
css/                  Tokens → base → shell → components → page styles
```

## Firebase

- Config: `js/firebase-config.js` (project `interpro-6f20c`)

  /* ---------- Facet model ---------- */

  function facetCounts() {
    const cats = {}, cities = {}, modes = {};
    let verified = 0;
    all.forEach((i) => {
      if (i.category) cats[i.category] = (cats[i.category] || 0) + 1;
      if (i.city) cities[i.city] = (cities[i.city] || 0) + 1;
      if (i.workMode) modes[i.workMode] = (modes[i.workMode] || 0) + 1;
      if (i.verified) verified += 1;
    });
    return { cats, cities, modes, verified, unverified: all.length - verified };
  }

  function facetGroup(title, type, entries, active) {
    if (!entries.length) return '';
    const inputs = entries.map(([value, count]) => `
...
        <div class="filter-group-title">${UI.esc(title)}</div>
        ${inputs}
      </div>`;
  }

  function trustGroup(counts) {
    const opt = (value, label, count) => `
      <label class="filter-option">
        <input type="checkbox" data-trust="${value}" ${state.trust.includes(value) ? 'checked' : ''}>
        <span>${label}</span>
        <span class="filter-count">${count}</span>
      </label>`;
    return `
      <div class="filter-group">
        <div class="filter-group-title">Trust</div>
        ${opt('verified', 'Verified', counts.verified)}
        ${opt('unverified', 'Unverified', counts.unverified)}
      </div>`;
  }

  function closedGroup() {
    return `
      <div class="filter-group">
        <div class="filter-group-title">Show</div>
        <label class="filter-option">
          <input type="checkbox" data-opt="closed" ${state.includeClosed ? 'checked' : ''}>
          <span>Include closed listings</span>
        </label>
      </div>`;
  }

  function chipGroup(title, type, entries, active) {
    if (!entries.length) return '';
    const chips = entries.map(([value]) => `
      <button type="button" class="chip ${active.includes(value) ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-chip="${type}" value="${UI.esc(value)}">${UI.esc(value)}</button>`).join('');
    return `
...
        <div class="filter-group-title">${UI.esc(title)}</div>
        <div class="chips">${chips}</div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function renderCategoryChips() {
    if (!els.catChips) return;
    const { cats } = facetCounts();
    const entries = Object.entries(cats).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    if (!entries.length) { els.catChips.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const allChip = `
      <button type="button" class="cat-chip ${state.categories.length ? '' : 'is-active'}" data-cat-all>
        All<span class="cat-chip-count">${all.length}</span>
      </button>`;
    const chips = entries.map(([value, count]) => `
      <button type="button" class="cat-chip ${state.categories.includes(value) ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-chip="categories" value="${UI.esc(value)}">
        ${UI.esc(value)}<span class="cat-chip-count">${count}</span>
      </button>`).join('');
    els.catChips.innerHTML = allChip + chips;
  }

  function renderFacets() {
    const counts = facetCounts();
    const catEntries = Object.entries(counts.cats).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    const cityEntries = Object.entries(counts.cities).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    const modeEntries = Object.entries(counts.modes).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);

    renderCategoryChips();

    const sideHtml = `
      ${trustGroup(counts)}
      ${facetGroup('City', 'cities', cityEntries, state.cities)}
      ${facetGroup('Work mode', 'modes', modeEntries, state.modes)}
      ${closedGroup()}`;

    if (els.sideFilters) els.sideFilters.innerHTML = sideHtml;

    if (els.drawerBody) {
      els.drawerBody.innerHTML = `
        ${trustGroup(counts)}
        ${chipGroup('Category', 'categories', catEntries.length ? catEntries : CATEGORY_FALLBACK.map((c) => [c, 0]), state.categories)}
        ${chipGroup('City', 'cities', cityEntries, state.cities)}
        ${chipGroup('Work mode', 'modes', modeEntries.length ? modeEntries : ['Remote', 'Hybrid', 'On-site'].map((m) => [m, 0]), state.modes)}
        ${closedGroup()}`;
    }
  }

#### Thinking

The user wants a globally collapsible slide-out navigation sidebar across all student pages (Dashboard, Browse Internships, Saved, Suggest, and other authenticated student pages). Currently, these pages have a static `.admin-shell` with an `.admin-side` rail that's always visible (vertical on desktop, a narrow 92px rail on mobile).

Requirements:
- Collapsed/hidden by default.
- Toggle icon (menu) opens it.
- Slides in from the left smoothly; slides back when closed.
- When closed, main content expands to use available space.
- When open, layout adjusts smoothly without breaking/overlapping content.
- Same component/styling/animation/items/behavior everywhere — reusable shared component.
- Active item highlighted per current page.
- Polished, smooth, consistent.
- Verify on all pages.

Design decisions:
1. Where does the toggle go? A menu button. On student pages, the top nav (`.site-nav`) has brand + nav-links + actions + burger. The burger currently opens `.mobile-panel` (probably only shown on small screens). We need a toggle that works at all widths on student pages.

Approach: modify `js/lib/shell.js` to add global sidebar behavior. The sidebar markup currently exists inline in each page (dashboard.html, internships.html, saved.html, suggest.html each have `<div class="admin-shell"><aside class="admin-side">…4 links…`). To make it a reusable shared component, best approach: have shell.js inject the sidebar markup into a placeholder, or build it dynamically on pages that opt in via a data attribute (e.g., `<body data-student-nav="dashboard">`). This guarantees a single implementation.

Plan:
- In shell.js, add a `buildStudentSidebar()` that runs on DOMContentLoaded if `document.body.dataset.studentNav` exists. It will:
  - Create the sidebar aside + backdrop and inject at the start of `.admin-shell` (or create the shell wrapper if missing?). Pages currently have `<div class="admin-shell"><aside class="admin-side">…</aside><main class="admin-main">…`. To avoid duplicating markup across pages, replace the per-page aside with JS injection: pages keep `<div class="admin-shell" ...><main class="admin-main">…`, and shell.js injects the aside. But that means editing 4 HTML files to remove the aside markup and add the body data attribute + toggle button. That's fine — "reusable shared component" = single JS builder + single CSS.

  Actually a simpler and more robust approach: keep the HTML pages minimal:
  - Add `data-student-nav="dashboard|browse|saved|suggest"` to each page's body.
  - shell.js builds the aside (with links + active state from the data attribute) and inserts it as the first child of `.admin-shell`.
  - Toggle button: add to the site-nav? The nav is shared via shell.js's `hydrateNavActions` etc. The nav markup is inline per page (`.site-nav` header with brand, nav-links, nav-actions, burger). We can have shell.js inject a sidebar toggle button into `.site-nav-inner` before the brand on student pages (a `.side-toggle` button with a hamburger icon).

- Behavior:
  - Desktop (width > 900px): sidebar collapsed by default; when open, occupies a 232px column and main content shifts (grid-template-columns transition). Smoothly: animate grid columns? Grid template columns can't be animated smoothly across all browsers… actually `grid-template-columns` is animatable in modern browsers if the track count is the same (Chrome supports grid track animation). Transitioning from `0fr`/`232px`? Transitioning between `0px` and `232px` works if the track count is the same: `grid-template-columns: 0px minmax(0,1fr)` ↔ `232px minmax(0,1fr)` — Chrome/Firefox can animate grid tracks (interpolating lengths). Safari? Since around 16? Risky but acceptable; fallback = no animation but still functional.

  Alternative smoother approach: sidebar as fixed/absolute overlay that slides in with transform, plus margin-left transition on main content when open on desktop. "When sidebar is open, layout should adjust smoothly without breaking or overlapping page content" — overlay would overlap content. They want layout adjustment (content shifts). So animate the grid track or margin.

  Simplest and most reliable: use flex layout: `.admin-shell { display:flex }`, sidebar width transitions 0→232px with overflow hidden, main flex:1. Width transitions animate smoothly everywhere. Sidebar inner content fixed width 232px so text doesn't reflow during animation (inner width fixed, aside overflow hidden).

  Current `.admin-shell` is grid `232px minmax(0,1fr)`. Change to flex? Other pages (admin/*) also use .admin-shell with .admin-side! Admin console pages have their own sidebar (admin links). The user said "authenticated student pages" — Dashboard, Browse, Saved, Suggest. Admin pages keep existing behavior. So we must not break the admin pages. Scope the new behavior: only when body has `data-student-nav`. CSS: `body[data-student-nav] .admin-shell { display:flex }` etc. Admin pages unchanged.

  Mobile (≤900px): currently a 92px rail. New requirement: collapsed by default everywhere, toggle opens slide-in. On mobile, sidebar should be off-canvas fixed overlay sliding from left (standard). Main content full width. This satisfies "main content expands".

  So:
  - Desktop: in-flow flex sidebar, width 0↔232, transition width .3s ease; inner content width 232 fixed.
  - Mobile: fixed off-canvas translateX(-100%)↔0 with backdrop; main always full width.

- State persistence: localStorage `ih-sidebar-open` = '1'/'0'? "Collapsed/hidden by default" — default collapsed; but remembering user's choice is polished. The requirement says collapsed by default. Persisting means after first open, next visit starts open — violates "default collapsed"? Default refers to initial state. Persist preference but default collapsed if no saved preference. Hmm, risk: user tests and sees it open due to persistence and thinks default is open. Safer: don't persist; always start collapsed. Requirement is explicit: "sidebar should be collapsed/hidden by default". Don't persist. Keep it simple.

- Toggle button placement: in top nav, left of brand? Or floating? Place at leftmost of nav bar: `[menu icon]` button `.side-toggle`, only visible on pages with data-student-nav. On mobile, the nav already has a burger on the right for the site menu; the left toggle is distinct.

  Also, when sidebar is open, include a close affordance: clicking backdrop (mobile) closes; on desktop, toggle button icon morphs to X or left-arrow; clicking again closes. Also Escape closes (mobile).

- Active item highlight: from body[data-student-nav] value matching link key.

- Nav items: Dashboard, Browse internships, Saved, Suggest internship — same as current aside, with icons. Keep "My space" label too.

**Additions to shell.js** (inside Shell IIFE, called from init):

```js
/* ---------- Collapsible student sidebar (shared) ---------- */

const STUDENT_NAV = [
  { key: 'dashboard', href: 'dashboard.html', label: 'Dashboard', icon: 'home' },
  { key: 'browse', href: 'internships.html', label: 'Browse internships', icon: 'search' },
  { key: 'saved', href: 'saved.html', label: 'Saved', icon: 'bookmark' },
  { key: 'suggest', href: 'suggest.html', label: 'Suggest internship', icon: 'send' }
];

function setupStudentSidebar() {
  const active = document.body.dataset.studentNav;
  if (!active) return;
  const shell = document.querySelector('.admin-shell');
  const navInner = document.querySelector('.site-nav-inner');
  if (!shell || !navInner) return;

  const aside = document.createElement('aside');
  aside.className = 'admin-side student-side';
  aside.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Student navigation');
  aside.innerHTML = `
    <div class="student-side-inner">
      <div class="admin-side-label">My space</div>
      ${STUDENT_NAV.map((item) => `
        <a class="admin-link ${item.key === active ? 'is-active' : ''}" href="${H(item.href)}"
           ${item.key === active ? 'aria-current="page"' : ''}>
          ${UI.icon(item.icon, 17)}
          ${item.label}
        </a>`).join('')}
    </div>`;
  shell.prepend(aside);

  const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
  backdrop.className = 'side-backdrop';
  document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

  const toggle = document.createElement('button');
  toggle.type = 'button';
  toggle.className = 'side-toggle';
  toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open navigation menu');
  toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  navInner.prepend(toggle);

  const mqMobile = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)');

  function setOpen(open) {
    document.body.classList.toggle('side-open', open);
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close navigation menu' : 'Open navigation menu');
    toggle.innerHTML = UI.icon(open ? 'x' : 'menu', 20);
    if (mqMobile.matches) document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
  }

  setOpen(false);
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(!document.body.classList.contains('side-open')));
  backdrop.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false));
  aside.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((a) => a.addEventListener('click', () => { if (mqMobile.matches) setOpen(false); }));
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false); });
  mqMobile.addEventListener('change', () => setOpen(false));
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   COLLAPSIBLE STUDENT SIDEBAR (shared component, shell.js)
   ============================================================ */

.side-toggle {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  flex: none;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--ink-700);
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-right: var(--s-3);
  transition: color var(--t-fast) var(--ease), border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease), background var(--t-fast) var(--ease);
}

.side-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--ink-900); color: var(--ink-950); }

body[data-student-nav] .admin-shell {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
}

body[data-student-nav] .admin-side {
  flex: none;
  width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-right: 0 solid var(--line);
  padding: 0;
  transition: width var(--t-base) var(--ease), border-color var(--t-base) var(--ease);
}

body[data-student-nav].side-open .admin-side {
  width: 232px;
  border-right-width: 1px;
}

.student-side-inner {
  width: 232px;
  padding: var(--s-6) var(--s-4);
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--nav-h);
}

.side-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: var(--nav-h) 0 0 0;
  z-index: calc(var(--z-drawer) - 2);
  background: rgba(11, 15, 20, 0.44);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity var(--t-base) var(--ease);
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  body[data-student-nav] .admin-side {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(--nav-h);
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    z-index: calc(var(--z-drawer) - 1);
    width: 264px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
    transform: translateX(-102%);
    transition: transform var(--t-base) var(--ease-out);
  }
  body[data-student-nav].side-open .admin-side { transform: none; }
  body[data-student-nav].side-open .side-backdrop { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
  .student-side-inner { width: auto; position: static; }
}
```

Layout convention: topbar + collapsible left sidebar (`.sidebar`; `.asb` in admin) + toast + modal; landing is a scroll narrative with a "Career Journey" progress widget (`:434-446`).

## Nav consistency — differs per page
Sidebar sets: `dasboard.html:295-330` = Dashboard/Browse/Saved(badge)/Suggest + DISCOVER field counts + PROFILE STRENGTH card, **no What's New**; `browse:421-438` same minus counts, adds "How InternHub works"; `what's_new:306-326` inserts What's New w/ badge; `suggest:275-292` has no What's New; `account(profile):215-263` is the outlier — label "Navigation", different order, `.sb-tooltip`, `.sb-account` user block, 260/76px tokens, 3-link top-nav (others 2), and is the only page with a hard-coded badge count (`:230` "12", `:239` "3"). Bell menu exists only on `dasboard:268-276`, `browse:401-407`, `account:211`; absent from what's_new/suggest.

## Per-page structure
- **dashboard**: greeting hero, SAVED stat + 70% strength bar (`:347`), field chips, search/sort, filters (mode/city/verified/include-closed), grid, empty state, suggest CTA, detail modal.
- **browse**: dark search zone + query suggestions, "New this week", category tiles, featured, grid/list + filter rail (city/mode/deadline/verified/new-only), closing-soon, cities, saved drawer, modal.
- **what's_new**: 48h-window intro, search, active chips, filter rail, buckets Just added/Added today/Yesterday.
- **suggest**: 5 numbered steps (opportunity, city+"other"+area, source/apply URLs, details+char count, cover image) + live preview column + history list.
- **account**: personal info (email disabled `:290`), preferences chips/mode, 4 notification switches, danger zone (change password / export "coming soon" `:407` / delete).
- **Spec-forbidden items present**: Saved nav entry + drawer on every student page; notification bell/menu; CV feature (`dasboard.html:327` `Add your CV to reach 100%`, stubbed at `:693`).

## Admin (brief)
dashboard (pending verification, activity, additions-vs-verifications chart), manage_internship (table+filters+delete), suggestion_verification (reject/compare/edit-before-verify modals), add_internship (7 collapsible sections, preview, dirty-state `beforeunload:753`), manage_users (suspend/reactivate/delete + user profile modal), analytics (5 hand-drawn SVG charts; `:325-335` documents `FirestoreAnalyticsSource` as a stub with `DevPlaceholderSource` badge). **`settings.html` is byte-identical to `manage_users.html`** (`diff -q` → IDENTICAL, h1 still "Manage Users") — no settings design exists. Sidebars are identical but stale: 13 "designed next/later" toasts in `dasboard.html`, 10 in `manage_internship.html` point at pages that already exist.

## Placeholders / fake data
`dasboard.html:347` "70% — Good" (static bar), `:272` "2 new this week", `:692-694,726` toasts ("Suggestion flow opens in the full build"), fake persona "track / Track Kumasi / +237 670 123 456 / track.kumasi@internhub.cm" (`account:270-295`), `account:407`, `admin/dasboard:497` "Signed out of Admin (demo)", closed listings `d:-1/-2`, `© 2026` footers. No lorem/TODO comments.

## Mapping → live, and gaps

| Template | Replaces / feeds | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| `landingpage.html` | `index.html` | Sign-in/Get-started `href="#"`; no auth handoff |
| `student_pages/dasboard.html` | `dashboard.html` | Missing What's New nav; saved not persisted |
| `browse_internship.html` | `internships.html` | Auth gate for browse absent |
| `what's_new.html` | **no live page** (new concept) | needs new route + `postedAt` data |
| `suggest_internship.html` | `suggest.html` | no upload/publish wiring |
| `account(profile).html` | **no live page** | prefs/notifications need Firestore doc |
| — | `saved.html` | template drops it as a page but keeps Saved nav (spec conflict) |
| — | `internship.html` | detail is only a modal in templates |
| — | `signin/register/reset/404.html` | not designed |
| `admin/dasboard.html` | `admin/index.html` | no claim-gating/admin-role UI |
| `manage_internship.html` | `admin/internships.html` | — |
| `add_internship.html` | `admin/editor.html` | image upload only a URL field |
| `suggestion_verification.html` | `admin/suggestions.html` | no "suggested-by" attribution/claim view |
| `manage_users.html` | **none live** | needs users collection |
| `analytics.html` | **none live** | all charts dev-placeholder |
| `settings.html` | **none** | duplicate file, must be rebuilt |

Absent from all templates: notification bell backed by `js/services/notifications.js`, `tools/make-me-admin.js` claim flow, real image upload, and any Firebase/Auth surface.

## Tech shape (all 13 files)
Standalone HTML, exactly one `<style>` + one `<script>` each. No external JS/CSS, no `.css`/`.js` files — only Google Fonts preconnect/`css2` links at lines 7–9 of every file. **Zero Firebase, zero `fetch`/XHR, zero `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`**: every record is a hardcoded JS array (`dasboard.html:468-483` 13 rows, `browse_internship.html:581-596` 14 rows, `what's_new.html:435-447` 12 rows) that drift between pages. Saved state is in-memory (`state.saved={}` vs `new Set()`).

**No relative links exist at all.** Only `href="#"` (31×) and landing fragments (`#discover #new #top #how #fields #cta #benefits`). Every nav item is a `<button data-toast="… prototype — separate file.">`; `dasboard.html` uses `data-nav="dashboard|browse|saved|suggest"` router stubs. Images: remote Unsplash URLs + inline-SVG data-URI fallbacks (`fbFor()` `landingpage.html:686`, `browse:610`) and `img:null` rows (`browse:587`).

## Design identity
Fonts everywhere: Fraunces (display), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (labels). Student palette: `--bg #f4f4f1`, `--ink #0d1b12`, `--green #0e6b3f`, `--green-deep #0a3d26`, `--mint #dcefe2`, `--amber #b45309`, `--r:14px`; `browse_internship.html` adds a dark band (`--dk #0c1410`). `landingpage.html` is off-identity: `#f1f2ec` bg, `--green #177a4c`, `--lime #bce23a`, `--pine #0d2b1d`. Admin is a separate dark theme (`--bg #0b110d`, `--acc #2fd57f`, `--coral #e0705c`). Layout convention: topbar + collapsible left sidebar (`.sidebar`; `.asb` in admin) + toast + modal; landing is a scroll narrative with a "Career Journey" progress widget (`:434-446`).

## Nav consistency — differs per page
Sidebar sets: `dasboard.html:295-330` = Dashboard/Browse/Saved(badge)/Suggest + DISCOVER field counts + PROFILE STRENGTH card, **no What's New**; `browse:421-438` same minus counts, adds "How InternHub works"; `what's_new:306-326` inserts What's New w/ badge; `suggest:275-292` has no What's New; `account(profile):215-263` is the outlier — label "Navigation", different order, `.sb-tooltip`, `.sb-account` user block, 260/76px tokens, 3-link top-nav (others 2), and is the only page with a hard-coded badge count (`:230` "12", `:239` "3"). Bell menu exists only on `dasboard:268-276`, `browse:401-407`, `account:211`; absent from what's_new/suggest.

## Per-page structure
- **dashboard**: greeting hero, SAVED stat + 70% strength bar (`:347`), field chips, search/sort, filters (mode/city/verified/include-closed), grid, empty state, suggest CTA, detail modal.
- **browse**: dark search zone + query suggestions, "New this week", category tiles, featured, grid/list + filter rail (city/mode/deadline/verified/new-only), closing-soon, cities, saved drawer, modal.
- **what's_new**: 48h-window intro, search, active chips, filter rail, buckets Just added/Added today/Yesterday.
- **suggest**: 5 numbered steps (opportunity, city+"other"+area, source/apply URLs, details+char count, cover image) + live preview column + history list.
- **account**: personal info (email disabled `:290`), preferences chips/mode, 4 notification switches, danger zone (change password / export "coming soon" `:407` / delete).
- **Spec-forbidden items present**: Saved nav entry + drawer on every student page; notification bell/menu; CV feature (`dasboard.html:327` `Add your CV to reach 100%`, stubbed at `:693`).

## Admin (brief)
dashboard (pending verification, activity, additions-vs-verifications chart), manage_internship (table+filters+delete), suggestion_verification (reject/compare/edit-before-verify modals), add_internship (7 collapsible sections, preview, dirty-state `beforeunload:753`), manage_users (suspend/reactivate/delete + user profile modal), analytics (5 hand-drawn SVG charts; `:325-335` documents `FirestoreAnalyticsSource` as a stub with `DevPlaceholderSource` badge). **`settings.html` is byte-identical to `manage_users.html`** (`diff -q` → IDENTICAL, h1 still "Manage Users") — no settings design exists. Sidebars are identical but stale: 13 "designed next/later" toasts in `dasboard.html`, 10 in `manage_internship.html` point at pages that already exist.

## Placeholders / fake data
`dasboard.html:347` "70% — Good" (static bar), `:272` "2 new this week", `:692-694,726` toasts ("Suggestion flow opens in the full build"), fake persona "track / Track Kumasi / +237 670 123 456 / track.kumasi@internhub.cm" (`account:270-295`), `account:407`, `admin/dasboard:497` "Signed out of Admin (demo)", closed listings `d:-1/-2`, `© 2026` footers. No lorem/TODO comments.

## Mapping → live, and gaps

| `student_pages/dasboard.html` | `dashboard.html` | Missing What's New nav; saved not persisted |
| `browse_internship.html` | `internships.html` | Auth gate for browse absent |
| `what's_new.html` | **no live page** (new concept) | needs new route + `postedAt` data |
| `suggest_internship.html` | `suggest.html` | no upload/publish wiring |
| `account(profile).html` | **no live page** | prefs/notifications need Firestore doc |
| — | `saved.html` | template drops it as a page but keeps Saved nav (spec conflict) |

| `manage_internship.html` | `admin/internships.html` | — |

INTERNHUB — ADMIN IMPLEMENTATION & INTEGRATION — PART 1 OF 2

IMPORTANT:

DO NOT START CODING IMMEDIATELY.

This prompt is PART 1 OF 2 of the complete Admin implementation specification.

Do not implement the Admin system in isolation.

The Admin system must connect to the same real Firebase backend and the same internship/user data used by the student application.

After reading both Admin parts and the Student prompt:

1. Inspect the entire current project.

2. Inspect all existing student and admin templates.

3. Inspect Firebase Authentication, Firestore, existing collections, rules, configuration, and reusable components.

4. Identify what should be retained, fixed, replaced, or connected.

5. Create a complete implementation checklist from all requirements.

6. Compare it against the Student prompt.

7. Only then begin implementation.

8. After implementation, test the complete system and verify every checklist item.

The objective is NOT to create an Admin prototype.

The objective is to turn the existing Admin designs into a real, secure, responsive, Firebase-connected Admin system controlling the same InternHub platform used by students.

==================================================

1. PROJECT RESET / WHAT TO RETAIN

==================================================

The old Admin implementation and fake/demo logic may be replaced where necessary.

Do NOT destroy useful existing infrastructure simply because the UI needs rebuilding.

Retain and correctly integrate where usable:

[ ] Existing Firebase configuration

[ ] Firebase Authentication

[ ] Firestore configuration

[ ] Existing Firestore rules that are still useful

[ ] Existing internship data structures where compatible

[ ] Existing student data structures where compatible

[ ] Useful Admin page templates

[ ] Useful internship templates

[ ] Useful assets

[ ] Useful reusable components

[ ] Existing functionality that does not conflict with this specification

The newer 23.8/Coder-generated designs should be treated as an important visual starting point where they are stronger.

Do NOT blindly rebuild visually good pages.

The objective is:

DESIGN POLISH

*

REAL FUNCTIONALITY

*

FIREBASE INTEGRATION

*

SECURITY

*

RESPONSIVENESS

*

PAGE CONNECTION

*

REAL DATA

*

FINAL QA

Do not preserve broken architecture merely because it already exists.

Do not destroy good designs unnecessarily.

==================================================

2. NO DEMO DATA

==================================================

This is a strict requirement.

Remove permanent demo/mock data from the Admin application.

Do NOT use:

[ ] Fake users

[ ] Fake internships

[ ] Fake suggestions

[ ] Fake statistics

[ ] Fake analytics

[ ] Fake activity

[ ] Fake verification counts

[ ] Fake notification counts

[ ] Fake percentages

[ ] Fake chart data

[ ] Hardcoded dashboard totals

If Firestore contains no records, Admin should naturally display real zero/empty states.

For example:

0 internships

0 verified internships

0 pending suggestions

0 students

0 views

0 saves

0 activity

Do not replace empty databases with fake numbers simply to make the dashboard look populated.

If development requires temporary seed data, keep it clearly separate and do not leave it as production data.

==================================================

3. FIREBASE + NETLIFY

==================================================

Hosting:

NETLIFY

Backend:

FIREBASE AUTHENTICATION

FIRESTORE

Do not introduce unnecessary alternative backend services.

Do NOT introduce Firebase Storage.

Images must use image URLs.

Existing valid Firebase configuration must be retained.

Do not replace working Firebase configuration with fake credentials.

If Firebase or Netlify information is missing:

DO NOT invent it.

Create the appropriate clearly marked configuration point or placeholder and continue implementing everything that does not depend on the missing value.

Do not hardcode secrets.

The final Admin application must work with the same Firebase project as the student application.

There must NOT be separate Admin and Student databases.

==================================================

4. ADMIN AUTHENTICATION AND AUTHORIZATION

==================================================

The Admin area is protected.

A normal student must NOT be able to access Admin functionality simply by manually entering an Admin URL.

Frontend route protection alone is NOT sufficient.

Do NOT rely on:

display:none

hidden navigation

frontend-only role checks

The system must use Firebase Authentication and appropriate Firestore security/authorization.

Admin identity/role must be tied to the actual authorized Admin account/configuration.

If the current project uses Firebase custom claims, preserve/use them where appropriate.

If an Admin email or role configuration is required and has not been provided:

leave a clearly marked configuration point.

Do not invent an Admin identity.

The Admin application must verify authentication before exposing protected data and operations.

==================================================

==================================================

Admin has a completely separate navigation system from students.

Admin navigation should include:

[ ] Dashboard

[ ] Manage Internships

[ ] Manage Users

[ ] Add Internship

[ ] Analytics

[ ] Settings

Do NOT add unnecessary duplicated navigation.

Do not overuse gradients, glows, giant pills, or excessive animation.

The Admin interface should look like a professionally engineered product, not a generic AI dashboard.

9. RESPONSIVENESS — CRITICAL

==================================================

Responsiveness is a major requirement.

Admin pages must work on:

[ ] Desktop

[ ] Laptop

[ ] Tablet

[ ] Android phones

[ ] Small mobile screens

Do NOT simply squeeze the desktop layout onto mobile.

The mobile version must be intentionally composed.

Desktop:

large composition

↓

Tablet:

compressed composition

↓

Mobile:

smaller, tighter, intelligently rearranged composition

On mobile:

[ ] Sidebar becomes drawer

[ ] Tables become responsive cards or usable horizontal layouts

[ ] Cards become compact

[ ] Typography reduces intelligently

[ ] Spacing compresses

[ ] Buttons fit the viewport

[ ] Search controls fit

[ ] Filters become mobile-friendly

[ ] Modals/side panels fit the screen

[ ] Forms stack correctly

[ ] Charts remain readable

[ ] No horizontal page overflow

[ ] No giant images

[ ] No giant empty spaces

[ ] Touch interactions work

Do not allow desktop tables or controls to destroy the mobile layout.

Do not assume responsive CSS works merely because media queries exist.

18. 48-HOUR WHAT'S NEW RULE
===========================

The New state must be timestamp-based.

An internship is considered new for approximately 48 hours after its appropriate creation/publication timestamp.

During the window:

[ ] Browse What's New

[ ] Dedicated What's New

[ ] Personalized Dashboard What's New

After the window:

[ ] Remove from What's New

[ ] Keep in Firestore

[ ] Keep in Browse

[ ] Keep searchable

[ ] Keep Details page

Do NOT manually remove internships after 48 hours.

Do NOT delete internships when the New period expires.
