52	.pill-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--dark);color:#e8ebe2;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 15px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}
53	.pill-tag::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
54	
55	/* ============ NAV — public landing only ============ */
56	.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;color:var(--ink);transition:background .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s,color .45s}
57	.nav-in{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(18px,3vw,30px);height:86px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:18px;transition:height .45s var(--ease)}
58	.nav.scrolled{background:rgba(9,30,20,.74);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.15);box-shadow:0 14px 44px -22px rgba(4,16,10,.65);color:#eaf5ec}
59	.nav.scrolled .nav-in{height:64px}
60	.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em;justify-self:start}
61	.brand .lg{width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--lime);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),background .45s,color .45s}
62	.brand .lg svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke-width:2.4}
63	.brand:hover .lg{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.05)}
64	.nav.scrolled .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
65	.nlinks{justify-self:center;display:flex;gap:2px}
66	.nl{position:relative;padding:9px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;opacity:.75;transition:opacity .25s}
67	.nl::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:4px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--lime);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
68	.nl:hover{opacity:1}
69	.nl:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
70	.nact{justify-self:end;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
71	.nsign{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;opacity:.8;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;transition:.25s}
72	.nsign:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--green)}
73	.nav.scrolled .nsign:hover{color:var(--lime)}
74	.ncta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 19px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s}
75	.ncta svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
76	.ncta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(110,150,20,.55)}
77	.ncta:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
78	.ncta:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.97)}
79	.menu-btn{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:11px;place-items:center;opacity:.85;transition:.25s}
80	.menu-btn:hover{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-1px)}
81	.menu-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
82	/* mobile panel */
83	.mmenu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:var(--pine2);color:#eaf5ec;transform:translateY(-102%);transition:transform .5s var(--ease);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:20px clamp(18px,5vw,30px) 26px;overflow-y:auto}
84	.mmenu::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(56% 34% at 82% -6%,rgba(188,226,58,.14),transparent 62%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 92px);pointer-events:none}
85	.mmenu.open{transform:none}
86	.mmenu>*{position:relative}
87	.mm-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px}
88	.mm-head .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
89	.mm-x{width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.25s}
90	.mm-x:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:rotate(90deg)}
91	.mm-x svg{width:17px;height:17px}
92	.mmenu nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:16px}
93	.mmenu nav a{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(28px,7vw,38px);font-weight:600;padding:16px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.1);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;transition:padding-left .3s var(--ease),color .2s}
94	.mmenu nav a span{font:600 11px var(--fm);color:#7ba389;letter-spacing:.18em}
95	.mmenu nav a:hover{padding-left:14px;color:var(--lime)}
96	.mm-cta{margin-top:auto;padding-top:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
97	.mm-note{margin-top:18px;text-align:center;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
98	
99	/* ============ HERO (unchanged) ============ */
100	.hero{position:relative;padding:158px 0 90px;overflow:clip}
101	.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.04fr .96fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,64px);align-items:center}
102	.hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,5.6vw,74px);margin:22px 0 20px}
103	.hero .sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(15px,1.4vw,17.5px);max-width:520px}
104	.searchbar{margin-top:30px;display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:16px;padding:7px;gap:6px;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s;max-width:560px}
105	.searchbar:focus-within{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(188,226,58,.28),var(--sh)}
106	.sb-q{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 14px;min-width:0}
107	.sb-q svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--dim);flex:none}
108	.sb-q input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:none;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink)}
109	.sb-q input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
110	.sb-div{width:1px;background:var(--line);margin:8px 0}
111	.sb-city{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 12px}
112	.sb-city svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--dim)}
113	.sb-city select{border:0;outline:0;background:none;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;appearance:none}
114	.sb-btn{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);border-radius:11px;padding:0 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
115	.sb-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
116	.sb-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
117	.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
118	.trust{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px;font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
119	.trust b{color:var(--green);font-weight:600}
120	.trust span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
121	.trust i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
122	.hero-vis{position:relative;height:560px}
123	.hv-glow{position:absolute;inset:8% 4%;background:radial-gradient(46% 40% at 60% 42%,rgba(188,226,58,.32),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40% 36% at 34% 66%,rgba(23,122,76,.22),transparent 70%);filter:blur(6px)}
124	.hv-main{position:absolute;left:8%;top:6%;width:74%;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);border:1px solid var(--line)}
125	.hv-main img{width:100%;height:420px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
126	.hv-main:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
127	.hv-main .pill-tag{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px}
128	.fcard{position:absolute;width:250px;will-change:transform}
129	.fcard .fc-in{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);animation:bob 7s ease-in-out infinite}
130	.fcard:nth-child(odd) .fc-in{animation-delay:-3s}
131	@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
132	.fc-top{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
133	.fc-av{width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--pine);color:var(--lime);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12px var(--fs)}
134	.fc-top b{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.25}
135	.fc-top span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
136	.fc-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
137	.fc-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut);font-style:normal}
138	.fc-meta i.v{background:rgba(23,122,76,.12);color:var(--green)}
139	.fc-meta i.d{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
140	.fc1{right:-2%;top:2%}
141	.fc2{left:-3%;bottom:20%}
142	.fc3{right:2%;bottom:-2%}
143	.hv-chip{position:absolute;left:16%;top:-2%;z-index:3}
144	
145	/* ============ TICKER ============ */
146	.ticker{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;padding:13px 0}
147	.tk-track{display:flex;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:tick 36s linear infinite}
148	.ticker:hover .tk-track{animation-play-state:paused}
149	@keyframes tick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
150	.tk-track span{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);padding:0 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}
151	.tk-track span::after{content:"·";color:var(--green);font-size:15px}
152	
153	/* ============ SECTIONS COMMON ============ */
154	.sec{padding:clamp(78px,9vw,124px) 0}
155	.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);flex-wrap:wrap}
156	.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin-top:14px;max-width:560px}
157	.sec-head p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:10px;max-width:520px}
158	.link-more{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s;padding-bottom:3px}
159	.link-more svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
160	.link-more:hover{border-color:var(--lime)}
161	.link-more:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
162	[data-rev]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .8s var(--ease)}
163	[data-rev="left"]{transform:translateX(-36px)}
164	[data-rev="right"]{transform:translateX(36px)}
165	[data-rev="scale"]{transform:scale(.93)}
166	[data-rev].in{opacity:1;transform:none}
167	
168	/* ============ DISCOVER GRID ============ */
169	.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(258px,1fr));gap:16px}
170	.icard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s}
171	.icard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh);border-color:var(--line2)}
172	.ic-media{position:relative;height:150px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pine)}
173	.ic-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}
174	.icard:hover .ic-media img{transform:scale(1.045)}
175	.ic-media .noimg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.6);font:700 26px var(--fs);background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--pine))}
176	.ic-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}
177	.bdg{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:4.5px 9px;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
178	.bdg.new{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
179	.bdg.ver{background:rgba(13,43,29,.72);color:#9fe8bd;border:1px solid rgba(159,232,189,.35)}
180	.save{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(251,252,248,.92);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:.2s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
181	.save svg{width:15px;height:15px}
182	.save:hover{transform:scale(1.1);color:var(--green)}
183	.save.on{background:var(--green-deep);color:var(--lime)}
184	.save.on svg{fill:currentColor}
185	.save.pop{animation:spop .35s var(--ease)}
186	@keyframes spop{40%{transform:scale(1.28)}}
187	.ic-body{padding:15px 16px 13px;flex:1}
188	.ic-body h3{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
189	.ic-co{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px}
190	.ic-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
191	.ic-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut)}
192	.ic-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
193	.ic-dead{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}
194	.ic-dead.warn{color:var(--amber)}
195	.ic-link{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
196	.ic-link svg{width:12px;height:12px}
197	.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:56px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:16px;color:var(--mut)}
198	.empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
199	
200	/* ============ HOW ============ */
201	.how{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
202	.how .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(36px,5vw,80px)}
203	.how-left{position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:start}
204	.how-left h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px);margin:14px 0 16px}
205	.how-left p{color:var(--mut);max-width:400px}
206	.steps{position:relative;padding-left:34px}
207	.rail{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:2px;background:var(--line2)}
208	.rail i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--green),var(--lime));transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}
209	.step{position:relative;padding:0 0 clamp(38px,4.5vw,58px)}
210	.step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-31px;top:7px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);border:2.5px solid var(--green);transition:background .4s,box-shadow .4s}
211	.step.in::before{background:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(188,226,58,.3)}
212	.step .num{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--green)}
213	.step h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 8px}
214	.step p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px;font-size:14.5px}
215	
216	/* ============ CONVERGE ============ */
217	.converge{overflow:clip}
218	.cv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
219	.cv-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);will-change:transform;border:1px solid var(--line)}
220	.cv-img img{width:100%;height:clamp(240px,30vw,380px);object-fit:cover}
221	.cv-mid{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,50px) 0 0}
222	.cv-mid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
223	.cv-mid p{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
224	
225	/* ============ PERSONAL ============ */
226	.personal{background:var(--pine);color:#eaf5ec;position:relative;overflow:clip}
227	.personal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 46% at 78% 18%,rgba(188,226,58,.12),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 96px)}
228	.personal .wrap{position:relative}
229	.personal .eyebrow{color:var(--lime)}
230	.p-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
231	.p-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin:14px 0 16px;color:#f4faf2}
232	.p-grid .ptxt p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:440px}
233	.pref-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
234	.pchip{border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#cfe3d4;transition:.2s var(--ease)}
235	.pchip:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-2px)}
236	.pchip.on{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
237	.rec-wrap{position:relative}
238	.rec-core{background:rgba(234,245,236,.06);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
239	.rec-core .av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px var(--fs);flex:none}
240	.rec-core b{font-size:14.5px}
241	.rec-core span{display:block;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fb59c;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
242	.rec-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
243	.recard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.05);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,background .3s;will-change:transform}
244	.recard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.5);background:rgba(234,245,236,.09)}
245	.recard .th{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green-deep)}
246	.recard .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
247	.recard b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
248	.recard span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8fb59c}
249	.recard .match{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--fm);color:var(--lime);flex:none}
250	
251	/* ============ FIELDS / LOCATIONS ============ */
252	.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);align-items:start}
253	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
254	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
255	.fchip svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}
256	.fchip em{font:600 10px var(--fm);font-style:normal;color:var(--dim)}
257	.fchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
258	.locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
259	.loc{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
260	.loc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
261	.loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
262	.loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
263	.loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,43,29,.05),rgba(13,43,29,.78))}
264	.loc div{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
265	.loc b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;color:#f4faf2;font-weight:600}
266	.loc span{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lime);text-transform:uppercase}
267	.loc.soon{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center}
268	.loc.soon::after{display:none}
269	.loc.soon b{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
270	.loc.soon span{color:var(--dim)}
271	.loc.soon div{position:static;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
272	
273	/* ============ CAROUSEL ============ */
274	.newsec{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:clip}
275	.car{position:relative;cursor:grab}
276	.car.drag{cursor:grabbing}
277	.car-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;will-change:transform;padding:6px 0 10px}
278	.car-track .icard{width:280px;flex:none;pointer-events:none}
279	.car-hint{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);gap:14px;align-items:center}
280	.car-hint i{width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
281	
282	/* ============ BENEFITS ============ */
283	.ben{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,4.5vw,70px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
284	.ben+.ben{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
285	.ben h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 12px}
286	.ben .bt p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}
287	.ben .bt ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
288	.ben .bt li{display:flex;gap:11px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
289	.ben .bt li svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--green);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
290	.bvis{position:relative;min-height:300px}
291	.stack{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:15px 17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
292	.bvis:hover .stack{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg)!important}
293	.stack b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
294	.stack span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
295	.stack .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
296	.stack .dl{font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
297	.stack .dl.ok{color:var(--green)}
298	.check-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:22px;max-width:420px;margin:auto}
299	.check-card h4{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:14px}
300	.ck{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
301	.ck .bx{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none;border-radius:7px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
302	.ck .bx svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:3}
303	.in .ck .bx{transform:scale(1)}
304	.ck:nth-child(3) .bx{transition-delay:.15s}.ck:nth-child(4) .bx{transition-delay:.3s}.ck:nth-child(5) .bx{transition-delay:.45s}
305	.ck b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
306	.ck span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
307	.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px}
308	.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
309	.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
310	.tcard .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(23,122,76,.1);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
311	.tcard .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
312	.tcard b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
313	.tcard p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px}
314	
315	/* ============ CTA ============ */
316	.cta-panel{position:relative;overflow:clip;background:var(--pine);border-radius:26px;color:#eaf5ec;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) clamp(26px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
317	.cta-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.16),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
318	.cta-panel>*{position:relative}
319	.cta-panel h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f4faf2;max-width:720px;margin:16px auto 18px}
320	.cta-panel p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 30px}
321	.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
322	.cta-note{margin-top:26px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389}
323	
324	/* ============ FOOTER — public landing only ============ */
325	footer{margin-top:clamp(70px,8vw,110px);background:var(--pine2);color:#a9c2b0;border-top:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);position:relative;overflow:clip}
326	footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(46% 34% at 12% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.09),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
327	.ft{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:38px;padding:clamp(54px,6vw,76px) 0 44px}
328	.ft .brand{color:#f4faf2}
329	.ft .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
330	.ft .fb p{font-size:13.5px;max-width:290px;margin-top:16px}
331	.ft .fb .fmono{margin-top:18px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
332	.ft .fb .fmono::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
333	.ft h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389;margin-bottom:18px}
334	.ft ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
335	.ft ul a{font-size:13.5px;color:#a9c2b0;transition:color .2s,padding-left .3s var(--ease)}
336	.ft ul a:hover{color:var(--lime);padding-left:6px}
337	.ft-bar{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.09);padding:22px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
338	.top-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.2);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a9c2b0;transition:.25s}
339	.top-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}
340	.top-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
341	.ft-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(88px,17.5vw,250px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.05);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(188,226,58,.12);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(6%)}
342	
343	/* ============ JOURNEY WIDGET ============ */
344	.journey{position:fixed;right:26px;top:96px;z-index:90;width:212px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px}
345	.journey h5{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7}
346	.jrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
347	.jrow b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em}
348	.jline{position:relative;height:74px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);margin:14px 0 12px 4px}
349	.jline i{position:absolute;left:0;width:2px;background:var(--green);height:0%}
350	.jline::before,.jline::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2)}
351	.jline::before{top:-4px}
352	.jline::after{bottom:-4px;background:var(--green)}
353	.jdot{position:absolute;left:-5px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);border:2.5px solid var(--green);top:0%}
354	.jstages{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
355	.jstages li{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
356	.jstages li::before{content:"–"}
357	.jstages li.on{color:var(--green)}
358	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:400;background:var(--dark);color:#eef1e8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
359	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
360	
361	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
362	@media (max-width:1240px){.journey{display:none}}
363	@media (max-width:1020px){
364	  .nlinks{display:none}
365	  .nsign{display:none}
366	  .menu-btn{display:grid}
367	  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
368	  .hero-vis{height:480px;max-width:560px}
369	  .how .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
370	  .how-left{position:static}
371	  .p-grid,.f-grid,.ben{grid-template-columns:1fr}
372	  .ben .bvis{order:2;min-height:320px}
373	}
374	@media (max-width:640px){
375	  .hero{padding-top:120px}
376	  .ncta{padding:9px 15px}
377	  .searchbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
378	  .sb-q{padding:12px 14px}
379	  .sb-div{width:auto;height:1px;margin:0 8px}
380	  .sb-city{padding:11px 14px}
381	  .sb-btn{padding:13px;justify-content:center}
382	  .hero-vis{height:430px}
383	  .fc2{display:none}
384	  .cv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
385	  .trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}
386	  .locs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
387	  .ft{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
388	}
389	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
390	  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
391	  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
392	  [data-rev]{opacity:1;transform:none}
393	  .car{overflow-x:auto}
394	  .car-track .icard{pointer-events:auto}
395	}
396	</style>

447	<!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
448	<section class="hero" id="top" data-stage="DISCOVER">
449	  <div class="wrap">
450	    <div>
451	      <span class="eyebrow">Cameroon's internship index</span>
452	      <h1 class="display">Find the right internship. <span class="hl">Without the search chaos.</span></h1>
453	      <p class="sub">InternHub gathers every open internship across Douala, Yaoundé, Buea and Bamenda — matched to your field, your city and your preferences, verified by our team, tracked to the deadline.</p>
454	      <form class="searchbar" id="searchForm">
455	        <div class="sb-q"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input id="q" placeholder="Internship, company or field…" autocomplete="off"></div>
456	        <div class="sb-div"></div>
457	        <div class="sb-city"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12S4 16 4 10a8 8 0 0 1 16 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg><select id="citySel"><option value="">All cities</option><option>Douala</option><option>Yaoundé</option><option>Buea</option><option>Remote</option></select></div>
458	        <button class="sb-btn" type="submit">Search<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
459	      </form>
460	      <div class="hero-ctas">
461	        <a class="btn btn-lime" href="#discover">View all positions<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
462	        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#cta">Suggest opportunity<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg></a>
463	      </div>
464	      <div class="trust" id="trustRow"></div>
465	    </div>
466	    <div class="hero-vis" id="heroVis">
467	      <div class="hv-glow" data-plx="0.05"></div>
468	      <span class="pill-tag hv-chip" data-float="10">Verified weekly</span>
469	      <div class="hv-main" data-float="6"><img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1522071820081-009f0129c71c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=60" alt="Students collaborating"><span class="pill-tag">Teams · Douala</span></div>
470	      <div class="fcard fc1" data-float="22"><div class="fc-in"><div class="fc-top"><span class="fc-av">AT</span><div><b>Software Engineering Intern</b><span>Afrimax Technologies</span></div></div><div class="fc-meta"><i class="v">Verified</i><i>Hybrid</i><i class="d">Closes in 5d</i></div></div></div>
471	      <div class="fcard fc2" data-float="16"><div class="fc-in"><div class="fc-top"><span class="fc-av">OC</span><div><b>Data Analyst Intern</b><span>Orange Cameroun</span></div></div><div class="fc-meta"><i class="v">Verified</i><i>Paid</i></div></div></div>
472	      <div class="fcard fc3" data-float="26"><div class="fc-in"><div class="fc-top"><span class="fc-av">SK</span><div><b>Graphic Design Intern</b><span>Studio Kalisté</span></div></div><div class="fc-meta"><i class="d">Closes in 3d</i><i>On-site</i></div></div></div>
473	    </div>
474	  </div>

479	<!-- ============ DISCOVER ============ -->
480	<section class="sec" id="discover" data-stage="EXPLORE">
481	  <div class="wrap">
482	    <div class="sec-head" data-rev>
483	      <div><span class="eyebrow">Live inventory</span><h2 class="display">Open right now, checked by humans</h2><p id="discCount"></p></div>
484	      <a class="link-more" href="#new">What's new this week<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
485	    </div>

487	  </div>

489	
490	<!-- ============ HOW ============ -->
491	<section class="sec how" id="how" data-stage="LEARN">
492	  <div class="wrap">
493	    <div class="how-left" data-rev="left">
494	      <span class="eyebrow">The workflow</span>
495	      <h2 class="display">Four steps between you and your first real role</h2>
496	      <p>No accounts required to browse. No fees, ever. Just a clear path from "what's out there?" to a submitted application.</p>
497	      <div style="margin-top:26px"><a class="btn btn-dark" href="#discover">Start discovering<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a></div>
498	    </div>
499	    <div class="steps" id="steps">
500	      <div class="rail"><i id="railFill"></i></div>
501	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">01</span><h3>Tell us what you're looking for</h3><p>Pick your field, your city and how you like to work. Thirty seconds — it shapes everything you see next.</p></div>
502	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">02</span><h3>Discover matching internships</h3><p>Every listing shows the deadline, the stipend when there is one, and whether our team has verified the company.</p></div>
503	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">03</span><h3>Save the ones worth chasing</h3><p>Bookmark opportunities and your dashboard tracks each deadline, warning you before anything closes.</p></div>
504	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">04</span><h3>Apply through the original source</h3><p>We hand you the company's own application link with every detail in place — you apply directly, nothing missing.</p></div>
505	    </div>
506	  </div>
507	</section>

514	      <div class="cv-img" id="cvR" data-rev="right"><img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1498050108023-c5249f4df085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=60" alt="Code on a screen"></div>
515	      <div class="cv-mid" data-rev><span class="eyebrow">One index</span><h2 class="display">Design desks and server rooms, <span class="hl">one scroll apart</span></h2><p>Fields that used to live on twelve different WhatsApp groups now live in one verified, searchable inventory.</p></div>

559	<!-- ============ BENEFITS ============ -->
560	<section class="sec" id="benefits" data-stage="GROW" style="padding-top:0">
561	  <div class="wrap">

732	(function(){
733	 const track=$("#carTrack"),wrap=$("#car");
734	 const base=L.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.nw-a.nw)).map(card).join("");
735	 track.innerHTML=base+base;
736	 if(reduced)return;
737	 let off=0,half=0,paused=false,drag=false,lx=0,vel=0,resumeT;
738	 const measure=()=>{half=track.scrollWidth/2;};
739	 measure();addEventListener("resize",measure);
740	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerenter",()=>paused=true);
741	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{paused=false;});
742	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{drag=true;paused=true;lx=e.clientX;wrap.classList.add("drag");wrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);});
743	 wrap.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{if(!drag)return;const dx=e.clientX-lx;lx=e.clientX;off-=dx;vel=-dx;});
744	 addEventListener("pointerup",()=>{drag=false;wrap.classList.remove("drag");resumeT=setTimeout(()=>paused=false,900);});
745	 wrap.addEventListener("wheel",e=>{if(Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY)){e.preventDefault();off+=e.deltaX;paused=true;clearTimeout(resumeT);resumeT=setTimeout(()=>paused=false,900);}},{passive:false});
746	 (function loop(){
747	  if(!paused&&!drag){vel*=.92;off+=.45+vel*.15;}
748	  if(half>0){off=((off%half)+half)%half;}
749	  track.style.transform=`translate3d(${-off}px,0,0)`;
750	  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
751	 })();
752	})();

754	const nav=$("#nav");

758	const jFill=$("#jFill"),jDot=$("#jDot"),jProg=$("#jProg"),jStageEl=$("#jStage");
759	const stageSecs=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-stage]")];

761	$("#heroVis").addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{const r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();mx=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5)*2;my=((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5)*2;});
762	$("#heroVis").addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{mx=0;my=0;});
763	let ticking=false;
764	function onScroll(){if(ticking)return;ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ticking=false;const y=scrollY,vh=innerHeight;
765	 nav.classList.toggle("scrolled",y>26);
766	 const max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-vh;const p=Math.min(1,y/max);
767	 jFill.style.height=(p*100)+"%";jDot.style.top=(p*100)+"%";jProg.textContent=Math.round(p*100)+"%";
768	 let cur="DISCOVER";stageSecs.forEach(s=>{if(s.getBoundingClientRect().top<vh*.5)cur=s.dataset.stage;});
769	 if(p>.96)cur="FUTURE";
770	 if(jStageEl.textContent!==cur){jStageEl.textContent=cur;document.querySelectorAll("#jStages li").forEach(li=>li.classList.toggle("on",li.dataset.s===cur));}
771	 if(!reduced){plx.forEach(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const c=(r.top+r.height/2-vh/2)*+el.dataset.plx;el.style.transform=`translateY(${c*-1}px)`;});

7	      return request.auth != null;

9

11	      return isAuthenticated() && request.auth.token.admin == true;

15	      return isAuthenticated() && request.auth.uid == userId;

22	
23	      // Users can create their own document
24	      allow create: if isAuthenticated() && request.auth.uid == userId;
25	
26	      // Users can update their own document

28	
29	      // Only admins can delete users
30	      allow delete: if isAdmin();

32	      // Saved internships subcollection

141	  function confirm({ title, message, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', danger = false }) {

152	          </div>
153	        </div>`;
154	      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

156

177	  function initReveals(root = document) {

179	    if (!items.length) return;
180	    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window) ||
181	        window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
182	      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-in'));

6	const Saved = (() => {
7	  let ids = new Set();
8	  let loaded = false;
9	
10	  function refOf(internshipId) {
11	    return firebaseDB
12	      .collection('users')
13	      .doc(Auth.profile.uid)
14	      .collection('saved')
15	      .doc(internshipId);
16	  }
17	
18	  return {
19	    get ids() { return ids; },
20	
21	    async load() {
22	      if (!Auth.profile) { ids = new Set(); return; }
23	      try {
24	        const snap = await firebaseDB
25	          .collection('users')
26	          .doc(Auth.profile.uid)
27	          .collection('saved')
28	          .get();
29	        ids = new Set(snap.docs.map((d) => d.id));
30	        loaded = true;
31	      } catch (err) {
32	        console.error('Saved.load failed:', err);
33	      }
34	    },
35	
36	    has(internshipId) {
37	      return ids.has(internshipId);
38	    },
39	
40	    /** Returns {ok, state:'saved'|'removed'} */
41	    async toggle(internshipId) {
42	      if (!Auth.profile) return { ok: false, error: 'signed-out' };
43	      try {
44	        if (ids.has(internshipId)) {
45	          await refOf(internshipId).delete();
46	          ids.delete(internshipId);
47	          return { ok: true, state: 'removed' };
48	        }
49	        await refOf(internshipId).set({
50	          internshipId,
51	          savedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
52	        });
53	        ids.add(internshipId);
54	        return { ok: true, state: 'saved' };
55	      } catch (err) {
56	        console.error('Saved.toggle failed:', err);
57	        return { ok: false, error: err.message };
58	      }
59	    },
60	
61	    /** Full internship objects for everything saved, newest-saved first. */
62	    async list() {
63	      if (!Auth.profile) return [];
64	      try {
65	        const snap = await firebaseDB
66	          .collection('users')
67	          .doc(Auth.profile.uid)
68	          .collection('saved')
69	          .orderBy('savedAt', 'desc')
70	          .get();
71	
72	        const entries = snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, savedAt: UI.toDate(d.data().savedAt) }));
73	        ids = new Set(entries.map((e) => e.id));
74	        if (!entries.length) return [];
75	
76	        const items = [];
77	        for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i += 10) {
78	          const chunk = entries.slice(i, i + 10);
79	          const docs = await firebaseDB.getAll(
80	            ...chunk.map((e) => firebaseDB.collection('internships').doc(e.id))
81	          );
82	          docs.forEach((doc, j) => {
83	            if (doc.exists) {
84	              const data = doc.data();
85	              items.push({
86	                id: doc.id,
87	                ...data,
88	                deadline: UI.toDate(data.deadline),
89	                createdAt: UI.toDate(data.createdAt),
90	                savedAt: chunk[j].savedAt
91	              });
92	            }
93	          });
94	        }
95	        return items;
96	      } catch (err) {
97	        console.error('Saved.list failed:', err);
98	        return [];
99	      }
100	    }
101	  };

57	    async load() {
58	      if (!Auth.profile) { cache = []; return cache; }
59	      try {
60	        const snap = await col().orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').limit(30).get();
61	        cache = snap.docs.map((doc) => ({
62	          id: doc.id,
63	          ...doc.data(),
64	          createdAt: UI.toDate(doc.data().createdAt)
65	        }));
66	      } catch (err) {
67	        console.error('Notifications.load failed:', err);
68	        cache = [];
69	      }
70	      return cache;
71	    },
72	
73	    async markAllRead() {
74	      if (!Auth.profile) return;
75	      try {
76	        const unread = cache.filter((n) => !n.read);
77	        if (!unread.length) return;
78	        const batch = firebaseDB.batch();
79	        unread.forEach((n) => batch.update(col().doc(n.id), { read: true }));
80	        await batch.commit();
81	        cache.forEach((n) => { n.read = true; });
82	      } catch (err) {
83	        console.error('Notifications.markAllRead failed:', err);
84	      }
85	    },
86	
87	    async markRead(id) {
88	      const item = cache.find((n) => n.id === id);
89	      if (!item || item.read) return;
90	      item.read = true;
91	      try {
92	        await col().doc(id).update({ read: true });
93	      } catch (_) { /* optimistic */ }
94	    }
95	  };
96	})();

55	/* ============ NAV — public landing only ============ */
56	.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;color:var(--ink);transition:background .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s,color .45s}
57	.nav-in{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(18px,3vw,30px);height:86px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:18px;transition:height .45s var(--ease)}
58	.nav.scrolled{background:rgba(9,30,20,.74);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.15);box-shadow:0 14px 44px -22px rgba(4,16,10,.65);color:#eaf5ec}
59	.nav.scrolled .nav-in{height:64px}
60	.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em;justify-self:start}
61	.brand .lg{width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--lime);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),background .45s,color .45s}
62	.brand .lg svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke-width:2.4}
63	.brand:hover .lg{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.05)}
64	.nav.scrolled .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
65	.nlinks{justify-self:center;display:flex;gap:2px}
66	.nl{position:relative;padding:9px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;opacity:.75;transition:opacity .25s}
67	.nl::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:4px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--lime);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
68	.nl:hover{opacity:1}
69	.nl:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
70	.nact{justify-self:end;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
71	.nsign{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;opacity:.8;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;transition:.25s}
72	.nsign:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--green)}
73	.nav.scrolled .nsign:hover{color:var(--lime)}
74	.ncta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 19px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s}
75	.ncta svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
76	.ncta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(110,150,20,.55)}
77	.ncta:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
78	.ncta:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.97)}
79	.menu-btn{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:11px;place-items:center;opacity:.85;transition:.25s}
80	.menu-btn:hover{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-1px)}
81	.menu-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
82	/* mobile panel */
83	.mmenu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:var(--pine2);color:#eaf5ec;transform:translateY(-102%);transition:transform .5s var(--ease);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:20px clamp(18px,5vw,30px) 26px;overflow-y:auto}
84	.mmenu::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(56% 34% at 82% -6%,rgba(188,226,58,.14),transparent 62%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 92px);pointer-events:none}
85	.mmenu.open{transform:none}
86	.mmenu>*{position:relative}
87	.mm-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px}
88	.mm-head .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
89	.mm-x{width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.25s}
90	.mm-x:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:rotate(90deg)}
91	.mm-x svg{width:17px;height:17px}
92	.mmenu nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:16px}
93	.mmenu nav a{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(28px,7vw,38px);font-weight:600;padding:16px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.1);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;transition:padding-left .3s var(--ease),color .2s}
94	.mmenu nav a span{font:600 11px var(--fm);color:#7ba389;letter-spacing:.18em}
95	.mmenu nav a:hover{padding-left:14px;color:var(--lime)}
96	.mm-cta{margin-top:auto;padding-top:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
97	.mm-note{margin-top:18px;text-align:center;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
98	
99	/* ============ HERO (unchanged) ============ */
100	.hero{position:relative;padding:158px 0 90px;overflow:clip}
101	.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.04fr .96fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,64px);align-items:center}
102	.hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,5.6vw,74px);margin:22px 0 20px}
103	.hero .sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(15px,1.4vw,17.5px);max-width:520px}
104	.searchbar{margin-top:30px;display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:16px;padding:7px;gap:6px;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s;max-width:560px}
105	.searchbar:focus-within{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(188,226,58,.28),var(--sh)}
106	.sb-q{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 14px;min-width:0}
107	.sb-q svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--dim);flex:none}
108	.sb-q input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:none;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink)}
109	.sb-q input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
110	.sb-div{width:1px;background:var(--line);margin:8px 0}
111	.sb-city{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 12px}
112	.sb-city svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--dim)}
113	.sb-city select{border:0;outline:0;background:none;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;appearance:none}
114	.sb-btn{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);border-radius:11px;padding:0 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
115	.sb-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
116	.sb-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
117	.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
118	.trust{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px;font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
119	.trust b{color:var(--green);font-weight:600}
120	.trust span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
121	.trust i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
122	.hero-vis{position:relative;height:560px}
123	.hv-glow{position:absolute;inset:8% 4%;background:radial-gradient(46% 40% at 60% 42%,rgba(188,226,58,.32),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40% 36% at 34% 66%,rgba(23,122,76,.22),transparent 70%);filter:blur(6px)}
124	.hv-main{position:absolute;left:8%;top:6%;width:74%;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);border:1px solid var(--line)}
125	.hv-main img{width:100%;height:420px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
126	.hv-main:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
127	.hv-main .pill-tag{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px}
128	.fcard{position:absolute;width:250px;will-change:transform}
129	.fcard .fc-in{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);animation:bob 7s ease-in-out infinite}
130	.fcard:nth-child(odd) .fc-in{animation-delay:-3s}
131	@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
132	.fc-top{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
133	.fc-av{width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--pine);color:var(--lime);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12px var(--fs)}
134	.fc-top b{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.25}
135	.fc-top span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
136	.fc-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
137	.fc-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut);font-style:normal}
138	.fc-meta i.v{background:rgba(23,122,76,.12);color:var(--green)}
139	.fc-meta i.d{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
140	.fc1{right:-2%;top:2%}
141	.fc2{left:-3%;bottom:20%}
142	.fc3{right:2%;bottom:-2%}
143	.hv-chip{position:absolute;left:16%;top:-2%;z-index:3}
144	
145	/* ============ TICKER ============ */
146	.ticker{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;padding:13px 0}
147	.tk-track{display:flex;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:tick 36s linear infinite}
148	.ticker:hover .tk-track{animation-play-state:paused}
149	@keyframes tick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
150	.tk-track span{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);padding:0 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}
151	.tk-track span::after{content:"·";color:var(--green);font-size:15px}
152	
153	/* ============ SECTIONS COMMON ============ */
154	.sec{padding:clamp(78px,9vw,124px) 0}
155	.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);flex-wrap:wrap}
156	.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin-top:14px;max-width:560px}
157	.sec-head p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:10px;max-width:520px}
158	.link-more{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s;padding-bottom:3px}
159	.link-more svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
160	.link-more:hover{border-color:var(--lime)}
161	.link-more:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
162	[data-rev]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .8s var(--ease)}
163	[data-rev="left"]{transform:translateX(-36px)}
164	[data-rev="right"]{transform:translateX(36px)}
165	[data-rev="scale"]{transform:scale(.93)}
166	[data-rev].in{opacity:1;transform:none}
167	
168	/* ============ DISCOVER GRID ============ */
169	.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(258px,1fr));gap:16px}
170	.icard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s}
171	.icard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh);border-color:var(--line2)}
172	.ic-media{position:relative;height:150px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pine)}
173	.ic-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}
174	.icard:hover .ic-media img{transform:scale(1.045)}
175	.ic-media .noimg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.6);font:700 26px var(--fs);background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--pine))}
176	.ic-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}
177	.bdg{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:4.5px 9px;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
178	.bdg.new{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
179	.bdg.ver{background:rgba(13,43,29,.72);color:#9fe8bd;border:1px solid rgba(159,232,189,.35)}
180	.save{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(251,252,248,.92);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:.2s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
181	.save svg{width:15px;height:15px}
182	.save:hover{transform:scale(1.1);color:var(--green)}
183	.save.on{background:var(--green-deep);color:var(--lime)}
184	.save.on svg{fill:currentColor}
185	.save.pop{animation:spop .35s var(--ease)}
186	@keyframes spop{40%{transform:scale(1.28)}}
187	.ic-body{padding:15px 16px 13px;flex:1}
188	.ic-body h3{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
189	.ic-co{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px}
190	.ic-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
191	.ic-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut)}
192	.ic-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
193	.ic-dead{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}
194	.ic-dead.warn{color:var(--amber)}
195	.ic-link{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
196	.ic-link svg{width:12px;height:12px}
197	.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:56px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:16px;color:var(--mut)}
198	.empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
199	
200	/* ============ HOW ============ */
201	.how{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
202	.how .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(36px,5vw,80px)}
203	.how-left{position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:start}
204	.how-left h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px);margin:14px 0 16px}
205	.how-left p{color:var(--mut);max-width:400px}
206	.steps{position:relative;padding-left:34px}
207	.rail{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:2px;background:var(--line2)}
208	.rail i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--green),var(--lime));transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}
209	.step{position:relative;padding:0 0 clamp(38px,4.5vw,58px)}
210	.step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-31px;top:7px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);border:2.5px solid var(--green);transition:background .4s,box-shadow .4s}
211	.step.in::before{background:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(188,226,58,.3)}
212	.step .num{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--green)}
213	.step h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 8px}
214	.step p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px;font-size:14.5px}
215	
216	/* ============ CONVERGE ============ */
217	.converge{overflow:clip}
218	.cv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
219	.cv-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);will-change:transform;border:1px solid var(--line)}
220	.cv-img img{width:100%;height:clamp(240px,30vw,380px);object-fit:cover}
221	.cv-mid{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,50px) 0 0}
222	.cv-mid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
223	.cv-mid p{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
224	
225	/* ============ PERSONAL ============ */
226	.personal{background:var(--pine);color:#eaf5ec;position:relative;overflow:clip}
227	.personal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 46% at 78% 18%,rgba(188,226,58,.12),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 96px)}
228	.personal .wrap{position:relative}
229	.personal .eyebrow{color:var(--lime)}
230	.p-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
231	.p-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin:14px 0 16px;color:#f4faf2}
232	.p-grid .ptxt p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:440px}
233	.pref-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
234	.pchip{border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#cfe3d4;transition:.2s var(--ease)}
235	.pchip:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-2px)}
236	.pchip.on{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
237	.rec-wrap{position:relative}
238	.rec-core{background:rgba(234,245,236,.06);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
239	.rec-core .av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px var(--fs);flex:none}
240	.rec-core b{font-size:14.5px}
241	.rec-core span{display:block;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fb59c;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
242	.rec-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
243	.recard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.05);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,background .3s;will-change:transform}
244	.recard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.5);background:rgba(234,245,236,.09)}
245	.recard .th{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green-deep)}
246	.recard .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
247	.recard b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
248	.recard span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8fb59c}
249	.recard .match{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--fm);color:var(--lime);flex:none}
250	
251	/* ============ FIELDS / LOCATIONS ============ */
252	.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);align-items:start}
253	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
254	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
255	.fchip svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}
256	.fchip em{font:600 10px var(--fm);font-style:normal;color:var(--dim)}
257	.fchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
258	.locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
259	.loc{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
260	.loc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
261	.loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
262	.loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
263	.loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,43,29,.05),rgba(13,43,29,.78))}
264	.loc div{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
265	.loc b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;color:#f4faf2;font-weight:600}
266	.loc span{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lime);text-transform:uppercase}
267	.loc.soon{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center}
268	.loc.soon::after{display:none}
269	.loc.soon b{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
270	.loc.soon span{color:var(--dim)}
271	.loc.soon div{position:static;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
272	
273	/* ============ CAROUSEL ============ */
274	.newsec{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:clip}
275	.car{position:relative;cursor:grab}
276	.car.drag{cursor:grabbing}
277	.car-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;will-change:transform;padding:6px 0 10px}
278	.car-track .icard{width:280px;flex:none;pointer-events:none}
279	.car-hint{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);gap:14px;align-items:center}
280	.car-hint i{width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
281	
282	/* ============ BENEFITS ============ */
283	.ben{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,4.5vw,70px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
284	.ben+.ben{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
285	.ben h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 12px}
286	.ben .bt p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}
287	.ben .bt ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
288	.ben .bt li{display:flex;gap:11px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
289	.ben .bt li svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--green);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
290	.bvis{position:relative;min-height:300px}
291	.stack{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:15px 17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
292	.bvis:hover .stack{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg)!important}
293	.stack b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
294	.stack span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
295	.stack .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
296	.stack .dl{font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
297	.stack .dl.ok{color:var(--green)}
298	.check-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:22px;max-width:420px;margin:auto}
299	.check-card h4{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:14px}
300	.ck{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
301	.ck .bx{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none;border-radius:7px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
302	.ck .bx svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:3}
303	.in .ck .bx{transform:scale(1)}
304	.ck:nth-child(3) .bx{transition-delay:.15s}.ck:nth-child(4) .bx{transition-delay:.3s}.ck:nth-child(5) .bx{transition-delay:.45s}
305	.ck b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
306	.ck span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
307	.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px}
308	.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
309	.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
310	.tcard .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(23,122,76,.1);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
311	.tcard .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
312	.tcard b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
313	.tcard p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px}
314	
315	/* ============ CTA ============ */
316	.cta-panel{position:relative;overflow:clip;background:var(--pine);border-radius:26px;color:#eaf5ec;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) clamp(26px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
317	.cta-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.16),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
318	.cta-panel>*{position:relative}
319	.cta-panel h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f4faf2;max-width:720px;margin:16px auto 18px}
320	.cta-panel p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 30px}
321	.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
322	.cta-note{margin-top:26px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389}
323	
324	/* ============ FOOTER — public landing only ============ */
325	footer{margin-top:clamp(70px,8vw,110px);background:var(--pine2);color:#a9c2b0;border-top:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);position:relative;overflow:clip}
326	footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(46% 34% at 12% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.09),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
327	.ft{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:38px;padding:clamp(54px,6vw,76px) 0 44px}
328	.ft .brand{color:#f4faf2}
329	.ft .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
330	.ft .fb p{font-size:13.5px;max-width:290px;margin-top:16px}
331	.ft .fb .fmono{margin-top:18px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
332	.ft .fb .fmono::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
333	.ft h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389;margin-bottom:18px}
334	.ft ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
335	.ft ul a{font-size:13.5px;color:#a9c2b0;transition:color .2s,padding-left .3s var(--ease)}
336	.ft ul a:hover{color:var(--lime);padding-left:6px}
337	.ft-bar{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.09);padding:22px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
338	.top-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.2);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a9c2b0;transition:.25s}
339	.top-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}
340	.top-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
341	.ft-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(88px,17.5vw,250px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.05);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(188,226,58,.12);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(6%)}
342	
343	/* ============ JOURNEY WIDGET ============ */
344	.journey{position:fixed;right:26px;top:96px;z-index:90;width:212px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px}
345	.journey h5{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7}
346	.jrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
347	.jrow b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em}
348	.jline{position:relative;height:74px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);margin:14px 0 12px 4px}
349	.jline i{position:absolute;left:0;width:2px;background:var(--green);height:0%}
350	.jline::before,.jline::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2)}
351	.jline::before{top:-4px}
352	.jline::after{bottom:-4px;background:var(--green)}
353	.jdot{position:absolute;left:-5px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);border:2.5px solid var(--green);top:0%}
354	.jstages{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
355	.jstages li{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
356	.jstages li::before{content:"–"}
357	.jstages li.on{color:var(--green)}
358	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:400;background:var(--dark);color:#eef1e8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
359	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
360	
361	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
362	@media (max-width:1240px){.journey{display:none}}
363	@media (max-width:1020px){
364	  .nlinks{display:none}
365	  .nsign{display:none}
366	  .menu-btn{display:grid}
367	  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
368	  .hero-vis{height:480px;max-width:560px}
369	  .how .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
370	  .how-left{position:static}
371	  .p-grid,.f-grid,.ben{grid-template-columns:1fr}
372	  .ben .bvis{order:2;min-height:320px}
373	}
374	@media (max-width:640px){
375	  .hero{padding-top:120px}
376	  .ncta{padding:9px 15px}
377	  .searchbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
378	  .sb-q{padding:12px 14px}
379	  .sb-div{width:auto;height:1px;margin:0 8px}
380	  .sb-city{padding:11px 14px}
381	  .sb-btn{padding:13px;justify-content:center}
382	  .hero-vis{height:430px}
383	  .fc2{display:none}
384	  .cv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
385	  .trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}
386	  .locs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
387	  .ft{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
388	}
389	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
390	  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
391	  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
392	  [data-rev]{opacity:1;transform:none}
393	  .car{overflow-x:auto}
394	  .car-track .icard{pointer-events:auto}
395	}
396	</style>

447	<!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
448	<section class="hero" id="top" data-stage="DISCOVER">
449	  <div class="wrap">
450	    <div>
451	      <span class="eyebrow">Cameroon's internship index</span>
452	      <h1 class="display">Find the right internship. <span class="hl">Without the search chaos.</span></h1>
453	      <p class="sub">InternHub gathers every open internship across Douala, Yaoundé, Buea and Bamenda — matched to your field, your city and your preferences, verified by our team, tracked to the deadline.</p>
454	      <form class="searchbar" id="searchForm">
455	        <div class="sb-q"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input id="q" placeholder="Internship, company or field…" autocomplete="off"></div>
456	        <div class="sb-div"></div>
457	        <div class="sb-city"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12S4 16 4 10a8 8 0 0 1 16 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg><select id="citySel"><option value="">All cities</option><option>Douala</option><option>Yaoundé</option><option>Buea</option><option>Remote</option></select></div>
458	        <button class="sb-btn" type="submit">Search<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
459	      </form>
460	      <div class="hero-ctas">
461	        <a class="btn btn-lime" href="#discover">View all positions<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
462	        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#cta">Suggest opportunity<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg></a>
463	      </div>
464	      <div class="trust" id="trustRow"></div>
465	    </div>
466	    <div class="hero-vis" id="heroVis">
467	      <div class="hv-glow" data-plx="0.05"></div>
468	      <span class="pill-tag hv-chip" data-float="10">Verified weekly</span>
469	      <div class="hv-main" data-float="6"><img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1522071820081-009f0129c71c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=60" alt="Students collaborating"><span class="pill-tag">Teams · Douala</span></div>
470	      <div class="fcard fc1" data-float="22"><div class="fc-in"><div class="fc-top"><span class="fc-av">AT</span><div><b>Software Engineering Intern</b><span>Afrimax Technologies</span></div></div><div class="fc-meta"><i class="v">Verified</i><i>Hybrid</i><i class="d">Closes in 5d</i></div></div></div>
471	      <div class="fcard fc2" data-float="16"><div class="fc-in"><div class="fc-top"><span class="fc-av">OC</span><div><b>Data Analyst Intern</b><span>Orange Cameroun</span></div></div><div class="fc-meta"><i class="v">Verified</i><i>Paid</i></div></div></div>
472	      <div class="fcard fc3" data-float="26"><div class="fc-in"><div class="fc-top"><span class="fc-av">SK</span><div><b>Graphic Design Intern</b><span>Studio Kalisté</span></div></div><div class="fc-meta"><i class="d">Closes in 3d</i><i>On-site</i></div></div></div>
473	    </div>
474	  </div>
475	</section>

479	<!-- ============ DISCOVER ============ -->
480	<section class="sec" id="discover" data-stage="EXPLORE">
481	  <div class="wrap">
482	    <div class="sec-head" data-rev>
483	      <div><span class="eyebrow">Live inventory</span><h2 class="display">Open right now, checked by humans</h2><p id="discCount"></p></div>
484	      <a class="link-more" href="#new">What's new this week<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
485	    </div>
486	    <div class="grid" id="gridDiscover" data-rev-group></div>
487	  </div>
488	</section>
489	
490	<!-- ============ HOW ============ -->
491	<section class="sec how" id="how" data-stage="LEARN">
492	  <div class="wrap">
493	    <div class="how-left" data-rev="left">
494	      <span class="eyebrow">The workflow</span>
495	      <h2 class="display">Four steps between you and your first real role</h2>
496	      <p>No accounts required to browse. No fees, ever. Just a clear path from "what's out there?" to a submitted application.</p>
497	      <div style="margin-top:26px"><a class="btn btn-dark" href="#discover">Start discovering<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a></div>
498	    </div>
499	    <div class="steps" id="steps">
500	      <div class="rail"><i id="railFill"></i></div>
501	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">01</span><h3>Tell us what you're looking for</h3><p>Pick your field, your city and how you like to work. Thirty seconds — it shapes everything you see next.</p></div>
502	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">02</span><h3>Discover matching internships</h3><p>Every listing shows the deadline, the stipend when there is one, and whether our team has verified the company.</p></div>
503	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">03</span><h3>Save the ones worth chasing</h3><p>Bookmark opportunities and your dashboard tracks each deadline, warning you before anything closes.</p></div>
504	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">04</span><h3>Apply through the original source</h3><p>We hand you the company's own application link with every detail in place — you apply directly, nothing missing.</p></div>
505	    </div>
506	  </div>
507	</section>

514	      <div class="cv-img" id="cvR" data-rev="right"><img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1498050108023-c5249f4df085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=60" alt="Code on a screen"></div>
515	      <div class="cv-mid" data-rev><span class="eyebrow">One index</span><h2 class="display">Design desks and server rooms, <span class="hl">one scroll apart</span></h2><p>Fields that used to live on twelve different WhatsApp groups now live in one verified, searchable inventory.</p></div>
516	    </div>

552	    <div><span class="eyebrow">Fresh this week</span><h2 class="display">What's new on the index</h2><p>Listings stay here for 48 hours after they land, then live on in Browse.</p></div>
553	    <a class="link-more" href="#discover">Open full inventory<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
554	  </div>

559	<!-- ============ BENEFITS ============ -->
560	<section class="sec" id="benefits" data-stage="GROW" style="padding-top:0">
561	  <div class="wrap">
562	    <div class="ben">
563	      <div class="bt" data-rev="left">
564	        <span class="eyebrow">Save & track</span>
565	        <h3>Save once, never miss a deadline</h3>
566	        <p>Your saved list is a quiet assistant. It watches every closing date so you don't have to.</p>
567	        <ul>

717	$("#fieldChips").innerHTML=FIELDS.map(f=>`<button class="fchip" data-f="${esc(f)}">${FICO[f]}${esc(f)}<em>${L.filter(x=>x.f===f).length}</em></button>`).join("");

726	function renderRec(){const m=L.filter(x=>prefs.has(x.f)).slice(0,3);const pool=m.length?m:L.slice(0,3);

732	(function(){
733	 const track=$("#carTrack"),wrap=$("#car");
734	 const base=L.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.nw-a.nw)).map(card).join("");
735	 track.innerHTML=base+base;
736	 if(reduced)return;
737	 let off=0,half=0,paused=false,drag=false,lx=0,vel=0,resumeT;
738	 const measure=()=>{half=track.scrollWidth/2;};
739	 measure();addEventListener("resize",measure);
740	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerenter",()=>paused=true);
741	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{paused=false;});
742	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{drag=true;paused=true;lx=e.clientX;wrap.classList.add("drag");wrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);});
743	 wrap.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{if(!drag)return;const dx=e.clientX-lx;lx=e.clientX;off-=dx;vel=-dx;});
744	 addEventListener("pointerup",()=>{drag=false;wrap.classList.remove("drag");resumeT=setTimeout(()=>paused=false,900);});
745	 wrap.addEventListener("wheel",e=>{if(Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY)){e.preventDefault();off+=e.deltaX;paused=true;clearTimeout(resumeT);resumeT=setTimeout(()=>paused=false,900);}},{passive:false});
746	 (function loop(){
747	  if(!paused&&!drag){vel*=.92;off+=.45+vel*.15;}
748	  if(half>0){off=((off%half)+half)%half;}
749	  track.style.transform=`translate3d(${-off}px,0,0)`;
750	  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
751	 })();
752	})();
