754	const nav=$("#nav");
755	const plx=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-plx]")];
756	const floats=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-float]")];
757	const cvL=$("#cvL"),cvR=$("#cvR"),rail=$("#railFill"),steps=$("#steps");
758	const jFill=$("#jFill"),jDot=$("#jDot"),jProg=$("#jProg"),jStageEl=$("#jStage");
759	const stageSecs=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-stage]")];
760	let mx=0,my=0,cmx=0,cmy=0;
761	$("#heroVis").addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{const r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();mx=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5)*2;my=((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5)*2;});
762	$("#heroVis").addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{mx=0;my=0;});
763	let ticking=false;
764	function onScroll(){if(ticking)return;ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ticking=false;const y=scrollY,vh=innerHeight;
765	 nav.classList.toggle("scrolled",y>26);
766	 const max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-vh;const p=Math.min(1,y/max);
767	 jFill.style.height=(p*100)+"%";jDot.style.top=(p*100)+"%";jProg.textContent=Math.round(p*100)+"%";
768	 let cur="DISCOVER";stageSecs.forEach(s=>{if(s.getBoundingClientRect().top<vh*.5)cur=s.dataset.stage;});
769	 if(p>.96)cur="FUTURE";
770	 if(jStageEl.textContent!==cur){jStageEl.textContent=cur;document.querySelectorAll("#jStages li").forEach(li=>li.classList.toggle("on",li.dataset.s===cur));}
771	 if(!reduced){plx.forEach(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const c=(r.top+r.height/2-vh/2)*+el.dataset.plx;el.style.transform=`translateY(${c*-1}px)`;});
772	  const r=cvL.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();const cp=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(vh-r.top)/(vh*.9)));
773	  cvL.style.transform=`translateX(${(1-cp)*-10}%) scale(${.94+cp*.06})`;

1	/* ============================================================
2	   INTERNSHIPS SERVICE · Firestore collection "internships"
3	   Single source of truth. Read paths are public; writes admin-only
4	   (enforced by security rules + checked here).

6	
7	const Internships = (() => {
8	  const col = () => firebaseDB.collection('internships');
9	
10	  function normalize(doc) {
11	    const d = doc.data();
12	    return {
13	      id: doc.id,
14	      ...d,
15	      deadline: UI.toDate(d.deadline),
16	      createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt),
17	      updatedAt: UI.toDate(d.updatedAt)
18	    };
19	  }
20	
21	  function byNewest(list) {
22	    return list.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
23	  }
24	
25	  return {
26	    /** All published internships, newest first. */
27	    async published() {
28	      try {
29	        const snap = await col().where('published', '==', true).get();
30	        return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize));
31	      } catch (err) {
32	        console.error('Internships.published failed:', err);
33	        throw err;
34	      }
35	    },
36	
37	    /** Featured + published, newest first. */
38	    async featured(limit = 6) {
39	      try {
40	        const snap = await col()
41	          .where('published', '==', true)
42	          .where('featured', '==', true)
43	          .get();
44	        return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize)).slice(0, limit);
45	      } catch (err) {
46	        console.error('Internships.featured failed:', err);
47	        return [];
48	      }
49	    },
50	
51	    /** Public single fetch — only returns published docs. */
52	    async get(id) {
53	      if (!id) return null;
54	      try {
55	        const doc = await col().doc(id).get();
56	        if (!doc.exists) return null;
57	        const item = normalize(doc);
58	        return item.published ? item : null;
59	      } catch (err) {
60	        console.error('Internships.get failed:', err);
61	        return null;
62	      }
63	    },
64	
65	    /** Admin: fetch regardless of publish state. */
66	    async getAny(id) {
67	      const doc = await col().doc(id).get();
68	      return doc.exists ? normalize(doc) : null;
69	    },
70	
71	    /** Admin: everything. */
72	    async all() {
73	      const snap = await col().get();
74	      return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize));
75	    },
76	
77	    async create(data) {
78	      const user = Auth.profile;
79	      if (!user) return { ok: false, error: 'Sign in to post an internship.' };
80	      try {
81	        const ref = await col().add({
82	          ...data,
83	          verified: user.isAdmin ? !!data.verified : false,
84	          featured: user.isAdmin ? !!data.featured : false,
85	          published: !!data.published,
86	          createdBy: user.uid,
87	          createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
88	          updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
89	        });
90	        return { ok: true, id: ref.id };
91	      } catch (err) {
92	        console.error('Internships.create failed:', err);
93	        return { ok: false, error: err.message };
94	      }
95	    },
96	
97	    async update(id, updates) {
98	      const user = Auth.profile;
99	      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
100	      try {
101	        await col().doc(id).update({
102	          ...updates,
103	          updatedBy: user.uid,
104	          updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
105	        });
106	        return { ok: true };
107	      } catch (err) {
108	        console.error('Internships.update failed:', err);
109	        return { ok: false, error: err.message };
110	      }
111	    },
112	
113	    async remove(id) {
114	      const user = Auth.profile;
115	      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
116	      try {

119	      } catch (err) {

1	rules_version = '2';
2	service cloud.firestore {
3	  match /databases/{database}/documents {
4	
5	    // Helper functions
6	    function isAuthenticated() {
7	      return request.auth != null;
8	    }
9	
10	    function isAdmin() {
11	      return isAuthenticated() && request.auth.token.admin == true;
12	    }
13	
14	    function isOwner(userId) {
15	      return isAuthenticated() && request.auth.uid == userId;
16	    }
17	
18	    // Users collection
19	    match /users/{userId} {
20	      // Profiles are private: only the owner or an admin can read them.
21	      allow read: if isOwner(userId) || isAdmin();
22	
23	      // Users can create their own document
24	      allow create: if isAuthenticated() && request.auth.uid == userId;
25	
26	      // Users can update their own document
27	      allow update: if isOwner(userId);
28	
29	      // Only admins can delete users
30	      allow delete: if isAdmin();
31	
32	      // Saved internships subcollection
33	      match /saved/{internshipId} {
34	        allow read, write: if isOwner(userId);
35	      }
36	
37	      // Notifications subcollection
38	      match /notifications/{notificationId} {
39	        allow read, write: if isOwner(userId);
40	      }
41	    }
42	
43	    // Internships collection
44	    match /internships/{internshipId} {
45	      // Anyone can read published internships; admins can read everything
46	      allow read: if resource.data.published == true || isAdmin();
47	
48	      // Admins manage everything; signed-in students may publish
49	      // unverified listings (title/company required).
50	      allow create: if isAdmin()
51	        || (isAuthenticated()
52	            && request.resource.data.published == true
53	            && request.resource.data.verified == false
54	            && request.resource.data.title is string
55	            && request.resource.data.company is string);
56	      allow update, delete: if isAdmin();
57	    }
58	
59	    // Suggestions collection
60	    match /suggestions/{suggestionId} {
61	      // Anyone can create suggestions (even anonymous)
62	      allow create: if true;
63	
64	      // Only admins can read / moderate suggestions
65	      allow read, update, delete: if isAdmin();
66	    }
67	  }
68	}

77	  const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

82	    return `${d.getDate()} ${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]}${withYear ? ' ' + d.getFullYear() : ''}`;
83	  }
84

95	    if (days < 0) return { label: 'Closed', cls: 'is-closed', days };
96	    if (days === 0) return { label: 'Closes today', cls: 'is-urgent', days };
97	    if (days <= 7) return { label: `${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'} left`, cls: 'is-urgent', days };
98	    return { label: `Closes ${fmtDate(internship.deadline, false)}`, cls: '', days };
99	  }
100	
101	  function isOpen(internship) {
102	    const days = daysUntil(internship.deadline);
103	    return days === null || days >= 0;
104	  }
105	
106	  function timeAgo(date) {
107	    const d = toDate(date);
108	    if (!d) return '';
109	    const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 1000);
110	    if (s < 60) return 'just now';
111	    if (s < 3600) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m ago`;
112	    if (s < 86400) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h ago`;
113	    if (s < 604800) return `${Math.floor(s / 86400)}d ago`;
114	    return fmtDate(d);

117	  /* ---------- Toasts ---------- */
118	
119	  let toastStack = null;
120	
121	  function toast(message, type = 'success') {

123	      toastStack = document.createElement('div');
124	      toastStack.className = 'toast-stack';
125	      toastStack.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
126	      document.body.appendChild(toastStack);
127	    }
128	    const el = document.createElement('div');
129	    el.className = `toast${type === 'error' ? ' toast-error' : ''}`;
130	    el.innerHTML = `${icon(type === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'check', 16)}<span>${esc(message)}</span>`;
131	    toastStack.appendChild(el);
132	    requestAnimationFrame(() => el.classList.add('is-shown'));
133	    setTimeout(() => {
134	      el.classList.remove('is-shown');
135	      setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300);
136	    }, 2600);
137	  }
138	
139	  /* ---------- Confirm modal ---------- */
140	
141	  function confirm({ title, message, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', danger = false }) {
142	    return new Promise((resolve) => {
143	      const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
144	      backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop';
145	      backdrop.innerHTML = `
146	        <div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${esc(title)}">
147	          <h3 class="modal-title">${esc(title)}</h3>
148	          <p class="modal-msg">${esc(message)}</p>
149	          <div class="modal-actions">
150	            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>
151	            <button type="button" class="btn ${danger ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-dark'}" style="${danger ? 'background:var(--red-600)' : ''}" data-act="ok">${esc(confirmLabel)}</button>
152	          </div>
153	        </div>`;
154	      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
155	      requestAnimationFrame(() => backdrop.classList.add('is-open'));
156	
157	      const close = (value) => {
158	        backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
159	        setTimeout(() => backdrop.remove(), 220);
160	        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
161	        resolve(value);
162	      };
163	      const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(false); };
164	      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
165	
166	      backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
167	        if (e.target === backdrop) close(false);
168	        const act = e.target.closest('[data-act]')?.dataset.act;
169	        if (act === 'cancel') close(false);
170	        if (act === 'ok') close(true);
171	      });
172	    });
173	  }
174	
175	  /* ---------- Scroll reveal ---------- */
176	
177	  function initReveals(root = document) {
178	    const items = root.querySelectorAll('.reveal:not(.is-in)');
179	    if (!items.length) return;
180	    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window) ||
181	        window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
182	      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-in'));
183	      return;
184	    }
185	    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
186	      entries.forEach((entry) => {
187	        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
188	          entry.target.classList.add('is-in');
189	          io.unobserve(entry.target);
190	        }
191	      });
192	    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -6% 0px' });
193	    items.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
194	  }
195	
196	  /* ---------- Skeleton rows ---------- */

198	  function skeletonRows(n = 4) {

202	    }

204	  }

206	  function skeletonCards(n = 6) {

211	          <div class="op-card-media"><div class="skel" style="width:56%;height:56%;background:rgba(250,249,246,0.06)"></div></div>
212	          <div class="op-card-body">
213	            <div class="skel skel-title" style="background:rgba(250,249,246,0.08)"></div>
214	            <div class="skel skel-meta" style="background:rgba(250,249,246,0.06)"></div>
215	          </div>
216	        </div>`;
217	    }
218	    return `<div class="op-grid">${html}</div>`;
219	  }
220	
221	  return {
222	    icon, esc, safeUrl, toDate, fmtDate, daysUntil, deadlineInfo, isOpen,

25	    async sync() {

27	      try {
28	        const saved = await Saved.list();
29	        const batch = firebaseDB.batch();

32	        for (const item of saved) {
33	          const days = UI.daysUntil(item.deadline);
34	          if (days === null || days < 0 || days > 7) continue;
35	
36	          const notifRef = col().doc(`deadline-${item.id}`);
37	          const existing = await notifRef.get();
38	          if (existing.exists) continue;
39	
40	          batch.set(notifRef, {
41	            type: 'deadline',
42	            title: days === 0 ? 'Closes today' : `Closes in ${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
43	            message: `${item.title} at ${item.company}`,
44	            internshipId: item.id,
45	            read: false,
46	            createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
47	          });
48	          writes++;
49	        }

51	        if (writes) await batch.commit();

62	          id: doc.id,
63	          ...doc.data(),
64	          createdAt: UI.toDate(doc.data().createdAt)
65	        }));

```json
  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   PLATFORM · settings + dynamic vocab (platform/config doc),\n   activity log (activity collection), analytics (real queries).\n   Loaded before other services.\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst DEFAULT_CONFIG = {\n  platformName: 'InternHub',\n  platformDescription: 'Verified internships across Cameroon, matched to your field, city and preferences.',\n  supportEmail: 'hello@internhub.cm',\n  defaultRegion: 'Cameroon',\n  newWindowHours: 48,\n  requireVerificationBeforePublish: false,\n  registrationOpen: true,\n  notifyNewMatches: true,\n  notifyLocationAlerts: true,\n  notifyDeadlineReminders: true,\n  notifySuggestionStatus: true,\n  fields: [\n    'Software Engineering', 'Data & AI', 'Cybersecurity', 'Networking',\n    'Electrical Engineering', 'Mechanical Engineering', 'Civil Engineering',\n    'Finance', 'Accounting', 'Marketing', 'Agriculture', 'Health',\n    'Design', 'Business', 'Education', 'Research', 'Other'\n  ],\n  categories: [\n    'Internship', 'Graduate Programme', 'Volunteer', 'Apprenticeship',\n    'Part-time', 'Research Assistant', 'Traineeship'\n  ],\n  locations: ['Buea', 'Mile 17', 'Bamenda', 'Douala', 'Yaoundé', 'Limbe', 'Kribi', 'Remote'],\n  workModes: ['On-site', 'Hybrid', 'Remote']\n};\n\nconst Settings = (() => {\n  let cache = null;\n  let unsub = null;\n\n  function merged(data) {\n    return { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...(data || {}), settings: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...(data || {}) } };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    DEFAULT: DEFAULT_CONFIG,\n    get data() { return cache || merged(null); },\n\n    /** Live subscription (admin). Public pages can call load() once. */\n    subscribe(cb) {\n      if (unsub) return unsub;\n      unsub = firebaseDB.collection('platform').doc('config')\n        .onSnapshot((snap) => {\n          cache = snap.exists ? merged(snap.data()) : merged(null);\n          if (cb) cb(cache);\n        }, () => { cache = merged(null); if (cb) cb(cache); });\n      return unsub;\n    },\n\n    async load() {\n      if (cache) return cache;\n      try {\n        const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('platform').doc('config').get();\n        cache = merged(snap.exists ? snap.data() : null);\n      } catch (_) { cache = merged(null); }\n      return cache;\n    },\n\n    async save(patch) {\n      const user = Auth.profile;\n      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };\n      try {\n        await firebaseDB.collection('platform').doc('config')\n          .set({ ...patch, updatedAt: serverTs() }, { merge: true });\n        cache = merged({ ...cache, ...patch });\n        return { ok: true };\n      } catch (err) { return { ok: false, error: err.message }; }\n    },\n\n    async addVocab(kind, value) {\n      const v = String(value || '').trim();\n      if (!v || !['fields', 'categories', 'locations'].includes(kind)) return { ok: false, error: 'Invalid field' };\n      const data = await this.load();\n      const list = new Set(data[kind] || []);\n      if (list.has(v)) return { ok: true };\n      list.add(v);\n      return this.save({ [kind]: [...list] });\n    },\n\n    async removeVocab(kind, value) {\n      const data = await this.load();\n      const list = (data[kind] || []).filter((x) => x !== value);\n      return this.save({ [kind]: list });\n    }\n  };\n})();\n\nconst Activity = (() => {\n  const col = () => firebaseDB.collection('activity');\n\n  function normalize(doc) {\n    const d = doc.data();\n    return { id: doc.id, ...d, createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt) };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    /** Admin-only write (enforced by rules). Never blocks the caller's action. */\n    async log({ action, targetType, targetId = '', targetTitle = '', summary = '' }) {\n      const user = Auth.profile;\n      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return;\n      try {\n        await col().add({\n          action, targetType, targetId, targetTitle, summary,\n          actor: user.displayName || user.email,\n          actorUid: user.uid,\n          createdAt: serverTs()\n        });\n      } catch (err) { console.error('Activity.log failed:', err); }\n    },\n\n    async recent(limit = 12) {\n      try {\n        const snap = await col().orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').limit(limit).get();\n        return snap.docs.map(normalize);\n      } catch (err) { console.error('Activity.recent failed:', err); return []; }\n    },\n\n    subscribe(limit, cb) {\n      return col().orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').limit(limit)\n        .onSnapshot((snap) => cb(snap.docs.map(normalize)), () => cb([]));\n    }\n  };\n})();\n\nconst Analytics = (() => {\n  const DAY = 86400000;\n\n  function since(range) {\n    if (range === 'all') return null;\n    const days = range === '7' ? 7 : range === '30' ? 30 : 90;\n    return new Date(Date.now() - days * DAY);\n  }\n\n  function inRange(dateObj, from) {\n    if (!from) return true;\n    const d = UI.toDate(dateObj);\n    return d && d >= from;\n  }\n\n  function bucket(items, keyFn, from) {\n    const out = {};\n    items.forEach((it) => {\n      if (!inRange(it.createdAt, from)) return;\n      const k = keyFn(it) || 'Unspecified';\n      out[k] = (out[k] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    async internships() {\n      try {\n        const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('internships').get();\n        return snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data(), createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt), publishedAt: UI.toDate(d.publishedAt) }));\n      } catch (_) { return []; }\n    },\n\n    /** Real metrics for a range: '7' | '30' | '90' | 'all'. */\n    async summary(range = '30') {\n      const from = since(range);\n      const [ints, users, sugg] = await Promise.all([this.internships(), this.users(), this.suggestions()]);\n      const published = ints.filter((i) => i.published);\n      const verified = ints.filter((i) => i.verified);\n      const newInts = ints.filter((i) => inRange(i.createdAt, from));\n      const newUsers = users.filter((u) => inRange(u.createdAt, from));\n\n      return {\n        range,\n        totals: {\n          internships: ints.length,\n          published: published.length,\n          verified: verified.length,\n          students: users.length,\n          suggestions: sugg.length,\n          pendingSuggestions: sugg.filter((s) => (s.status || 'pending') === 'pending').length\n        },\n        growth: {\n          internships: newInts.length,\n          students: newUsers.length\n        },\n        byField: bucket(newInts, (i) => i.field, from),\n        byLocation: bucket(newInts, (i) => i.city, from),\n        recentlyAdded: newInts.slice().sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0)).slice(0, 8),\n        suggestionStatus: bucket(sugg, (s) => s.status || 'pending', null)\n      };\n    }\n  };\n})();\n",
```

#### Thinking

I made an error: `Shell_viewReady` is an implicit global assignment — that's fine but I should avoid referencing it before Shell exists. Actually it creates a global function `Shell_viewReady`. That's acceptable but sloppy. Let me keep it but ensure pages use `document.addEventListener('shell:ready')` or just run their logic on DOMContentLoaded after shell re-inits body. Problem: Shell.init wipes `document.body.innerHTML` and moves `#view` into the slot. Page scripts that queried elements BEFORE shell ran would lose references. So pages must render their content AFTER 'shell:ready'. I'll standardize: page scripts add their markup into `#view` which persists (moved into slot), and they run on 'shell:ready' event, or they define content inside #view in static HTML (which gets moved). 

Simplest robust contract: each page has `<body data-app=... data-nav=...><main id="view"> ...static content or containers... </main> ...scripts... </body>`. Shell moves #view into #view-slot. Page script listens for 'shell:ready' then wires up within #view (queries still valid since same DOM nodes were moved, not recreated). Good — moving preserves nodes and event listeners attached to children. So page script can attach listeners on DOMContentLoaded (before or after move) because the nodes persist. Fine.

'9+' : String(n);\n    badge.hidden = !n;\n  }\n\n  function init() {\n    const bell = document.querySelector('[data-bell]');\n    const panel = document.querySelector('[data-notif-panel]');\n    if (!bell || !panel) return;\n\n    render(Notifications.list);\n    updateBadge();\n\n    bell.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); panel.classList.toggle('is-open'); });\n    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!panel.contains(e.target) && !bell.contains(e.target)) panel.classList.remove('is-open'); });\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') panel.classList.remove('is-open'); });\n\n    const markAll = panel.querySelector('[data-mark-all]');\n    if (markAll) markAll.addEventListener('click', async () => { await Notifications.markAllRead(); render(Notifications.list); updateBadge(); });\n\n    panel.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n      const item = e.target.closest('[data-notif]');\n      if (!item) return;\n      Notifications.markRead(item.dataset.notif);\n      item.classList.remove('is-unread');\n      updateBadge();\n      if (item.dataset.goto) window.location.href = item.dataset.goto;\n    });\n  }\n\n  return { init, render, updateBadge };\n})();\n",

139	.fc-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut);font-style:normal}
140	.fc-meta i.v{background:rgba(23,122,76,.12);color:var(--green)}
141	.fc-meta i.d{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
142	.fc1{right:-2%;top:2%}
143	.fc2{left:-3%;bottom:20%}
144	.fc3{right:2%;bottom:-2%}
145	.hv-chip{position:absolute;left:16%;top:-2%;z-index:3}
146	
147	/* ============ TICKER ============ */
148	.ticker{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;padding:13px 0}
149	.tk-track{display:flex;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:tick 36s linear infinite}
150	.ticker:hover .tk-track{animation-play-state:paused}
151	@keyframes tick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
152	.tk-track span{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);padding:0 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}
153	.tk-track span::after{content:"·";color:var(--green);font-size:15px}
154	
155	/* ============ SECTIONS COMMON ============ */
156	.sec{padding:clamp(78px,9vw,124px) 0}
157	.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);flex-wrap:wrap}
158	.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin-top:14px;max-width:560px}
159	.sec-head p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:10px;max-width:520px}
160	.link-more{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s;padding-bottom:3px}
161	.link-more svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
162	.link-more:hover{border-color:var(--lime)}
163	.link-more:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
164	[data-rev]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .8s var(--ease)}
165	[data-rev="left"]{transform:translateX(-36px)}
166	[data-rev="right"]{transform:translateX(36px)}
167	[data-rev="scale"]{transform:scale(.93)}
168	[data-rev].in{opacity:1;transform:none}
169	
170	/* ============ DISCOVER GRID ============ */
171	.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(258px,1fr));gap:16px}
172	.icard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s}
173	.icard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh);border-color:var(--line2)}
174	.ic-media{position:relative;height:150px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pine)}
175	.ic-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}
176	.icard:hover .ic-media img{transform:scale(1.045)}
177	.ic-media .noimg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.6);font:700 26px var(--fs);background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--pine))}
178	.ic-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}
179	.bdg{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:4.5px 9px;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
180	.bdg.new{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
181	.bdg.ver{background:rgba(13,43,29,.72);color:#9fe8bd;border:1px solid rgba(159,232,189,.35)}
182	.save{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(251,252,248,.92);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:.2s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
183	.save svg{width:15px;height:15px}
184	.save:hover{transform:scale(1.1);color:var(--green)}
185	.save.on{background:var(--green-deep);color:var(--lime)}
186	.save.on svg{fill:currentColor}
187	.save.pop{animation:spop .35s var(--ease)}
188	@keyframes spop{40%{transform:scale(1.28)}}
189	.ic-body{padding:15px 16px 13px;flex:1}
190	.ic-body h3{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
191	.ic-co{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px}
192	.ic-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
193	.ic-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut)}
194	.ic-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
195	.ic-dead{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}
196	.ic-dead.warn{color:var(--amber)}
197	.ic-link{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
198	.ic-link svg{width:12px;height:12px}
199	.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:56px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:16px;color:var(--mut)}
200	.empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
201	
202	/* ============ HOW ============ */
203	.how{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
204	.how .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(36px,5vw,80px)}
205	.how-left{position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:start}
206	.how-left h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px);margin:14px 0 16px}
207	.how-left p{color:var(--mut);max-width:400px}
208	.steps{position:relative;padding-left:34px}
209	.rail{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:2px;background:var(--line2)}
210	.rail i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--green),var(--lime));transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}
211	.step{position:relative;padding:0 0 clamp(38px,4.5vw,58px)}
212	.step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-31px;top:7px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);border:2.5px solid var(--green);transition:background .4s,box-shadow .4s}
213	.step.in::before{background:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(188,226,58,.3)}
214	.step .num{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--green)}
215	.step h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 8px}
216	.step p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px;font-size:14.5px}
217	
218	/* ============ CONVERGE ============ */
219	.converge{overflow:clip}
220	.cv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
221	.cv-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);will-change:transform;border:1px solid var(--line)}
222	.cv-img img{width:100%;height:clamp(240px,30vw,380px);object-fit:cover}
223	.cv-mid{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,50px) 0 0}
224	.cv-mid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
225	.cv-mid p{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
226	
227	/* ============ PERSONAL ============ */
228	.personal{background:var(--pine);color:#eaf5ec;position:relative;overflow:clip}
229	.personal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 46% at 78% 18%,rgba(188,226,58,.12),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 96px)}
230	.personal .wrap{position:relative}
231	.personal .eyebrow{color:var(--lime)}
232	.p-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
233	.p-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin:14px 0 16px;color:#f4faf2}
234	.p-grid .ptxt p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:440px}
235	.pref-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
236	.pchip{border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#cfe3d4;transition:.2s var(--ease)}
237	.pchip:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-2px)}
238	.pchip.on{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
239	.rec-wrap{position:relative}
240	.rec-core{background:rgba(234,245,236,.06);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
241	.rec-core .av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px var(--fs);flex:none}
242	.rec-core b{font-size:14.5px}
243	.rec-core span{display:block;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fb59c;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
244	.rec-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
245	.recard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.05);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,background .3s;will-change:transform}
246	.recard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.5);background:rgba(234,245,236,.09)}
247	.recard .th{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green-deep)}
248	.recard .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
249	.recard b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
250	.recard span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8fb59c}
251	.recard .match{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--fm);color:var(--lime);flex:none}
252	
253	/* ============ FIELDS / LOCATIONS ============ */
254	.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);align-items:start}
255	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
256	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
257	.fchip svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}
258	.fchip em{font:600 10px var(--fm);font-style:normal;color:var(--dim)}
259	.fchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
260	.locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
261	.loc{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
262	.loc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
263	.loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
264	.loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
265	.loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,43,29,.05),rgba(13,43,29,.78))}
266	.loc div{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
267	.loc b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;color:#f4faf2;font-weight:600}
268	.loc span{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lime);text-transform:uppercase}
269	.loc.soon{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center}
270	.loc.soon::after{display:none}
271	.loc.soon b{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
272	.loc.soon span{color:var(--dim)}
273	.loc.soon div{position:static;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
274	
275	/* ============ CAROUSEL ============ */
276	.newsec{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:clip}
277	.car{position:relative;cursor:grab}
278	.car.drag{cursor:grabbing}
279	.car-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;will-change:transform;padding:6px 0 10px}
280	.car-track .icard{width:280px;flex:none;pointer-events:none}
281	.car-hint{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);gap:14px;align-items:center}
282	.car-hint i{width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
283	
284	/* ============ BENEFITS ============ */
285	.ben{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,4.5vw,70px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
286	.ben+.ben{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
287	.ben h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 12px}
288	.ben .bt p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}
289	.ben .bt ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
290	.ben .bt li{display:flex;gap:11px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
291	.ben .bt li svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--green);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
292	.bvis{position:relative;min-height:300px}
293	.stack{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:15px 17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
294	.bvis:hover .stack{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg)!important}
295	.stack b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
296	.stack span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
297	.stack .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
298	.stack .dl{font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
299	.stack .dl.ok{color:var(--green)}
300	.check-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:22px;max-width:420px;margin:auto}
301	.check-card h4{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:14px}
302	.ck{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
303	.ck .bx{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none;border-radius:7px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
304	.ck .bx svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:3}
305	.in .ck .bx{transform:scale(1)}
306	.ck:nth-child(3) .bx{transition-delay:.15s}.ck:nth-child(4) .bx{transition-delay:.3s}.ck:nth-child(5) .bx{transition-delay:.45s}
307	.ck b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
308	.ck span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
309	.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px}
310	.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
311	.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
312	.tcard .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(23,122,76,.1);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
313	.tcard .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
314	.tcard b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
315	.tcard p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px}
316	
317	/* ============ CTA ============ */
318	.cta-panel{position:relative;overflow:clip;background:var(--pine);border-radius:26px;color:#eaf5ec;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) clamp(26px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
319	.cta-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.16),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
320	.cta-panel>*{position:relative}
321	.cta-panel h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f4faf2;max-width:720px;margin:16px auto 18px}
322	.cta-panel p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 30px}
323	.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
324	.cta-note{margin-top:26px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389}
325	
326	/* ============ FOOTER — public landing only ============ */
327	footer{margin-top:clamp(70px,8vw,110px);background:var(--pine2);color:#a9c2b0;border-top:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);position:relative;overflow:clip}
328	footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(46% 34% at 12% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.09),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
329	.ft{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:38px;padding:clamp(54px,6vw,76px) 0 44px}
330	.ft .brand{color:#f4faf2}
331	.ft .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
332	.ft .fb p{font-size:13.5px;max-width:290px;margin-top:16px}
333	.ft .fb .fmono{margin-top:18px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
334	.ft .fb .fmono::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
335	.ft h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389;margin-bottom:18px}
336	.ft ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
337	.ft ul a{font-size:13.5px;color:#a9c2b0;transition:color .2s,padding-left .3s var(--ease)}
338	.ft ul a:hover{color:var(--lime);padding-left:6px}
339	.ft-bar{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.09);padding:22px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
340	.top-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.2);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a9c2b0;transition:.25s}
341	.top-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}
342	.top-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
343	.ft-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(88px,17.5vw,250px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.05);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(188,226,58,.12);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(6%)}
344	
345	/* ============ JOURNEY WIDGET ============ */
346	.journey{position:fixed;right:26px;top:96px;z-index:90;width:212px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px}
347	.journey h5{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7}
348	.jrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
349	.jrow b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em}
350	.jline{position:relative;height:74px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);margin:14px 0 12px 4px}
351	.jline i{position:absolute;left:0;width:2px;background:var(--green);height:0%}
352	.jline::before,.jline::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2)}
353	.jline::before{top:-4px}
354	.jline::after{bottom:-4px;background:var(--green)}
355	.jdot{position:absolute;left:-5px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);border:2.5px solid var(--green);top:0%}
356	.jstages{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
357	.jstages li{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
358	.jstages li::before{content:"–"}
359	.jstages li.on{color:var(--green)}
360	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:400;background:var(--dark);color:#eef1e8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
361	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
362	
363	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
364	@media (max-width:1240px){.journey{display:none}}
365	@media (max-width:1020px){
366	  .nlinks{display:none}
367	  .nsign{display:none}
368	  .menu-btn{display:grid}

```
function card(it){
  const dl=UI.deadlineInfo(it);
  const warn=dl.days!==null&&dl.days<=7;
  const saved=Auth.profile&&Saved.has(it.id);
  const href='internship.html?id='+encodeURIComponent(it.id);
  const media=it.image?`<img src="${UI.esc(it.image)}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.outerHTML='<div class=noimg>${UI.esc(UI.initials(it.company))}</div>'">`:`<div class="noimg">${UI.esc(UI.initials(it.company))}</div>`;
  return `<article class="icard">
    <div class="ic-media">${media}
      <div class="ic-badges">${UI.isNew(it)?'<span class="bdg new">New</span>':''}${it.verified?'<span class="bdg ver">Verified</span>':'<span class="bdg ver pend">Pending review</span>'}</div>
      <button class="save${saved?' on':''}" data-save="${UI.esc(it.id)}" aria-pressed="${saved}" aria-label="${saved?'Remove from saved':'Save internship'}">${ICON.bookmark}</button>
    </div>
    <div class="ic-body"><h3><a href="${href}">${UI.esc(it.title)}</a></h3><p class="ic-co">${UI.esc(it.company)} · ${UI.esc(it.city||'Cameroon')}</p>
      <div class="ic-meta"><i>${UI.esc(it.field||'Internship')}</i><i>${UI.esc(it.workMode||'')}</i>${it.stipend?`<i>${UI.esc(it.stipend)}</i>`:''}</div></div>
    <div class="ic-foot"><span class="ic-dead${warn?' warn':''}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span><a class="ic-link" href="${href}">Details${ICON.arrow}</a></div></article>`;
}
```

```
    const sr=steps.getBoundingClientRect(); const sp=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(vh*0.7-sr.top)/sr.height)); if(rail)rail.style.transform=`scaleY(${sp})`;
  }
}); }
```

```
}
document.addEventListener('click',onSave);
```

```
}
```

      el.style.display='';

    });

  }

    syncFieldChips();

  function syncFieldChips(){document.querySelectorAll("#fieldChips .fchip").forEach(b=>{const on=b.dataset.f===st.field;b.style.borderColor=on?"var(--green)":"";b.style.background=on?"var(--lime)":"";b.style.color=on?"var(--lime-ink)":"";});}

    }).join("");

    const pf=(Auth.profile&&Auth.profile.preferences&&Auth.profile.preferences.fields)||[];
    const pool=(S.fields&&S.fields.length)?S.fields:[...new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.field).filter(Boolean))];
    let base=pf.filter(f=>pool.includes(f));
    if(!base.length){const counts={};S.data.forEach(d=>{if(d.field)counts[d.field]=(counts[d.field]||0)+1;});base=Object.entries(counts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,2).map(x=>x[0]);}
    prefs=new Set(base);

    document.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-save]");if(!b)return;e.preventDefault();
      if(!Auth.profile){toast("Sign in to save internships");setTimeout(()=>{location.href="signin.html?next="+encodeURIComponent("student_pages/dashboard.html");},900);return;}
      const id=b.dataset.save;b.disabled=true;
      Saved.toggle(id).then(r=>{b.disabled=false;if(!r.ok){toast("Could not update your saved list");return;}
        const on=r.state==="saved";b.classList.toggle("on",on);b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(on));b.setAttribute("aria-label",on?"Remove from saved":"Save internship");
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-save="'+id+'"]').forEach(x=>{if(x!==b){x.classList.toggle("on",on);x.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(on));}});

    });}

#### Thinking

Now I understand the shell contract clearly:
- Page HTML: `<body data-app="student" data-nav="browse">`, includes ui.css, app.css, scripts (compat, config, ui, platform, auth, [internships/saved/notifications/...], rows, notify-ui, shell), and a `<div id="view">...content...</div>` that the shell moves into `#view-slot`.
- Pages run logic via `onReady(() => {...})` after `shell:ready`.
- Shell expects `Notifications` and `NotifyUI` to exist for student (loaded when signed in). If I don't load notifications.js/notify-ui.js on a student page, `Notifications.load()` throws → caught? In init() it's `Notifications.load().then(...)` inside `if (mode==='student' && Auth.profile)`. If Notifications undefined → ReferenceError thrown inside init() async → unhandled, shell:ready might still fire? No — the throw happens before `window.__shellReady=true`. So init() would reject and never dispatch shell:ready → onReady callbacks never run → page content empty.

1	/* ============================================================
2	   NOTIFICATIONS · users/{uid}/notifications
3	   Owner-scoped. Admin/suggestions push into a specific user's
4	   subcollection (allowed by rules). No global notifications.
5	   ============================================================ */
6	
7	const Notifications = (() => {
8	  let cache = [];
9	
10	  function colOf(uid) {
11	    return firebaseDB.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('notifications');
12	  }
13	
14	  return {
15	    get list() { return cache; },
16	    unreadCount() { return cache.filter((n) => !n.read).length; },
17	
18	    /** Low-level: write one notification to a given user (used by admin flows). */
19	    async pushTo(uid, payload) {
20	      if (!uid || uid === 'anonymous') return;
21	      try { await colOf(uid).add(payload); } catch (err) { console.error('pushTo failed:', err); }
22	    },
23	
24	    /** Scan saved internships; raise deadline alerts within 7 days. */
25	    async sync() {
26	      if (!Auth.profile) return;
27	      const prefs = Auth.profile.notifications || {};
28	      if (!prefs.deadlineReminders) return;
29	      try {
30	        const saved = await Saved.list();
31	        let writes = 0;
32	        for (const item of saved) {
33	          const days = UI.daysUntil(item.deadline);
34	          if (days === null || days < 0 || days > 7) continue;
35	          const ref = colOf(Auth.profile.uid).doc(`deadline-${item.id}`);
36	          if ((await ref.get()).exists) continue;
37	          await ref.set({
38	            type: 'deadline',
39	            title: days === 0 ? 'Closes today' : `Closes in ${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
40	            message: `${item.title} at ${item.company}`,
41	            internshipId: item.id, read: false, createdAt: serverTs()
42	          });
43	          writes++;
44	        }
45	      } catch (err) { console.error('Notifications.sync failed:', err); }
46	    },
47	
48	    async load() {
49	      if (!Auth.profile) { cache = []; return cache; }
50	      try {
51	        const snap = await colOf(Auth.profile.uid).orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').limit(30).get();
52	        cache = snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data(), createdAt: UI.toDate(d.data().createdAt) }));
53	      } catch (err) { console.error('Notifications.load failed:', err); cache = []; }
54	      return cache;
55	    },
56	
57	    async markAllRead() {
58	      if (!Auth.profile) return;
59	      try {
60	        const unread = cache.filter((n) => !n.read);
61	        if (!unread.length) return;
62	        const batch = firebaseDB.batch();
63	        unread.forEach((n) => batch.update(colOf(Auth.profile.uid).doc(n.id), { read: true }));
64	        await batch.commit();
65	        cache.forEach((n) => { n.read = true; });
66	      } catch (err) { console.error('markAllRead failed:', err); }
67	    },
68	
69	    async markRead(id) {
70	      const item = cache.find((n) => n.id === id);
71	      if (!item || item.read) return;
72	      item.read = true;
73	      try { await colOf(Auth.profile.uid).doc(id).update({ read: true }); } catch (_) {}
74	    }
75	  };
76	})();

```json
{
  "content": "rules_version = '2';\n\n// ============================================================\n// InternHub · Firestore security\n// One shared database for the student and admin experiences.\n// Privilege comes ONLY from the Firebase Auth custom claim\n// `token.admin == true` (granted server-side via tools/setAdminClaim.js).\n// A student can never reach admin writes by guessing a URL.\n// ============================================================\nservice cloud.firestore {\n  match /databases/{database}/documents {\n\n    function signedIn()   { return request.auth != null; }\n    function isAdmin()    { return signedIn() && request.auth.token.admin == true; }\n    function owner(uid)   { return signedIn() && request.auth.uid == uid; }\n    function changed(keys){ return keys.toSet().difference(resource.data.keys().toSet()).size() > 0\n                          || keys.exists(k => request.resource.data.get(k) != resource.data.get(k)); }\n\n    // ---------- Internships: public read of published, admin-only writes ----------\n    match /internships/{id} {\n      allow read: if isAdmin() || resource.data.published == true;\n      allow create, update, delete: if isAdmin();\n    }\n\n    // ---------- Suggestions: student/anonymous submit (pending), owner or admin read ----------\n    match /suggestions/{id} {\n      allow get, list: if isAdmin()\n                     || (signedIn() && resource.data.submittedBy == request.auth.uid)\n                     || resource.data.submittedBy == 'anonymous';\n      // New submissions are always pending and attributed honestly.\n      allow create: if request.resource.data.status == 'pending'\n                    && request.resource.data.submittedBy == (signedIn() ? request.auth.uid : 'anonymous');\n      // Only staff edits/declines/verifies/removes a suggestion.\n      allow update, delete: if isAdmin();\n    }\n\n    // ---------- Users: owner-scoped profile; admin may moderate ----------\n    match /users/{uid} {\n      allow read:  if owner(uid) || isAdmin();\n      // A new student creates only a plain, non-privileged profile.\n      allow create: if owner(uid)\n                    && request.resource.data.uid == uid\n                    && request.resource.data.get('role', 'student') == 'student'\n                    && request.resource.data.get('admin', false) != true;\n      // Owner may edit their profile but can never grant themselves admin/role/uid.\n      allow update: if isAdmin()\n                    || (owner(uid)\n                        && request.resource.data.get('admin', false) == resource.data.get('admin', false)\n                        && request.resource.data.get('role', 'student') == resource.data.get('role', 'student')\n                        && request.resource.data.uid == resource.data.uid);\n      allow delete: if owner(uid) || isAdmin();\n\n      // Saved internships (owner only)\n      match /saved/{internshipId} {\n        allow read, write: if owner(uid);\n      }\n\n      // Notifications: owner reads/marks read; owner or admin may create an alert.\n      match /notifications/{notifId} {\n        allow read, update: if owner(uid);\n        allow create: if owner(uid) || isAdmin();\n        allow delete: if owner(uid) || isAdmin();\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- Platform config: public read of taxonomy, admin writes ----------\n    match /platform/{doc} {\n      allow read: if true;\n      allow write: if isAdmin();\n    }\n\n    // ---------- Activity log: admin only ----------\n    match /activity/{id} {\n      allow read, write: if isAdmin();\n    }\n\n    // Everything else is denied.\n    match /{document=**} {\n      allow read, write: if false;\n    }\n  }\n}\n",
  "file_path": "C:/Users/USER/Desktop/internship universe/updated project/firestore.rules"
}
```

```json
{
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n/* ============================================================\n   setAdminClaim · grants the `admin: true` custom claim that the\n   Firestore rules trust. Custom claims are a server-side (Admin\n   SDK) operation — the browser can never grant them, which is\n   exactly why a student cannot reach Admin by typing a URL.\n   ------------------------------------------------------------\n   CONFIGURATION REQUIRED: you must point this at your own\n   Firebase service-account key. Do NOT commit the key.\n\n     1. Firebase console → Project settings → Service accounts\n        → \"Generate new private key\" → download the JSON.\n     2. Run (PowerShell):\n          $env:GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = \"C:\\path\\to\\serviceAccount.json\"\n          node tools/setAdminClaim.js --email you@internhub.cm\n        or pass the key path directly:\n          node tools/setAdminClaim.js --key ./serviceAccount.json --uid <UID>\n\n   The service-account path is a required input; it is intentionally\n   not hardcoded anywhere in this repository.\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst admin = require('firebase-admin');\n\nfunction parseArgs(argv) {\n  const out = {};\n  for (let i = 2; i < argv.length; i++) {\n    const a = argv[i];\n    if (a === '--key') out.key = argv[++i];\n    else if (a === '--email') out.email = argv[++i];\n    else if (a === '--uid') out.uid = argv[++i];\n    else if (a === '--revoke') out.revoke = true;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n  const args = parseArgs(process.argv);\n\n  if (args.key) {\n    admin.initializeApp({ credential: admin.credential.cert(require(require('path').resolve(args.key))) });\n  } else if (process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS) {\n    admin.initializeApp({ credential: admin.credential.applicationDefault() });\n  } else {\n    console.error('CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED: set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or pass --key <path-to-service-account.json>');\n    process.exit(2);\n  }\n\n  if (!args.email && !args.uid) {\n    console.error('Pass --email <user@example.com> or --uid <UID> of the account to change.');\n    process.exit(2);\n  }\n\n  const user = args.uid\n    ? await admin.auth().getUser(args.uid)\n    : await admin.auth().getUserByEmail(args.email);\n\n  const claim = args.revoke ? { admin: null } : { admin: true };\n  await admin.auth().setCustomUserClaims(user.uid, claim);\n\n  console.log(`${args.revoke ? 'Revoked' : 'Granted'} admin claim for ${user.email || user.uid} (${user.uid}).`);\n  console.log('The user must sign out and back in (or refresh their ID token) for the change to take effect.');\n}\n\nmain().catch((err) => { console.error('Failed:', err.message); process.exit(1); });\n",
  "file_path": "C:/Users/USER/Desktop/internship universe/updated project/tools/setAdminClaim.js"
}
```

```json
  "content": "/* ============================================================\n   NOTIFY UI · bell dropdown (student topbar). Owner-scoped\n   notifications; no separate notification page.\n   ============================================================ */\n\nconst NotifyUI = (() => {\n  function render(items) {\n    const list = document.querySelector('[data-notif-list]');\n    if (!list) return;\n    if (!items || !items.length) {\n      list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"notif-empty\">You\\'re all caught up. Deadline and suggestion alerts appear here.</div>';\n      return;\n    }\n    list.innerHTML = items.map((n) => `\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"notif-item${n.read ? '' : ' is-unread'}\" data-notif=\"${UI.esc(n.id)}\" ${n.internshipId ? `data-goto=\"${H('internship.html')}?id=${encodeURIComponent(n.internshipId)}\"` : ''}>\n        <span class=\"notif-item-title\">${UI.esc(n.title || '')}</span>\n        <span class=\"notif-item-msg\">${UI.esc(n.message || '')}</span>\n        <span class=\"notif-item-time\">${UI.esc(UI.timeAgo(n.createdAt))}</span>\n      </button>`).join('');\n  }\n\n  function updateBadge() {\n    const badge = document.querySelector('[data-notif-badge]');\n    if (!badge) return;\n    const n = Notifications.unreadCount();\n    badge.textContent = n > 9 ? '9+' : String(n);\n    badge.hidden = !n;\n  }\n\n  function init() {\n    const bell = document.querySelector('[data-bell]');\n    const panel = document.querySelector('[data-notif-panel]');\n    if (!bell || !panel) return;\n\n    render(Notifications.list);\n    updateBadge();\n\n    bell.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); panel.classList.toggle('is-open'); });\n    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!panel.contains(e.target) && !bell.contains(e.target)) panel.classList.remove('is-open'); });\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') panel.classList.remove('is-open'); });\n\n    const markAll = panel.querySelector('[data-mark-all]');\n    if (markAll) markAll.addEventListener('click', async () => { await Notifications.markAllRead(); render(Notifications.list); updateBadge(); });\n\n    panel.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n      const item = e.target.closest('[data-notif]');\n      if (!item) return;\n      Notifications.markRead(item.dataset.notif);\n      item.classList.remove('is-unread');\n      updateBadge();\n      if (item.dataset.goto) window.location.href = item.dataset.goto;\n    });\n  }\n\n  return { init, render, updateBadge };\n})();\n",
```

194	.ic-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
195	.ic-dead{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}
196	.ic-dead.warn{color:var(--amber)}
197	.ic-link{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
198	.ic-link svg{width:12px;height:12px}
199	.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:56px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:16px;color:var(--mut)}
200	.empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
201	
202	/* ============ HOW ============ */
203	.how{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
204	.how .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(36px,5vw,80px)}
205	.how-left{position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:start}
206	.how-left h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px);margin:14px 0 16px}
207	.how-left p{color:var(--mut);max-width:400px}
208	.steps{position:relative;padding-left:34px}
209	.rail{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:2px;background:var(--line2)}
210	.rail i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--green),var(--lime));transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}
211	.step{position:relative;padding:0 0 clamp(38px,4.5vw,58px)}
212	.step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-31px;top:7px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);border:2.5px solid var(--green);transition:background .4s,box-shadow .4s}
213	.step.in::before{background:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(188,226,58,.3)}
214	.step .num{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--green)}
215	.step h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 8px}
216	.step p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px;font-size:14.5px}
217	
218	/* ============ CONVERGE ============ */
219	.converge{overflow:clip}
220	.cv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
221	.cv-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);will-change:transform;border:1px solid var(--line)}
222	.cv-img img{width:100%;height:clamp(240px,30vw,380px);object-fit:cover}
223	.cv-mid{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,50px) 0 0}
224	.cv-mid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
225	.cv-mid p{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
226	
227	/* ============ PERSONAL ============ */
228	.personal{background:var(--pine);color:#eaf5ec;position:relative;overflow:clip}
229	.personal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 46% at 78% 18%,rgba(188,226,58,.12),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 96px)}
230	.personal .wrap{position:relative}
231	.personal .eyebrow{color:var(--lime)}
232	.p-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
233	.p-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin:14px 0 16px;color:#f4faf2}
234	.p-grid .ptxt p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:440px}
235	.pref-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
236	.pchip{border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#cfe3d4;transition:.2s var(--ease)}
237	.pchip:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-2px)}
238	.pchip.on{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
239	.rec-wrap{position:relative}
240	.rec-core{background:rgba(234,245,236,.06);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
241	.rec-core .av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px var(--fs);flex:none}
242	.rec-core b{font-size:14.5px}
243	.rec-core span{display:block;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fb59c;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
244	.rec-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
245	.recard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.05);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,background .3s;will-change:transform}
246	.recard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.5);background:rgba(234,245,236,.09)}
247	.recard .th{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green-deep)}
248	.recard .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
249	.recard b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
250	.recard span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8fb59c}
251	.recard .match{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--fm);color:var(--lime);flex:none}
252	
253	/* ============ FIELDS / LOCATIONS ============ */
254	.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);align-items:start}
255	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
256	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
257	.fchip svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}
258	.fchip em{font:600 10px var(--fm);font-style:normal;color:var(--dim)}
259	.fchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
260	.locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
261	.loc{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
262	.loc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
263	.loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
264	.loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
265	.loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,43,29,.05),rgba(13,43,29,.78))}
266	.loc div{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
267	.loc b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;color:#f4faf2;font-weight:600}
268	.loc span{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lime);text-transform:uppercase}
269	.loc.soon{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center}
270	.loc.soon::after{display:none}
271	.loc.soon b{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
272	.loc.soon span{color:var(--dim)}
273	.loc.soon div{position:static;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
274	
275	/* ============ CAROUSEL ============ */
276	.newsec{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:clip}
277	.car{position:relative;cursor:grab}
278	.car.drag{cursor:grabbing}
279	.car-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;will-change:transform;padding:6px 0 10px}
280	.car-track .icard{width:280px;flex:none;pointer-events:none}
281	.car-hint{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);gap:14px;align-items:center}
282	.car-hint i{width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
283	
284	/* ============ BENEFITS ============ */
285	.ben{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,4.5vw,70px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
286	.ben+.ben{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
287	.ben h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 12px}
288	.ben .bt p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}
289	.ben .bt ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
290	.ben .bt li{display:flex;gap:11px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
291	.ben .bt li svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--green);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
292	.bvis{position:relative;min-height:300px}
293	.stack{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:15px 17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
294	.bvis:hover .stack{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg)!important}
295	.stack b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
296	.stack span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
297	.stack .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
298	.stack .dl{font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
299	.stack .dl.ok{color:var(--green)}
300	.check-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:22px;max-width:420px;margin:auto}
301	.check-card h4{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:14px}
302	.ck{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
303	.ck .bx{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none;border-radius:7px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
304	.ck .bx svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:3}
305	.in .ck .bx{transform:scale(1)}
306	.ck:nth-child(3) .bx{transition-delay:.15s}.ck:nth-child(4) .bx{transition-delay:.3s}.ck:nth-child(5) .bx{transition-delay:.45s}
307	.ck b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
308	.ck span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
309	.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px}
310	.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
311	.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
312	.tcard .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(23,122,76,.1);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
313	.tcard .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
314	.tcard b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
315	.tcard p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px}
316	
317	/* ============ CTA ============ */
318	.cta-panel{position:relative;overflow:clip;background:var(--pine);border-radius:26px;color:#eaf5ec;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) clamp(26px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
319	.cta-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.16),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
320	.cta-panel>*{position:relative}
321	.cta-panel h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f4faf2;max-width:720px;margin:16px auto 18px}
322	.cta-panel p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 30px}
323	.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
324	.cta-note{margin-top:26px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389}
325	
326	/* ============ FOOTER — public landing only ============ */
327	footer{margin-top:clamp(70px,8vw,110px);background:var(--pine2);color:#a9c2b0;border-top:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);position:relative;overflow:clip}
328	footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(46% 34% at 12% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.09),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
329	.ft{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:38px;padding:clamp(54px,6vw,76px) 0 44px}
330	.ft .brand{color:#f4faf2}
331	.ft .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
332	.ft .fb p{font-size:13.5px;max-width:290px;margin-top:16px}
333	.ft .fb .fmono{margin-top:18px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
334	.ft .fb .fmono::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
335	.ft h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389;margin-bottom:18px}
336	.ft ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
337	.ft ul a{font-size:13.5px;color:#a9c2b0;transition:color .2s,padding-left .3s var(--ease)}
338	.ft ul a:hover{color:var(--lime);padding-left:6px}
339	.ft-bar{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.09);padding:22px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
340	.top-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.2);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a9c2b0;transition:.25s}
341	.top-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}
342	.top-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
343	.ft-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(88px,17.5vw,250px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.05);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(188,226,58,.12);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(6%)}
344	
345	/* ============ JOURNEY WIDGET ============ */
346	.journey{position:fixed;right:26px;top:96px;z-index:90;width:212px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px}
347	.journey h5{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7}
348	.jrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
349	.jrow b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em}
350	.jline{position:relative;height:74px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);margin:14px 0 12px 4px}
351	.jline i{position:absolute;left:0;width:2px;background:var(--green);height:0%}
352	.jline::before,.jline::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2)}
353	.jline::before{top:-4px}
354	.jline::after{bottom:-4px;background:var(--green)}
355	.jdot{position:absolute;left:-5px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);border:2.5px solid var(--green);top:0%}
356	.jstages{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
357	.jstages li{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
358	.jstages li::before{content:"–"}
359	.jstages li.on{color:var(--green)}
360	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:400;background:var(--dark);color:#eef1e8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
361	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
362	
363	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
364	@media (max-width:1240px){.journey{display:none}}
365	@media (max-width:1020px){
366	  .nlinks{display:none}
367	  .nsign{display:none}
368	  .menu-btn{display:grid}
369	  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
370	  .hero-vis{height:480px;max-width:560px}
371	  .how .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
372	  .how-left{position:static}
373	  .p-grid,.f-grid,.ben{grid-template-columns:1fr}
374	  .ben .bvis{order:2;min-height:320px}
375	}
376	@media (max-width:640px){
377	  .hero{padding-top:120px}
378	  .ncta{padding:9px 15px}
379	  .searchbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
380	  .sb-q{padding:12px 14px}
381	  .sb-div{width:auto;height:1px;margin:0 8px}
382	  .sb-city{padding:11px 14px}
383	  .sb-btn{padding:13px;justify-content:center}
384	  .hero-vis{height:430px}
385	  .fc2{display:none}
386	  .cv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
387	  .trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}
388	  .locs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
389	  .ft{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
390	}
391	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
392	  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
393	  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
394	  [data-rev]{opacity:1;transform:none}
395	  .car{overflow-x:auto}
396	  .car-track .icard{pointer-events:auto}
397	}
398	</style>

442	  <div class="jrow"><span>Cities</span><b id="jCities">—</b></div>

446	  </ul>

449	<!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
450	<section class="hero" id="top" data-stage="DISCOVER">
451	  <div class="wrap">
