1112	
1113	## Appendix C - Apple Liquid Glass: Honest Web Approximation
1114	
1115	Do **not** treat random CSS snippets as official Apple Liquid Glass.
1116	
1117	### What is official
1118	Apple documents Liquid Glass inside Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and Developer Documentation for **Apple platforms**. It is a dynamic material used across Apple platform UI. Apple's native implementation belongs to Apple platform APIs and system components, **not a public web CSS package**.
1119	
1120	Relevant official docs:
1121	- Apple Human Interface Guidelines → Materials
1122	- Apple Developer Documentation → Liquid Glass
1123	- Apple Developer Documentation → Adopting Liquid Glass
1124	- SwiftUI → Material
1125	
1126	### What is NOT official
1127	There is no `liquid-glass.css` from Apple for normal websites.
1128	
1129	A web approximation can use:
1130	- `backdrop-filter`
1131	- transparent backgrounds
1132	- layered borders
1133	- highlight overlays
1134	- gradients
1135	- motion
1136	- strong contrast fallbacks
1137	
1138	But that is **web glassmorphism / frosted-glass approximation**, not official Apple Liquid Glass. Label it as such in comments.
1139	
1140	### Safer web approximation skeleton
1141	
1142	```css
1143	.liquid-glass-web-approx {
1144	  position: relative;
1145	  isolation: isolate;
1146	  overflow: hidden;
1147	  border-radius: 999px;
1148	  border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .32);
1149	  background:
1150	    linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .30), rgb(255 255 255 / .08)),
1151	    rgb(255 255 255 / .12);
1152	  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%) contrast(1.05);
1153	  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%) contrast(1.05);
1154	  box-shadow:
1155	    inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .48),
1156	    inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .12),
1157	    0 18px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / .18);
1158	}
1159	
1160	.liquid-glass-web-approx::before {
1161	  content: "";
1162	  position: absolute;
1163	  inset: 0;
1164	  z-index: -1;
1165	  border-radius: inherit;
1166	  background:
1167	    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / .55), transparent 34%),
1168	    linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .18), transparent 42%, rgb(255 255 255 / .14));
1169	  pointer-events: none;
1170	}
1171	
1172	.liquid-glass-web-approx::after {
1173	  content: "";
1174	  position: absolute;
1175	  inset: 1px;
1176	  border-radius: inherit;
1177	  border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .14);
1178	  pointer-events: none;
1179	}
1180	
1181	@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
1182	  .liquid-glass-web-approx {
1183	    border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / .18);
1184	    background:
1185	      linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .16), rgb(255 255 255 / .04)),
1186	      rgb(15 23 42 / .42);
1187	    box-shadow:
1188	      inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .22),
1189	      0 18px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / .42);
1190	  }
1191	}
1192	
1193	@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
1194	  .liquid-glass-web-approx {
1195	    background: rgb(255 255 255 / .96);
1196	    backdrop-filter: none;
1197	    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
1198	  }
1199	}
1200	```
1201	
1202	**Important:** `prefers-reduced-transparency` has uneven browser support; test it. Always provide enough contrast even without blur.
1203

141	  function wire(mode) {
142	    const app = document.getElementById('app');
143	    const sidenav = document.getElementById('sidenav');
144	    const mq = matchMedia('(max-width: 960px)');
145	
146	    if (!mq.matches && localStorage.getItem(LS) === '1') app.classList.add('is-collapsed');
147	
148	    const toggleCollapse = () => {
149	      if (mq.matches) {
150	        const open = app.classList.toggle('nav-open');
151	        document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
152	      } else {
153	        const c = app.classList.toggle('is-collapsed');
154	        localStorage.setItem(LS, c ? '1' : '0');
155	      }
156	    };
157	    const openDrawer = () => { app.classList.add('nav-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; };
158	    const closeDrawer = () => { app.classList.remove('nav-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
159	
160	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-collapse]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', toggleCollapse));
161	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-scrim-open]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', openDrawer));
162	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-scrim]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer));
163	    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer(); });
164	    mq.addEventListener('change', () => { closeDrawer(); });
165	
166	    // Account dropdown
167	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-btn]').forEach((btn) => {
168	      const pop = btn.parentElement.querySelector('[data-menu-pop]');
169	      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
170	        e.stopPropagation();
171	        const open = pop.classList.toggle('is-open');
172	        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
173	      });
174	      document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!pop.contains(e.target)) { pop.classList.remove('is-open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); } });
175	    });
176	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-signout]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => Auth.signOut()));
177	
178	    // Page title
179	    const navKey = document.body.dataset.nav;
180	    const items = mode === 'admin' ? ADMIN_NAV : STUDENT_NAV;
181	    const titleEl = app.querySelector('[data-page-title]');
182	    const cur = items.find((i) => i.key === navKey);
183	    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = cur ? cur.label : '';
184	  }
185	
186	  async function initFooterAndReveals() {
187	    UI.initReveals(document.getElementById('view-slot') || document);
188	  }
189	
190	  async function init() {
191	    const mode = document.body.dataset.app;
192	    if (!mode) return; // landing/auth pages manage their own chrome
193	    await Auth.ready;
194	
195	    const view = document.getElementById('view');
196	    const active = document.body.dataset.nav || '';
197	    document.body.innerHTML = mode === 'admin' ? buildAdmin(active) : buildStudent(active);
198	    const slot = document.getElementById('view-slot');
199	    if (view && view.children.length) slot.appendChild(view);
200	    else if (view) { /* content injected by page script into #view later */ }
201	
202	    wire(mode);
203	
204	    if (mode === 'student' && Auth.profile) {
205	      Notifications.load().then(() => NotifyUI.init());
206	      NotifyUI.render(Notifications.list);
207	      NotifyUI.updateBadge();
208	    }
209	    initFooterAndReveals();
210	    window.__shellReady = true;
211	    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shell:ready'));
212	  }
213	
214	  // Pages using the shared frame run their logic after the shell has
215	  // rebuilt the DOM. Landing/auth pages (no data-app) run immediately.
216	  window.onReady = function (cb) {
217	    if (!document.body.dataset.app || window.__shellReady) cb();
218	    else document.addEventListener('shell:ready', cb, { once: true });
219	  };
220	
221	  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
222	  return { init, STUDENT_NAV, ADMIN_NAV };
223	})();

85	.notif-item-time{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.05em}
86	.notif-empty{padding:26px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
87	
88	/* ---------- Toolbar / search ---------- */
89	.toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
90	.search-field{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:200px}
91	.search-field svg{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--dim)}
92	.search-field .input{padding-left:36px}
93	.toolbar .select,.toolbar .search-field{max-width:none}
94	.seg{display:inline-flex;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:3px;gap:2px}
95	.seg button{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
96	.seg button.is-on{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
97	
98	/* ---------- Filters (browse) ---------- */
99	.browse-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:248px minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px;align-items:start}
100	.filters{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:18px;max-height:calc(100vh - var(--nav-h) - 32px);overflow-y:auto}
101	.filter-group{padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
102	.filter-group:last-child{border-bottom:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
103	.filter-group h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:11px}
104	.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
105	.chip{border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);transition:.18s}
106	.chip:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
107	.chip.is-on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
108	.check-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
109	
110	/* ---------- Tables ---------- */
111	.table-wrap{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;background:var(--card)}
112	table.data{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px}
113	table.data th{text-align:left;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;background:var(--bg)}
114	table.data td{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
115	table.data tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
116	table.data tbody tr{transition:background .15s}
117	table.data tbody tr:hover{background:var(--bg2)}
118	.cell-title{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
119	.cell-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
120	.row-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end}
121	.tbtn{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);color:var(--mut);transition:.16s}
122	.tbtn:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
123	.tbtn.danger:hover{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red)}
124	.avatar-cell{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
125	.pagination{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
126	.pagination .pg-info{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
127	.pg-btns{display:flex;gap:6px}
128	.pg-btn{min-width:34px;height:34px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
129	.pg-btn:hover{border-color:var(--line2)}
130	.pg-btn.is-on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
131	.pg-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
132	
133	/* ---------- Tabs (settings/account) ---------- */
134	.tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:22px;overflow-x:auto}
135	.tab{padding:11px 15px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;margin-bottom:-1px}
136	.tab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
137	.tab.is-on{color:var(--green);border-bottom-color:var(--green);font-weight:600}
138	.tab-panel{display:none}.tab-panel.is-on{display:block}
139	.danger-zone{border:1px solid var(--red);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:20px;background:var(--red-bg)}
140	.danger-zone h3{color:var(--red);font-size:17px}
141	
142	/* ---------- Mobile card tables ---------- */
143	@media (max-width:860px){
144	  .app,.app.is-collapsed{grid-template-columns:1fr}
145	  .sidenav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;z-index:70;width:270px;height:100vh;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
146	  .app.nav-open .sidenav{transform:none}
147	  .app.nav-open .scrim{display:block;opacity:1}
148	  .app.is-collapsed .nav-label,.app.is-collapsed .brand-txt,.app.is-collapsed .admin-profile-txt{display:inline}
149	  .app.is-collapsed .nav-item,.app.is-collapsed .sidenav-top{justify-content:flex-start}
150	  .only-mobile{display:grid}.collapse-btn{display:none}
151	  .only-desktop{display:none !important}
152	  .app--admin .admin-profile .avatar{background:var(--lime)}
153	  .filters{position:static;max-height:none}
154	  .browse-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
155	  .browse-layout .filters{display:none}
156	  .browse-layout.filters-open .filters{display:block}
157	  .ft-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
158	  .grid-2,.grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
159	  /* table -> card */
160	  table.data thead{display:none}
161	  table.data,table.data tbody,table.data tr,table.data td{display:block;width:100%}
162	  table.data tr{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);margin-bottom:12px;padding:8px 4px;background:var(--card)}
163	  table.data td{border:0;padding:7px 14px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;align-items:center}
164	  table.data td::before{content:attr(data-label);font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
165	  table.data td.no-label::before{display:none}
166	  .row-actions{justify-content:flex-start}
167	}
168	@media (max-width:560px){
169	  .ft-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}
170	  .topbar-title{font-size:16px}
171	  .icard-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
172	}

5	const Rows = (() => {
6	  function detailHref(id) { return H('internship.html') + '?id=' + encodeURIComponent(id); }
7	
8	  function media(item) {
9	    if (item.image && /^https?:/i.test(item.image)) {
10	      return `<img src="${UI.esc(item.image)}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.replaceWith(Object.assign(document.createElement('div'),{className:'ic-fallback',textContent:${JSON.stringify((item.company || 'I').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase())}}))">`;
11	    }
12	    const ch = (item.company || 'I').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
13	    return `<div class="ic-fallback">${UI.esc(ch)}</div>`;
14	  }
15	
16	  function badges(item) {
17	    let html = '';
18	    if (UI.isNew(item)) html += '<span class="bdg bdg-new">New</span>';
19	    if (item.verified) html += `<span class="bdg bdg-ver">${UI.icon('shield', 11)} Verified</span>`;
20	    else html += '<span class="bdg bdg-pend">Pending</span>';
21	    return html;
22	  }
23	
24	  function card(item) {
25	    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
26	    const saved = Saved.has(item.id);
27	    const ext = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
28	    const meta = [item.field, item.workMode, item.duration].filter(Boolean)
29	      .map((m) => `<i>${UI.esc(m)}</i>`).join('');
30	
31	    return `<article class="icard">
32	      <div class="ic-media">${media(item)}
33	        <div class="ic-badges">${badges(item)}</div>
34	        <button type="button" class="save${saved ? ' on' : ''}" data-save="${UI.esc(item.id)}"
35	                aria-pressed="${saved}" aria-label="${saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship'}">
36	          ${UI.icon('bookmark', 15, saved)}
37	        </button>
38	      </div>
39	      <div class="ic-body">
40	        <h3 class="ic-title"><a href="${detailHref(item.id)}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
41	        <p class="ic-co">${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.city ? ' · ' + UI.esc(item.city) : ''}</p>
42	        <div class="ic-meta">${meta}</div>
43	      </div>
44	      <div class="ic-foot">
45	        <span class="ic-dead${dl.cls ? ' ' + dl.cls : ''}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span>
46	        <a class="ic-link" href="${ext || detailHref(item.id)}"${ext ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener"' : ''}>Details ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 12)}</a>
47	      </div>
48	    </article>`;
49	  }
50	
51	  function grid(items) {
52	    if (!items.length) return '';
53	    return `<div class="icard-grid">${items.map(card).join('')}</div>`;
54	  }
55	
56	  function empty(message = 'No internships found.', sub = '') {
57	    return `<div class="ic-empty"><b>${UI.esc(message)}</b>${sub ? `<span>${UI.esc(sub)}</span>` : ''}</div>`;
58	  }
59	
60	  function error() {
61	    return `<div class="ic-empty ic-error"><b>Couldn't load internships</b>
62	      <span>There was a problem reaching the database.</span>
63	      <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:14px">Retry</button></div>`;
64	  }
65	
66	  function skeleton(n = 6) {
67	    let html = '';
68	    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) html += `<div class="icard icard-skel"><div class="ic-media"></div><div class="ic-body"><div class="skel skel-title"></div><div class="skel skel-meta"></div></div></div>`;
69	    return `<div class="icard-grid">${html}</div>`;
70	  }
71	
72	  function initSaveHandling() {
73	    document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
74	      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-save]');
75	      if (!btn) return;
76	      e.preventDefault();
77	      if (!Auth.profile) {
78	        UI.toast('Sign in to save internships');
79	        setTimeout(() => { window.location.href = `${H('signin.html')}?next=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search)}`; }, 800);
80	        return;
81	      }
82	      const id = btn.dataset.save;
83	      btn.disabled = true;
84	      const res = await Saved.toggle(id);
85	      btn.disabled = false;
86	      if (!res.ok) { UI.toast('Could not update your saved list', 'error'); return; }
87	      const on = res.state === 'saved';
88	      btn.classList.toggle('on', on);
89	      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
90	      btn.innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 15, on);
91	      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saved:changed', { detail: { id, on } }));
92	    });
93	  }

Let me design the new register.html script:
```js
(function () {
  document.getElementById('mark').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 16, true);
  // eye toggles for password + confirm
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-pw]').forEach(eye => {
    eye.innerHTML = UI.icon('eye', 17);
    eye.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const i = document.getElementById(eye.dataset.pw);
      const s = i.type === 'password'; i.type = s ? 'text' : 'password';
      eye.innerHTML = UI.icon(s ? 'eye-off' : 'eye', 17);
    });
  });

  Auth.ready.then(() => { if (Auth.profile) location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath()); });

  const err = document.getElementById('err'), form = document.getElementById('regForm'), btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  function showErr(m) { err.textContent = m; err.classList.add('show'); btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); btn.disabled = false; }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); err.classList.remove('show');
    const name = form.name.value.trim(), email = form.email.value.trim();
    const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
    const confirm = document.getElementById('confirm').value;
    const terms = document.getElementById('terms').checked;
    if (!name) return showErr('Please enter your name.');
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) return showErr('Enter a valid email address.');
    if (password.length < 6) return showErr('Password must be at least 6 characters.');
    if (password !== confirm) return showErr('Passwords do not match.');
    if (!terms) return showErr('Please accept the terms to continue.');
    btn.classList.add('is-loading'); btn.disabled = true;
    const res = await Auth.register(name, email, password);
    if (!res.ok) return showErr(res.error);
    location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath());
  });
})();
```

Now the script:
```html
<script>
(function () {
  document.getElementById('mark').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 16, true);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-pw]').forEach((eye) => {
    eye.innerHTML = UI.icon('eye', 17);
    eye.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const i = document.getElementById(eye.dataset.pw);
      const s = i.type === 'password'; i.type = s ? 'text' : 'password';
      eye.innerHTML = UI.icon(s ? 'eye-off' : 'eye', 17);
    });
  });

  Auth.ready.then(() => { if (Auth.profile) location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath()); });

  const err = document.getElementById('err'), form = document.getElementById('regForm'), btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  function showErr(m) { err.textContent = m; err.classList.add('show'); btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); btn.disabled = false; }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); err.classList.remove('show');
    const name = form.name.value.trim(), email = form.email.value.trim();
    const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
    const confirm = document.getElementById('confirm').value;
    if (!name) return showErr('Please enter your name.');
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) return showErr('Enter a valid email address.');
    if (password.length < 6) return showErr('Password must be at least 6 characters.');
    if (password !== confirm) return showErr('Passwords do not match.');
    if (!document.getElementById('terms').checked) return showErr('Please accept the terms to continue.');
    btn.classList.add('is-loading'); btn.disabled = true;
    const res = await Auth.register(name, email, password);
    if (!res.ok) return showErr(res.error);
    location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath());
  });
})();
</script>
```

old:
```
(function () {
  document.getElementById('mark').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 16, true);
  const eye = document.querySelector('[data-pw]'); eye.innerHTML = UI.icon('eye', 17);
  eye.addEventListener('click', () => { const i = document.getElementById(eye.dataset.pw); const s = i.type === 'password'; i.type = s ? 'text' : 'password'; eye.innerHTML = UI.icon(s ? 'eye-off' : 'eye', 17); });

  const prefs = { locations: new Set(), workModes: new Set() };
  function chips(box, values, set) {
    box.innerHTML = values.map(v => `<button type="button" class="chip" data-v="${UI.esc(v)}">${UI.esc(v)}</button>`).join('');
    box.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(c => c.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const v = c.dataset.v; set.has(v) ? set.delete(v) : set.add(v); c.classList.toggle('is-on');
    }));
  }
  Auth.ready.then(() => { if (Auth.profile) location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath()); });

  Settings.load().then(cfg => {
    const sel = document.getElementById('field');
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Choose…</option>' + cfg.fields.map(f => `<option>${UI.esc(f)}</option>`).join('');
    chips(document.getElementById('locChips'), cfg.locations, prefs.locations);
    chips(document.getElementById('modeChips'), cfg.workModes, prefs.workModes);
  });

  const err = document.getElementById('err'), form = document.getElementById('regForm'), btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  function showErr(m) { err.textContent = m; err.classList.add('show'); btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); btn.disabled = false; }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); err.classList.remove('show');
    const name = form.name.value.trim(), email = form.email.value.trim(), password = document.getElementById('password').value;
    if (!name) return showErr('Please enter your name.');
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) return showErr('Enter a valid email address.');
    if (password.length < 6) return showErr('Password must be at least 6 characters.');
    btn.classList.add('is-loading'); btn.disabled = true;
    const res = await Auth.register(name, email, password);
    if (!res.ok) return showErr(res.error);
    try {
      await Auth.updateProfile({
        institution: form.institution.value.trim(),
        field: sel_val(),
        preferences: { fields: sel_val() ? [sel_val()] : [], locations: [...prefs.locations], workModes: [...prefs.workModes] }
      });
    } catch (_) {}
    location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath());
  });
  function sel_val() { return document.getElementById('field').value; }
})();
```

      <div class="field"><label for="name">Full name</label><input class="input" id="name" autocomplete="name" required placeholder="Your name"></div>
      <div class="field"><label for="email">Email</label><input class="input" type="email" id="email" autocomplete="email" required placeholder="you@example.com"></div>
      <div class="field">
        <label for="password">Password</label>

      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label for="confirm">Confirm password</label>
        <div class="pw-toggle"><input class="input" type="password" id="confirm" autocomplete="new-password" required placeholder="Repeat your password"><button type="button" data-pw="confirm" aria-label="Show password"></button></div>
      </div>
      <label class="check" style="margin:2px 0 20px"><input type="checkbox" id="terms" required> I agree to the <a href="terms.html" style="color:var(--green)">Terms</a> and <a href="privacy.html" style="color:var(--green)">Privacy Policy</a>.</label>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-block btn-lg" type="submit" id="submitBtn">Create account</button>
    </form>
    <p class="auth-alt">Already registered? <a href="signin.html">Sign in</a></p>
  </div>

<script>
(function () {
  document.getElementById('mark').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 16, true);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-pw]').forEach((eye) => {
    eye.innerHTML = UI.icon('eye', 17);
    eye.addEventListener('click', () => { const i = document.getElementById(eye.dataset.pw); const s = i.type === 'password'; i.type = s ? 'text' : 'password'; eye.innerHTML = UI.icon(s ? 'eye-off' : 'eye', 17); });
  });

  Auth.ready.then(() => { if (Auth.profile) location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath()); });

  const err = document.getElementById('err'), form = document.getElementById('regForm'), btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  function showErr(m) { err.textContent = m; err.classList.add('show'); btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); btn.disabled = false; }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); err.classList.remove('show');
    const name = form.name.value.trim(), email = form.email.value.trim();
    const password = document.getElementById('password').value, confirm = document.getElementById('confirm').value;
    if (!name) return showErr('Please enter your name.');
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) return showErr('Enter a valid email address.');
    if (password.length < 6) return showErr('Password must be at least 6 characters.');
    if (password !== confirm) return showErr('Passwords do not match.');
    if (!document.getElementById('terms').checked) return showErr('Please accept the terms to continue.');
    btn.classList.add('is-loading'); btn.disabled = true;
    const res = await Auth.register(name, email, password);
    if (!res.ok) return showErr(res.error);
    location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath());
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

        </div>
      </div>

(function () {
  document.getElementById('mark').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 16, true);
  const err = document.getElementById('err');
  const form = document.getElementById('signinForm');

  const eye = document.querySelector('[data-pw]');
  eye.innerHTML = UI.icon('eye', 17);

    const show = inp.type === 'password';
    inp.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
    eye.innerHTML = UI.icon(show ? 'eye-off' : 'eye', 17);
  });

  Auth.ready.then(() => { if (Auth.profile) location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath()); });
  if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('suspended')) err.textContent = 'This account has been suspended. Contact support.', err.classList.add('show');

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    err.classList.remove('show');
    const email = form.email.value.trim(), password = form.password.value;
    if (!email || !password) { err.textContent = 'Enter your email and password.', err.classList.add('show'); return; }
    btn.classList.add('is-loading'); btn.disabled = true;
    const res = await Auth.signIn(email, password);
    if (res.ok) { await Auth.waitForUser(); location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath()); }
    else { err.textContent = res.error; err.classList.add('show'); btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); btn.disabled = false; }
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    present, absent,

  }, null, 0);
}

```js
() => {
  const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
  const rgb = (el, prop) => el ? getComputedStyle(el)[prop] : null;
  const side = q('.sidenav');
  const active = q('.nav-item.is-active');
  const navItem = q('.nav-item');
  const topbar = q('.topbar');
  const content = q('.app-content');
  const hello = q('#hello');
  const savedBox = q('#savedBox');
  const deadlineBox = q('#deadlineBox');
  const newBox = q('#newBox');
  const prefBox = q('#prefBox');
  const de = document.documentElement;
  return JSON.stringify({
    href: location.href,
    shellReady: !!window.__shellReady,
    dataApp: document.body.getAttribute('data-app'),
    hello: hello && hello.textContent,
    sidenavBg: rgb(side,'backgroundColor'),
    navCount: document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').length,
    activeText: active && active.textContent.trim(),
    activeBg: rgb(active,'backgroundColor'),
    activeColor: rgb(active,'color'),
    navColor: rgb(navItem,'color'),
    topbarBg: rgb(topbar,'backgroundColor'),
    contentBg: rgb(content,'backgroundColor'),
    bodyBg: rgb(document.body,'backgroundColor'),
    savedEmpty: savedBox ? savedBox.textContent.trim().slice(0,80) : null,
    deadlineTxt: deadlineBox ? deadlineBox.textContent.trim().slice(0,80) : null,
    newTxt: newBox ? newBox.textContent.trim().slice(0,80) : null,
    prefTxt: prefBox ? prefBox.textContent.trim().slice(0,80) : null,
    overflowX: de.scrollWidth > de.clientWidth ? (de.scrollWidth - de.clientWidth) : 0,
    scrollW: de.scrollWidth, clientW: de.clientWidth
  });
}
```

<script src="assets/js/services/platform.js"></script>
<script src="assets/js/services/auth.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  document.getElementById('mark').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 16, true);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-pw]').forEach((eye) => {
    eye.innerHTML = UI.icon('eye', 17);
    eye.addEventListener('click', () => { const i = document.getElementById(eye.dataset.pw); const s = i.type === 'password'; i.type = s ? 'text' : 'password'; eye.innerHTML = UI.icon(s ? 'eye-off' : 'eye', 17); });
  });

  Auth.ready.then(() => { if (Auth.profile) location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath()); });

  const err = document.getElementById('err'), form = document.getElementById('regForm'), btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  function showErr(m) { err.textContent = m; err.classList.add('show'); btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); btn.disabled = false; }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); err.classList.remove('show');
    const name = document.getElementById('name').value.trim();
    const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
    const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
    const confirm = document.getElementById('confirm').value;
    if (!name) return showErr('Please enter your name.');
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) return showErr('Enter a valid email address.');
    if (password.length < 6) return showErr('Password must be at least 6 characters.');
    if (password !== confirm) return showErr('Passwords do not match.');
    if (!document.getElementById('terms').checked) return showErr('Please accept the terms to continue.');
    btn.classList.add('is-loading'); btn.disabled = true;
    const res = await Auth.register(name, email, password);
    if (!res.ok) return showErr(res.error);
    location.replace(Auth.afterAuthPath());
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

213	.step h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 8px}
214	.step p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px;font-size:14.5px}
215	
216	/* ============ CONVERGE ============ */
217	.converge{overflow:clip}
218	.cv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
219	.cv-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);will-change:transform;border:1px solid var(--line)}
220	.cv-img img{width:100%;height:clamp(240px,30vw,380px);object-fit:cover}
221	.cv-mid{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,50px) 0 0}
222	.cv-mid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
223	.cv-mid p{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
224	
225	/* ============ PERSONAL ============ */
226	.personal{background:var(--pine);color:#eaf5ec;position:relative;overflow:clip}
227	.personal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 46% at 78% 18%,rgba(188,226,58,.12),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 96px)}
228	.personal .wrap{position:relative}
229	.personal .eyebrow{color:var(--lime)}
230	.p-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
231	.p-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin:14px 0 16px;color:#f4faf2}
232	.p-grid .ptxt p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:440px}
233	.pref-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
234	.pchip{border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#cfe3d4;transition:.2s var(--ease)}
235	.pchip:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-2px)}
236	.pchip.on{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
237	.rec-wrap{position:relative}
238	.rec-core{background:rgba(234,245,236,.06);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
239	.rec-core .av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px var(--fs);flex:none}
240	.rec-core b{font-size:14.5px}
241	.rec-core span{display:block;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fb59c;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
242	.rec-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
243	.recard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.05);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,background .3s;will-change:transform}
244	.recard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.5);background:rgba(234,245,236,.09)}
245	.recard .th{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green-deep)}
246	.recard .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
247	.recard b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
248	.recard span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8fb59c}
249	.recard .match{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--fm);color:var(--lime);flex:none}
250	
251	/* ============ FIELDS / LOCATIONS ============ */
252	.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);align-items:start}
253	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
254	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
255	.fchip svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}
256	.fchip em{font:600 10px var(--fm);font-style:normal;color:var(--dim)}
257	.fchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
258	.locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
259	.loc{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
260	.loc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
261	.loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
262	.loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
263	.loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,43,29,.05),rgba(13,43,29,.78))}
264	.loc div{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
265	.loc b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;color:#f4faf2;font-weight:600}
266	.loc span{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lime);text-transform:uppercase}
267	.loc.soon{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center}
268	.loc.soon::after{display:none}
269	.loc.soon b{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
270	.loc.soon span{color:var(--dim)}
271	.loc.soon div{position:static;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
272	
273	/* ============ CAROUSEL ============ */
274	.newsec{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:clip}
275	.car{position:relative;cursor:grab}
276	.car.drag{cursor:grabbing}
277	.car-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;will-change:transform;padding:6px 0 10px}
278	.car-track .icard{width:280px;flex:none;pointer-events:none}
279	.car-hint{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);gap:14px;align-items:center}
280	.car-hint i{width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
281	
282	/* ============ BENEFITS ============ */
283	.ben{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,4.5vw,70px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
284	.ben+.ben{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
285	.ben h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 12px}
286	.ben .bt p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}
287	.ben .bt ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
288	.ben .bt li{display:flex;gap:11px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
289	.ben .bt li svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--green);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
290	.bvis{position:relative;min-height:300px}
291	.stack{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:15px 17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
292	.bvis:hover .stack{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg)!important}
293	.stack b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
294	.stack span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
295	.stack .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
296	.stack .dl{font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
297	.stack .dl.ok{color:var(--green)}
298	.check-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:22px;max-width:420px;margin:auto}
299	.check-card h4{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:14px}
300	.ck{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
301	.ck .bx{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none;border-radius:7px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
302	.ck .bx svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:3}
303	.in .ck .bx{transform:scale(1)}
304	.ck:nth-child(3) .bx{transition-delay:.15s}.ck:nth-child(4) .bx{transition-delay:.3s}.ck:nth-child(5) .bx{transition-delay:.45s}
305	.ck b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
306	.ck span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
307	.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px}
308	.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
309	.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
310	.tcard .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(23,122,76,.1);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
311	.tcard .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
312	.tcard b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
313	.tcard p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px}
314	
315	/* ============ CTA ============ */
316	.cta-panel{position:relative;overflow:clip;background:var(--pine);border-radius:26px;color:#eaf5ec;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) clamp(26px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
317	.cta-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.16),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
318	.cta-panel>*{position:relative}
319	.cta-panel h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f4faf2;max-width:720px;margin:16px auto 18px}
320	.cta-panel p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 30px}
321	.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
322	.cta-note{margin-top:26px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389}
323	
324	/* ============ FOOTER — public landing only ============ */
325	footer{margin-top:clamp(70px,8vw,110px);background:var(--pine2);color:#a9c2b0;border-top:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);position:relative;overflow:clip}
326	footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(46% 34% at 12% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.09),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
327	.ft{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:38px;padding:clamp(54px,6vw,76px) 0 44px}
328	.ft .brand{color:#f4faf2}
329	.ft .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
330	.ft .fb p{font-size:13.5px;max-width:290px;margin-top:16px}
331	.ft .fb .fmono{margin-top:18px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
332	.ft .fb .fmono::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
333	.ft h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389;margin-bottom:18px}
334	.ft ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
335	.ft ul a{font-size:13.5px;color:#a9c2b0;transition:color .2s,padding-left .3s var(--ease)}
336	.ft ul a:hover{color:var(--lime);padding-left:6px}
337	.ft-bar{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.09);padding:22px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
338	.top-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.2);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a9c2b0;transition:.25s}
339	.top-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}
340	.top-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
341	.ft-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(88px,17.5vw,250px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.05);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(188,226,58,.12);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(6%)}
342	
343	/* ============ JOURNEY WIDGET ============ */
344	.journey{position:fixed;right:26px;top:96px;z-index:90;width:212px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px}
345	.journey h5{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7}
346	.jrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
347	.jrow b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em}
348	.jline{position:relative;height:74px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);margin:14px 0 12px 4px}
349	.jline i{position:absolute;left:0;width:2px;background:var(--green);height:0%}
350	.jline::before,.jline::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2)}
351	.jline::before{top:-4px}
352	.jline::after{bottom:-4px;background:var(--green)}
353	.jdot{position:absolute;left:-5px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);border:2.5px solid var(--green);top:0%}
354	.jstages{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
355	.jstages li{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
356	.jstages li::before{content:"–"}
357	.jstages li.on{color:var(--green)}
358	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:400;background:var(--dark);color:#eef1e8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
359	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
360	
361	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
362	@media (max-width:1240px){.journey{display:none}}
363	@media (max-width:1020px){
364	  .nlinks{display:none}
365	  .nsign{display:none}
366	  .menu-btn{display:grid}
367	  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
368	  .hero-vis{height:480px;max-width:560px}
369	  .how .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
370	  .how-left{position:static}
371	  .p-grid,.f-grid,.ben{grid-template-columns:1fr}
372	  .ben .bvis{order:2;min-height:320px}
373	}
374	@media (max-width:640px){
375	  .hero{padding-top:120px}
376	  .ncta{padding:9px 15px}
377	  .searchbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
378	  .sb-q{padding:12px 14px}
379	  .sb-div{width:auto;height:1px;margin:0 8px}
380	  .sb-city{padding:11px 14px}
381	  .sb-btn{padding:13px;justify-content:center}
382	  .hero-vis{height:430px}
383	  .fc2{display:none}
384	  .cv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
385	  .trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}
386	  .locs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
387	  .ft{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
388	}
389	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
390	  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
391	  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
392	  [data-rev]{opacity:1;transform:none}
393	  .car{overflow-x:auto}
394	  .car-track .icard{pointer-events:auto}
395	}
396	</style>

452	      <h1 class="display">Find the right internship. <span class="hl">Without the search chaos.</span></h1>
453	      <p class="sub">InternHub gathers every open internship across Douala, Yaoundé, Buea and Bamenda — matched to your field, your city and your preferences, verified by our team, tracked to the deadline.</p>
454	      <form class="searchbar" id="searchForm">
455	        <div class="sb-q"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input id="q" placeholder="Internship, company or field…" autocomplete="off"></div>

458	        <button class="sb-btn" type="submit">Search<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
459	      </form>

461	        <a class="btn btn-lime" href="#discover">View all positions<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
462	        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#cta">Suggest opportunity<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg></a>
463	      </div>
464	      <div class="trust" id="trustRow"></div>
465	    </div>
466	    <div class="hero-vis" id="heroVis">
467	      <div class="hv-glow" data-plx="0.05"></div>

668	<script>
669	const L=[
670	 {id:1,t:"Software Engineering Intern",co:"Afrimax Technologies",city:"Douala",f:"Software Engineering",mode:"Hybrid",pay:"Paid",d:5,v:true,nw:true,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1498050108023-c5249f4df085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"},
671	 {id:2,t:"Data Analyst Intern",co:"Orange Cameroun",city:"Douala",f:"Data & AI",mode:"Hybrid",pay:"Paid",d:9,v:true,nw:true,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551288049-bebda4e38f71?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"},
672	 {id:3,t:"Graphic Design Intern",co:"Studio Kalisté",city:"Douala",f:"Design",mode:"On-site",pay:"Stipend",d:3,v:true,nw:true,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1561070791-2526d30994b5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"},
673	 {id:4,t:"UX Research Intern",co:"Minka Health",city:"Yaoundé",f:"Design",mode:"Remote",pay:"Paid",d:15,v:false,nw:false,img:null},
674	 {id:5,t:"AgriTech Intern",co:"AgriPro Cameroon",city:"Buea",f:"Agriculture",mode:"On-site",pay:"Stipend",d:10,v:true,nw:true,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500937386664-56d1dfef3854?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"},
675	 {id:6,t:"Finance Analyst Intern",co:"MTN Cameroun",city:"Douala",f:"Finance",mode:"On-site",pay:"Paid",d:6,v:true,nw:false,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1554224155-6726b3ff858f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"},
676	 {id:7,t:"Machine Learning Intern",co:"DataLab Africa",city:"Remote",f:"Data & AI",mode:"Remote",pay:"Unpaid",d:20,v:false,nw:false,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1461749280684-dccba630e2f6?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"},
677	 {id:8,t:"Public Health Intern",co:"Yaoundé General Hospital",city:"Yaoundé",f:"Health",mode:"On-site",pay:"Unpaid",d:22,v:false,nw:false,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1576091160399-112ba8d25d1d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"},
678	 {id:9,t:"Growth Marketing Intern",co:"Tokeri Ventures",city:"Remote",f:"Marketing",mode:"Remote",pay:"Stipend",d:8,v:true,nw:true,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1557804506-669a67965ba0?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"},
679	 {id:10,t:"Electrical Engineering Intern",co:"Eneo Cameroon",city:"Douala",f:"Engineering",mode:"On-site",pay:"Paid",d:14,v:true,nw:false,img:"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1581091226825-a6a2a5aee158?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=60"}
680	];
681	const FIELDS=["Software Engineering","Data & AI","Design","Finance","Agriculture","Engineering","Health","Marketing"];
682	const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
683	const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;");
684	const initials=n=>n.split(/\s+/).map(w=>w[0]).join("").slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
685	const reduced=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
686	const fbC={};function fbFor(n){if(fbC[n])return fbC[n];const s='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="400"><defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#177a4c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0d2b1d"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="600" height="400" fill="url(#g)"/><text x="300" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="110" font-weight="700" fill="rgba(188,226,58,.4)" text-anchor="middle">'+initials(n)+"</text></svg>";return fbC[n]="data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,"+encodeURIComponent(s);}
687	const dead=it=>it.d<=1?["Closes tomorrow",true]:it.d<=7?["Closes in "+it.d+"d",true]:["Closes in "+it.d+"d",false];
688	
689	function card(it){const[dt,wr]=dead(it);
690	 return `<article class="icard">
691	  <div class="ic-media">${it.img?`<img src="${it.img}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.outerHTML='<div class=noimg>${initials(it.co)}</div>'">`:`<div class="noimg">${initials(it.co)}</div>`}
692	   <div class="ic-badges">${it.nw?'<span class="bdg new">New</span>':""}${it.v?'<span class="bdg ver">Verified</span>':'<span class="bdg ver" style="color:#cfd6cd;border-color:rgba(207,214,205,.3)">Pending</span>'}</div>
693	   <button class="save" data-save="${it.id}" aria-label="Save internship"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 21l-7-5-7 5V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg></button></div>
694	  <div class="ic-body"><h3>${esc(it.t)}</h3><p class="ic-co">${esc(it.co)} · ${esc(it.city)}</p>
695	   <div class="ic-meta"><i>${esc(it.f)}</i><i>${esc(it.mode)}</i><i>${esc(it.pay)}</i></div></div>
696	  <div class="ic-foot"><span class="ic-dead${wr?" warn":""}">${dt}</span><span class="ic-link">Details<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></span></div></article>`;}
697	
698	const st={q:"",city:"",field:""};
699	function filtered(){return L.filter(it=>{
700	 if(st.city&&it.city!==st.city)return false;
701	 if(st.field&&it.f!==st.field)return false;
702	 if(st.q){const h=(it.t+" "+it.co+" "+it.f+" "+it.city).toLowerCase();if(!h.includes(st.q.toLowerCase()))return false;}
703	 return true;});}
704	function renderGrid(){const list=filtered();
705	 $("#gridDiscover").innerHTML=list.length?list.map(card).join(""):`<div class="empty"><b>No matches in the current index</b>Try clearing a filter — or suggest this opportunity and we'll chase it.<div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="clearF">Clear filters</button></div></div>`;
706	 $("#discCount").textContent=`Showing ${list.length} of ${L.length} open roles · updated this week`;
707	 const c=$("#clearF");if(c)c.addEventListener("click",()=>{st.q="";st.city="";st.field="";$("#q").value="";$("#citySel").value="";syncFieldChips();renderGrid();});}
708	$("#searchForm").addEventListener("submit",e=>{e.preventDefault();st.q=$("#q").value.trim();st.city=$("#citySel").value;renderGrid();$("#discover").scrollIntoView({behavior:reduced?"auto":"smooth"});toast("Index filtered — "+filtered().length+" matches.");});
709	document.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-save]");if(!b)return;b.classList.toggle("on");b.classList.remove("pop");void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add("pop");toast(b.classList.contains("on")?"Saved to your list.":"Removed from saved.");});
710	
711	const tk=FIELDS.concat(["Douala","Yaoundé","Buea","Bamenda","Verified weekly","Free for students"]);
712	$("#tkTrack").innerHTML=(tk.map(t=>`<span>${t}</span>`).join("")).repeat(2);
713	$("#trustRow").innerHTML=`<span><i></i><b>${L.length}</b>&nbsp;open roles</span><span><i></i><b>${new Set(L.map(x=>x.city)).size}</b>&nbsp;cities</span><span><i></i><b>100%</b>&nbsp;free for students</span>`;

213	.step.in::before{background:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(188,226,58,.3)}
214	.step .num{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--green)}
215	.step h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 8px}
216	.step p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px;font-size:14.5px}
217	
218	/* ============ CONVERGE ============ */
219	.converge{overflow:clip}
220	.cv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
221	.cv-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);will-change:transform;border:1px solid var(--line)}
222	.cv-img img{width:100%;height:clamp(240px,30vw,380px);object-fit:cover}
223	.cv-mid{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,50px) 0 0}
224	.cv-mid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
225	.cv-mid p{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
226	
227	/* ============ PERSONAL ============ */
228	.personal{background:var(--pine);color:#eaf5ec;position:relative;overflow:clip}
229	.personal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 46% at 78% 18%,rgba(188,226,58,.12),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 96px)}
230	.personal .wrap{position:relative}
231	.personal .eyebrow{color:var(--lime)}
232	.p-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
233	.p-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin:14px 0 16px;color:#f4faf2}
234	.p-grid .ptxt p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:440px}
235	.pref-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
236	.pchip{border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#cfe3d4;transition:.2s var(--ease)}
237	.pchip:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-2px)}
238	.pchip.on{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
239	.rec-wrap{position:relative}
240	.rec-core{background:rgba(234,245,236,.06);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
241	.rec-core .av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px var(--fs);flex:none}
242	.rec-core b{font-size:14.5px}
243	.rec-core span{display:block;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fb59c;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
244	.rec-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
245	.recard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.05);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,background .3s;will-change:transform}
246	.recard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.5);background:rgba(234,245,236,.09)}
247	.recard .th{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green-deep)}
248	.recard .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
249	.recard b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
250	.recard span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8fb59c}
251	.recard .match{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--fm);color:var(--lime);flex:none}
252	
253	/* ============ FIELDS / LOCATIONS ============ */
254	.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);align-items:start}
255	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
256	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
257	.fchip svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}
258	.fchip em{font:600 10px var(--fm);font-style:normal;color:var(--dim)}
259	.fchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
260	.locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
261	.loc{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
262	.loc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
263	.loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
264	.loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
265	.loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,43,29,.05),rgba(13,43,29,.78))}
266	.loc div{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
267	.loc b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;color:#f4faf2;font-weight:600}
268	.loc span{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lime);text-transform:uppercase}
269	.loc.soon{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center}
270	.loc.soon::after{display:none}
271	.loc.soon b{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
272	.loc.soon span{color:var(--dim)}
273	.loc.soon div{position:static;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
274	
275	/* ============ CAROUSEL ============ */
276	.newsec{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:clip}
277	.car{position:relative;cursor:grab}
278	.car.drag{cursor:grabbing}
279	.car-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;will-change:transform;padding:6px 0 10px}
280	.car-track .icard{width:280px;flex:none;pointer-events:none}
281	.car-hint{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);gap:14px;align-items:center}
282	.car-hint i{width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
283	
284	/* ============ BENEFITS ============ */
285	.ben{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,4.5vw,70px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
286	.ben+.ben{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
287	.ben h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 12px}
288	.ben .bt p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}
289	.ben .bt ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
290	.ben .bt li{display:flex;gap:11px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
291	.ben .bt li svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--green);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
292	.bvis{position:relative;min-height:300px}
293	.stack{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:15px 17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
294	.bvis:hover .stack{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg)!important}
295	.stack b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
296	.stack span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
297	.stack .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
298	.stack .dl{font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
299	.stack .dl.ok{color:var(--green)}
300	.check-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:22px;max-width:420px;margin:auto}
301	.check-card h4{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:14px}
302	.ck{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
303	.ck .bx{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none;border-radius:7px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
304	.ck .bx svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:3}
305	.in .ck .bx{transform:scale(1)}
306	.ck:nth-child(3) .bx{transition-delay:.15s}.ck:nth-child(4) .bx{transition-delay:.3s}.ck:nth-child(5) .bx{transition-delay:.45s}
307	.ck b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
308	.ck span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
309	.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px}
310	.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
311	.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
312	.tcard .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(23,122,76,.1);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
313	.tcard .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
314	.tcard b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
315	.tcard p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px}
316	
317	/* ============ CTA ============ */
318	.cta-panel{position:relative;overflow:clip;background:var(--pine);border-radius:26px;color:#eaf5ec;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) clamp(26px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
319	.cta-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.16),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
320	.cta-panel>*{position:relative}
321	.cta-panel h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f4faf2;max-width:720px;margin:16px auto 18px}
322	.cta-panel p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 30px}
323	.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
324	.cta-note{margin-top:26px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389}
325	
326	/* ============ FOOTER — public landing only ============ */
327	footer{margin-top:clamp(70px,8vw,110px);background:var(--pine2);color:#a9c2b0;border-top:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);position:relative;overflow:clip}
328	footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(46% 34% at 12% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.09),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
329	.ft{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:38px;padding:clamp(54px,6vw,76px) 0 44px}
330	.ft .brand{color:#f4faf2}
331	.ft .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
332	.ft .fb p{font-size:13.5px;max-width:290px;margin-top:16px}
333	.ft .fb .fmono{margin-top:18px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
334	.ft .fb .fmono::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
335	.ft h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389;margin-bottom:18px}
336	.ft ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
337	.ft ul a{font-size:13.5px;color:#a9c2b0;transition:color .2s,padding-left .3s var(--ease)}
338	.ft ul a:hover{color:var(--lime);padding-left:6px}
339	.ft-bar{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.09);padding:22px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
340	.top-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.2);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a9c2b0;transition:.25s}
341	.top-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}
342	.top-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
343	.ft-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(88px,17.5vw,250px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.05);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(188,226,58,.12);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(6%)}
344	
345	/* ============ JOURNEY WIDGET ============ */
346	.journey{position:fixed;right:26px;top:96px;z-index:90;width:212px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px}
347	.journey h5{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7}
348	.jrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
349	.jrow b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em}
350	.jline{position:relative;height:74px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);margin:14px 0 12px 4px}
351	.jline i{position:absolute;left:0;width:2px;background:var(--green);height:0%}
352	.jline::before,.jline::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2)}
353	.jline::before{top:-4px}
354	.jline::after{bottom:-4px;background:var(--green)}
355	.jdot{position:absolute;left:-5px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);border:2.5px solid var(--green);top:0%}
356	.jstages{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
357	.jstages li{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
358	.jstages li::before{content:"–"}
359	.jstages li.on{color:var(--green)}
360	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:400;background:var(--dark);color:#eef1e8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
361	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
362	
363	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
364	@media (max-width:1240px){.journey{display:none}}
365	@media (max-width:1020px){
366	  .nlinks{display:none}
367	  .nsign{display:none}
368	  .menu-btn{display:grid}
369	  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
370	  .hero-vis{height:480px;max-width:560px}
371	  .how .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
372	  .how-left{position:static}
373	  .p-grid,.f-grid,.ben{grid-template-columns:1fr}
374	  .ben .bvis{order:2;min-height:320px}
375	}
376	@media (max-width:640px){
377	  .hero{padding-top:120px}
378	  .ncta{padding:9px 15px}
379	  .searchbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
380	  .sb-q{padding:12px 14px}
381	  .sb-div{width:auto;height:1px;margin:0 8px}
382	  .sb-city{padding:11px 14px}
383	  .sb-btn{padding:13px;justify-content:center}
384	  .hero-vis{height:430px}
385	  .fc2{display:none}
386	  .cv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
387	  .trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}
388	  .locs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
389	  .ft{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
390	}
391	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
392	  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
393	  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
394	  [data-rev]{opacity:1;transform:none}
395	  .car{overflow-x:auto}
396	  .car-track .icard{pointer-events:auto}
397	}
398	</style>

479	<!-- ============ HOW ============ -->

654	<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-auth-compat.js"></script>
655	<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js"></script>
656	<script src="assets/js/firebase-config.js"></script>
657	<script src="assets/js/lib/ui.js"></script>
658	<script src="assets/js/services/platform.js"></script>

662	<script>
663	(function(){
664	  "use strict";
665	  const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
666	  const reduced=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
667	  const ICON={
668	    bookmark:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 21l-7-5-7 5V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>',
669	    arrow:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>'
670	  };
671	  const DEFAULT_FIC='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="7" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M9 7V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2M3 12.5h18"/></svg>';
672	  const FICO={
673	    'Software Engineering':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 6l-5 6 5 6M16 6l5 6-5 6"/></svg>',
674	    'Data & AI':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-8M22 20H2"/></svg>',
675	    Design:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 19l7-7 3 3-7 7-3-3z"/><path d="M18 13l-1.5-7.5L2 2l3.5 14.5L13 18l5-5z"/></svg>',
676	    Finance:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v10M15 9.5c0-1.4-1.3-2.5-3-2.5s-3 1.1-3 2.5 1.3 2.5 3 2.5 3 1.1 3 2.5-1.3 2.5-3 2.5-3-1.1-3-2.5"/></svg>',
677	    Agriculture:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 22V8"/><path d="M12 8C12 4 9 2 5 2c0 4 3 6 7 6zM12 12c0-4 3-6 7-6 0 4-3 6-7 6z"/></svg>',
678	    Engineering:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 2L3 14h7l-1 8 10-12h-7l1-8z"/></svg>',
679	    Health:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/></svg>',
680	    Marketing:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 11l18-8v18L3 13v-2z"/><path d="M7 13v6a2 2 0 0 0 4 0v-4"/></svg>'
681	  };
682	  const S={data:[],fields:[],locations:[],categories:[]};
683	  const st={q:"",city:"",field:""};
684	  let prefs=new Set();
685	
686	  const count=(arr)=>arr.length;
687	  const citiesPresent=()=>new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.city).filter(Boolean));
688	  const detailHref=(id)=>'internship.html?id='+encodeURIComponent(id);
689	
690	  function card(it){
691	    const dl=UI.deadlineInfo(it);
692	    const warn=dl.days!==null&&dl.days<=7;
693	    const saved=Auth.profile&&Saved.has(it.id);
694	    const href=detailHref(it.id);
695	    const ini=UI.esc(UI.initials(it.company||'—'));
696	    const media=it.image
697	      ? `<img src="${UI.esc(it.image)}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.outerHTML='<div class=noimg>${ini}</div>'">`
698	      : `<div class="noimg">${ini}</div>`;
699	    const badges=(UI.isNew(it)?'<span class="bdg new">New</span>':'')
700	      + (it.verified?'<span class="bdg ver">Verified</span>':'<span class="bdg ver" style="color:#cfd6cd;border-color:rgba(207,214,205,.3)">Pending</span>');
701	    return `<article class="icard">
702	      <div class="ic-media">${media}
703	        <div class="ic-badges">${badges}</div>
704	        <button class="save${saved?' on':''}" data-save="${UI.esc(it.id)}" aria-pressed="${saved}" aria-label="${saved?'Remove from saved':'Save internship'}">${ICON.bookmark}</button></div>
705	      <div class="ic-body"><h3><a href="${href}">${UI.esc(it.title||'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
706	        <p class="ic-co">${UI.esc(it.company||'—')} · ${UI.esc(it.city||'Cameroon')}</p>
707	        <div class="ic-meta"><i>${UI.esc(it.field||'Internship')}</i>${it.workMode?`<i>${UI.esc(it.workMode)}</i>`:''}${it.stipend?`<i>${UI.esc(it.stipend)}</i>`:''}</div></div>
708	      <div class="ic-foot"><span class="ic-dead${warn?' warn':''}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span><a class="ic-link" href="${href}">Details${ICON.arrow}</a></div></article>`;
709	  }
710	
711	  function filtered(){return S.data.filter(it=>{
712	    if(st.city&&it.city!==st.city)return false;
713	    if(st.field&&it.field!==st.field)return false;
714	    if(st.q){const h=(it.title+' '+it.company+' '+it.field+' '+it.city).toLowerCase();if(!h.includes(st.q.toLowerCase()))return false;}
715	    return true;});}
716	
717	  function renderGrid(){
718	    const g=$('#gridDiscover'); const list=filtered();
719	    if(!S.data.length){
720	      g.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><b>The index is being built</b>Our team is verifying the first internships now. Browse again shortly, or suggest an opportunity and we'll chase it down.</div>`;
721	      $('#discCount').textContent='';
722	    }else if(!list.length){
723	      g.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><b>No matches in the current index</b>Try clearing a filter — or suggest this opportunity and we'll chase it.<div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="clearF">Clear filters</button></div></div>`;
724	      $('#discCount').textContent=`Showing 0 of ${count(S.data)} open roles`;
725	      const c=$('#clearF');if(c)c.addEventListener("click",clearFilters);
726	    }else{
727	      g.innerHTML=list.map(card).join("");
728	      $('#discCount').textContent=`Showing ${count(list)} of ${count(S.data)} open roles`;
729	    }
730	  }
731	
732	  function clearFilters(){st.q="";st.city="";st.field="";const q=$('#q');const cs=$('#citySel');if(q)q.value="";if(cs)cs.value="";syncFieldChips();renderGrid();}
733	
734	  function renderCitySel(){
735	    const cs=$('#citySel'); if(!cs)return;
736	    const cities=(S.locations||[]).filter(c=>c!=='Remote').concat(['Remote']);
737	    cs.innerHTML='<option value="">All cities</option>'+cities.map(c=>`<option${c===st.city?' selected':''}>${UI.esc(c)}</option>`).join("");
738	  }
739	
740	  function renderHero(){
741	    const pill=$('#hvPill'); if(pill) pill.textContent=S.data.length?`${count(S.data)} open listings`:'Live index';
742	    const pool=S.data.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.verified?1:0)-(a.verified?1:0));
743	    ['#fc1','#fc2','#fc3'].forEach((sel,i)=>{const el=$(sel);if(!el)return;const it=pool[i];
744	      if(!it){el.style.display='none';return;}
745	      const dl=UI.deadlineInfo(it);const warn=dl.days!==null&&dl.days<=7;
746	      el.style.display='';
747	      el.querySelector('.fc-in').innerHTML=
748	        `<div class="fc-top"><span class="fc-av">${UI.esc(UI.initials(it.company||'—'))}</span><div><b>${UI.esc(it.title||'Role')}</b><span>${UI.esc(it.company||'')}</span></div></div>
749	         <div class="fc-meta">${it.verified?'<i class="v">Verified</i>':''}${it.workMode?`<i>${UI.esc(it.workMode)}</i>`:''}${dl.days!==null?`<i class="${warn?'d':''}">${UI.esc(dl.days<0?'Closed':dl.label)}</i>`:''}</div>`;
750	    });
751	  }
752	
753	  function renderTicker(){
754	    const tk=(S.fields||[]).slice(0,8).concat(S.locations||[]).concat(['Verified weekly','Free for students']);
755	    $('#tkTrack').innerHTML=(tk.map(t=>`<span>${UI.esc(t)}</span>`).join("")).repeat(2);
756	  }
757	
758	  function renderTrust(){
759	    $('#trustRow').innerHTML=`<span><i></i><b>${count(S.data)}</b>&nbsp;open roles</span><span><i></i><b>${citiesPresent().size}</b>&nbsp;cities</span><span><i></i><b>100%</b>&nbsp;free for students</span>`;
760	  }
761	
762	  function renderFieldChips(){
763	    const fields=S.fields&&S.fields.length?S.fields:[...new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.field).filter(Boolean))];
764	    $('#fieldChips').innerHTML=fields.map((f,i)=>`<button class="fchip" data-f="${UI.esc(f)}" data-rev style="transition-delay:${i*45}ms">${FICO[f]||DEFAULT_FIC}${UI.esc(f)}<em>${count(S.data.filter(x=>x.field===f))}</em></button>`).join("");
765	    syncFieldChips();
766	  }
767	  function syncFieldChips(){document.querySelectorAll("#fieldChips .fchip").forEach(b=>{const on=b.dataset.f===st.field;b.style.borderColor=on?"var(--green)":"";b.style.background=on?"var(--lime)":"";b.style.color=on?"var(--lime-ink)":"";});}
768	
769	  function renderLocs(){
770	    const locs=S.locations&&S.locations.length?S.locations:[...citiesPresent()];
771	    $('#locTiles').innerHTML=locs.map((c,i)=>{
772	      const n=count(S.data.filter(x=>x.city===c));
773	      return `<button class="loc${n?'':' soon'}" data-city="${UI.esc(c)}" data-rev style="transition-delay:${i*45}ms;${n?'background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--pine))':''}"><div><b>${UI.esc(c)}</b><span>${n?n+' open':'soon'}</span></div></button>`;
774	    }).join("");
775	  }
776	
777	  function seedPrefs(){
778	    const pf=(Auth.profile&&Auth.profile.preferences&&Auth.profile.preferences.fields)||[];
779	    const pool=(S.fields&&S.fields.length)?S.fields:[...new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.field).filter(Boolean))];
780	    let base=pf.filter(f=>pool.includes(f));
781	    if(!base.length){const counts={};S.data.forEach(d=>{if(d.field)counts[d.field]=(counts[d.field]||0)+1;});base=Object.entries(counts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,2).map(x=>x[0]);}
782	    prefs=new Set(base);
783	  }
784	  function renderPrefChips(){
785	    const pool=(S.fields&&S.fields.length)?S.fields:[...new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.field).filter(Boolean))];
