#### Thinking

`UI.initReveals` observes `[data-rev]:not(.in)` with threshold 0.12 + rootMargin. Spec uses .16 and separately handles `[data-rev-group]` children with `i*70ms` stagger and `ioStep` at .5 for `.step`.

Difference: current index.html adds `data-rev` + inline `transition-delay:i*45ms` on field chips and loc tiles inside `data-rev-group` containers. But the grid (`#gridDiscover`) and `#recList`/`.trio` children: `#gridDiscover` has `data-rev-group` but its children are created later and have no `data-rev` → they never animate (whole grid has no data-rev either... wait `#gridDiscover` itself has `data-rev-group` only, not `data-rev`. So `UI.initReveals` finds nothing for the grid → cards just appear with no reveal. The `.trio` has `data-rev-group` too, and its children (tcards) have no data-rev → no animation.

So the spec's group-stagger behaviour is genuinely missing. To restore faithfully: implement spec-style reveal in index.html:
- `io` threshold .16 observing `[data-rev]`
- `[data-rev-group]` children get `data-rev=""` + `transition-delay:i*70ms`
- `ioStep` threshold .5 for `.step`

But groups are populated AFTER data loads (gridDiscover, fieldChips, locTiles, recList, trio). So the group-stagger pass must run after renderAll, on dynamically added children. Solution: a `reveal(root)` function that (a) observes any `[data-rev]:not(.in)` and (b) converts `[data-rev-group]` children, then call it after each render (or after renderAll + after renderGrid/renderFieldChips/renderLocs re-renders).

Careful: repeated calls must not re-add delays to already-processed children. Use a marker: skip children that already have `data-rev` attribute. Spec: `[...g.children].forEach((c,i)=>{c.setAttribute("data-rev","");...})`. If called twice, it would reset delays (same values) and re-observe already-`.in` elements → they'd stay `.in` since observer adds `in` when intersecting; already `.in` elements being re-observed is harmless. But to be safe, skip elements already having `data-rev` attr, and unobserve after.

Implementation plan for `revealScan(root)`:
```js
let io,ioStep;
function initRevealObservers(){
  if(!("IntersectionObserver" in window)||reduced){
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-rev]").forEach(el=>el.classList.add("in"));
    document.querySelectorAll(".step").forEach(el=>el.classList.add("in"));
    return;
  }
  io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.16});
  ioStep=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");ioStep.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.5});
}
function revealScan(root){
  if(!io){ // reduced/no IO
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev]:not(.in),.step:not(.in)").forEach(el=>el.classList.add("in"));
    return;
  }
  root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev-group]").forEach(g=>{
    [...g.children].forEach((c,i)=>{ if(c.hasAttribute("data-rev"))return; c.setAttribute("data-rev",""); c.style.transitionDelay=(i*70)+"ms"; });
  });
  root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev]:not(.in)").forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
  root.querySelectorAll(".step:not(.in)").forEach(el=>ioStep.observe(el));
}
```

```js
  let io=null,ioStep=null;
  function initReveals(){
    if(!("IntersectionObserver" in window)||reduced)return;
    io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.16});
    ioStep=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");ioStep.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.5});
  }
  function revealScan(root){
    if(!io){root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev]:not(.in),.step:not(.in)").forEach(el=>el.classList.add("in"));return;}
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev-group]").forEach(g=>{
      [...g.children].forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.hasAttribute("data-rev"))return;c.setAttribute("data-rev","");c.style.transitionDelay=(i*70)+"ms";});
    });
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev]:not(.in)").forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
    root.querySelectorAll(".step:not(.in)").forEach(el=>ioStep.observe(el));
  }
```
Careful: `.step` elements also have `data-rev` in markup (`<div class="step" data-rev>`). So they'd be observed by both io (.16) and ioStep (.5). Spec: io observes all `[data-rev]` including steps → steps get `.in` at .16; ioStep ALSO observes `.step` at .5 → also adds `.in`. Redundant but harmless — the earlier of the two wins (io at .16). So the step dot lights when 16% visible. Spec behaviour. Keep faithful: both observe.

Wait — but `[data-rev]:not(.in)` — since both add `.in`, whichever fires first. Fine.

But `.step` needs `.in` for the dot; with reduced motion, transitions are .01ms so it's fine either way. Also the group children don't get data-rev in that branch — the CSS media query only targets `[data-rev]`. Since we add `.in` directly to all `[data-rev]`, and group children lack the attribute, they're visible by default (no opacity:0 rule applies). ✓

  function showError(){
    const g=$('#gridDiscover'); if(g)g.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><b>Couldn't load the index</b>There was a problem reaching the database. Check your connection and reload.</div>`;

  let io=null,ioStep=null;
  function initReveals(){
    if(!("IntersectionObserver" in window)||reduced)return;
    io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.16});
    ioStep=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");ioStep.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.5});
  }
  function revealScan(root){
    if(!io){root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev]:not(.in),.step:not(.in)").forEach(el=>el.classList.add("in"));return;}
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev-group]").forEach(g=>{
      [...g.children].forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.hasAttribute("data-rev"))return;c.setAttribute("data-rev","");c.style.transitionDelay=(i*70)+"ms";});
    });
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-rev]:not(.in)").forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
    root.querySelectorAll(".step:not(.in)").forEach(el=>ioStep.observe(el));
  }

- n === 0 → if LOCI[c] exists: still show the image tile (spec-faithful, interactive, "0 open")? or soon?

Cleanest, spec-faithful and honest:
- If LOCI[c] (curated city with imagery): always image tile, interactive, label = n ? `${n} open` : 'soon'.
- Else (no curated imagery): n ? gradient interactive tile with `${n} open` : non-interactive soon tile.

```js
async () => {
  const q = s => document.querySelector(s);
  const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const out = {};
  await sleep(2500); // let firestore + images settle

  // permitted published query
  try {
    const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('internships').where('published','==',true).get();
    out.publishedDocs = snap.size;
  } catch (e) { out.publishedDocs = 'ERR ' + String(e).slice(0,80); }

  out.locs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#locTiles .loc')].map(l => ({
    city: (l.querySelector('b')||{}).textContent,
    label: (l.querySelector('span')||{}).textContent,
    soon: l.classList.contains('soon'),
    clickable: l.tagName === 'BUTTON',
    img: !!l.querySelector('img'),
    imgLoaded: l.querySelector('img') ? l.querySelector('img').naturalWidth > 0 : null,
    imgH: l.querySelector('img') ? l.querySelector('img').getBoundingClientRect().height : null
  }));

  // scroll through the page and sample the journey widget
  const H = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight;
  const samples = [];
  for (const f of [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99]) {
    scrollTo(0, H * f);
    await sleep(320);
    samples.push({
      at: Math.round(f*100) + '%',
      stage: q('#jStage').textContent,
      prog: q('#jProg').textContent,
      fill: q('#jFill').style.height,
      dot: q('#jDot').style.top,
      on: [...document.querySelectorAll('#jStages li.on')].map(li => li.dataset.s),
      nav: q('#nav').classList.contains('scrolled'),
      rail: q('#railFill').style.transform,
      cvL: q('#cvL').style.transform.slice(0, 34),
      cvR: q('#cvR').style.transform.slice(0, 34),
      stepsIn: [...document.querySelectorAll('.step')].filter(s=>s.classList.contains('in')).length,
      reveals: document.querySelectorAll('[data-rev].in').length + '/' + document.querySelectorAll('[data-rev]').length
    });
  }
  out.samples = samples;
  out.hero = { floats: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-float]')].map(f=>f.dataset.float+':'+f.style.transform.slice(0,30)), plx: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-plx]')].map(f=>f.style.transform) };
  // carousel motion
  const t0 = q('#carTrack').style.transform;
  await sleep(600);
  const t1 = q('#carTrack').style.transform;
  out.car = { children: q('#carTrack').children.length, t0, t1, moved: t0 !== t1, half: q('#carTrack').scrollWidth/2, text: (q('#carTrack').textContent||'').slice(0,50) };
  scrollTo(0,0);
  out.hOverflow = document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth;
  return out;
}
```

33	const Settings = (() => {
34	  let cache = null;
35	  let unsub = null;
36	
37	  function merged(data) {
38	    return { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...(data || {}), settings: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...(data || {}) } };
39	  }
40	
41	  return {
42	    DEFAULT: DEFAULT_CONFIG,
43	    get data() { return cache || merged(null); },
44	
45	    /** Live subscription (admin). Public pages can call load() once. */
46	    subscribe(cb) {
47	      if (unsub) return unsub;
48	      unsub = firebaseDB.collection('platform').doc('config')
49	        .onSnapshot((snap) => {
50	          cache = snap.exists ? merged(snap.data()) : merged(null);
51	          if (cb) cb(cache);
52	        }, () => { cache = merged(null); if (cb) cb(cache); });
53	      return unsub;
54	    },
55	
56	    async load() {
57	      if (cache) return cache;
58	      try {
59	        const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('platform').doc('config').get();
60	        cache = merged(snap.exists ? snap.data() : null);
61	      } catch (_) { cache = merged(null); }
62	      return cache;
63	    },
64	
65	    async save(patch) {
66	      const user = Auth.profile;
67	      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
68	      try {
69	        await firebaseDB.collection('platform').doc('config')
70	          .set({ ...patch, updatedAt: serverTs() }, { merge: true });
71	        cache = merged({ ...cache, ...patch });
72	        return { ok: true };
73	      } catch (err) { return { ok: false, error: err.message }; }
74	    },
75	
76	    async addVocab(kind, value) {
77	      const v = String(value || '').trim();
78	      if (!v || !['fields', 'categories', 'locations'].includes(kind)) return { ok: false, error: 'Invalid field' };
79	      const data = await this.load();
80	      const list = new Set(data[kind] || []);
81	      if (list.has(v)) return { ok: true };
82	      list.add(v);
83	      return this.save({ [kind]: [...list] });
84	    },
85	
86	    async removeVocab(kind, value) {
87	      const data = await this.load();
88	      const list = (data[kind] || []).filter((x) => x !== value);
89	      return this.save({ [kind]: list });
90	    }
91	  };
92	})();

94	const Activity = (() => {
95	  const col = () => firebaseDB.collection('activity');
96	
97	  function normalize(doc) {
98	    const d = doc.data();
99	    return { id: doc.id, ...d, createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt) };
100	  }
101	
102	  return {
103	    /** Admin-only write (enforced by rules). Never blocks the caller's action. */
104	    async log({ action, targetType, targetId = '', targetTitle = '', summary = '' }) {
105	      const user = Auth.profile;
106	      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return;
107	      try {
108	        await col().add({
109	          action, targetType, targetId, targetTitle, summary,
110	          actor: user.displayName || user.email,
111	          actorUid: user.uid,
112	          createdAt: serverTs()
113	        });
114	      } catch (err) { console.error('Activity.log failed:', err); }
115	    },
116	
117	    async recent(limit = 12) {
118	      try {
119	        const snap = await col().orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').limit(limit).get();
120	        return snap.docs.map(normalize);
121	      } catch (err) { console.error('Activity.recent failed:', err); return []; }
122	    },
123	
124	    subscribe(limit, cb) {
125	      return col().orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').limit(limit)
126	        .onSnapshot((snap) => cb(snap.docs.map(normalize)), () => cb([]));
127	    }
128	  };
129	})();

131	const Analytics = (() => {
132	  const DAY = 86400000;
133	
134	  function since(range) {
135	    if (range === 'all') return null;
136	    const days = range === '7' ? 7 : range === '30' ? 30 : 90;
137	    return new Date(Date.now() - days * DAY);
138	  }
139	
140	  function inRange(dateObj, from) {
141	    if (!from) return true;
142	    const d = UI.toDate(dateObj);
143	    return d && d >= from;
144	  }
145	
146	  function bucket(items, keyFn, from) {
147	    const out = {};
148	    items.forEach((it) => {
149	      if (!inRange(it.createdAt, from)) return;
150	      const k = keyFn(it) || 'Unspecified';
151	      out[k] = (out[k] || 0) + 1;
152	    });
153	    return out;
154	  }
155	
156	  return {
157	    async internships() {
158	      try {
159	        const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('internships').get();
160	        return snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data(), createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt), publishedAt: UI.toDate(d.publishedAt) }));
161	      } catch (_) { return []; }
162	    },
163	    async users() {
164	      try {
165	        const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('users').get();
166	        return snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data(), createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt) }));
167	      } catch (_) { return []; }
168	    },
169	    async suggestions() {
170	      try {
171	        const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('suggestions').get();
172	        return snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data(), createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt) }));
173	      } catch (_) { return []; }
174	    },
175	
176	    /** Real metrics for a range: '7' | '30' | '90' | 'all'. */
177	    async summary(range = '30') {
178	      const from = since(range);
179	      const [ints, users, sugg] = await Promise.all([this.internships(), this.users(), this.suggestions()]);
180	      const published = ints.filter((i) => i.published);
181	      const verified = ints.filter((i) => i.verified);
182	      const newInts = ints.filter((i) => inRange(i.createdAt, from));
183	      const newUsers = users.filter((u) => inRange(u.createdAt, from));
184	
185	      return {
186	        range,
187	        totals: {
188	          internships: ints.length,
189	          published: published.length,
190	          verified: verified.length,
191	          students: users.length,
192	          suggestions: sugg.length,
193	          pendingSuggestions: sugg.filter((s) => (s.status || 'pending') === 'pending').length
194	        },
195	        growth: {
196	          internships: newInts.length,
197	          students: newUsers.length
198	        },
199	        byField: bucket(newInts, (i) => i.field, from),
200	        byLocation: bucket(newInts, (i) => i.city, from),
201	        recentlyAdded: newInts.slice().sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0)).slice(0, 8),
202	        suggestionStatus: bucket(sugg, (s) => s.status || 'pending', null)
203	      };
204	    }
205	  };
206	})();

Now I have the full picture of the design system. Let me plan Page 2 implementation.

Key decisions:
1. The current page uses `shell.js` frame (green sidebar + topbar). The spec's student dashboard has its own topbar/sidebar. Per §02 priority: MANDATORY DESIGN wins, but §14 says preserve functional system, and §15 says admin sidebar should keep green/mint structural panel. The memory says: "keep classmate's WHITE image-rich landing as homepage base". Hmm, that's for landing.

For the student dashboard, the spec has a LIGHT sidebar (`background:#f7f8f5`) with a topbar. But the current shell.js provides a GREEN sidebar (`--pine`). §09 says "GREEN / MINT STRUCTURAL PANEL + WHITE / LIGHT MAIN CONTENT AREA + CONTROLLED GREEN ACCENTS" is already correct — DO NOT CHANGE. The green sidebar is the "structural panel". So keeping shell.js's green sidebar is consistent with §09 AND with the previous session's work (#35 "Unify green sidebar panel (student + admin)", #36 verified).

So: keep shell.js frame (green sidebar + topbar + bell + account menu + footer), and restore INTO the main content area all of the spec's features: hero, chips, toolbar, filters, results head, grid, empty, cta, modal. Plus add to the sidebar the DISCOVER quick links and PROFILE STRENGTH card and Saved nav item + badge.

Wait — but shell.js is shared across all student pages. Adding DISCOVER quick links + profile strength card to the sidebar would affect all student pages. Hmm. The spec's browse page probably has a different sidebar. Let me check the spec browse_internship.html sidebar quickly to decide whether sidebar sections should be per-page (injected by the page) or global.

Better approach: shell.js supports an optional per-page sidebar extension. Let me check what the spec browse page's sidebar contains. Let me grep the spec files for `sb-label` / `sb-card` / `discover` to see per-page sidebar content.

Also I need to add a "Saved" nav entry to STUDENT_NAV? The standing constraint says "No Saved page". The spec's Saved nav switches the dashboard to saved-only view. In the current app, shell nav items are real links. So for the dashboard page, I can make the sidebar's Saved button switch to the saved view (in-page), which satisfies the spec's feature without creating a Saved page.

Since shell.js builds the sidebar generically, the cleanest approach: shell.js exposes a hook for pages to inject extra sidebar content (e.g. `window.ShellSide` or a data attribute). Let me look at how the spec browse page structures its sidebar to determine if the DISCOVER/PROFILE sections are dashboard-specific.

#### Thinking

So across the spec's student pages, the sidebar consistently has: Dashboard, Browse internships, Saved (+nbadge), Suggest internship, and a bottom `.sb-card` (per-page content: dashboard → PROFILE STRENGTH; browse/suggest → an `ol` with numbered tips).

The current shell.js STUDENT_NAV = dashboard, browse, whats-new, suggest — no Saved. The spec student sidebars have Dashboard / Browse / Saved / Suggest (the account page spec has Dashboard/Browse/What's New/Suggest/Saved). Let me check the account spec sidebar items: lines 218-239 → Dashboard, Browse, What's New, Suggest, Saved (with data-toast "No saved internships yet"). Hmm.

So across specs, "Saved" appears in the sidebar of every student page. That means shell.js's STUDENT_NAV should include a Saved entry. But the standing constraint is "No Saved page". The spec never navigates to a saved page — Saved toggles a saved-only view within the current page (`go('saved')` on the dashboard; on browse, `#sbSaved` probably switches view too).

Design decision: Add "Saved" to shell.js's STUDENT_NAV as a real link to `student_pages/dashboard.html?view=saved` — the dashboard implements the saved-only view. That keeps one page (no Saved page), preserves the sidebar feature, and works from any student page. And the dashboard reads `?view=saved` on load to start in saved view.

Hmm, but is that "inventing"? The spec's Saved button switches to a saved-only listing view. Making it a link to dashboard?view=saved is the faithful multi-page equivalent. Good. And the badge count must show saved count → shell.js can update it from Saved.ids after load.

Also the sidebar `.sb-card` is per-page content. I'll add a hook in shell.js: a `<template id="side-card">` or a designated element in `#view` that gets moved into the sidebar. Simplest: page includes `<div id="view">…</div>` and optionally `<aside data-sidecard>` outside `#view`; shell moves it into `.sidenav-foot` (before Account link) — for the student frame. Hmm, but shell does `document.body.innerHTML = build(...)`, which destroys anything outside `#view`. Actually it moves `#view` into `#view-slot` — but the innerHTML replacement happens BEFORE the move? Let's re-read:

```js
const view = document.getElementById('view');
const active = document.body.dataset.nav || '';
document.body.innerHTML = mode === 'admin' ? buildAdmin(active) : buildStudent(active);
const slot = document.getElementById('view-slot');
if (view && view.children.length) slot.appendChild(view);
```

`view` is a detached reference to the original `#view` element (innerHTML replacement removes it from the DOM but the JS reference survives), then it's appended into the new slot. So any element outside `#view` gets destroyed. Therefore, per-page sidebar extras must live INSIDE `#view` and be moved out by the page script, OR shell must collect them before replacing.

Cleanest: shell, before replacing body.innerHTML, collects elements with `[data-sidecard]` (anywhere in body) into a variable and injects them into the sidebar after build. That's a small, well-contained change to shell.js that benefits dashboard (profile strength) and later browse/suggest pages (their `.sb-card` tips).

Let me implement:
```js
const sideCards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-sidecard]')];
document.body.innerHTML = ...;
// move #view
const sideSlot = document.getElementById('sidenav-extra');
sideCards.forEach(el => sideSlot.appendChild(el));
```
And add `<div class="sidenav-extra" id="sidenav-extra"></div>` in buildStudent between `.sidenav-list` and `.sidenav-foot`. Also for admin (harmless; admin specs may have side cards too — I'll check later).

Also need "Saved" nav item with badge in STUDENT_NAV. But STUDENT_NAV items render as `<a class="nav-item" href>`. I need a badge span. I'll extend `navList()` to support an optional `badge` key: `{ key:'saved', href:'student_pages/dashboard.html?view=saved', icon:'bookmark', label:'Saved', badge:'saved-count' }` → renders `<span class="nav-badge" data-saved-badge hidden>0</span>`. Then shell updates it from `Saved.ids.size` after `Saved.load()`.

Does shell currently load Saved? No. `Notifications.load()` for students. I'll add `Saved.load().then(updateSavedBadges)` for signed-in students. Careful: Saved.load requires Auth.profile. Fine.

CSS: `.nav-badge` on green sidebar. Existing `.badge-count` in ui.css is green bg/white text — on the pine sidebar with lime active state, a lime badge reads better. I'll add a `.nav-badge` rule in app.css.

Now the DISCOVER quick links: in the spec they're inside `.discover` after the nav buttons, with three field links and counts. That's page-specific content (dashboard). Actually browse spec doesn't have `.discover`. So DISCOVER goes in the dashboard page as a `data-sidecard`-style extra... but it belongs right after the nav list, before the sb-card. I'll allow two hooks: `[data-sideblock]` (inserted after nav list) and `[data-sidecard]` (inserted at the bottom, above foot). Simpler: one hook `[data-side]` inserted into `#sidenav-extra` which sits between `.sidenav-list` and `.sidenav-foot`; the page can put both the discover block and the sb-card inside it, and CSS `margin-top:auto` on the sb-card pushes it down. Since `.sidenav` is a flex column with `.sidenav-list{flex:1}`, the extra div will sit after the list. Hmm — `.sidenav-list` has `flex:1` so it grows and pushes everything else down. That means `.sidenav-extra` would be at the bottom already. To make discover appear right after nav items, I should instead put the extra slot INSIDE the scroll area... Let me restructure: keep `.sidenav-list{flex:1}` but place `#sidenav-extra` right after it; the discover block and sb-card will both be near the bottom, with sb-card last. Actually the spec has `.sb-card{margin-top:auto}` inside a single `.sb-scroll` column with `gap:4px`, so discover appears right after nav buttons and sb-card is pushed to the bottom. Equivalent in shell: `.sidenav` is `display:flex;flex-direction:column`; `.sidenav-list{flex:1}` already pushes subsequent content to the bottom. If I set `.sidenav-list{flex:0 1 auto}` and `.sidenav-extra{flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column}` with the sb-card having `margin-top:auto`, I'd reproduce the spec exactly.

Simplest safe approach: give `#sidenav-extra` `flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto` and change `.sidenav-list` to not flex-grow... but `.sidenav-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto}` exists for long admin nav. Changing it affects admin too. Alternative: add a modifier class on the app when extra content exists. Hmm, getting complex.

Cleaner: keep `.sidenav-list{flex:1}` but move the extra slot INSIDE the nav list container? No — nav list is generated.

Let me do: in buildStudent, render:
```html
<nav class="sidenav-list">${navList(...)}</nav>
<div class="sidenav-extra" id="sidenav-extra"></div>
<div class="sidenav-foot">…</div>
```
and add CSS:
```css
.sidenav-extra{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:0}
.sidenav-extra .sb-card{margin-top:auto}
```
With `.sidenav-list{flex:1}`, when nav list content is short it grows and extra sits right above foot. The discover block would then be at the bottom, just above profile-strength card and Account. Visually: nav items at top, then a gap, then DISCOVER + PROFILE STRENGTH + Account at the bottom. In the spec: nav items, DISCOVER immediately below, then gap, then sb-card at bottom + Account.

To match the spec more faithfully: make `.sidenav-extra` itself flex:1 and `.sidenav-list` flex:0 0 auto when extras exist. I can do that with a CSS rule scoped to `.app--student .sidenav-list` only if `#sidenav-extra:not(:empty)`. CSS `:has()` is widely supported in 2026 Chrome. Use:
```css
.sidenav:has(.sidenav-extra:not(:empty)) .sidenav-list{flex:0 1 auto}
.sidenav-extra{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto}
```
With `.sb-card{margin-top:auto}`. That gives: nav list at natural height, then extra column grows, discover right under nav, sb-card pushed to bottom. 

But wait — `.sidenav-extra` children: the page puts `<div class="sb-discover">` and `<div class="sb-card">` inside a single `[data-side]` wrapper element, or two separate `[data-side]` elements? If the wrapper is moved as one element, `margin-top:auto` must be on the sb-card inside the wrapper, and the wrapper must be the flex container. Simplest: shell moves ALL `[data-side]` elements individually into `#sidenav-extra` (so the wrapper isn't needed), and the page marks each block with `data-side`.

Good. Now also: when sidebar is collapsed (`is-collapsed`), the spec hides `.discover` and `.sb-card`. Add CSS: `.app.is-collapsed .sidenav-extra{display:none}`.

Now the main content. The dashboard page will contain, inside `#view`:
- `.hero` (spec) with `#todayLine`, `#greetLine`, `#heroSub`, `.hero-aside` with two `.stat`s (SAVED count, PROFILE STRENGTH bar).
- `#chips` field chips with counts (from real data: fields present in published listings, ordered by Settings.fields).
- `.toolbar` (search input, sort select, filters button + count).
- `#filterPanel` (`.filters` grid-rows animation) with WORK MODE checkboxes (from Settings.workModes), CITY select (from Settings.locations + Remote), Verified only, Include closed listings, Reset all filters.
- `.results-head` with `#resultsLabel` + `#viewNote`/`#clearView`.
- `#grid` — spec card markup (`.card-int` etc.) vs existing `.icard` (Rows.card). §03 says features/page structure must match; the card is a visual component. #### Thinking

Good. Profile fields: displayName, email, username, phone, institution, field, course, academicLevel, preferences{fields,locations,workModes}, notifications{...}.

Profile strength — honest computation from real profile data. Define required set: displayName, email(always), phone, institution, field(or preferences.fields), course, academicLevel, preferences.fields, preferences.locations, preferences.workModes. Let me pick a reasonable, explainable set of 6 checks and compute % = filled/6*100 rounded. Label: `${pct}% — ${pct>=80?'Complete':pct>=50?'Good':'Needs work'}`. That's real data derived, not fabricated. I'll put the function in a shared place since account page might use it too — but keep it in the dashboard for now, or better: add to `Auth` as `Auth.profileStrength()`? That's a service change; it's used by dashboard (2 places: hero stat + sidebar card). I'll define it locally in dashboard.html to avoid touching auth.js — but account.html might want it later. Local is fine and minimal.

Modals: spec has modals in dashboard, browse, what's-new (all with the same structure: img, badges, title, company, meta, desc, Save, Apply) and account (different, small). So a shared `DetailModal` lib makes sense — used by dashboard, browse, whats-new. That's a good investment and avoids triplicating. I'll create `assets/js/lib/detail-modal.js` with:
- `DetailModal.mount()` → injects the modal markup (once) into body
- `DetailModal.open(item)` → fills from a normalized internship object
- Save button uses `Saved.toggle` + updates all `[data-save="id"]` on the page + dispatches `saved:changed`
- Apply → `UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl)` new tab; else link to detail page
- "Full listing" link → `Rows.detailHref(item.id)`

```js
function profileStrength(p){
  const checks = [p.displayName, p.email, p.phone, p.institution, p.field || (p.preferences?.fields||[]).length, p.course, p.academicLevel, (p.preferences?.locations||[]).length, (p.preferences?.workModes||[]).length];
  const done = checks.filter(Boolean).length;
  return Math.round(done/checks.length*100);
}
```

Now the dashboard page markup for `[data-side]` blocks must be OUTSIDE `#view` (since `#view` gets moved into the content slot). }

/* ============================================================
   DETAIL MODAL · quick view for an internship card.
   Pages call DetailModal.init(() => items). Card controls stay
   real links to the full listing, so pages that never init the
   modal (or ids that aren't loaded) simply navigate.
   ============================================================ */

const DetailModal = (() => {
  let backdrop = null;
  let getItems = () => [];
  let currentId = null;
  let lastFocus = null;
  let wired = false;

  const q = (sel) => (backdrop ? backdrop.querySelector(sel) : null);

  function paintSave(on) {
    const btn = q('#dmSave');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = on ? 'Saved ✓' : 'Save';
    btn.classList.toggle('btn-primary', on);
    btn.classList.toggle('btn-ghost', !on);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
  }

  function build() {
    if (backdrop) return backdrop;
    backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop';
    backdrop.innerHTML = `
      <div class="modal modal-lg" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dmTitle">
        <button type="button" class="dm-x" data-dm-close aria-label="Close">${UI.icon('x', 16)}</button>
        <div class="dm-media" id="dmMedia"></div>
        <div class="dm-body">
          <div class="dm-badges" id="dmBadges"></div>
          <h3 class="modal-title" id="dmTitle"></h3>
          <p class="dm-company" id="dmCompany"></p>
          <div class="dm-meta" id="dmMeta"></div>
          <p class="dm-desc" id="dmDesc"></p>
          <div class="modal-actions dm-actions">
            <a class="dm-full" id="dmFull" href="#">Full listing ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="dmSave" aria-pressed="false">Save</button>
            <a class="btn btn-primary" id="dmApply" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Apply</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === backdrop || e.target.closest('[data-dm-close]')) close();
    });

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('#dmSave') || !currentId) return;
      const btn = q('#dmSave');
      btn.disabled = true;
      const res = await Saved.toggle(currentId);
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (!res.ok) { UI.toast('Could not update your saved list', 'error'); return; }
      const on = res.state === 'saved';
      paintSave(on);
      document.querySelectorAll(`[data-save="${currentId}"]`).forEach((b) => {
        b.classList.toggle('on', on);
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', on ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship');
        b.innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 15, on);
      });
      UI.toast(on ? "Saved — we'll track its deadline for you" : 'Removed from saved');
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saved:changed', { detail: { id: currentId, on } }));
    });

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const apply = e.target.closest('#dmApply');
      if (apply && !apply.hidden && currentId) Internships.bump(currentId, 'clicks');
    });
    return backdrop;
  }

  function paintMedia(item) {
    const box = q('#dmMedia');
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="ic-fallback">${UI.esc(UI.initials(item.company || 'InternHub'))}</div>`;
    const url = UI.safeUrl(item.image);
    if (!url) return;
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = url;
    img.alt = '';
    img.loading = 'lazy';
    img.addEventListener('error', () => img.remove());
    box.appendChild(img);
  }

  function paintMeta(item) {
    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
    const bits = [
      item.field ? UI.icon('briefcase', 12) + UI.esc(item.field) : '',
      item.duration ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(item.duration) : '',
      item.workMode ? UI.icon('globe', 12) + UI.esc(item.workMode) : '',
      item.stipend ? UI.icon('sparkles', 12) + UI.esc(item.stipend) : '',
      dl.label ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(dl.label) : ''
    ].filter(Boolean);
    q('#dmMeta').innerHTML = bits.map((b) => `<span>${b}</span>`).join('');
  }

  function open(id) {
    const item = getItems().find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
    if (!item) return;
    currentId = item.id;
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    build();

    paintMedia(item);
    q('#dmBadges').innerHTML = badges(item);
    q('#dmTitle').textContent = item.title || 'Untitled role';
    q('#dmCompany').textContent = [item.company, item.city].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—';
    paintMeta(item);

    const desc = q('#dmDesc');
    desc.textContent = item.description || '';
    desc.hidden = !item.description;

    const full = q('#dmFull');
    const apply = q('#dmApply');
    const ext = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
    full.href = Rows.detailHref(item.id);
    full.classList.toggle('btn', !ext);
    full.classList.toggle('btn-primary', !ext);
    apply.href = ext || '#';
    apply.hidden = !ext;

    const save = q('#dmSave');
    save.hidden = !Auth.profile;
    paintSave(Saved.has(item.id));

    backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    q('#dmSave')?.focus();
  }

  function close() {
    if (!backdrop || !backdrop.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    currentId = null;
    if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
  }

  function init(itemsGetter) {
    if (typeof itemsGetter === 'function') getItems = itemsGetter;
    if (wired) return;
    wired = true;
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const trigger = e.target.closest('[data-details]');
      if (!trigger) return;
      const known = getItems().some((x) => String(x.id) === String(trigger.dataset.details));
      if (!known) return;                      // nothing to show — follow the link
      e.preventDefault();
      open(trigger.dataset.details);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); });
  }

  return { init, open, close };
})();

```js
  async function init() {
    const mode = document.body.dataset.app;
    if (!mode) return; // landing/auth pages manage their own chrome
    await Auth.ready;

    const view = document.getElementById('view');
    const active = document.body.dataset.nav || '';
    document.body.innerHTML = mode === 'admin' ? buildAdmin(active) : buildStudent(active);
    const slot = document.getElementById('view-slot');
    if (view && view.children.length) slot.appendChild(view);
    else if (view) { /* content injected by page script into #view later */ }

    wire(mode);

    if (mode === 'student' && Auth.profile) {
      Notifications.load().then(() => NotifyUI.init());
```

```css
/* ---------- Sidebar · per-page blocks (discover links, profile card) ---------- */
body>[data-side]{display:none}
```

```css
/* ---------- Toolbar panel + collapsible filter drawer (dashboard/browse) ---------- */
.toolbar-panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
.toolbar-panel .search-field .input{background:transparent;border-color:transparent}
.toolbar-panel .search-field .input:focus{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--white)}
.fcount{min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:700 10.5px var(--fm);display:grid;place-items:center}
.chips.is-scroll{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding-bottom:4px}
.chips.is-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.chips.is-scroll .chip{flex:none}
.chip .n{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);opacity:.75}
.fdrawer{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;opacity:0;margin-top:0;transition:grid-template-rows .35s var(--ease),opacity .3s,margin .3s}
.fdrawer.is-open{grid-template-rows:1fr;opacity:1;margin-top:12px}
.fdrawer>div{overflow:hidden}
.fdrawer-in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:20px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:18px 20px}
.fgroup h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:10px}
.chk-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chk-pill{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.chk-pill input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.chk-pill span{display:inline-block;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:999px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;user-select:none}
.chk-pill input:checked+span{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
.chk-pill input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px}
.linklike{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green);padding:4px 0}
.linklike:hover{text-decoration:underline}
```

Confirmed: JS drawer breakpoint 960px, CSS drawer breakpoint 860px. That's a genuine bug in the 861–960px range: `.app.nav-open` would be added but `.sidenav` stays in the grid column (not fixed), and `.only-mobile` hamburger button would be `display:none` (since `.only-mobile{display:grid}` is inside the 860px query). .hstat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px 16px;min-width:150px}
```css
.hstat .ico{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.hstat .lbl{font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.hstat .val{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}
.hstat .pbar{width:110px;margin-top:7px;background:var(--bg2)}
.hstat .pbar i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),#1a8a54)}
```

Hmm — `.pbar` in the sidebar is lime on translucent white. In the hero (light bg) it must be green. Scoped `.hstat .pbar` overrides. Good.

Toolbar panel:
```css
.toolbar.toolbar-panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:10px;margin-top:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
.toolbar-panel .search-field .input{background:transparent;border-color:transparent}
.toolbar-panel .search-field .input:focus{background:var(--white);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(23,122,76,.15)}
.fcount{min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:700 10.5px var(--fm);display:grid;place-items:center}
```

Collapsible filter drawer:
```css
.fdrawer{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;opacity:0;margin-top:0;transition:grid-template-rows .35s var(--ease),opacity .3s,margin .3s}
.fdrawer.is-open{grid-template-rows:1fr;opacity:1;margin-top:12px}
.fdrawer>div{overflow:hidden}
.fdrawer-in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:20px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:18px 20px}
.fgroup h4{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:10px}
.chk-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chk-pill{position:relative;display:inline-block;cursor:pointer}
.chk-pill input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.chk-pill span{display:inline-block;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:999px;background:var(--white);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);transition:.2s;user-select:none}
.chk-pill:hover span{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
.chk-pill input:checked+span{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
.chk-pill input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px}
.linklike{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green-ink);padding:4px 0}
.linklike:hover{text-decoration:underline}
```

Note: `.switch` in ui.css is `display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none` — spec's switch has `margin-bottom:9px` for stacking. I'll add `.fgroup .switch{display:flex;margin-bottom:9px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink)}` and `.fgroup .switch:last-child{margin-bottom:0}`.

Results head:
```css
.results-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:26px 2px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.results-head .eyebrow{color:var(--dim)}
.view-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.view-note button{color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.view-note button:hover{text-decoration:underline}
```

CTA:
```css
.cta{position:relative;margin-top:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--green-deep),var(--green));border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:28px 32px;color:#eaf5ee;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -20px rgba(11,66,41,.55);overflow:hidden}
.cta::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-80px;width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(234,245,238,.16),transparent)}
.cta>*{position:relative}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,27px);margin-bottom:6px;color:#f4faf2}
.cta p{color:#bcd9c6;font-size:14px;max-width:52ch}
```

`filtered()`:
```js
function filtered() {
  const q = state.q.trim().toLowerCase();
  const list = ALL.filter((it) => {
    if (state.view === 'saved' && !Saved.has(it.id)) return false;
    const days = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
    if (!state.incClosed && days !== null && days < 0) return false;
    if (state.field !== 'All fields' && it.field !== state.field) return false;
    if (state.city !== 'All cities' && it.city !== state.city) return false;
    if (state.modes.length && !state.modes.includes(it.workMode)) return false;
    if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;
    if (q) {
      const hay = `${it.title} ${it.company} ${it.city} ${it.field}`.toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  if (state.sort === 'newest') list.sort((a,b) => (b.createdAt||0) - (a.createdAt||0));
  if (state.sort === 'closing') list.sort((a,b) => {
    const da = UI.daysUntil(a.deadline), db = UI.daysUntil(b.deadline);
    const va = da === null ? 999 : (da < 0 ? 999 : da);
```

57	        ids = new Set(entries.map((e) => e.id));
58	        if (!entries.length) return [];
59	        const items = [];
60	        for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i += 10) {
61	          const chunk = entries.slice(i, i + 10);
62	          const docs = await firebaseDB.getAll(...chunk.map((e) => firebaseDB.collection('internships').doc(e.id)));
63	          docs.forEach((doc, j) => {
64	            if (doc.exists && doc.data().published) {
65	              const d = doc.data();

67	                id: doc.id, title: d.title, company: d.company, image: d.image || '',
68	                field: d.field || '', category: d.category || '', city: d.city || '',

70	                verified: !!d.verified, deadline: UI.toDate(d.deadline), createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt),
71	                savedAt: chunk[j].savedAt
72	              });
73	            }
74	          });
75	        }
76	        return items;
77	      } catch (err) { console.error('Saved.list failed:', err); return []; }
78	    }

```js
window.onReady(async function () {
  if (!(await Auth.requireSignedIn())) return;
  Rows.initSaveHandling();

  const p = Auth.profile;
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
```
```js
  let ALL = [];
```

```js
    verOnly: false, incClosed: false, sort: 'newest', view: 'all' };

  DetailModal.init(() => ALL);

  /* ---------- static links + icons ---------- */
  const LINKS = { browse: 'student_pages/browse.html', suggest: 'student_pages/suggest.html',
    'whats-new': 'student_pages/whats-new.html', account: 'student_pages/account.html' };
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-navlink]').forEach((a) => { a.href = H(LINKS[a.dataset.navlink]); });
  $('ctaSuggest').href = H(LINKS.suggest);
  $('cvLink').href = H(LINKS.account) + '?tab=profile';
  const findBtn = document.querySelector('.dash-actions [data-navlink="browse"]');
  if (findBtn) findBtn.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', UI.icon('arrow-right', 16));
  $('searchIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('search', 16);
  $('filterIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('filter', 15);
  $('savedIco').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 17);
  $('emptyIco').innerHTML = UI.icon('briefcase', 22);

  /* ---------- greeting + date ---------- */
  const first = (p.displayName || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'there';
  const now = new Date();
  const h = now.getHours();
  $('greetLine').textContent = `${h < 12 ? 'Good morning' : h < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening'}, ${first}`;
  $('todayLine').textContent = now.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',
    { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }).toUpperCase();

  /* ---------- profile strength (real fields only) ---------- */
  function profileStrength() {
    const prefs = p.preferences || {};
    const checks = [
      p.displayName, p.email, p.phone, p.institution, p.course, p.academicLevel,
      p.field || (prefs.fields || []).length,
      (prefs.locations || []).length, (prefs.workModes || []).length
    ];
    const done = checks.filter((v) => v && String(v).trim()).length;
    return Math.round((done / checks.length) * 100);
  }
  function renderStrength() {
    const pct = profileStrength();
    const label = pct >= 100 ? 'Complete' : pct >= 70 ? 'Good' : pct >= 40 ? 'Getting there' : 'Getting started';
    $('pctLine').textContent = `${pct}% — ${label}`;
    $('heroPct').textContent = `${pct}%`;
    $('pctBar').style.width = pct + '%';
    $('heroPctBar').style.width = pct + '%';
  }
```

```js
  function filtered() {
    const q = state.q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = ALL.filter((it) => {
      if (state.view === 'saved' && !Saved.has(it.id)) return false;
      const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
      if (!state.incClosed && d !== null && d < 0) return false;
      if (state.field !== 'All fields' && it.field !== state.field) return false;
      if (state.city !== 'All cities' && it.city !== state.city) return false;
      if (state.modes.length && !state.modes.includes(it.workMode)) return false;
      if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;
      if (q && !`${it.title} ${it.company} ${it.city} ${it.field}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    if (state.sort === 'closing') list.sort((a, b) => sortKey(a) - sortKey(b));
    else if (state.sort === 'az') list.sort((a, b) => (a.title || '').localeCompare(b.title || ''));
    else list.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
    return list;
  }
  function sortKey(it) {
    const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
    return d === null || d < 0 ? 999 : d;
  }
```

<script src="../assets/js/lib/shell.js"></script>
<script>
window.onReady(async function () {
  if (!(await Auth.requireSignedIn())) return;
  Rows.initSaveHandling();

  const p = Auth.profile;
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const grid = $('grid');
  let ALL = [];
  let VOCAB = Settings.DEFAULT;
  const state = { q: '', field: 'All fields', modes: [], city: 'All cities',
    verOnly: false, incClosed: false, sort: 'newest', view: 'all' };

  DetailModal.init(() => ALL);

  // static nav links (portable paths) + icons
  const LINKS = { browse: 'student_pages/browse.html', suggest: 'student_pages/suggest.html',
    'whats-new': 'student_pages/whats-new.html', account: 'student_pages/account.html' };
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-navlink]').forEach((a) => { a.href = H(LINKS[a.dataset.navlink]); });
  $('ctaSuggest').href = H(LINKS.suggest);
  $('cvLink').href = H(LINKS.account) + '?tab=profile';
  const findBtn = document.querySelector('.dash-actions [data-navlink="browse"]');
  if (findBtn) findBtn.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', UI.icon('arrow-right', 16));
  $('searchIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('search', 16);
  $('filterIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('filter', 15);
  $('savedIco').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 17);
  $('emptyIco').innerHTML = UI.icon('briefcase', 22);

  // greeting + date
  const first = (p.displayName || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'there';
  const now = new Date();
  const hr = now.getHours();
  $('greetLine').textContent = `${hr < 12 ? 'Good morning' : hr < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening'}, ${first}`;
  $('todayLine').textContent = now.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',
    { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }).toUpperCase();

  // profile strength · computed from the real profile, never hardcoded
  function profileStrength() {
    const prefs = p.preferences || {};
    const checks = [p.displayName, p.email, p.phone, p.institution, p.course, p.academicLevel,
      p.field || (prefs.fields || []).length, (prefs.locations || []).length, (prefs.workModes || []).length];
    const done = checks.filter((v) => v && String(v).trim()).length;
    return Math.round((done / checks.length) * 100);
  }
  function renderStrength() {
    const pct = profileStrength();
    const label = pct >= 100 ? 'Complete' : pct >= 70 ? 'Good' : pct >= 40 ? 'Getting there' : 'Getting started';
    $('pctLine').textContent = `${pct}% — ${label}`;
    $('heroPct').textContent = `${pct}%`;
    $('pctBar').style.width = `${pct}%`;
    $('heroPctBar').style.width = `${pct}%`;
  }

  // filtering + sorting
  const sortKey = (it) => { const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline); return d === null || d < 0 ? 999 : d; };

  function filtered() {
    const q = state.q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = ALL.filter((it) => {
      if (state.view === 'saved' && !Saved.has(it.id)) return false;
      const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
      if (!state.incClosed && d !== null && d < 0) return false;
      if (state.field !== 'All fields' && it.field !== state.field) return false;
      if (state.city !== 'All cities' && it.city !== state.city) return false;
      if (state.modes.length && !state.modes.includes(it.workMode)) return false;
      if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;
      if (q && !`${it.title} ${it.company} ${it.city} ${it.field}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    if (state.sort === 'closing') list.sort((a, b) => sortKey(a) - sortKey(b));
    else if (state.sort === 'az') list.sort((a, b) => (a.title || '').localeCompare(b.title || ''));
    else list.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
    return list;
  }

  function fieldCounts() {
    const counts = {};
    ALL.forEach((it) => {
      if (!it.field || !UI.isOpen(it)) return;
      counts[it.field] = (counts[it.field] || 0) + 1;
    });
    const names = Object.keys(counts).sort((a, b) => counts[b] - counts[a] || a.localeCompare(b));
    return { names, counts };
  }

  function renderChips() {
    const { names, counts } = fieldCounts();
    const open = ALL.filter((it) => UI.isOpen(it)).length;
    const chips = [['All fields', open]].concat(names.map((n) => [n, counts[n]]));
    $('chips').innerHTML = chips.map(([name, n]) =>
      `<button type="button" class="chip${state.field === name ? ' is-on' : ''}" role="tab" aria-selected="${state.field === name}" data-chip="${UI.esc(name)}">${UI.esc(name)} <span class="n">${n}</span></button>`).join('');
  }

  function renderDiscover() {
    const { names, counts } = fieldCounts();
    const top = (names.length ? names : ['Software Engineering', 'Data & AI', 'Finance']).slice(0, 3);
    $('qLinks').innerHTML = top.map((f) =>
      `<button type="button" class="q-link" data-field="${UI.esc(f)}">${UI.esc(f)} <span>${counts[f] || 0}</span></button>`).join('');
  }

  function renderModes() {
    const modes = (VOCAB.workModes || []).length ? VOCAB.workModes : Settings.DEFAULT.workModes;
    $('modeRow').innerHTML = modes.map((m) =>
      `<label class="chk-pill"><input type="checkbox" class="modeChk" value="${UI.esc(m)}"${state.modes.includes(m) ? ' checked' : ''}><span>${UI.esc(m)}</span></label>`).join('');
  }

  function renderCities() {
    const cities = [...new Set(ALL.map((it) => it.city).filter(Boolean))].sort();
    $('citySelect').innerHTML = ['All cities'].concat(cities)
      .map((c) => `<option${c === state.city ? ' selected' : ''}>${UI.esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
  }

  function filterCount() {
    return state.modes.length + (state.verOnly ? 1 : 0) + (state.incClosed ? 1 : 0) + (state.city !== 'All cities' ? 1 : 0);
  }
  function renderFCount() {
    const n = filterCount();
    $('fCount').hidden = !n;
    $('fCount').textContent = n;
  }

  function render() {
    const list = filtered();
    grid.innerHTML = Rows.grid(list);

    const none = !list.length;
    $('empty').hidden = !none;
    if (none) {
      $('emptyTitle').textContent = state.view === 'saved' ? 'No saved internships yet' : 'No internships match';
      $('emptyText').textContent = state.view === 'saved'
        ? 'Save internships you like and this space will track their deadlines for you.'
        : 'Try adjusting your search or filters — new verified roles are added regularly.';
    }

    const q = state.q.trim();
    $('resultsLabel').textContent = state.view === 'saved'
      ? `${list.length} SAVED`
      : `${list.length} OPEN ROLE${list.length === 1 ? '' : 'S'}${q ? ` · "${q.toUpperCase()}"` : ''}`;
    $('viewNote').hidden = state.view !== 'saved';
    $('savedPanel').hidden = state.view === 'saved';

    const savedItems = ALL.filter((it) => Saved.has(it.id));
    $('savedCount').textContent = Saved.ids.size;
    const closing = savedItems.filter((it) => { const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline); return d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= 7; }).length;
    const sub = $('heroSub');
    if (!savedItems.length) sub.textContent = 'No deadlines on your radar yet — save internships to track them here.';
    else if (closing) sub.textContent = `${closing} of your saved internship${closing > 1 ? 's' : ''} close${closing > 1 ? '' : 's'} within 7 days — review them below.`;
    else sub.textContent = `You're tracking ${savedItems.length} internship${savedItems.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}. Nice pace — keep exploring.`;

    Shell.syncSavedBadge();
  }

  function setView(view) {
    state.view = view;
    Shell.markNav(view === 'saved' ? 'saved' : 'dashboard');
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    if (view === 'saved') url.searchParams.set('view', 'saved'); else url.searchParams.delete('view');
    history.replaceState(null, '', url);
    render();
  }

  function resetFilters() {
    state.q = ''; state.field = 'All fields'; state.modes = []; state.city = 'All cities';
    state.verOnly = false; state.incClosed = false;
    $('searchInput').value = ''; $('citySelect').value = 'All cities';
    $('verOnly').checked = false; $('incClosed').checked = false;
    document.querySelectorAll('.modeChk').forEach((c) => { c.checked = false; });
    renderChips(); renderFCount(); render();
  }

  // control events
  let deb;
  $('searchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    clearTimeout(deb);
    deb = setTimeout(() => { state.q = e.target.value; render(); }, 160);
  });
  $('sortSelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.sort = e.target.value; render(); });
  $('chips').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const c = e.target.closest('[data-chip]');
    if (!c) return;
    state.field = c.dataset.chip; renderChips(); render();
  });
  $('modeRow').addEventListener('change', () => {
    state.modes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.modeChk:checked')].map((c) => c.value);
    renderFCount(); render();
  });
  $('citySelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.city = e.target.value; renderFCount(); render(); });
  $('verOnly').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.verOnly = e.target.checked; renderFCount(); render(); });
  $('incClosed').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.incClosed = e.target.checked; renderFCount(); render(); });
  $('resetFilters').addEventListener('click', () => { resetFilters(); UI.toast('Filters reset'); });
  $('emptyReset').addEventListener('click', resetFilters);
  $('filterBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = $('filterPanel').classList.toggle('is-open');
    $('filterBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
  });
  $('clearView').addEventListener('click', () => setView('all'));
  $('qLinks').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-field]');
    if (!b) return;
    state.field = b.dataset.field;
    renderChips(); render();
    $('chips').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  });

===== internhub-qa-verification-method.md
---
name: internhub-qa-verification-method
description: How to visually verify the InternHub "updated project" deliverable given the fixed 531px browser viewport, blocked screenshots, and auth-gated app pages
metadata:
  type: project
---

Visual QA of the InternHub deliverable (`Desktop/internship universe/updated project/`) has three recurring environment constraints that block the naive "navigate + screenshot every page" approach.

**Why:** These have bitten multiple sessions. The browser-use in-app viewport is fixed at ~531px and cannot be resized; `take_screenshot` fails with `NATIVE_BROWSER_VIEWPORT_UNAVAILABLE` when the in-app browser is not focused/visible (only `take_snapshot` and `evaluate_script` keep working); and the student/admin app pages are auth-gated — they redirect to `signin.html?next=<page>` when signed out, and credentials must never be invented.

**How to apply:**
- Verify styling with `evaluate_script` + `getComputedStyle` (returns exact rgb values) instead of screenshots. This is actually more precise for confirming token/color changes.
- Desktop and tablet widths cannot be rendered at all (viewport stuck at 531px = the `max-width:860px` mobile/drawer regime). Confirm those layouts by reading the CSS media queries, and say so explicitly rather than claiming a full responsive pass.
- To test the auth-gated app shell without logging in: `internship.html` renders the real student shell (green sidebar) while signed out — use it as a live shell sample. Or inject the shell markup plus a `<link>` to the real `assets/css/app.css` into any live page and read computed styles.
- Serve locally with `python -m http.server <port>` from the `internship universe` root (note: `python`, not `python3`, on this Windows box); the deliverable is then at `/<percent-encoded updated project>/...`. Stop stray servers when done.

Related: [[internhub-rebuild-state]], [[internhub-homepage-white-preference]].

Excellent data. Findings:

1. **`.fdrawer` open height = 0** — the drawer does NOT expand. `fdrawerClosed.h = 0` and `fdrawerOpen.h = 0`. Problem!
   Why? `.fdrawer{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr}` + `.fdrawer>div{overflow:hidden}` + `.fdrawer.is-open{grid-template-rows:1fr}`.
   
   Hmm, but `.fdrawer` itself is inside `#view` which is a block. `.fdrawer{display:grid}` with `grid-template-rows:0fr` — the row is 0fr → 0 height. With `is-open` → `1fr` should size to content.
   
   But wait: measurement happened immediately after adding the class — the `transition:grid-template-rows .35s` means the computed value animates from 0fr, so at t=0 the height is still 0! That's the transition, not a bug. The `rect` was read synchronously right after `classList.add`. So h=0 is expected mid-transition.
   
   I need to re-measure after the transition completes (~400ms). Let me redo with a delay.

   Also `.chk-pill span` MISSING — because `#modeRow` is empty in static markup (pills are rendered by JS). Expected. So that check was meaningless.

2. **`fdrawerIn` desktop gridTemplateColumns: "277.75px 277.75px 277.75px 277.75px 0px"** — there's a phantom 5th column of 0px! That's from `.fgroup[style="align-self:end"]`... no. Actually `repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr))` with 4 items at 1213px wide → 4 columns of ~277px. The extra `0px` column is likely a 5th grid item. What's the 5th child of `.fdrawer-in`? Looking at markup: 4 `.fgroup` divs. Hmm, but whitespace text nodes aren't grid items. 

   Wait — actually auto-fit collapses empty tracks to 0. With `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px,1fr))`, the number of tracks is determined by the container width: floor((1213-40+20)/(190+20)) = floor(1193/210) = 5 tracks. auto-fit collapses *empty* tracks to 0px, but `1fr` distribution... Actually auto-fit collapses empty tracks, so we'd get 4 tracks. Chrome reports the collapsed 5th track as 0px. That's normal auto-fit behaviour and harmless (spec has the same).

3. **`docScrollW: 1265` at iframe width 1280** — no horizontal overflow (1265 = 1280 - 15 scrollbar). Good. Phone: 375 vs 390 → fine. Tablet: 805 vs 820 → fine. **No overflow at any width.**

4. `emptyDisplay: display none` — because `hidden` attribute + `.state` doesn't set display. Good.

5. `hstatRect` desktop 150×80, phone 281×66 (flex:1 full width). Good, matches spec mobile behaviour.

6. `ctaBtn` = lime `rgb(188,226,58)` with `rgb(28,38,7)` ink — the app's accent. Good.

7. `toolbar` bg `#fbfcf8` (var(--card)), border `#dfe2d7`, radius 16px, padding 10px, margin-top 12px. Matches spec intent.

8. `searchInput` transparent bg + transparent border, padding-left 36px. Good.

9. `hero` desktop h=239, padding 28px 30px, radius 16px. h1 38px Fraunces 600. Good.

10. `dashGrid` desktop 715/477 (1.5fr/1fr), tablet 753 single col (≤900px), phone 323. Good.

11. `resultsHead` margin 26px/14px. Good.

12. `chips` nowrap + overflow-x auto + padding 18px 2px 6px. Good.
