68	.sidebar{width:250px;flex:none;background:#f7f8f6;border-right:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:64px;height:calc(100vh - 64px);overflow:hidden;transition:width .35s var(--ease)}
69	body.sb-collapsed .sidebar{width:76px}
70	.sb-scroll{height:100%;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:18px 14px;scrollbar-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
71	.sb-label{padding:4px 12px 8px;transition:opacity .2s}
72	body.sb-collapsed .sb-label{opacity:0}
73	.nav-btn{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--ink2);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;transition:.2s;text-align:left}
74	.nav-btn:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
75	.nav-btn.on{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
76	.nav-btn .ico svg{width:18px;height:18px}
77	.nav-btn .txt{white-space:nowrap;max-width:160px;transition:max-width .3s var(--ease),opacity .2s}
78	body.sb-collapsed .txt{max-width:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden}
79	body.sb-collapsed .nav-btn{justify-content:center;padding:10px}
80	.nbadge{position:absolute;right:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:600 11px/20px var(--fs);text-align:center}
81	body.sb-collapsed .nbadge{right:6px;top:6px;transform:none;min-width:16px;height:16px;font-size:9.5px;line-height:16px;padding:0 4px}
82	.sb-card{margin-top:auto;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px}
83	body.sb-collapsed .sb-card{display:none}
84	.sb-card .eyebrow{display:block;margin-bottom:10px}
85	.sb-card ol{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
86	.sb-card li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
87	.sb-card li b{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);font:600 10.5px/18px var(--fm);text-align:center}
88	.backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;top:64px;background:rgba(10,20,14,.4);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s;z-index:90}
89	body.sb-open .backdrop,body.frail-open .backdrop{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
90	
91	/* ============ MAIN ============ */
92	.main{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:24px clamp(14px,2.6vw,32px) 40px}
93	
94	/* ---- DARK DISCOVERY ZONE ---- */
95	.darkzone{position:relative;border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(24px,3.2vw,36px) clamp(18px,3vw,36px) 26px;color:var(--dk-txt);overflow:hidden;
96	  background:linear-gradient(150deg,#0a3d26 0%,#0e6b3f 55%,#0a4930 100%)}
97	.darkzone::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
98	  background:radial-gradient(760px 280px at 88% -20%,rgba(140,255,190,.20),transparent 62%),
99	  radial-gradient(520px 240px at 4% 130%,rgba(140,255,190,.10),transparent 60%),
100	  repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
101	.darkzone>*{position:relative}
102	.darkzone .eyebrow{color:#9fd8b4}
103	.darkzone h1{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,38px);color:#f7fdf9;margin:10px 0 6px}
104	.darkzone .sub{color:#cfe9d8;font-size:14px;max-width:600px}
105	.searchwrap{position:relative;max-width:700px;margin-top:20px}
106	.searchbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:13px;padding:7px 7px 7px 15px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
107	.searchbar .s-ico{color:var(--muted)}
108	.searchbar .s-ico svg{width:17px;height:17px}
109	.searchbar input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink)}
110	.searchbar input::placeholder{color:#9aa5a0}
111	.s-clear{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted)}
112	.s-clear:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
113	.s-clear svg{width:14px;height:14px}
114	.s-clear[hidden]{display:none}
115	.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;padding:10px 16px;transition:.2s var(--ease);white-space:nowrap}
116	.btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
117	.btn.primary{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
118	.btn.primary:hover{background:var(--green-ink);transform:translateY(-1px)}
119	.btn.ghost{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--ink2)}
120	.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
121	.btn.sm{padding:7px 12px;font-size:12.5px;border-radius:9px}
122	.btn.dghost{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#d7f2e2;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
123	.btn.dghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
124	/* suggestions */
125	.sug{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:0;right:0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);padding:6px;z-index:60;display:none}
126	.sug.open{display:block}
127	.sug-it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2);text-align:left}
128	.sug-it svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--muted);flex:none}
129	.sug-it .st{margin-left:auto;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
130	.sug-it.on,.sug-it:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
131	.sug-head{padding:7px 11px 4px;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
132	.popular{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
133	.popular .eyebrow{color:#8fc7a6}
134	.popular button{border:1px solid rgba(234,255,243,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#d7f2e2;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 13px;font-size:12.5px;transition:.2s}
135	.popular button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
136	
137	/* ---- MARQUEE ---- */
138	.mq-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:30px 0 4px}
139	.mq-head h2{font-size:22px;color:#f7fdf9}
140	.mq-head .eyebrow{color:#8fc7a6}
141	.marquee{overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 3.5%,#000 96.5%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 3.5%,#000 96.5%,transparent)}
142	.mq-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:mq 80s linear infinite}
143	.mq-half{display:flex;gap:16px;padding-right:16px}
144	.marquee:hover .mq-track,.marquee:focus-within .mq-track{animation-play-state:paused}
145	@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
146	.dcard{width:332px;flex:none;background:var(--dk);border:1px solid var(--dk-line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--dk-txt);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
147	.dcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(140,255,190,.42);box-shadow:0 24px 48px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 0 24px -8px rgba(140,255,190,.15)}
148	.dc-media{position:relative;height:150px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
149	.dc-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
150	.dcard:hover .dc-media img{transform:scale(1.06)}
151	.dc-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}
152	.badge{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:4px 8px}
153	.badge.new{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink)}
154	.badge.soon{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
155	.badge.closed{background:rgba(20,26,22,.72);color:#cfd6d1}
156	.badge.ver{background:rgba(12,20,16,.6);color:#9fe8bd;border:1px solid rgba(140,255,190,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
157	.save-btn{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.2s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
158	.save-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
159	.save-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
160	.save-btn.on svg{fill:currentColor}
161	@keyframes savepop{0%{transform:scale(1)}40%{transform:scale(1.25)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
162	.save-btn.pop{animation:savepop .35s var(--ease)}
163	.dc-media .save-btn{background:rgba(12,20,16,.55);color:#bfe8cd;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
164	.dc-media .save-btn.on{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink)}
165	.dc-body{padding:14px 15px 12px}
166	.dc-body h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#f2fbf6}
167	.dc-co{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dk-mut);margin-top:3px}
168	.dc-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 12px;margin-top:10px;list-style:none}
169	.dc-meta li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:var(--dk-mut)}
170	.dc-meta svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px}
171	.dc-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 15px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
172	.ci-dead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--dk-mut)}
173	.ci-dead svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px}
174	.ci-dead.warn{color:#f0b269;font-weight:600}
175	.ci-dead.off{color:#8a948e}
176	.mq-empty{border:1px dashed rgba(234,255,243,.25);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;text-align:center;color:#cfe9d8;font-size:13.5px}
177	
178	/* ---- LIGHT ZONE ---- */
179	.lsec{margin-top:30px}
180	/* category tiles */
181	.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(158px,1fr));gap:12px}
182	.tile{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px;text-align:left;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
183	.tile:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh1)}
184	.tile.on{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--green)}
185	.tile .t-ico{width:36px;height:36px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
186	.tile.on .t-ico{background:#fff}
187	.tile .t-ico svg{width:17px;height:17px}
188	.tile b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
189	.tile span{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
190	/* featured */
191	.feat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(240px,42%) 1fr;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
192	.feat::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(420px 200px at 100% 0,rgba(14,107,63,.06),transparent 60%)}
193	.feat-media{position:relative;min-height:230px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
194	.feat-media img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
195	.feat:hover .feat-media img{transform:scale(1.04)}
196	.feat-body{padding:24px 26px;position:relative}
197	.feat-body .eyebrow{color:var(--green-ink)}
198	.feat-body h3{font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,25px);margin:8px 0 4px}
199	.feat-co{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px}
200	.vcheck{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
201	.vcheck svg{width:9px;height:9px;stroke-width:3}
202	.feat-desc{color:var(--ink2);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:10px;max-width:560px}
203	.feat .ic-meta{margin-top:12px}
204	.feat-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
205	.feat .save-btn{position:static;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--ink2);box-shadow:none}
206	.feat .save-btn.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
207	/* browse area */
208	.browse{display:grid;grid-template-columns:248px minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px;align-items:start}
209	.frail{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;position:sticky;top:84px;max-height:calc(100vh - 102px);overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}
210	.frail-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px}
211	.linklike{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green-ink);padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px}
212	.linklike:hover{text-decoration:underline}
213	.frail-x{display:none}
214	.fsec{padding:13px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
215	.fsec:first-of-type{border-top:0}
216	.fsec>.eyebrow{display:block;margin-bottom:9px}
217	.cbx{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 4px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px}
218	.cbx:hover{background:var(--mint2)}
219	.cbx input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
220	.cbx .box{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;border:1.5px solid var(--line2);border-radius:5px;background:#fff;position:relative;transition:.15s}
221	.cbx input:checked+.box{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
222	.cbx input:checked+.box::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:4.5px;top:1.5px;width:4px;height:8px;border:solid #fff;border-width:0 2px 2px 0;transform:rotate(45deg)}
223	.cbx .txt{flex:1;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
224	.cbx .cnt{font:500 11px var(--fm);color:var(--muted)}
225	.pillrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
226	.pill{border:1px solid var(--line2);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 13px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);transition:.18s}
227	.pill:hover{border-color:var(--green)}
228	.pill.on{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
229	.select{position:relative;display:block}
230	.select select{width:100%;appearance:none;padding:9px 32px 9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
231	.select::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:13px;top:50%;width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.7px solid var(--muted);border-bottom:1.7px solid var(--muted);transform:translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg);pointer-events:none}
232	.switch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
233	.switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0}
234	.switch .track{width:34px;height:20px;flex:none;border-radius:999px;background:#d8dcd6;position:relative;transition:.25s}
235	.switch .track::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:left .25s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
236	.switch input:checked+.track{background:var(--green)}
237	.switch input:checked+.track::after{left:16px}
238	.frail-apply{display:none;width:100%;margin-top:14px}
239	/* toolbar */
240	.rtoolbar{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
241	.achips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:9px}
242	.achips:empty{display:none}
243	.achip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 6px 5px 11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;animation:pop .25s var(--ease)}
244	@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.85);opacity:0}}
245	.achip button{width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center}
246	.achip button:hover{background:rgba(10,82,50,.15)}
247	.achip svg{width:10px;height:10px;stroke-width:2.6}
248	.rt-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
249	#frailOpen{display:none}
250	.fbadge{min-width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:600 10.5px/18px var(--fs);text-align:center;padding:0 5px}
251	.fbadge[hidden]{display:none}
252	.viewtoggle{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
253	.viewtoggle button{width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted)}
254	.viewtoggle button.on{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink)}
255	.viewtoggle svg{width:16px;height:16px}
256	/* grid cards */
257	.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}
258	.icard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s}
259	.icard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--sh2);border-color:var(--line2)}
260	.ic-media{position:relative;height:138px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
261	.ic-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
262	.icard:hover .ic-media img{transform:scale(1.05)}
263	.icard.off .ic-media img{filter:grayscale(.7);opacity:.8}
264	.noimg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
265	.noimg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 10px,transparent 10px 20px)}
266	.noimg .mg{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font:700 28px var(--fs)}
267	.ic-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}
268	.ic-media .save-btn{background:rgba(251,251,250,.92);color:var(--ink2)}
269	.ic-media .save-btn.on{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
270	.mono-av{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:-15px;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green-deep);color:#bfe8cd;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 11.5px var(--fs);border:2px solid var(--surface)}
271	.ic-body{padding:22px 14px 12px;flex:1}
272	.ic-body h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
273	.ic-co{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
274	.ic-meta{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 12px;margin-top:9px}
275	.ic-meta li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2)}
276	.ic-meta svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
277	.ic-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
278	.light-dead{color:var(--muted)}
279	.light-dead.warn{color:var(--amber);font-weight:600}
280	.light-dead.off{color:#9aa5a0}
281	/* list view */
282	.cards.list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
283	.irow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;transition:.2s}
284	.irow:hover{border-color:var(--line2);box-shadow:var(--sh1);transform:translateX(2px)}
285	.ir-thumb{position:relative;width:96px;height:72px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
286	.ir-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
287	.ir-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
288	.ir-main h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
289	.ir-co{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
290	.ir-side{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex:none}
291	.ir-save{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line2);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink2);transition:.18s}
292	.ir-save:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
293	.ir-save.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
294	.ir-save svg{width:15px;height:15px}
295	.ir-save.on svg{fill:#fff}
296	/* closing soon strip */

5	.app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--side-w) minmax(0,1fr);min-height:100vh;transition:grid-template-columns .28s var(--ease)}
6	.app.is-collapsed{grid-template-columns:var(--side-cw) minmax(0,1fr)}
7	.scrim{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;background:rgba(18,21,17,.42);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s}
8	/* ---------- Sidebar · green structural panel (student + admin) ---------- */
9	.sidenav{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:16px 12px;border-right:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.1);overflow:hidden;background:var(--pine)}
10	.sidenav-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px 18px}
11	.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.01em;min-width:0;color:#f4faf2}
12	.brand-mark{width:32px;height:32px;flex:none;border-radius:9px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine);display:grid;place-items:center}
13	.brand-txt{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
14	.collapse-btn{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#9fb3a6;flex:none;transition:.2s}
15	.collapse-btn:hover{background:rgba(234,245,236,.08);color:#fff}
16	.sidenav-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden}
17	.sidenav-foot{margin-top:auto;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.12);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
18	.nav-item{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#b9c9be;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .18s,color .18s}
19	.nav-item:hover{background:rgba(234,245,236,.07);color:#fff}
20	.nav-item.is-active{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);font-weight:600}
21	.nav-ic{width:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
22	.nav-label{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
23	/* collapsed rail */
24	.app.is-collapsed .nav-item,.app.is-collapsed .sidenav-top{justify-content:center}
25	.app.is-collapsed .nav-label,.app.is-collapsed .brand-txt,.app.is-collapsed .admin-profile-txt{display:none}
26	.app.is-collapsed .admin-profile{justify-content:center}
27	/* admin profile block */
28	.admin-profile{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 8px;min-width:0}
29	.admin-profile-txt b{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#f4faf2}
30	.admin-profile-txt span{font-size:11px;color:#9fb3a6}
31	.admin-profile .avatar{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
32	
33	/* ---------- Sidebar · per-page blocks (DISCOVER links, PROFILE STRENGTH) ---------- */
34	body>[data-side]{display:none}
35	.sidenav-extra{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-height:0}
36	.sidenav:has(.sidenav-extra:not(:empty)) .sidenav-list{flex:0 1 auto}
37	.sidenav:has(.sidenav-extra:not(:empty)) .sidenav-extra{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden}
38	.sb-label{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9fb3a6;padding:10px 12px 6px;white-space:nowrap}
39	.sb-discover{margin-top:12px;padding-top:4px;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.12)}
40	.q-link{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:9px;font-size:13.5px;color:#b9c9be;text-align:left;transition:background .18s,color .18s}
41	.q-link:hover{background:rgba(234,245,236,.07);color:#fff}
42	.q-link span{font:500 11px var(--fm);color:#9fb3a6}
43	.sb-card{margin-top:auto;background:rgba(234,245,236,.07);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.12);border-radius:12px;padding:14px}
44	.sb-card h5{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9fb3a6}
45	.sb-card .pct{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#f4faf2;margin:6px 0 8px}
46	.sb-card a{display:inline-block;margin-top:9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--lime)}
47	.sb-card a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
48	.pbar{height:6px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.16);overflow:hidden}
49	.pbar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--lime);transition:width .5s var(--ease)}
50	.nav-badge{margin-left:auto;min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);font:700 11px var(--fm);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
51	.nav-item.is-active .nav-badge{background:var(--pine);color:var(--lime)}
52	.app.is-collapsed .sidenav-extra{display:none}
53	.app.is-collapsed .nav-badge{position:absolute;top:4px;right:8px;margin:0;min-width:16px;height:16px;padding:0;font-size:9.5px}
54	
55	/* ---------- Main ---------- */
56	.app-main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:100vh}
57	.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;height:var(--nav-h);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 clamp(16px,3vw,28px);background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
58	.topbar-title{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:18px}
59	.top-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-left:8px}
60	.top-nav a{padding:8px 13px;border-radius:9px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);transition:background .2s,color .2s}
61	.top-nav a:hover{background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink)}
62	.top-nav a.is-on{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
63	.topbar-actions{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
64	.app-content{flex:1;padding:clamp(18px,3vw,30px);min-width:0;animation:viewIn .3s var(--ease) both}
65	@keyframes viewIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
66	.only-mobile{display:none}
67	
68	/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
69	.app-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card)}
70	.student-footer{padding:30px clamp(18px,3vw,30px) 18px}
71	.ft-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:26px;max-width:1100px}
72	.ft-brand p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;margin-top:12px;max-width:34ch}
73	.ft-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
74	.ft-col h5{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:2px}
75	.ft-col a{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut);transition:color .2s}
76	.ft-col a:hover{color:var(--green)}
77	.ft-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:22px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font:500 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
78	.admin-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding:14px clamp(18px,3vw,30px);font:500 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
79	
80	/* ---------- Dropdown / menu ---------- */
81	.menu-wrap{position:relative}
82	.menu-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 8px 5px 5px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);transition:.2s}
83	.menu-btn:hover{border-color:var(--line2)}
84	.avatar{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green-deep);color:var(--lime);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12px var(--fs);flex:none}
85	.menu-pop{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);right:0;z-index:120;min-width:210px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:8px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-6px);transition:.18s var(--ease)}
86	.menu-pop.is-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none}
87	.menu-head{padding:8px 10px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:6px}
88	.menu-head b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}.menu-head span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
89	.menu-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:9px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);text-align:left;transition:background .15s}
90	.menu-item:hover{background:var(--bg2)}
91	.menu-item.is-danger{color:var(--red)}
92	.menu-sep{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:6px 0}
93	
94	/* ---------- Bell + notifications ---------- */
95	.bell-wrap .icon-btn{position:relative}
96	.bell-dot{position:absolute;top:6px;right:7px;min-width:16px;height:16px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font:700 10px var(--fm);display:grid;place-items:center;border:2px solid var(--bg)}
97	.notif-pop{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 10px);right:0;z-index:120;width:320px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-6px);transition:.18s var(--ease);overflow:hidden}
98	.notif-pop.is-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none}
99	.notif-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
100	.notif-mark{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase}
101	.notif-list{max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto}
102	.notif-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:background .15s}
103	.notif-item:hover{background:var(--bg2)}
104	.notif-item.is-unread{background:var(--green-soft)}
105	.notif-item-title{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
106	.notif-item-msg{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
107	.notif-item-time{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.05em}
108	.notif-empty{padding:26px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
109	
110	/* ---------- Toolbar / search ---------- */
111	.toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
112	.search-field{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:200px}
113	.search-field svg{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--dim)}
114	.search-field .input{padding-left:36px}
115	.toolbar .select,.toolbar .search-field{max-width:none}
116	.seg{display:inline-flex;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:3px;gap:2px}
117	.seg button{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
118	.seg button.is-on{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
119	
120	/* ---------- Discovery workspace (hero, toolbar panel, collapsible filters, CTA) ---------- */
121	.hero{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card),#f5f8f4);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:28px 30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
122	.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-120px;right:-80px;width:420px;height:300px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(23,122,76,.13),transparent);pointer-events:none}
123	.hero>*{position:relative}
124	.hero h1{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,38px);margin:8px 0 6px}
125	.hero-sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;max-width:52ch}
126	.hero-aside{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
127	.hstat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px 16px;min-width:150px}
128	.hstat .ico{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
129	.hstat .lbl{font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
130	.hstat .val{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
131	.hstat .pbar{width:110px;margin-top:8px;background:var(--bg2)}
132	.hstat .pbar i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),#1a8a54)}
133	
134	.toolbar.toolbar-panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:10px;margin-top:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
135	.toolbar-panel .search-field .input{background:transparent;border-color:transparent}
136	.toolbar-panel .search-field .input:focus{background:var(--white);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(23,122,76,.15)}
137	.fcount{min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:700 10.5px var(--fm);display:grid;place-items:center}
138	
139	.fdrawer{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;opacity:0;margin-top:0;transition:grid-template-rows .35s var(--ease),opacity .3s,margin-top .3s}
140	.fdrawer.is-open{grid-template-rows:1fr;opacity:1;margin-top:12px}
141	.fdrawer>div{overflow:hidden}
142	.fdrawer-in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:20px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:18px 20px}
143	.fgroup h4{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:10px}
144	.fgroup .switch{display:flex;margin-bottom:9px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink)}
145	.fgroup .switch:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
146	.chk-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
147	.chk-pill{position:relative;display:inline-block;cursor:pointer}
148	.chk-pill input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
149	.chk-pill span{display:inline-block;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:999px;background:var(--white);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);transition:.2s;user-select:none}
150	.chk-pill:hover span{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
151	.chk-pill input:checked+span{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
152	.chk-pill input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px}
153	.linklike{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green-ink);padding:4px 0}
154	.linklike:hover{text-decoration:underline}
155	
156	.results-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:26px 2px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
157	.view-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
158	.view-note button{color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
159	.view-note button:hover{text-decoration:underline}
160	
161	.cta{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px;padding:28px 32px;border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--green-deep),var(--green));color:#eaf5ee;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -20px rgba(11,66,41,.55);overflow:hidden}
162	.cta::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-80px;width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(234,245,238,.16),transparent)}
163	.cta>*{position:relative}
164	.cta h2{font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,27px);margin-bottom:6px;color:#f4faf2}
165	.cta p{color:#bcd9c6;font-size:14px;max-width:52ch}
166	
167	/* ---------- Filters (browse) ---------- */
168	.browse-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:248px minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px;align-items:start}
169	.filters{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:18px;max-height:calc(100vh - var(--nav-h) - 32px);overflow-y:auto}
170	.filter-group{padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
171	.filter-group:last-child{border-bottom:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
172	.filter-group h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:11px}
173	.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
174	.chips.is-scroll{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;padding:18px 2px 6px;scrollbar-width:none}
175	.chips.is-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
176	.chips.is-scroll .chip{flex:none}
177	.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);transition:.18s}
178	.chip:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
179	.chip.is-on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
180	.chip .n{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);opacity:.72}
181	.check-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
182	
183	/* ---------- Tables ---------- */
184	.table-wrap{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;background:var(--card)}
185	table.data{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px}
186	table.data th{text-align:left;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;background:var(--bg)}
187	table.data td{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
188	table.data tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
189	table.data tbody tr{transition:background .15s}
190	table.data tbody tr:hover{background:var(--bg2)}
191	.cell-title{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
192	.cell-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
193	.row-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end}
194	.tbtn{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);color:var(--mut);transition:.16s}
195	.tbtn:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
196	.tbtn.danger:hover{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red)}
197	.avatar-cell{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
198	.pagination{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
199	.pagination .pg-info{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
200	.pg-btns{display:flex;gap:6px}
201	.pg-btn{min-width:34px;height:34px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
202	.pg-btn:hover{border-color:var(--line2)}
203	.pg-btn.is-on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
204	.pg-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
205	
206	/* ---------- Tabs (settings/account) ---------- */
207	.tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:22px;overflow-x:auto}
208	.tab{padding:11px 15px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;margin-bottom:-1px}
209	.tab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
210	.tab.is-on{color:var(--green);border-bottom-color:var(--green);font-weight:600}
211	.tab-panel{display:none}.tab-panel.is-on{display:block}
212	.danger-zone{border:1px solid var(--red);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:20px;background:var(--red-bg)}
213	.danger-zone h3{color:var(--red);font-size:17px}
214	
215	/* ---------- App frame → drawer (matches shell.js max-width:960px) ---------- */
216	@media (max-width:960px){
217	  .app,.app.is-collapsed{grid-template-columns:1fr}
218	  .sidenav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;z-index:70;width:270px;height:100vh;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
219	  .app.nav-open .sidenav{transform:none}
220	  .app.nav-open .scrim{display:block;opacity:1}
221	  .app.is-collapsed .nav-label,.app.is-collapsed .brand-txt,.app.is-collapsed .admin-profile-txt{display:inline}
222	  .app.is-collapsed .nav-item,.app.is-collapsed .sidenav-top{justify-content:flex-start}
223	  .app.is-collapsed .sidenav-extra{display:flex}
224	  .app.is-collapsed .nav-badge{position:static;min-width:20px;height:20px;font-size:11px}
225	  .only-mobile{display:grid}
226	  .collapse-btn{display:none}
227	  .top-nav{display:none}
228	}
229	
230	/* ---------- Discovery workspace · small screens ---------- */
231	@media (max-width:640px){
232	  .hero{padding:22px 20px}
233	  .hero-aside{width:100%}
234	  .hstat{flex:1;min-width:140px}
235	  .toolbar-panel{padding:8px}
236	  .toolbar-panel .select,.toolbar-panel #filterBtn{flex:1}
237	  .cta{padding:24px 20px}
238	}
239	
240	/* ---------- Mobile card tables ---------- */
241	@media (max-width:860px){
242	  .only-desktop{display:none !important}
243	  .filters{position:static;max-height:none}
244	  .browse-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
245	  .browse-layout .filters{display:none}
246	  .browse-layout.filters-open .filters{display:block}

Now I have the complete picture of the design system. Let me build the Page 3 comparison checklist and then implement.

**PAGE 3 CHECKLIST — Browse (`student_pages/browse.html`)**

| # | Spec element/feature | Current | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `.darkzone` hero: eyebrow "Opportunity discovery", h1 "Find your next internship.", computed `#heroSub` | MISSING | Add (green structural panel; §09-compliant) |

| 3 | `#sug` typeahead dropdown: recent searches + hits w/ type labels, arrow/Enter/Escape nav | MISSING | Add |
| 4 | `.popular` quick searches (5) | MISSING | Add, driven by real data (top fields/cities) not hardcoded |
| 5 | `.mq-head` + `.marquee` "New this week" dark cards, hover-pause, seamless dup, reduced-motion fallback | MISSING | Add |
| 6 | `.dcard` dark card | MISSING | Add CSS + renderer |

App has: chart ✓ (Data & AI), pencil ✓ (Design), sparkles (Finance? no), ban... Let me map:

.popular button{border:1px solid rgba(234,255,243,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#d7f2e2;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 13px;font-size:12.5px;transition:.2s}
.popular button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}

.mq-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:30px 0 4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mq-head h2{font-size:22px;color:#f7fdf9}
.marquee{overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 3.5%,#000 96.5%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 3.5%,#000 96.5%,transparent)}
.mq-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:mq 80s linear infinite}
.mq-half{display:flex;gap:16px;padding-right:16px}
.marquee:hover .mq-track,.marquee:focus-within .mq-track{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.mq-empty{border:1px dashed rgba(234,255,243,.25);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;text-align:center;color:#cfe9d8;font-size:13.5px}
.sk-dk{width:332px;flex:none;height:290px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}

.dcard{width:332px;flex:none;background:var(--pine2);border:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;color:#eaf5ee;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.dcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.4);box-shadow:0 24px 48px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.75)}
.dc-media{position:relative;height:150px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
.dc-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
.dcard:hover .dc-media img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.dc-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:calc(100% - 60px)}
.dc-body{padding:14px 15px 12px}
.dc-body h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#f2fbf6;font-family:var(--fs);line-height:1.35}
.dc-co{font-size:12.5px;color:#9fb3a6;margin-top:3px}
.dc-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 12px;margin-top:10px}
.dc-meta i{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:#9fb3a6;font-style:normal}
.dc-meta svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px}
.dc-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 15px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.btn-dghost{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#d7f2e2;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.btn-dghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}

.feat-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.feat-save{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:.2s var(--ease)}
.feat-save:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
.feat-save.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
.feat-save.on svg{fill:currentColor}

.frail-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.frail-head .eyebrow{color:var(--ink);font-size:12px}
.frail-x{display:none;width:34px;height:34px}
.fsec{padding:13px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.fsec:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.fsec>.eyebrow{display:block;margin-bottom:9px;color:var(--dim)}
.cbx{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 4px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;transition:background .15s}
.cbx:hover{background:var(--green-soft)}
.cbx input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.cbx .box{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;border:1.5px solid var(--line2);border-radius:5px;background:var(--white);position:relative;transition:.15s}
.cbx input:checked+.box{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
.cbx input:checked+.box::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:4.5px;top:1.5px;width:4px;height:8px;border:solid #fff;border-width:0 2px 2px 0;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.cbx input:focus-visible+.box{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px}
.cbx .txt{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.cbx .cnt{font:500 11px var(--fm);color:var(--mut);flex:none}
.pillrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}

.pillrow .pill:hover{border-color:var(--green)}
.pillrow .pill.is-on{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}

.frail-apply{display:none;width:100%;margin-top:14px}
.frail-scrim{display:none}

.dm-note{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px}

.sb-card ol{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.sb-card li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;font-size:12.5px;color:#c3d3c8}
.sb-card li b{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(188,226,58,.18);color:var(--lime);font:600 10.5px/18px var(--fm);text-align:center}

/* ---------- Browse · filter rail → drawer ---------- */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .browse-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .filters{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;z-index:150;width:302px;height:100vh;max-height:none;border-radius:0 16px 16px 0;transform:translateX(-105%);transition:transform .35s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .browse-layout.filters-open .filters{transform:none}
  .browse-layout.filters-open+.frail-scrim{display:block;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:140;background:rgba(18,21,17,.42);backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
  .frail-x{display:grid}
  .frail-apply{display:inline-flex}
  .frail-open-btn{display:inline-flex}
}
@media (max-width:960px){
  .feat{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .feat-media{min-height:190px}
}
@media (max-width:720px){
  .dcard,.sk-dk{width:290px}
  .rtoolbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .rt-right{justify-content:space-between}
  .rt-sort{flex:1}
  .irow{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .ir-side{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}
  .searchbar{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px}
  .searchbar input{order:2;flex-basis:100%;padding:6px 4px}
  .searchbar .s-clear{order:3;margin-left:auto}
  .searchbar .btn{order:4}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .cta-slim{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
  .tiles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}

/* ---------- Browse · reduced motion + touch ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .mq-track{animation:none}
  .marquee{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none}
  .mq-half.dup{display:none}
  .dcard:hover,.tile:hover,.ccard:hover,.irow:hover{transform:none}
  .feat:hover .feat-media img{transform:none}
}
@media (hover:none),(pointer:coarse){
  .dcard:hover,.tile:hover,.ccard:hover,.irow:hover{transform:none;box-shadow:none}
  .dcard:hover .dc-media img,.feat:hover .feat-media img{transform:none}
}

  function timeAgo(date) {
    const d = toDate(date);
    if (!d) return '';
    const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 1000);
    if (s < 60) return 'just now';
    if (s < 3600) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m ago`;
    if (s < 86400) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h ago`;

      toastStack.className = 'toast-stack';

    }
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = `toast${type === 'error' ? ' toast-error' : ''}`;
    el.innerHTML = `${icon(type === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'check', 16)}<span>${esc(message)}</span>`;
    toastStack.appendChild(el);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => el.classList.add('is-shown'));
    setTimeout(() => {
      el.classList.remove('is-shown');
      setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 320);
    }, 2800);
  }

  function confirm({ title, message, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', danger = false }) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
      backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop';
      backdrop.innerHTML = `
        <div class="modal modal-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${esc(title)}">
          <h3 class="modal-title">${esc(title)}</h3>
          <p class="modal-msg">${esc(message)}</p>
          <div class="modal-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn ${danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}" data-act="ok">${esc(confirmLabel)}</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => backdrop.classList.add('is-open'));
      const close = (value) => {
        backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
        setTimeout(() => backdrop.remove(), 240);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        resolve(value);
      };
      const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(false); };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === backdrop) close(false);
        const act = e.target.closest('[data-act]')?.dataset.act;
        if (act === 'cancel') close(false);
        if (act === 'ok') close(true);
      });
    });
  }

  function initReveals(root = document) {
    const items = root.querySelectorAll('[data-rev]:not(.in)');
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window) || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('in'));
      return;
    }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((e) => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -6% 0px' });
    items.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
  }

  function skeletonRows(n = 4) {
    let html = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) html += `<div class="skel-row"><div style="flex:1"><div class="skel skel-title"></div><div class="skel skel-meta"></div></div><div class="skel skel-chip"></div></div>`;
    return `<div class="state-skeleton" aria-hidden="true">${html}</div>`;

  /** Spec deadline line: Closed / Closes today / tomorrow / in N days / Closes 5 Mar / Rolling. */
  function deadlineLine(item) {
    const days = UI.daysUntil(item.deadline);
    let label, cls = '';
    if (days === null) label = 'Rolling deadline';
    else if (days < 0) { label = 'Closed'; cls = 'off'; }
    else if (days === 0) { label = 'Closes today'; cls = 'warn'; }
    else if (days === 1) { label = 'Closes tomorrow'; cls = 'warn'; }
    else if (days <= 14) { label = `Closes in ${days} days`; cls = 'warn'; }
    else label = `Closes ${UI.fmtDate(item.deadline, false)}`;
    return `<span class="dead${cls ? ' ' + cls : ''}">${UI.icon('clock', 12)} ${UI.esc(label)}</span>`;
  }

  function metaList(item, cls) {
    const bits = [
      item.field ? UI.icon('briefcase', 12) + UI.esc(item.field) : '',
      item.duration ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(item.duration) : '',
      item.workMode ? UI.icon('globe', 12) + UI.esc(item.workMode) : '',
      item.city ? UI.icon('pin', 12) + UI.esc(item.city) : ''
    ].filter(Boolean);
    return bits.length ? `<div class="${cls}">${bits.map((b) => `<i>${b}</i>`).join('')}</div>` : '';
  }

104	.searchbar{margin-top:30px;display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:16px;padding:7px;gap:6px;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s;max-width:560px}
105	.searchbar:focus-within{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(188,226,58,.28),var(--sh)}
106	.sb-q{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 14px;min-width:0}
107	.sb-q svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--dim);flex:none}
108	.sb-q input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:none;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink)}
109	.sb-q input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
110	.sb-div{width:1px;background:var(--line);margin:8px 0}
111	.sb-city{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 12px}
112	.sb-city svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--dim)}
113	.sb-city select{border:0;outline:0;background:none;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;appearance:none}
114	.sb-btn{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);border-radius:11px;padding:0 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
115	.sb-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
116	.sb-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
117	.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
118	.trust{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px;font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
119	.trust b{color:var(--green);font-weight:600}
120	.trust span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
121	.trust i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
122	.hero-vis{position:relative;height:560px}
123	.hv-glow{position:absolute;inset:8% 4%;background:radial-gradient(46% 40% at 60% 42%,rgba(188,226,58,.32),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40% 36% at 34% 66%,rgba(23,122,76,.22),transparent 70%);filter:blur(6px)}
124	.hv-main{position:absolute;left:8%;top:6%;width:74%;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);border:1px solid var(--line)}
125	.hv-main img{width:100%;height:420px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
126	.hv-main:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
127	.hv-main .pill-tag{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px}
128	.fcard{position:absolute;width:250px;will-change:transform}
129	.fcard .fc-in{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);animation:bob 7s ease-in-out infinite}
130	.fcard:nth-child(odd) .fc-in{animation-delay:-3s}
131	@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
132	.fc-top{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
133	.fc-av{width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--pine);color:var(--lime);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12px var(--fs)}
134	.fc-top b{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.25}
135	.fc-top span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
136	.fc-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
137	.fc-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut);font-style:normal}
138	.fc-meta i.v{background:rgba(23,122,76,.12);color:var(--green)}
139	.fc-meta i.d{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
140	.fc1{right:-2%;top:2%}
141	.fc2{left:-3%;bottom:20%}
142	.fc3{right:2%;bottom:-2%}
143	.hv-chip{position:absolute;left:16%;top:-2%;z-index:3}
144	
145	/* ============ TICKER ============ */
146	.ticker{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;padding:13px 0}
147	.tk-track{display:flex;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:tick 36s linear infinite}
148	.ticker:hover .tk-track{animation-play-state:paused}
149	@keyframes tick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
150	.tk-track span{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);padding:0 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}
151	.tk-track span::after{content:"·";color:var(--green);font-size:15px}
152	
153	/* ============ SECTIONS COMMON ============ */
154	.sec{padding:clamp(78px,9vw,124px) 0}
155	.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);flex-wrap:wrap}
156	.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin-top:14px;max-width:560px}
157	.sec-head p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:10px;max-width:520px}
158	.link-more{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s;padding-bottom:3px}
159	.link-more svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
160	.link-more:hover{border-color:var(--lime)}
161	.link-more:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
162	[data-rev]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .8s var(--ease)}
163	[data-rev="left"]{transform:translateX(-36px)}
164	[data-rev="right"]{transform:translateX(36px)}
165	[data-rev="scale"]{transform:scale(.93)}
166	[data-rev].in{opacity:1;transform:none}
167	
168	/* ============ DISCOVER GRID ============ */
169	.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(258px,1fr));gap:16px}
170	.icard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s}
171	.icard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh);border-color:var(--line2)}
172	.ic-media{position:relative;height:150px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pine)}
173	.ic-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}
174	.icard:hover .ic-media img{transform:scale(1.045)}
175	.ic-media .noimg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.6);font:700 26px var(--fs);background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--pine))}
176	.ic-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}
177	.bdg{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:4.5px 9px;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
178	.bdg.new{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
179	.bdg.ver{background:rgba(13,43,29,.72);color:#9fe8bd;border:1px solid rgba(159,232,189,.35)}
180	.save{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(251,252,248,.92);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:.2s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
181	.save svg{width:15px;height:15px}
182	.save:hover{transform:scale(1.1);color:var(--green)}
183	.save.on{background:var(--green-deep);color:var(--lime)}
184	.save.on svg{fill:currentColor}
185	.save.pop{animation:spop .35s var(--ease)}
186	@keyframes spop{40%{transform:scale(1.28)}}
187	.ic-body{padding:15px 16px 13px;flex:1}
188	.ic-body h3{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
189	.ic-co{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px}
190	.ic-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
191	.ic-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut)}
192	.ic-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
193	.ic-dead{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}
194	.ic-dead.warn{color:var(--amber)}
195	.ic-link{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
196	.ic-link svg{width:12px;height:12px}
197	.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:56px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:16px;color:var(--mut)}
198	.empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
199	
200	/* ============ HOW ============ */
201	.how{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
202	.how .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(36px,5vw,80px)}
203	.how-left{position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:start}
204	.how-left h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px);margin:14px 0 16px}
205	.how-left p{color:var(--mut);max-width:400px}
206	.steps{position:relative;padding-left:34px}
207	.rail{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:2px;background:var(--line2)}
208	.rail i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--green),var(--lime));transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}
209	.step{position:relative;padding:0 0 clamp(38px,4.5vw,58px)}
210	.step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-31px;top:7px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);border:2.5px solid var(--green);transition:background .4s,box-shadow .4s}
211	.step.in::before{background:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(188,226,58,.3)}
212	.step .num{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--green)}
213	.step h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 8px}
214	.step p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px;font-size:14.5px}
215	
216	/* ============ CONVERGE ============ */
217	.converge{overflow:clip}
218	.cv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
219	.cv-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);will-change:transform;border:1px solid var(--line)}
220	.cv-img img{width:100%;height:clamp(240px,30vw,380px);object-fit:cover}
221	.cv-mid{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,50px) 0 0}
222	.cv-mid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
223	.cv-mid p{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
224	
225	/* ============ PERSONAL ============ */
226	.personal{background:var(--pine);color:#eaf5ec;position:relative;overflow:clip}
227	.personal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 46% at 78% 18%,rgba(188,226,58,.12),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 96px)}
228	.personal .wrap{position:relative}
229	.personal .eyebrow{color:var(--lime)}
230	.p-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
231	.p-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin:14px 0 16px;color:#f4faf2}
232	.p-grid .ptxt p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:440px}
233	.pref-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
234	.pchip{border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#cfe3d4;transition:.2s var(--ease)}
235	.pchip:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-2px)}
236	.pchip.on{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
237	.rec-wrap{position:relative}
238	.rec-core{background:rgba(234,245,236,.06);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
239	.rec-core .av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px var(--fs);flex:none}
240	.rec-core b{font-size:14.5px}
241	.rec-core span{display:block;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fb59c;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
242	.rec-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
243	.recard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.05);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,background .3s;will-change:transform}
244	.recard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.5);background:rgba(234,245,236,.09)}
245	.recard .th{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green-deep)}
246	.recard .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
247	.recard b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
248	.recard span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8fb59c}
249	.recard .match{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--fm);color:var(--lime);flex:none}
250	
251	/* ============ FIELDS / LOCATIONS ============ */
252	.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);align-items:start}
253	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
254	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
255	.fchip svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}
256	.fchip em{font:600 10px var(--fm);font-style:normal;color:var(--dim)}
257	.fchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
258	.locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
259	.loc{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
260	.loc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
261	.loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
262	.loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
263	.loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,43,29,.05),rgba(13,43,29,.78))}
264	.loc div{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
265	.loc b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;color:#f4faf2;font-weight:600}
266	.loc span{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lime);text-transform:uppercase}
267	.loc.soon{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center}
268	.loc.soon::after{display:none}
269	.loc.soon b{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
270	.loc.soon span{color:var(--dim)}
271	.loc.soon div{position:static;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
272	
273	/* ============ CAROUSEL ============ */
274	.newsec{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:clip}
275	.car{position:relative;cursor:grab}
276	.car.drag{cursor:grabbing}
277	.car-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;will-change:transform;padding:6px 0 10px}
278	.car-track .icard{width:280px;flex:none;pointer-events:none}
279	.car-hint{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);gap:14px;align-items:center}
280	.car-hint i{width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
281	
282	/* ============ BENEFITS ============ */
283	.ben{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,4.5vw,70px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
284	.ben+.ben{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
285	.ben h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 12px}
286	.ben .bt p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}
287	.ben .bt ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
288	.ben .bt li{display:flex;gap:11px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
289	.ben .bt li svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--green);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
290	.bvis{position:relative;min-height:300px}
291	.stack{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:15px 17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
292	.bvis:hover .stack{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg)!important}
293	.stack b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
294	.stack span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
295	.stack .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
296	.stack .dl{font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
297	.stack .dl.ok{color:var(--green)}
298	.check-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:22px;max-width:420px;margin:auto}
299	.check-card h4{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:14px}
300	.ck{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
301	.ck .bx{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none;border-radius:7px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
302	.ck .bx svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:3}
303	.in .ck .bx{transform:scale(1)}
304	.ck:nth-child(3) .bx{transition-delay:.15s}.ck:nth-child(4) .bx{transition-delay:.3s}.ck:nth-child(5) .bx{transition-delay:.45s}
305	.ck b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
306	.ck span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
307	.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px}
308	.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
309	.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
310	.tcard .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(23,122,76,.1);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
311	.tcard .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
312	.tcard b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
313	.tcard p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px}
314	
315	/* ============ CTA ============ */
316	.cta-panel{position:relative;overflow:clip;background:var(--pine);border-radius:26px;color:#eaf5ec;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) clamp(26px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
317	.cta-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.16),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
318	.cta-panel>*{position:relative}
319	.cta-panel h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f4faf2;max-width:720px;margin:16px auto 18px}
320	.cta-panel p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 30px}
321	.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
322	.cta-note{margin-top:26px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389}
323	
324	/* ============ FOOTER — public landing only ============ */
325	footer{margin-top:clamp(70px,8vw,110px);background:var(--pine2);color:#a9c2b0;border-top:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);position:relative;overflow:clip}
326	footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(46% 34% at 12% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.09),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
327	.ft{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:38px;padding:clamp(54px,6vw,76px) 0 44px}
328	.ft .brand{color:#f4faf2}
329	.ft .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
330	.ft .fb p{font-size:13.5px;max-width:290px;margin-top:16px}
331	.ft .fb .fmono{margin-top:18px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
332	.ft .fb .fmono::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
333	.ft h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389;margin-bottom:18px}
334	.ft ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
335	.ft ul a{font-size:13.5px;color:#a9c2b0;transition:color .2s,padding-left .3s var(--ease)}
336	.ft ul a:hover{color:var(--lime);padding-left:6px}
337	.ft-bar{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.09);padding:22px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
338	.top-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.2);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a9c2b0;transition:.25s}
339	.top-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}
340	.top-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
341	.ft-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(88px,17.5vw,250px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.05);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(188,226,58,.12);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(6%)}
342	
343	/* ============ JOURNEY WIDGET ============ */
344	.journey{position:fixed;right:26px;top:96px;z-index:90;width:212px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px}
345	.journey h5{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7}
346	.jrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
347	.jrow b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em}
348	.jline{position:relative;height:74px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);margin:14px 0 12px 4px}
349	.jline i{position:absolute;left:0;width:2px;background:var(--green);height:0%}
350	.jline::before,.jline::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2)}
351	.jline::before{top:-4px}
352	.jline::after{bottom:-4px;background:var(--green)}
353	.jdot{position:absolute;left:-5px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);border:2.5px solid var(--green);top:0%}
354	.jstages{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
355	.jstages li{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
356	.jstages li::before{content:"–"}
357	.jstages li.on{color:var(--green)}
358	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:400;background:var(--dark);color:#eef1e8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
359	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
360	
361	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
362	@media (max-width:1240px){.journey{display:none}}
363	@media (max-width:1020px){
364	  .nlinks{display:none}
365	  .nsign{display:none}

368	  .hero-vis{height:480px;max-width:560px}
369	  .how .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
370	  .how-left{position:static}
371	  .p-grid,.f-grid,.ben{grid-template-columns:1fr}
372	  .ben .bvis{order:2;min-height:320px}
373	}
374	@media (max-width:640px){
375	  .hero{padding-top:120px}
376	  .ncta{padding:9px 15px}
377	  .searchbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
378	  .sb-q{padding:12px 14px}
379	  .sb-div{width:auto;height:1px;margin:0 8px}
380	  .sb-city{padding:11px 14px}
381	  .sb-btn{padding:13px;justify-content:center}
382	  .hero-vis{height:430px}
383	  .fc2{display:none}
384	  .cv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
385	  .trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}
386	  .locs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
387	  .ft{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
388	}
389	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
390	  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
391	  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
392	  [data-rev]{opacity:1;transform:none}
393	  .car{overflow-x:auto}
394	  .car-track .icard{pointer-events:auto}
395	}
396	</style>

451	      <span class="eyebrow">Cameroon's internship index</span>
452	      <h1 class="display">Find the right internship. <span class="hl">Without the search chaos.</span></h1>
453	      <p class="sub">InternHub gathers every open internship across Douala, Yaoundé, Buea and Bamenda — matched to your field, your city and your preferences, verified by our team, tracked to the deadline.</p>

490	<!-- ============ HOW ============ -->
491	<section class="sec how" id="how" data-stage="LEARN">
492	  <div class="wrap">
493	    <div class="how-left" data-rev="left">
494	      <span class="eyebrow">The workflow</span>
495	      <h2 class="display">Four steps between you and your first real role</h2>
496	      <p>No accounts required to browse. No fees, ever. Just a clear path from "what's out there?" to a submitted application.</p>
497	      <div style="margin-top:26px"><a class="btn btn-dark" href="#discover">Start discovering<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a></div>
498	    </div>
499	    <div class="steps" id="steps">
500	      <div class="rail"><i id="railFill"></i></div>
501	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">01</span><h3>Tell us what you're looking for</h3><p>Pick your field, your city and how you like to work. Thirty seconds — it shapes everything you see next.</p></div>
502	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">02</span><h3>Discover matching internships</h3><p>Every listing shows the deadline, the stipend when there is one, and whether our team has verified the company.</p></div>
503	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">03</span><h3>Save the ones worth chasing</h3><p>Bookmark opportunities and your dashboard tracks each deadline, warning you before anything closes.</p></div>
504	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">04</span><h3>Apply through the original source</h3><p>We hand you the company's own application link with every detail in place — you apply directly, nothing missing.</p></div>
505	    </div>
506	  </div>
