559	<!-- ============ BENEFITS ============ -->
560	<section class="sec" id="benefits" data-stage="GROW" style="padding-top:0">
561	  <div class="wrap">
562	    <div class="ben">
563	      <div class="bt" data-rev="left">
564	        <span class="eyebrow">Save & track</span>
565	        <h3>Save once, never miss a deadline</h3>
566	        <p>Your saved list is a quiet assistant. It watches every closing date so you don't have to.</p>
567	        <ul>
568	          <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>Deadline warnings 7 days and 48 hours before close</li>
569	          <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>Stipend and work-mode captured on every save</li>
570	          <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>Saved roles stay saved after they leave What's New</li>
571	        </ul>
572	      </div>
573	      <div class="bvis" data-rev="right">
574	        <div class="stack" style="left:6%;top:6%;width:270px;transform:rotate(-3deg)"><div class="row"><div><b>Finance Analyst Intern</b><span>MTN Cameroun · Douala</span></div><span class="dl">6d left</span></div></div>
575	        <div class="stack" style="right:4%;top:34%;width:260px;transform:rotate(2deg)"><div class="row"><div><b>AgriTech Intern</b><span>AgPro · Buea</span></div><span class="dl ok">Tracked</span></div></div>
576	        <div class="stack" style="left:12%;bottom:2%;width:265px;transform:rotate(-1deg)"><div class="row"><div><b>UX Research Intern</b><span>Minka Health · Remote</span></div><span class="dl">15d left</span></div></div>
577	      </div>
578	    </div>
579	    <div class="ben">
580	      <div class="bvis" data-rev="left" id="checkVis">
581	        <div class="check-card">
582	          <h4>Verification pass · listing #128</h4>
583	          <div class="ck"><span class="bx"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span><div><b>Company registration confirmed</b><span>Checked against the company's own posting</span></div></div>
584	          <div class="ck"><span class="bx"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span><div><b>Application link tested</b><span>Opens a live, public application page</span></div></div>
585	          <div class="ck"><span class="bx"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span><div><b>Deadline & stipend recorded</b><span>Comparable at a glance</span></div></div>
586	          <div class="ck"><span class="bx"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span><div><b>Contact details verified</b><span>A real person answers</span></div></div>
587	        </div>
588	      </div>
589	      <div class="bt" data-rev="right">
590	        <span class="eyebrow">Built on verification</span>
591	        <h3>Checked before it reaches you</h3>
592	        <p>Volume is easy. Trust is the product. Every listing is confirmed against the company's own posting before it goes live — and unverified suggestions are clearly labelled until they pass.</p>
593	        <ul>
594	          <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l7 4v6c0 5-3.5 8.5-7 10-3.5-1.5-7-5-7-10V6z"/></svg>Human review on every student suggestion</li>
595	          <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l7 4v6c0 5-3.5 8.5-7 10-3.5-1.5-7-5-7-10V6z"/></svg>Expired roles removed automatically at deadline</li>
596	        </ul>
597	      </div>
598	    </div>
599	    <div style="text-align:center" data-rev>
600	      <span class="eyebrow" style="justify-content:center">Why students stay</span>
601	      <h2 class="display" style="font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,42px);margin-top:14px">Built on verification, not volume</h2>
602	    </div>
603	    <div class="trio" data-rev-group>
604	      <div class="tcard"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span><b>Checked</b><p>Every listing is confirmed against the company's own posting before it goes live.</p></div>
605	      <div class="tcard"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg></span><b>Tracked</b><p>Deadlines, stipends and work mode are recorded so you can compare at a glance.</p></div>
606	      <div class="tcard"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 12v8H4v-8M12 2v13M7 10l5 5 5-5"/></svg></span><b>Free</b><p>InternHub is free for students, always — funded by partner companies, not by you.</p></div>
607	    </div>
608	  </div>
609	</section>

616	      <h2 class="display">Your first real role starts with a single scroll.</h2>
617	      <p>Join students across five cities who stopped searching twelve tabs at a time. Free account, thirty seconds, whole index.</p>
618	      <div class="cta-btns">
619	        <a class="btn btn-lime" href="#discover">Browse internships<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>

628	<footer>
629	  <div class="wrap">

740	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerenter",()=>paused=true);

746	 (function loop(){
747	  if(!paused&&!drag){vel*=.92;off+=.45+vel*.15;}
748	  if(half>0){off=((off%half)+half)%half;}

762	$("#heroVis").addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{mx=0;my=0;});
763	let ticking=false;
764	function onScroll(){if(ticking)return;ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ticking=false;const y=scrollY,vh=innerHeight;
765	 nav.classList.toggle("scrolled",y>26);
766	 const max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-vh;const p=Math.min(1,y/max);
767	 jFill.style.height=(p*100)+"%";jDot.style.top=(p*100)+"%";jProg.textContent=Math.round(p*100)+"%";
768	 let cur="DISCOVER";stageSecs.forEach(s=>{if(s.getBoundingClientRect().top<vh*.5)cur=s.dataset.stage;});
769	 if(p>.96)cur="FUTURE";
770	 if(jStageEl.textContent!==cur){jStageEl.textContent=cur;document.querySelectorAll("#jStages li").forEach(li=>li.classList.toggle("on",li.dataset.s===cur));}

772	  const r=cvL.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();const cp=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(vh-r.top)/(vh*.9)));
773	  cvL.style.transform=`translateX(${(1-cp)*-10}%) scale(${.94+cp*.06})`;
774	  cvR.style.transform=`translateX(${(1-cp)*10}%) scale(${.94+cp*.06})`;
775	  const sr=steps.getBoundingClientRect();const sp=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(vh*.7-sr.top)/(sr.height)));rail.style.transform=`scaleY(${sp})`;
776	  document.querySelectorAll(".recard").forEach(el=>{const rr=el.getBoundingClientRect();const c2=(rr.top+rr.height/2-vh/2)/vh;el.style.transform=`translateX(${c2*+el.dataset.rx}px)`;});}
777	});}

38	.mono{font-family:var(--fm)}

40	.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(188,226,58,.25)}
41	.display{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.06}
42	.hl{background:linear-gradient(transparent 60%,var(--lime) 60%,var(--lime) 94%,transparent 94%)}
43	.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;padding:13px 22px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s,background .2s,border-color .2s;white-space:nowrap}
44	.btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
45	.btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
46	.btn-lime{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
47	.btn-lime:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(120,160,20,.5)}
48	.btn-dark{background:var(--green-deep);color:#eaf5ec}
49	.btn-dark:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -14px rgba(11,66,41,.55)}
50	.btn-ghost{border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--ink);background:transparent}
51	.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--ink);transform:translateY(-2px)}
52	.btn-ghost.light{border-color:rgba(234,245,236,.3);color:#eaf5ec}
53	.btn-ghost.light:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime)}
54	.pill-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--dark);color:#e8ebe2;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 15px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}
55	.pill-tag::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
56	
57	/* ============ NAV — public landing only ============ */
58	.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;color:var(--ink);transition:background .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s,color .45s}
59	.nav-in{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(18px,3vw,30px);height:86px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:18px;transition:height .45s var(--ease)}
60	.nav.scrolled{background:rgba(9,30,20,.74);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.15);box-shadow:0 14px 44px -22px rgba(4,16,10,.65);color:#eaf5ec}
61	.nav.scrolled .nav-in{height:64px}
62	.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em;justify-self:start}
63	.brand .lg{width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--lime);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),background .45s,color .45s}
64	.brand .lg svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke-width:2.4}
65	.brand:hover .lg{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.05)}
66	.nav.scrolled .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
67	.nlinks{justify-self:center;display:flex;gap:2px}
68	.nl{position:relative;padding:9px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;opacity:.75;transition:opacity .25s}
69	.nl::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:4px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--lime);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
70	.nl:hover{opacity:1}
71	.nl:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
72	.nact{justify-self:end;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
73	.nsign{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;opacity:.8;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;transition:.25s}
74	.nsign:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--green)}
75	.nav.scrolled .nsign:hover{color:var(--lime)}
76	.ncta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 19px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),box-shadow .25s}
77	.ncta svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
78	.ncta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(110,150,20,.55)}
79	.ncta:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
80	.ncta:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.97)}
81	.menu-btn{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:11px;place-items:center;opacity:.85;transition:.25s}
82	.menu-btn:hover{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-1px)}
83	.menu-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
84	/* mobile panel */
85	.mmenu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:var(--pine2);color:#eaf5ec;transform:translateY(-102%);transition:transform .5s var(--ease);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:20px clamp(18px,5vw,30px) 26px;overflow-y:auto}
86	.mmenu::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(56% 34% at 82% -6%,rgba(188,226,58,.14),transparent 62%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 92px);pointer-events:none}
87	.mmenu.open{transform:none}
88	.mmenu>*{position:relative}
89	.mm-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px}
90	.mm-head .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
91	.mm-x{width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.25s}
92	.mm-x:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:rotate(90deg)}
93	.mm-x svg{width:17px;height:17px}
94	.mmenu nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:16px}
95	.mmenu nav a{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(28px,7vw,38px);font-weight:600;padding:16px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.1);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;transition:padding-left .3s var(--ease),color .2s}
96	.mmenu nav a span{font:600 11px var(--fm);color:#7ba389;letter-spacing:.18em}
97	.mmenu nav a:hover{padding-left:14px;color:var(--lime)}
98	.mm-cta{margin-top:auto;padding-top:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
99	.mm-note{margin-top:18px;text-align:center;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
100	
101	/* ============ HERO (unchanged) ============ */
102	.hero{position:relative;padding:158px 0 90px;overflow:clip}
103	.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.04fr .96fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,64px);align-items:center}
104	.hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,5.6vw,74px);margin:22px 0 20px}
105	.hero .sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(15px,1.4vw,17.5px);max-width:520px}
106	.searchbar{margin-top:30px;display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:16px;padding:7px;gap:6px;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s;max-width:560px}
107	.searchbar:focus-within{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(188,226,58,.28),var(--sh)}
108	.sb-q{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 14px;min-width:0}
109	.sb-q svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--dim);flex:none}
110	.sb-q input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:none;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink)}
111	.sb-q input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
112	.sb-div{width:1px;background:var(--line);margin:8px 0}
113	.sb-city{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 12px}
114	.sb-city svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--dim)}
115	.sb-city select{border:0;outline:0;background:none;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;appearance:none}
116	.sb-btn{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);border-radius:11px;padding:0 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
117	.sb-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
118	.sb-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
119	.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
120	.trust{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px;font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
121	.trust b{color:var(--green);font-weight:600}
122	.trust span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
123	.trust i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
124	.hero-vis{position:relative;height:560px}
125	.hv-glow{position:absolute;inset:8% 4%;background:radial-gradient(46% 40% at 60% 42%,rgba(188,226,58,.32),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40% 36% at 34% 66%,rgba(23,122,76,.22),transparent 70%);filter:blur(6px)}
126	.hv-main{position:absolute;left:8%;top:6%;width:74%;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);border:1px solid var(--line)}
127	.hv-main img{width:100%;height:420px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
128	.hv-main:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
129	.hv-main .pill-tag{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px}
130	.fcard{position:absolute;width:250px;will-change:transform}
131	.fcard .fc-in{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);animation:bob 7s ease-in-out infinite}
132	.fcard:nth-child(odd) .fc-in{animation-delay:-3s}
133	@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
134	.fc-top{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
135	.fc-av{width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--pine);color:var(--lime);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12px var(--fs)}
136	.fc-top b{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.25}
137	.fc-top span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
138	.fc-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
139	.fc-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut);font-style:normal}
140	.fc-meta i.v{background:rgba(23,122,76,.12);color:var(--green)}
141	.fc-meta i.d{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
142	.fc1{right:-2%;top:2%}
143	.fc2{left:-3%;bottom:20%}
144	.fc3{right:2%;bottom:-2%}
145	.hv-chip{position:absolute;left:16%;top:-2%;z-index:3}
146	
147	/* ============ TICKER ============ */
148	.ticker{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;padding:13px 0}
149	.tk-track{display:flex;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:tick 36s linear infinite}
150	.ticker:hover .tk-track{animation-play-state:paused}
151	@keyframes tick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
152	.tk-track span{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);padding:0 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}
153	.tk-track span::after{content:"·";color:var(--green);font-size:15px}
154	
155	/* ============ SECTIONS COMMON ============ */
156	.sec{padding:clamp(78px,9vw,124px) 0}
157	.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);flex-wrap:wrap}
158	.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin-top:14px;max-width:560px}
159	.sec-head p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:10px;max-width:520px}
160	.link-more{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s;padding-bottom:3px}
161	.link-more svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
162	.link-more:hover{border-color:var(--lime)}
163	.link-more:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
164	[data-rev]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .8s var(--ease)}
165	[data-rev="left"]{transform:translateX(-36px)}
166	[data-rev="right"]{transform:translateX(36px)}
167	[data-rev="scale"]{transform:scale(.93)}
168	[data-rev].in{opacity:1;transform:none}
169	
170	/* ============ DISCOVER GRID ============ */
171	.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(258px,1fr));gap:16px}
172	.icard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s}
173	.icard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh);border-color:var(--line2)}
174	.ic-media{position:relative;height:150px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pine)}
175	.ic-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}
176	.icard:hover .ic-media img{transform:scale(1.045)}
177	.ic-media .noimg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.6);font:700 26px var(--fs);background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--pine))}
178	.ic-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}
179	.bdg{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:4.5px 9px;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
180	.bdg.new{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
181	.bdg.ver{background:rgba(13,43,29,.72);color:#9fe8bd;border:1px solid rgba(159,232,189,.35)}
182	.save{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(251,252,248,.92);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:.2s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
183	.save svg{width:15px;height:15px}
184	.save:hover{transform:scale(1.1);color:var(--green)}
185	.save.on{background:var(--green-deep);color:var(--lime)}
186	.save.on svg{fill:currentColor}
187	.save.pop{animation:spop .35s var(--ease)}
188	@keyframes spop{40%{transform:scale(1.28)}}
189	.ic-body{padding:15px 16px 13px;flex:1}
190	.ic-body h3{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
191	.ic-co{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px}
192	.ic-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
193	.ic-meta i{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 8px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut)}
194	.ic-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
195	.ic-dead{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}
196	.ic-dead.warn{color:var(--amber)}
197	.ic-link{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
198	.ic-link svg{width:12px;height:12px}
199	.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:56px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:16px;color:var(--mut)}
200	.empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
201	
202	/* ============ HOW ============ */
203	.how{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
204	.how .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(36px,5vw,80px)}
205	.how-left{position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:start}
206	.how-left h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px);margin:14px 0 16px}
207	.how-left p{color:var(--mut);max-width:400px}
208	.steps{position:relative;padding-left:34px}
209	.rail{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:2px;background:var(--line2)}
210	.rail i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--green),var(--lime));transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}
211	.step{position:relative;padding:0 0 clamp(38px,4.5vw,58px)}
212	.step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-31px;top:7px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);border:2.5px solid var(--green);transition:background .4s,box-shadow .4s}
213	.step.in::before{background:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(188,226,58,.3)}
214	.step .num{font:600 12px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--green)}
215	.step h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px);font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 8px}
216	.step p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px;font-size:14.5px}
217	
218	/* ============ CONVERGE ============ */
219	.converge{overflow:clip}
220	.cv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
221	.cv-img{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh);will-change:transform;border:1px solid var(--line)}
222	.cv-img img{width:100%;height:clamp(240px,30vw,380px);object-fit:cover}
223	.cv-mid{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,50px) 0 0}
224	.cv-mid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,52px)}
225	.cv-mid p{color:var(--mut);max-width:560px;margin:14px auto 0}
226	
227	/* ============ PERSONAL ============ */
228	.personal{background:var(--pine);color:#eaf5ec;position:relative;overflow:clip}
229	.personal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 46% at 78% 18%,rgba(188,226,58,.12),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 96px)}
230	.personal .wrap{position:relative}
231	.personal .eyebrow{color:var(--lime)}
232	.p-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
233	.p-grid h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin:14px 0 16px;color:#f4faf2}
234	.p-grid .ptxt p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:440px}
235	.pref-chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
236	.pchip{border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.25);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#cfe3d4;transition:.2s var(--ease)}
237	.pchip:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-2px)}
238	.pchip.on{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
239	.rec-wrap{position:relative}
240	.rec-core{background:rgba(234,245,236,.06);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
241	.rec-core .av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px var(--fs);flex:none}
242	.rec-core b{font-size:14.5px}
243	.rec-core span{display:block;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fb59c;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
244	.rec-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
245	.recard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;background:rgba(234,245,236,.05);border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,background .3s;will-change:transform}
246	.recard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(188,226,58,.5);background:rgba(234,245,236,.09)}
247	.recard .th{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green-deep)}
248	.recard .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
249	.recard b{display:block;font-size:13.5px}
250	.recard span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8fb59c}
251	.recard .match{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--fm);color:var(--lime);flex:none}
252	
253	/* ============ FIELDS / LOCATIONS ============ */
254	.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);align-items:start}
255	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
256	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
257	.fchip svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--green)}
258	.fchip em{font:600 10px var(--fm);font-style:normal;color:var(--dim)}
259	.fchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
260	.locs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
261	.loc{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:118px;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
262	.loc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
263	.loc img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
264	.loc:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
265	.loc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(13,43,29,.05),rgba(13,43,29,.78))}
266	.loc div{position:absolute;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
267	.loc b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;color:#f4faf2;font-weight:600}
268	.loc span{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--lime);text-transform:uppercase}
269	.loc.soon{background:var(--bg2);display:grid;place-items:center}
270	.loc.soon::after{display:none}
271	.loc.soon b{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
272	.loc.soon span{color:var(--dim)}
273	.loc.soon div{position:static;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
274	
275	/* ============ CAROUSEL ============ */
276	.newsec{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:clip}
277	.car{position:relative;cursor:grab}
278	.car.drag{cursor:grabbing}
279	.car-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;will-change:transform;padding:6px 0 10px}
280	.car-track .icard{width:280px;flex:none;pointer-events:none}
281	.car-hint{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);gap:14px;align-items:center}
282	.car-hint i{width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
283	
284	/* ============ BENEFITS ============ */
285	.ben{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(30px,4.5vw,70px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) 0}
286	.ben+.ben{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
287	.ben h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,34px);font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 12px}
288	.ben .bt p{color:var(--mut);max-width:440px}
289	.ben .bt ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
290	.ben .bt li{display:flex;gap:11px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
291	.ben .bt li svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--green);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
292	.bvis{position:relative;min-height:300px}
293	.stack{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:15px 17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
294	.bvis:hover .stack{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg)!important}
295	.stack b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
296	.stack span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
297	.stack .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
298	.stack .dl{font:700 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
299	.stack .dl.ok{color:var(--green)}
300	.check-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:22px;max-width:420px;margin:auto}
301	.check-card h4{font:600 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:14px}
302	.ck{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
303	.ck .bx{width:21px;height:21px;flex:none;border-radius:7px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
304	.ck .bx svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:3}
305	.in .ck .bx{transform:scale(1)}
306	.ck:nth-child(3) .bx{transition-delay:.15s}.ck:nth-child(4) .bx{transition-delay:.3s}.ck:nth-child(5) .bx{transition-delay:.45s}
307	.ck b{font-size:13.5px;display:block}
308	.ck span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
309	.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:44px}
310	.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;transition:.25s var(--ease)}
311	.tcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
312	.tcard .ic{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(23,122,76,.1);color:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
313	.tcard .ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
314	.tcard b{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:20px;font-weight:600}
315	.tcard p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px}
316	
317	/* ============ CTA ============ */
318	.cta-panel{position:relative;overflow:clip;background:var(--pine);border-radius:26px;color:#eaf5ec;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,84px) clamp(26px,5vw,80px);text-align:center}
319	.cta-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(52% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.16),transparent 65%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(234,245,236,.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
320	.cta-panel>*{position:relative}
321	.cta-panel h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,58px);color:#f4faf2;max-width:720px;margin:16px auto 18px}
322	.cta-panel p{color:#a9c2b0;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 30px}
323	.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
324	.cta-note{margin-top:26px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389}
325	
326	/* ============ FOOTER — public landing only ============ */
327	footer{margin-top:clamp(70px,8vw,110px);background:var(--pine2);color:#a9c2b0;border-top:1px solid rgba(188,226,58,.16);position:relative;overflow:clip}
328	footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(46% 34% at 12% 0%,rgba(188,226,58,.09),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
329	.ft{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:38px;padding:clamp(54px,6vw,76px) 0 44px}
330	.ft .brand{color:#f4faf2}
331	.ft .brand .lg{background:var(--lime);color:var(--pine)}
332	.ft .fb p{font-size:13.5px;max-width:290px;margin-top:16px}
333	.ft .fb .fmono{margin-top:18px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
334	.ft .fb .fmono::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
335	.ft h4{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7ba389;margin-bottom:18px}
336	.ft ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
337	.ft ul a{font-size:13.5px;color:#a9c2b0;transition:color .2s,padding-left .3s var(--ease)}
338	.ft ul a:hover{color:var(--lime);padding-left:6px}
339	.ft-bar{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.09);padding:22px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6d947e}
340	.top-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(234,245,236,.2);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a9c2b0;transition:.25s}
341	.top-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}
342	.top-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
343	.ft-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(88px,17.5vw,250px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;color:rgba(188,226,58,.05);-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(188,226,58,.12);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(6%)}
344	
345	/* ============ JOURNEY WIDGET ============ */
346	.journey{position:fixed;right:26px;top:96px;z-index:90;width:212px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px}
347	.journey h5{font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7}
348	.jrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
349	.jrow b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em}
350	.jline{position:relative;height:74px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);margin:14px 0 12px 4px}
351	.jline i{position:absolute;left:0;width:2px;background:var(--green);height:0%}
352	.jline::before,.jline::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2)}
353	.jline::before{top:-4px}
354	.jline::after{bottom:-4px;background:var(--green)}
355	.jdot{position:absolute;left:-5px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime);border:2.5px solid var(--green);top:0%}
356	.jstages{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
357	.jstages li{font:600 9.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;gap:8px;transition:color .3s}
358	.jstages li::before{content:"–"}
359	.jstages li.on{color:var(--green)}
360	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:400;background:var(--dark);color:#eef1e8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
361	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
362	
363	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
364	@media (max-width:1240px){.journey{display:none}}
365	@media (max-width:1020px){
366	  .nlinks{display:none}
367	  .nsign{display:none}
368	  .menu-btn{display:grid}
369	  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
370	  .hero-vis{height:480px;max-width:560px}
371	  .how .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
372	  .how-left{position:static}
373	  .p-grid,.f-grid,.ben{grid-template-columns:1fr}
374	  .ben .bvis{order:2;min-height:320px}
375	}
376	@media (max-width:640px){
377	  .hero{padding-top:120px}
378	  .ncta{padding:9px 15px}
379	  .searchbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
380	  .sb-q{padding:12px 14px}
381	  .sb-div{width:auto;height:1px;margin:0 8px}
382	  .sb-city{padding:11px 14px}
383	  .sb-btn{padding:13px;justify-content:center}
384	  .hero-vis{height:430px}
385	  .fc2{display:none}
386	  .cv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
387	  .trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}
388	  .locs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
389	  .ft{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
390	}
391	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
392	  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
393	  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms !important;transition-duration:.01ms !important}
394	  [data-rev]{opacity:1;transform:none}
395	  .car{overflow-x:auto}
396	  .car-track .icard{pointer-events:auto}
397	}
398	</style>

436	<!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
437	<section class="hero" id="top" data-stage="DISCOVER">
438	  <div class="wrap">
439	    <div>
440	      <span class="eyebrow">Cameroon's internship index</span>
441	      <h1 class="display">Find the right internship. <span class="hl">Without the search chaos.</span></h1>
442	      <p class="sub">InternHub gathers every open internship across Douala, Yaoundé, Buea and Bamenda — matched to your field, your city and your preferences, verified by our team, tracked to the deadline.</p>
443	      <form class="searchbar" id="searchForm">
444	        <div class="sb-q"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input id="q" placeholder="Internship, company or field…" autocomplete="off"></div>
445	        <div class="sb-div"></div>
446	        <div class="sb-city"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12S4 16 4 10a8 8 0 0 1 16 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg><select id="citySel"><option value="">All cities</option><option>Douala</option><option>Yaoundé</option><option>Buea</option><option>Remote</option></select></div>
447	        <button class="sb-btn" type="submit">Search<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
448	      </form>

450	        <a class="btn btn-lime" href="student_pages/browse.html">View all positions<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
451	        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="student_pages/suggest.html">Suggest opportunity<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg></a>
452	      </div>

454	    </div>

456	      <div class="hv-glow"></div>

459	      <div class="fcard fc1" id="fc1"><div class="fc-in"></div></div>
460	      <div class="fcard fc2" id="fc2"><div class="fc-in"></div></div>
461	      <div class="fcard fc3" id="fc3"><div class="fc-in"></div></div>
462	    </div>

468	<!-- ============ DISCOVER ============ -->
469	<section class="sec" id="discover" data-stage="EXPLORE">
470	  <div class="wrap">
471	    <div class="sec-head" data-rev>
472	      <div><span class="eyebrow">Live inventory</span><h2 class="display">Open right now, checked by humans</h2><p id="discCount"></p></div>
473	      <a class="link-more" href="#new">What's new this week<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
474	    </div>
475	    <div class="grid" id="gridDiscover" data-rev-group></div>
476	  </div>
477	</section>
478	
479	<!-- ============ HOW ============ -->
480	<section class="sec how" id="how" data-stage="LEARN">
481	  <div class="wrap">
482	    <div class="how-left" data-rev="left">
483	      <span class="eyebrow">The workflow</span>
484	      <h2 class="display">Four steps between you and your first real role</h2>
485	      <p>No accounts required to browse. No fees, ever. Just a clear path from "what's out there?" to a submitted application.</p>
486	      <div style="margin-top:26px"><a class="btn btn-dark" href="#discover">Start discovering<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a></div>
487	    </div>
488	    <div class="steps" id="steps">
489	      <div class="rail"><i id="railFill"></i></div>
490	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">01</span><h3>Tell us what you're looking for</h3><p>Pick your field, your city and how you like to work. Thirty seconds — it shapes everything you see next.</p></div>
491	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">02</span><h3>Discover matching internships</h3><p>Every listing shows the deadline, the stipend when there is one, and whether our team has verified the company.</p></div>
492	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">03</span><h3>Save the ones worth chasing</h3><p>Bookmark opportunities and your dashboard tracks each deadline, warning you before anything closes.</p></div>
493	      <div class="step" data-rev><span class="num">04</span><h3>Apply through the original source</h3><p>We hand you the company's own application link with every detail in place — you apply directly, nothing missing.</p></div>
494	    </div>
495	  </div>
496	</section>

498	<!-- ============ CONVERGE ============ -->
499	<section class="sec converge" id="converge" data-stage="EXPLORE">
500	  <div class="wrap">
501	    <div class="cv-grid">

503	      <div class="cv-img" id="cvR" data-rev="right"><img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1498050108023-c5249f4df085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=60" alt="Code on a screen"></div>
504	      <div class="cv-mid" data-rev><span class="eyebrow">One index</span><h2 class="display">Design desks and server rooms, <span class="hl">one scroll apart</span></h2><p>Fields that used to live on twelve different WhatsApp groups now live in one verified, searchable inventory.</p></div>
505	    </div>
506	  </div>
507	</section>

548	<!-- ============ BENEFITS ============ -->
549	<section class="sec" id="benefits" data-stage="GROW" style="padding-top:0">
550	  <div class="wrap">
551	    <div class="ben">
552	      <div class="bt" data-rev="left">
553	        <span class="eyebrow">Save & track</span>
554	        <h3>Save once, never miss a deadline</h3>

571	          <div class="ck"><span class="bx"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span><div><b>Contact details verified</b><span>A real person answers</span></div></div>

580	          <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l7 4v6c0 5-3.5 8.5-7 10-3.5-1.5-7-5-7-10V6z"/></svg>Closing dates tracked on every card and re-checked when you visit</li>

662	<script>
663	(function(){
664	  "use strict";
665	  const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
666	  const reduced=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
667	  const ICON={
668	    bookmark:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 21l-7-5-7 5V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>',
669	    arrow:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>'
670	  };
671	  const DEFAULT_FIC='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="7" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M9 7V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2M3 12.5h18"/></svg>';
672	  const FICO={
673	    'Software Engineering':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 6l-5 6 5 6M16 6l5 6-5 6"/></svg>',
674	    'Data & AI':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-8M22 20H2"/></svg>',
675	    Design:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 19l7-7 3 3-7 7-3-3z"/><path d="M18 13l-1.5-7.5L2 2l3.5 14.5L13 18l5-5z"/></svg>',
676	    Finance:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v10M15 9.5c0-1.4-1.3-2.5-3-2.5s-3 1.1-3 2.5 1.3 2.5 3 2.5 3 1.1 3 2.5-1.3 2.5-3 2.5-3-1.1-3-2.5"/></svg>',
677	    Agriculture:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 22V8"/><path d="M12 8C12 4 9 2 5 2c0 4 3 6 7 6zM12 12c0-4 3-6 7-6 0 4-3 6-7 6z"/></svg>',
678	    Engineering:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 2L3 14h7l-1 8 10-12h-7l1-8z"/></svg>',
679	    Health:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/></svg>',
680	    Marketing:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 11l18-8v18L3 13v-2z"/><path d="M7 13v6a2 2 0 0 0 4 0v-4"/></svg>'
681	  };
682	  const S={data:[],fields:[],locations:[],categories:[]};
683	  const st={q:"",city:"",field:""};
684	  let prefs=new Set();
685	
686	  const count=(arr)=>arr.length;
687	  const citiesPresent=()=>new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.city).filter(Boolean));
688	  const detailHref=(id)=>'internship.html?id='+encodeURIComponent(id);
689	
690	  function card(it){
691	    const dl=UI.deadlineInfo(it);
692	    const warn=dl.days!==null&&dl.days<=7;
693	    const saved=Auth.profile&&Saved.has(it.id);
694	    const href=detailHref(it.id);
695	    const ini=UI.esc(UI.initials(it.company||'—'));
696	    const media=it.image
697	      ? `<img src="${UI.esc(it.image)}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.outerHTML='<div class=noimg>${ini}</div>'">`
698	      : `<div class="noimg">${ini}</div>`;
699	    const badges=(UI.isNew(it)?'<span class="bdg new">New</span>':'')
700	      + (it.verified?'<span class="bdg ver">Verified</span>':'<span class="bdg ver" style="color:#cfd6cd;border-color:rgba(207,214,205,.3)">Pending</span>');
701	    return `<article class="icard">
702	      <div class="ic-media">${media}
703	        <div class="ic-badges">${badges}</div>
704	        <button class="save${saved?' on':''}" data-save="${UI.esc(it.id)}" aria-pressed="${saved}" aria-label="${saved?'Remove from saved':'Save internship'}">${ICON.bookmark}</button></div>
705	      <div class="ic-body"><h3><a href="${href}">${UI.esc(it.title||'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
706	        <p class="ic-co">${UI.esc(it.company||'—')} · ${UI.esc(it.city||'Cameroon')}</p>
707	        <div class="ic-meta"><i>${UI.esc(it.field||'Internship')}</i>${it.workMode?`<i>${UI.esc(it.workMode)}</i>`:''}${it.stipend?`<i>${UI.esc(it.stipend)}</i>`:''}</div></div>
708	      <div class="ic-foot"><span class="ic-dead${warn?' warn':''}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span><a class="ic-link" href="${href}">Details${ICON.arrow}</a></div></article>`;
709	  }
710	
711	  function filtered(){return S.data.filter(it=>{
712	    if(st.city&&it.city!==st.city)return false;
713	    if(st.field&&it.field!==st.field)return false;
714	    if(st.q){const h=(it.title+' '+it.company+' '+it.field+' '+it.city).toLowerCase();if(!h.includes(st.q.toLowerCase()))return false;}
715	    return true;});}
716	
717	  function renderGrid(){
718	    const g=$('#gridDiscover'); const list=filtered();
719	    if(!S.data.length){
720	      g.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><b>The index is being built</b>Our team is verifying the first internships now. Browse again shortly, or suggest an opportunity and we'll chase it down.</div>`;
721	      $('#discCount').textContent='';
722	    }else if(!list.length){
723	      g.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><b>No matches in the current index</b>Try clearing a filter — or suggest this opportunity and we'll chase it.<div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="clearF">Clear filters</button></div></div>`;
724	      $('#discCount').textContent=`Showing 0 of ${count(S.data)} open roles`;
725	      const c=$('#clearF');if(c)c.addEventListener("click",clearFilters);
726	    }else{
727	      g.innerHTML=list.map(card).join("");
728	      $('#discCount').textContent=`Showing ${count(list)} of ${count(S.data)} open roles`;
729	    }
730	  }
731	
732	  function clearFilters(){st.q="";st.city="";st.field="";const q=$('#q');const cs=$('#citySel');if(q)q.value="";if(cs)cs.value="";syncFieldChips();renderGrid();}
733	
734	  function renderCitySel(){
735	    const cs=$('#citySel'); if(!cs)return;
736	    const cities=(S.locations||[]).filter(c=>c!=='Remote').concat(['Remote']);
737	    cs.innerHTML='<option value="">All cities</option>'+cities.map(c=>`<option${c===st.city?' selected':''}>${UI.esc(c)}</option>`).join("");
738	  }
739	
740	  function renderHero(){
741	    const pill=$('#hvPill'); if(pill) pill.textContent=S.data.length?`${count(S.data)} open listings`:'Live index';
742	    const pool=S.data.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.verified?1:0)-(a.verified?1:0));
743	    ['#fc1','#fc2','#fc3'].forEach((sel,i)=>{const el=$(sel);if(!el)return;const it=pool[i];
744	      if(!it){el.style.display='none';return;}
745	      const dl=UI.deadlineInfo(it);const warn=dl.days!==null&&dl.days<=7;
746	      el.style.display='';
747	      el.querySelector('.fc-in').innerHTML=
748	        `<div class="fc-top"><span class="fc-av">${UI.esc(UI.initials(it.company||'—'))}</span><div><b>${UI.esc(it.title||'Role')}</b><span>${UI.esc(it.company||'')}</span></div></div>
749	         <div class="fc-meta">${it.verified?'<i class="v">Verified</i>':''}${it.workMode?`<i>${UI.esc(it.workMode)}</i>`:''}${dl.days!==null?`<i class="${warn?'d':''}">${UI.esc(dl.days<0?'Closed':dl.label)}</i>`:''}</div>`;
750	    });
751	  }
752	
753	  function renderTicker(){
754	    const tk=(S.fields||[]).slice(0,8).concat(S.locations||[]).concat(['Verified weekly','Free for students']);
755	    $('#tkTrack').innerHTML=(tk.map(t=>`<span>${UI.esc(t)}</span>`).join("")).repeat(2);
756	  }
757	
758	  function renderTrust(){
759	    $('#trustRow').innerHTML=`<span><i></i><b>${count(S.data)}</b>&nbsp;open roles</span><span><i></i><b>${citiesPresent().size}</b>&nbsp;cities</span><span><i></i><b>100%</b>&nbsp;free for students</span>`;
760	  }
761	
762	  function renderFieldChips(){
763	    const fields=S.fields&&S.fields.length?S.fields:[...new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.field).filter(Boolean))];
764	    $('#fieldChips').innerHTML=fields.map((f,i)=>`<button class="fchip" data-f="${UI.esc(f)}" data-rev style="transition-delay:${i*45}ms">${FICO[f]||DEFAULT_FIC}${UI.esc(f)}<em>${count(S.data.filter(x=>x.field===f))}</em></button>`).join("");
765	    syncFieldChips();
766	  }
767	  function syncFieldChips(){document.querySelectorAll("#fieldChips .fchip").forEach(b=>{const on=b.dataset.f===st.field;b.style.borderColor=on?"var(--green)":"";b.style.background=on?"var(--lime)":"";b.style.color=on?"var(--lime-ink)":"";});}
768	
769	  function renderLocs(){
770	    const locs=S.locations&&S.locations.length?S.locations:[...citiesPresent()];
771	    $('#locTiles').innerHTML=locs.map((c,i)=>{
772	      const n=count(S.data.filter(x=>x.city===c));
773	      return `<button class="loc${n?'':' soon'}" data-city="${UI.esc(c)}" data-rev style="transition-delay:${i*45}ms;${n?'background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--pine))':''}"><div><b>${UI.esc(c)}</b><span>${n?n+' open':'soon'}</span></div></button>`;
774	    }).join("");
775	  }
776	
777	  function seedPrefs(){
778	    const pf=(Auth.profile&&Auth.profile.preferences&&Auth.profile.preferences.fields)||[];
779	    const pool=(S.fields&&S.fields.length)?S.fields:[...new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.field).filter(Boolean))];
780	    let base=pf.filter(f=>pool.includes(f));
781	    if(!base.length){const counts={};S.data.forEach(d=>{if(d.field)counts[d.field]=(counts[d.field]||0)+1;});base=Object.entries(counts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,2).map(x=>x[0]);}
782	    prefs=new Set(base);
783	  }
784	  function renderPrefChips(){
785	    const pool=(S.fields&&S.fields.length)?S.fields:[...new Set(S.data.map(d=>d.field).filter(Boolean))];
786	    $('#prefChips').innerHTML=pool.map(f=>`<button class="pchip${prefs.has(f)?" on":""}" data-p="${UI.esc(f)}">${UI.esc(f)}</button>`).join("");
787	    renderRec();
788	  }
789	  function renderRec(){
790	    const signed=!!Auth.profile;
791	    const av=$('#recAv'),title=$('#recTitle');
792	    if(av)av.textContent=signed?UI.initials((Auth.profile&&Auth.profile.displayName)||''):'';
793	    if(title)title.textContent=signed?"Recommended for you":"Popular on the index";
794	    let m=S.data.filter(x=>prefs.has(x.field)).slice(0,4);
795	    if(!m.length)m=S.data.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.verified?1:0)-(a.verified?1:0)).slice(0,4);
796	    $('#recList').innerHTML=m.length?m.map(it=>{const dl=UI.deadlineInfo(it);
797	      return `<a class="recard" href="${detailHref(it.id)}"><span class="th" style="display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--lime);font:700 15px var(--fs)">${UI.esc(UI.initials(it.company||'—'))}</span><div><b>${UI.esc(it.title||'Role')}</b><span>${UI.esc(it.company||'')} · ${UI.esc(it.city||'')}</span></div><span class="match">${UI.esc(dl.days!==null?(dl.days<0?'Closed':(dl.days===0?'Today':dl.days+'d')):'Open')}</span></a>`;
798	    }).join(""):'<p style="color:#8fb59c;font-size:13.5px">No open roles match these fields yet. Add a field or check back soon.</p>';
799	    $('#recNote').textContent=signed?[...prefs].slice(0,2).join(" + ")||"Popular fields":"Popular fields";
800	  }
801	
802	  function renderSaveStack(){
803	    const el=$('#saveStack');if(!el)return;
804	    const pos=['left:6%;top:6%;width:270px;transform:rotate(-3deg)','right:4%;top:34%;width:262px;transform:rotate(2deg)','left:12%;bottom:2%;width:266px;transform:rotate(-1deg)'];
805	    if(!S.data.length){el.innerHTML=`<div class="stack" style="left:50%;top:50%;width:290px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-2deg)"><div class="row" style="flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px"><div><b>Nothing tracked yet</b><span>Sign in and save a role — InternHub watches every closing date for you.</span></div></div></div>`;return;}
806	    el.innerHTML=S.data.slice(0,3).map((it,i)=>{const dl=UI.deadlineInfo(it);const warn=dl.days!==null&&dl.days<=7&&dl.days>=0;
807	      const badge=dl.days===null?'Tracked':(dl.days<0?'Closed':dl.label);
808	      return `<div class="stack" style="${pos[i]||pos[0]}"><div class="row"><div><b>${UI.esc(it.title||'Role')}</b><span>${UI.esc((it.company||'')+(it.city?' · '+it.city:''))}</span></div><span class="dl${warn?'':' ok'}">${UI.esc(badge)}</span></div></div>`;
809	    }).join("");
810	  }
811	
812	  function renderCar(){
813	    const list=S.data.slice().sort((a,b)=>(UI.isNew(b)?1:0)-(UI.isNew(a)?1:0)).slice(0,12);
814	    $('#carTrack').innerHTML=list.length?list.map(card).join(""):'<p style="color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;padding:20px">No listings yet — the index opens as soon as roles are verified.</p>';
815	  }
816	
817	  function renderAll(){renderHero();renderTicker();renderTrust();renderCitySel();renderGrid();renderFieldChips();renderLocs();seedPrefs();renderPrefChips();renderSaveStack();renderCar();}
818	
819	  function showError(){
820	    const g=$('#gridDiscover'); if(g)g.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><b>Couldn't load the index</b>There was a problem reaching the database. Check your connection and reload.</div>`;
821	    $('#discCount').textContent='';
822	  }
823	
824	  // ---- wiring (static DOM) ----
825	  function wire(){
826	    $('#searchForm').addEventListener("submit",e=>{e.preventDefault();st.q=$('#q').value.trim();st.city=$('#citySel').value;renderGrid();$("#discover").scrollIntoView({behavior:reduced?"auto":"smooth"});});
827	    document.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-save]");if(!b)return;e.preventDefault();
828	      if(!Auth.profile){toast("Sign in to save internships");setTimeout(()=>{location.href="signin.html?next="+encodeURIComponent("student_pages/dashboard.html");},900);return;}
829	      const id=b.dataset.save;b.disabled=true;
830	      Saved.toggle(id).then(r=>{b.disabled=false;if(!r.ok){toast("Could not update your saved list");return;}
831	        const on=r.state==="saved";b.classList.toggle("on",on);b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(on));b.setAttribute("aria-label",on?"Remove from saved":"Save internship");
832	        document.querySelectorAll('[data-save="'+id+'"]').forEach(x=>{if(x!==b){x.classList.toggle("on",on);x.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(on));}});
833	        toast(on?"Saved to your list":"Removed from saved");});
834	    });
835	    $('#fieldChips').addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-f]");if(!b)return;st.field=st.field===b.dataset.f?"":b.dataset.f;syncFieldChips();renderGrid();$("#discover").scrollIntoView({behavior:reduced?"auto":"smooth"});});

739	 measure();addEventListener("resize",measure);
740	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerenter",()=>paused=true);
741	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{paused=false;});
742	 wrap.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{drag=true;paused=true;lx=e.clientX;wrap.classList.add("drag");wrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);});
743	 wrap.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{if(!drag)return;const dx=e.clientX-lx;lx=e.clientX;off-=dx;vel=-dx;});

745	 wrap.addEventListener("wheel",e=>{if(Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY)){e.preventDefault();off+=e.deltaX;paused=true;clearTimeout(resumeT);resumeT=setTimeout(()=>paused=false,900);}},{passive:false});
746	 (function loop(){
747	  if(!paused&&!drag){vel*=.92;off+=.45+vel*.15;}

762	$("#heroVis").addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{mx=0;my=0;});
763	let ticking=false;
764	function onScroll(){if(ticking)return;ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ticking=false;const y=scrollY,vh=innerHeight;
765	 nav.classList.toggle("scrolled",y>26);
766	 const max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-vh;const p=Math.min(1,y/max);
767	 jFill.style.height=(p*100)+"%";jDot.style.top=(p*100)+"%";jProg.textContent=Math.round(p*100)+"%";
768	 let cur="DISCOVER";stageSecs.forEach(s=>{if(s.getBoundingClientRect().top<vh*.5)cur=s.dataset.stage;});
769	 if(p>.96)cur="FUTURE";
770	 if(jStageEl.textContent!==cur){jStageEl.textContent=cur;document.querySelectorAll("#jStages li").forEach(li=>li.classList.toggle("on",li.dataset.s===cur));}
771	 if(!reduced){plx.forEach(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const c=(r.top+r.height/2-vh/2)*+el.dataset.plx;el.style.transform=`translateY(${c*-1}px)`;});
772	  const r=cvL.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();const cp=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(vh-r.top)/(vh*.9)));
773	  cvL.style.transform=`translateX(${(1-cp)*-10}%) scale(${.94+cp*.06})`;
774	  cvR.style.transform=`translateX(${(1-cp)*10}%) scale(${.94+cp*.06})`;
775	  const sr=steps.getBoundingClientRect();const sp=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(vh*.7-sr.top)/(sr.height)));rail.style.transform=`scaleY(${sp})`;
776	  document.querySelectorAll(".recard").forEach(el=>{const rr=el.getBoundingClientRect();const c2=(rr.top+rr.height/2-vh/2)/vh;el.style.transform=`translateX(${c2*+el.dataset.rx}px)`;});}
777	});}

48	  const byNewest = (list) => list.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
49	
50	  async function listQuery(query) {
51	    const snap = await query.get();
52	    return snap.docs.map(normalize);
53	  }
54	
55	  return {
56	    normalize,
57	
58	    /** Published, newest first. Optional limit for landing/carousels.
59	     *  Falls back to an index-free query (sort client-side) on a fresh
60	     *  Firestore project whose composite index isn't deployed yet. */
61	    async published(limit = null) {
62	      let q = col().where('published', '==', true).orderBy('createdAt', 'desc');
63	      if (limit) q = q.limit(limit);
64	      try {
65	        const items = await listQuery(q);
66	        return byNewest(items);
67	      } catch (err) {
68	        if (err && /requires an index|failed-precondition/i.test(String(err.code || '') + ' ' + String(err.message || ''))) {
69	          try {
70	            let fallback = col().where('published', '==', true);
71	            if (limit) fallback = fallback.limit(limit * 2);
72	            const snap = await fallback.get();
73	            console.warn('Internships.published: composite index missing — using index-free fallback. Deploy firestore.indexes.json.');
74	            return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize)).slice(0, limit || undefined);
75	          } catch (e2) { console.error('Internships.published fallback failed:', e2); throw e2; }
76	        }
77	        console.error('Internships.published failed:', err); throw err;
78	      }
79	    },
80	
81	    /** Published, cursor-paginated (pageSize). Returns {items, cursor, more}. */
82	    async publishedPage(pageSize = 24, cursor = null) {
83	      let q = col().where('published', '==', true).orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').limit(pageSize);
84	      if (cursor) q = col().where('published', '==', true).orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
85	        .startAfter(cursor).limit(pageSize);
86	      try {
87	        const snap = await q.get();
88	        const items = snap.docs.map(normalize);
89	        const last = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1];
90	        return { items, cursor: last ? last.data().createdAt : null, more: snap.size === pageSize };
91	      } catch (err) { console.error('Internships.publishedPage failed:', err); throw err; }
92	    },
93	
94	    /** Published + verified within the "New" window (Browse What's New / global). */
95	    async whatsNew(limit = 24) {
96	      const all = await this.published(limit * 4);
97	      return all.filter((i) => UI.isNew(i)).slice(0, limit);
98	    },
99	
100	    async featured(limit = 6) {
101	      try {
102	        const snap = await col().where('published', '==', true).where('featured', '==', true).limit(limit).get();
103	        return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize));
104	      } catch (_) { return []; }

125	    async all(limit = 500) {

133	      if (!user || !user.isAdmin) return { ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
134	      try {
135	        const now = serverTs();
136	        const ref = await col().add({
137	          ...data,

140	          published: !!data.published,
141	          status: data.published ? 'published' : 'draft',
142	          publishedAt: data.published ? now : null,
143	          createdBy: user.uid,
144	          createdAt: now,
145	          updatedAt: now
146	        });
147	        Activity.log({ action: data.published ? 'internship.published' : 'internship.created', targetType: 'internship', targetId: ref.id, targetTitle: data.title });

172	        return { ok: true };

141	  function wire(mode) {
142	    const app = document.getElementById('app');
143	    const sidenav = document.getElementById('sidenav');
144	    const mq = matchMedia('(max-width: 960px)');
145	
146	    if (!mq.matches && localStorage.getItem(LS) === '1') app.classList.add('is-collapsed');
147	
148	    const toggleCollapse = () => {
149	      if (mq.matches) {
150	        const open = app.classList.toggle('nav-open');
151	        document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
152	      } else {
153	        const c = app.classList.toggle('is-collapsed');
154	        localStorage.setItem(LS, c ? '1' : '0');
155	      }
156	    };
157	    const openDrawer = () => { app.classList.add('nav-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; };
158	    const closeDrawer = () => { app.classList.remove('nav-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
159	
160	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-collapse]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', toggleCollapse));
161	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-scrim-open]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', openDrawer));
162	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-scrim]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer));
163	    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer(); });
164	    mq.addEventListener('change', () => { closeDrawer(); });
165	
166	    // Account dropdown
167	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-btn]').forEach((btn) => {
168	      const pop = btn.parentElement.querySelector('[data-menu-pop]');

170	        e.stopPropagation();
171	        const open = pop.classList.toggle('is-open');
172	        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));

174	      document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!pop.contains(e.target)) { pop.classList.remove('is-open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); } });
175	    });
176	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-signout]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => Auth.signOut()));
177	
178	    // Page title
179	    const navKey = document.body.dataset.nav;
180	    const items = mode === 'admin' ? ADMIN_NAV : STUDENT_NAV;
181	    const titleEl = app.querySelector('[data-page-title]');
182	    const cur = items.find((i) => i.key === navKey);

141	  .fgroup h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:10px}
142	  .chk-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}

150	  .switch .track::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.25);transition:left .25s var(--ease)}
151	  .switch input:checked+.track{background:var(--green)}

156	  .results-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:26px 2px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}

161	  .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(295px,1fr));gap:20px}
162	  .card-int{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s}
163	  .card-int:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--sh-2);border-color:var(--line-2)}

172	  .badge.closed{background:rgba(240,240,238,.92);color:var(--muted)}
173	  .save-btn{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);color:var(--ink-2);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18);transition:.2s}
174	  .save-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.08);color:var(--green-ink)}
175	  .save-btn.on{background:var(--green);color:#fff}

177	  .ci-body{padding:15px 16px 12px;flex:1}

182	  .ci-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

194	    background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--green-deep),var(--green));border-radius:16px;padding:28px 32px;color:#eaf5ee;
195	    box-shadow:0 18px 40px -20px rgba(10,61,38,.55);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
196	  .cta::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-80px;width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(234,245,238,.16),transparent)}
197	  .cta h2{font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,27px);margin-bottom:6px}

5	const Rows = (() => {
6	  function detailHref(id) { return H('internship.html') + '?id=' + encodeURIComponent(id); }
7	
8	  function media(item) {
9	    if (item.image && /^https?:/i.test(item.image)) {
10	      return `<img src="${UI.esc(item.image)}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.replaceWith(Object.assign(document.createElement('div'),{className:'ic-fallback',textContent:${JSON.stringify((item.company || 'I').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase())}}))">`;
11	    }
12	    const ch = (item.company || 'I').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
13	    return `<div class="ic-fallback">${UI.esc(ch)}</div>`;
14	  }
15	
16	  function badges(item) {
17	    let html = '';
18	    if (UI.isNew(item)) html += '<span class="bdg bdg-new">New</span>';
19	    if (item.verified) html += `<span class="bdg bdg-ver">${UI.icon('shield', 11)} Verified</span>`;
20	    else html += '<span class="bdg bdg-pend">Pending</span>';
21	    return html;
22	  }
23	
24	  function card(item) {
25	    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
26	    const saved = Saved.has(item.id);
27	    const ext = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
28	    const meta = [item.field, item.workMode, item.duration].filter(Boolean)
29	      .map((m) => `<i>${UI.esc(m)}</i>`).join('');
30	
31	    return `<article class="icard">
32	      <div class="ic-media">${media(item)}
33	        <div class="ic-badges">${badges(item)}</div>
34	        <button type="button" class="save${saved ? ' on' : ''}" data-save="${UI.esc(item.id)}"
35	                aria-pressed="${saved}" aria-label="${saved ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship'}">
36	          ${UI.icon('bookmark', 15, saved)}
37	        </button>
38	      </div>
39	      <div class="ic-body">
40	        <h3 class="ic-title"><a href="${detailHref(item.id)}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
41	        <p class="ic-co">${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.city ? ' · ' + UI.esc(item.city) : ''}</p>
42	        <div class="ic-meta">${meta}</div>
43	      </div>
44	      <div class="ic-foot">
45	        <span class="ic-dead${dl.cls ? ' ' + dl.cls : ''}">${UI.esc(dl.label)}</span>
46	        <a class="ic-link" href="${ext || detailHref(item.id)}"${ext ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener"' : ''}>Details ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 12)}</a>
47	      </div>
48	    </article>`;
49	  }
50	
51	  function grid(items) {
52	    if (!items.length) return '';
53	    return `<div class="icard-grid">${items.map(card).join('')}</div>`;
54	  }
55	
56	  function empty(message = 'No internships found.', sub = '') {
57	    return `<div class="ic-empty"><b>${UI.esc(message)}</b>${sub ? `<span>${UI.esc(sub)}</span>` : ''}</div>`;
58	  }
59	
60	  function error() {
61	    return `<div class="ic-empty ic-error"><b>Couldn't load internships</b>
62	      <span>There was a problem reaching the database.</span>
63	      <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:14px">Retry</button></div>`;
64	  }
65	
66	  function skeleton(n = 6) {
67	    let html = '';
68	    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) html += `<div class="icard icard-skel"><div class="ic-media"></div><div class="ic-body"><div class="skel skel-title"></div><div class="skel skel-meta"></div></div></div>`;
69	    return `<div class="icard-grid">${html}</div>`;
70	  }
71	
72	  function initSaveHandling() {
73	    document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
74	      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-save]');
75	      if (!btn) return;
76	      e.preventDefault();
77	      if (!Auth.profile) {
78	        UI.toast('Sign in to save internships');
79	        setTimeout(() => { window.location.href = `${H('signin.html')}?next=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search)}`; }, 800);
80	        return;
81	      }
82	      const id = btn.dataset.save;
83	      btn.disabled = true;
84	      const res = await Saved.toggle(id);
85	      btn.disabled = false;
86	      if (!res.ok) { UI.toast('Could not update your saved list', 'error'); return; }
87	      const on = res.state === 'saved';
88	      btn.classList.toggle('on', on);
89	      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
90	      btn.innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 15, on);
91	      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saved:changed', { detail: { id, on } }));
92	    });
93	  }
94	
95	  return { card, grid, empty, error, skeleton, detailHref, initSaveHandling };

1	/* ============================================================
2	   SAVED · users/{uid}/saved  (batched getAll, no N+1)
3	   ============================================================ */
4	
5	const Saved = (() => {
6	  let ids = new Set();
7	  let loaded = false;
8	
9	  function refOf(uid, internshipId) {
10	    return firebaseDB.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('saved').doc(internshipId);
11	  }
12	
13	  return {
14	    get ids() { return ids; },
15	    get loaded() { return loaded; },
16	
17	    async load() {
18	      if (!Auth.profile) { ids = new Set(); return; }
19	      try {
20	        const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('users').doc(Auth.profile.uid).collection('saved').get();
21	        ids = new Set(snap.docs.map((d) => d.id));
22	        loaded = true;
23	      } catch (err) { console.error('Saved.load failed:', err); }
24	    },
25	
26	    has(id) { return ids.has(id); },
27	
28	    async toggle(internshipId) {
29	      if (!Auth.profile) return { ok: false, error: 'signed-out' };
30	      try {
31	        const uid = Auth.profile.uid;
32	        if (ids.has(internshipId)) {
33	          await refOf(uid, internshipId).delete();
34	          ids.delete(internshipId);
35	          firebaseDB.collection('internships').doc(internshipId).update({ saves: FV.increment(-1) }).catch(() => {});
36	          return { ok: true, state: 'removed' };
37	        }
38	        await refOf(uid, internshipId).set({ internshipId, savedAt: serverTs() });
39	        ids.add(internshipId);
40	        firebaseDB.collection('internships').doc(internshipId).update({ saves: FV.increment(1) }).catch(() => {});
41	        return { ok: true, state: 'saved' };
42	      } catch (err) { console.error('Saved.toggle failed:', err); return { ok: false, error: err.message }; }
43	    },
44	
45	    /** Full internship objects for everything saved, newest-saved first. */
46	    async list() {
47	      if (!Auth.profile) return [];
48	      try {
49	        const snap = await firebaseDB.collection('users').doc(Auth.profile.uid)
50	          .collection('saved').orderBy('savedAt', 'desc').get();
51	        const entries = snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, savedAt: UI.toDate(d.data().savedAt) }));
52	        ids = new Set(entries.map((e) => e.id));
53	        if (!entries.length) return [];
54	        const items = [];
55	        for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i += 10) {
56	          const chunk = entries.slice(i, i + 10);
57	          const docs = await firebaseDB.getAll(...chunk.map((e) => firebaseDB.collection('internships').doc(e.id)));
58	          docs.forEach((doc, j) => {
59	            if (doc.exists && doc.data().published) {
60	              const d = doc.data();
61	              items.push({
62	                id: doc.id, title: d.title, company: d.company, image: d.image || '',
63	                field: d.field || '', category: d.category || '', city: d.city || '',
64	                workMode: d.workMode || '', duration: d.duration || '', stipend: d.stipend || '',
65	                verified: !!d.verified, deadline: UI.toDate(d.deadline), createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt),
66	                savedAt: chunk[j].savedAt
67	              });
68	            }
69	          });
70	        }
71	        return items;
72	      } catch (err) { console.error('Saved.list failed:', err); return []; }
73	    }
74	  };
75	})();

99	    if (days <= 7) return { label: `${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'} left`, cls: 'is-urgent', days };

122	    if (s < 86400) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h ago`;

132	      toastStack.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');

137	    el.innerHTML = `${icon(type === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'check', 16)}<span>${esc(message)}</span>`;
138	    toastStack.appendChild(el);
139	    requestAnimationFrame(() => el.classList.add('is-shown'));
140	    setTimeout(() => {
141	      el.classList.remove('is-shown');
142	      setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 320);
143	    }, 2800);
144	  }
145	
146	  function confirm({ title, message, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', danger = false }) {
147	    return new Promise((resolve) => {

153	          <p class="modal-msg">${esc(message)}</p>

156	            <button type="button" class="btn ${danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}" data-act="ok">${esc(confirmLabel)}</button>
157	          </div>
158	        </div>`;
159	      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
160	      requestAnimationFrame(() => backdrop.classList.add('is-open'));
161	      const close = (value) => {
162	        backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
163	        setTimeout(() => backdrop.remove(), 240);
164	        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
