91	window.onReady(function () {
92	  Rows.initSaveHandling();
93	  const layout = document.getElementById('browseLayout');
94	  const resultsEl = document.getElementById('results');
95	  const countEl = document.getElementById('count');
96	  const moreWrap = document.getElementById('moreWrap');
97	  const loadMore = document.getElementById('loadMore');
98	  const searchIc = document.getElementById('searchIc');
99	  searchIc.innerHTML = UI.icon('search', 16);
100	
101	  const FACETS = [
102	    { key: 'fields', el: 'facetField', title: 'Field', get: (i) => i.field },
103	    { key: 'cities', el: 'facetCity', title: 'Location', get: (i) => i.city },
104	    { key: 'categories', el: 'facetCategory', title: 'Category', get: (i) => i.category },
105	    { key: 'modes', el: 'facetMode', title: 'Work mode', get: (i) => i.workMode }
106	  ];
107	  const PAGE = 12;
108	  let ALL = [];
109	  const f = { q: '', sort: 'new', verified: false, open: false,
110	    fields: new Set(), cities: new Set(), categories: new Set(), modes: new Set() };
111	  let shown = PAGE;
112	
113	  function matches(it) {
114	    if (f.verified && !it.verified) return false;
115	    if (f.open && !UI.isOpen(it)) return false;
116	    for (const fc of FACETS) {
117	      if (f[fc.key].size && !f[fc.key].has(fc.get(it))) return false;
118	    }
119	    if (f.q) {
120	      const hay = `${it.title} ${it.company} ${it.field} ${it.city} ${it.category}`.toLowerCase();
121	      if (!hay.includes(f.q)) return false;
122	    }
123	    return true;
124	  }
125	
126	  function sorted(list) {
127	    const a = list.slice();
128	    if (f.sort === 'az') return a.sort((x, y) => (x.title || '').localeCompare(y.title || ''));
129	    if (f.sort === 'closing') return a.sort((x, y) => {
130	      const dx = UI.daysUntil(x.deadline), dy = UI.daysUntil(y.deadline);
131	      if (dx === null && dy === null) return 0;
132	      if (dx === null) return 1;
133	      if (dy === null) return -1;
134	      return dx - dy;
135	    });
136	    return a.sort((x, y) => (y.createdAt || 0) - (x.createdAt || 0));
137	  }
138	
139	  function renderFacets() {
140	    for (const fc of FACETS) {
141	      const vals = [...new Set(ALL.map(fc.get).filter(Boolean))].sort();
142	      const box = document.getElementById(fc.el);
143	      if (!vals.length) { box.innerHTML = ''; box.style.display = 'none'; continue; }
144	      box.style.display = '';
145	      box.innerHTML = `<h4>${fc.title}</h4><div class="chips">${vals.map((v) =>
146	        `<button type="button" class="chip${f[fc.key].has(v) ? ' is-on' : ''}" data-facet="${fc.key}" data-val="${UI.esc(v)}" aria-pressed="${f[fc.key].has(v)}">${UI.esc(v)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
147	    }
148	  }
149	
150	  function activeCount() {
151	    return f.fields.size + f.cities.size + f.categories.size + f.modes.size +
152	      (f.verified ? 1 : 0) + (f.open ? 1 : 0);
153	  }
154	
155	  function render() {
156	    const match = sorted(ALL.filter(matches));
157	    const slice = match.slice(0, shown);
158	    const badge = document.querySelector('[data-filter-count]');
159	    if (badge) badge.textContent = activeCount() ? `Filters (${activeCount()})` : 'Filters';
160	
161	    if (!ALL.length) { countEl.textContent = ''; resultsEl.innerHTML = Rows.empty('The index is being built.', 'Verified internships appear here shortly.'); moreWrap.hidden = true; return; }
162	    if (!match.length) {
163	      countEl.textContent = '';
164	      resultsEl.innerHTML = `${Rows.empty('No internships match these filters.', 'Try clearing a filter or widening your search.')}
165	        <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:-30px"><button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" data-clear-all>Clear filters</button></div>`;
166	      moreWrap.hidden = true; return;
167	    }
168	    countEl.textContent = `Showing ${slice.length} of ${match.length} open ${match.length === 1 ? 'role' : 'roles'}`;
169	    resultsEl.innerHTML = Rows.grid(slice);
170	    moreWrap.hidden = shown >= match.length;
171	  }
172	
173	  function resetPage() { shown = PAGE; }
174	
175	  // ---- events ----
176	  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
177	    const chip = e.target.closest('[data-facet]');
178	    if (chip) {
179	      const set = f[chip.dataset.facet], v = chip.dataset.val;
180	      set.has(v) ? set.delete(v) : set.add(v);
181	      resetPage(); renderFacets(); render(); return;
182	    }
183	    if (e.target.closest('[data-clear-all]')) {
184	      f.fields.clear(); f.cities.clear(); f.categories.clear(); f.modes.clear();
185	      f.verified = f.open = false;
186	      document.querySelector('[data-flag="verified"]').checked = false;
187	      document.querySelector('[data-flag="open"]').checked = false;
188	      resetPage(); renderFacets(); render(); return;
189	    }
190	    if (e.target.closest('[data-f-open]')) { layout.classList.add('filters-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; return; }
191	    if (e.target.closest('[data-f-close]')) { layout.classList.remove('filters-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; return; }
192	  });
193	
194	  document.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
195	    const flag = e.target.closest('[data-flag]');
196	    if (flag) { f[flag.dataset.flag] = flag.checked; resetPage(); render(); }
197	  });
198	
199	  let deb;
200	  document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
201	    clearTimeout(deb);
202	    deb = setTimeout(() => { f.q = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase(); resetPage(); render(); }, 160);
203	  });
204	  document.getElementById('sort').addEventListener('change', (e) => { f.sort = e.target.value; resetPage(); render(); });
205	  loadMore.addEventListener('click', () => { shown += PAGE; render(); });
206	
207	  document.addEventListener('saved:changed', () => render());
208	
209	  // ---- boot ----
210	  async function boot() {
211	    resultsEl.innerHTML = Rows.skeleton(6);
212	    try { await Auth.ready; await Saved.load(); } catch (_) {}
213	    try { ALL = (await Internships.published(200)) || []; }
214	    catch (err) { console.error(err); resultsEl.innerHTML = Rows.error(); return; }
215	    renderFacets(); render();
216	  }
217	  boot();
218	});

/* ============================================================
   DETAIL MODAL · quick view for an internship card.
   Pages call DetailModal.init(() => items). Card controls stay
   real links to the full listing, so pages that never init the
   modal (or ids that aren't loaded) simply navigate.
   ============================================================ */

const DetailModal = (() => {
  let backdrop = null;
  let getItems = () => [];
  let currentId = null;
  let lastFocus = null;
  let wired = false;

  const q = (sel) => (backdrop ? backdrop.querySelector(sel) : null);

  function paintSave(on) {
    const btn = q('#dmSave');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = on ? 'Saved ✓' : 'Save';
    btn.classList.toggle('btn-primary', on);
    btn.classList.toggle('btn-ghost', !on);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
  }

  function build() {
    if (backdrop) return backdrop;
    backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop';
    backdrop.innerHTML = `
      <div class="modal modal-lg" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dmTitle">
        <button type="button" class="dm-x" data-dm-close aria-label="Close">${UI.icon('x', 16)}</button>
        <div class="dm-media" id="dmMedia"></div>
        <div class="dm-body">
          <div class="dm-badges" id="dmBadges"></div>
          <h3 class="modal-title" id="dmTitle"></h3>
          <p class="dm-company" id="dmCompany"></p>
          <div class="dm-meta" id="dmMeta"></div>
          <p class="dm-desc" id="dmDesc"></p>
          <div class="modal-actions dm-actions">
            <a class="dm-full" id="dmFull" href="#">Full listing ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="dmSave" aria-pressed="false">Save</button>
            <a class="btn btn-primary" id="dmApply" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Apply</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === backdrop || e.target.closest('[data-dm-close]')) close();
    });

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('#dmSave') || !currentId) return;
      const btn = q('#dmSave');
      btn.disabled = true;
      const res = await Saved.toggle(currentId);
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (!res.ok) { UI.toast('Could not update your saved list', 'error'); return; }
      const on = res.state === 'saved';
      paintSave(on);
      document.querySelectorAll(`[data-save="${currentId}"]`).forEach((b) => {
        b.classList.toggle('on', on);
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', on ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship');
        b.innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 15, on);
      });
      UI.toast(on ? "Saved — we'll track its deadline for you" : 'Removed from saved');
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saved:changed', { detail: { id: currentId, on } }));
    });

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const apply = e.target.closest('#dmApply');
      if (apply && !apply.hidden && currentId) Internships.bump(currentId, 'clicks');
    });
    return backdrop;
  }

  function paintMedia(item) {
    const box = q('#dmMedia');
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="ic-fallback">${UI.esc(UI.initials(item.company || 'InternHub'))}</div>`;
    const url = UI.safeUrl(item.image);
    if (!url) return;
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = url;
    img.alt = '';
    img.loading = 'lazy';
    img.addEventListener('error', () => img.remove());
    box.appendChild(img);
  }

  function paintMeta(item) {
    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
    const bits = [
      item.field ? UI.icon('briefcase', 12) + UI.esc(item.field) : '',
      item.duration ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(item.duration) : '',
      item.workMode ? UI.icon('globe', 12) + UI.esc(item.workMode) : '',
      item.stipend ? UI.icon('sparkles', 12) + UI.esc(item.stipend) : '',
      dl.label ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(dl.label) : ''
    ].filter(Boolean);
    q('#dmMeta').innerHTML = bits.map((b) => `<span>${b}</span>`).join('');
  }

  function open(id) {
    const item = getItems().find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
    if (!item) return;
    currentId = item.id;
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    build();

    paintMedia(item);
    q('#dmBadges').innerHTML = badges(item);
    q('#dmTitle').textContent = item.title || 'Untitled role';
    q('#dmCompany').textContent = [item.company, item.city].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—';
    paintMeta(item);

    const desc = q('#dmDesc');
    desc.textContent = item.description || '';
    desc.hidden = !item.description;

    const full = q('#dmFull');
    const apply = q('#dmApply');
    const ext = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
    full.href = Rows.detailHref(item.id);
    full.classList.toggle('btn', !ext);
    full.classList.toggle('btn-primary', !ext);
    apply.href = ext || '#';
    apply.hidden = !ext;

    const save = q('#dmSave');
    save.hidden = !Auth.profile;
    paintSave(Saved.has(item.id));

    backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    q('#dmSave')?.focus();
  }

  function close() {
    if (!backdrop || !backdrop.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    currentId = null;
    if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
  }

  function init(itemsGetter) {
    if (typeof itemsGetter === 'function') getItems = itemsGetter;
    if (wired) return;
    wired = true;
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const trigger = e.target.closest('[data-details]');
      if (!trigger) return;
      const known = getItems().some((x) => String(x.id) === String(trigger.dataset.details));
      if (!known) return;                      // nothing to show — follow the link
      e.preventDefault();
      open(trigger.dataset.details);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); });
  }

  return { init, open, close };
})();

    const mode = document.body.dataset.app;
    if (!mode) return; // landing/auth pages manage their own chrome
    await Auth.ready;

    const view = document.getElementById('view');
    const sideBlocks = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-side]')];
    const active = document.body.dataset.nav || '';
    document.body.innerHTML = mode === 'admin' ? buildAdmin(active) : buildStudent(active);
    const slot = document.getElementById('view-slot');
    // content injected by page script into #view later is fine — the node survives the rebuild
    if (view && view.children.length) slot.appendChild(view);
    const extra = document.getElementById('sidenav-extra');
    if (extra) sideBlocks.forEach((el) => extra.appendChild(el));

    wire(mode);

    if (mode === 'student' && Auth.profile) {
      Notifications.load().then(() => NotifyUI.init());
      NotifyUI.render(Notifications.list);
      NotifyUI.updateBadge();
      if (typeof Saved !== 'undefined') {
        Saved.load().then(syncSavedBadge);
        document.addEventListener('saved:changed', syncSavedBadge);
      }
    }
    initFooterAndReveals();
    window.__shellReady = true;
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shell:ready'));
  }
...

490	  function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;"); }
491	  function deadline(d){
492	    if(d<0) return "Closed";
493	    if(d===0) return "Closes today";
494	    if(d===1) return "Closes tomorrow";
495	    if(d<=14) return "Closes in "+d+" days";
496	    return "Closes "+new Date(Date.now()+d*864e5).toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"short"});
497	  }
498	  function badges(it){
499	    var b=[];
500	    if(it.days<0){ b.push(["closed","Closed"]); }
501	    else{
502	      if(it.posted<=2) b.push(["new","New"]);
503	      if(it.ver) b.push(["ver","Verified"]);
504	      if(it.days<=7) b.push(["soon","Closing soon"]);
505	    }
506	    return b;
507	  }
508	  var fbCache={};
509	  function fallback(company){
510	    if(fbCache[company]) return fbCache[company];
511	    var ini = company.split(/\s+/).map(function(w){return w[0];}).join("").slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
512	    var svg = "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"900\" height=\"500\"><defs><linearGradient id=\"g\" x1=\"0\" y1=\"0\" x2=\"1\" y2=\"1\"><stop offset=\"0\" stop-color=\"#0f7a49\"/><stop offset=\"1\" stop-color=\"#0a3d26\"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width=\"900\" height=\"500\" fill=\"url(#g)\"/><text x=\"450\" y=\"285\" font-family=\"Arial,sans-serif\" font-size=\"150\" font-weight=\"700\" fill=\"rgba(255,255,255,0.28)\" text-anchor=\"middle\">"+ini+"</text></svg>";
513	    fbCache[company] = "data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,"+encodeURIComponent(svg);
514	    return fbCache[company];
515	  }

522	  /* ---------- filtering ---------- */

527	      if(!state.incClosed && it.days<0) return false;
528	      if(state.field!=="All fields" && it.field!==state.field) return false;
529	      if(state.city!=="All cities" && it.city!==state.city) return false;
530	      if(state.modes.length && state.modes.indexOf(it.mode)===-1) return false;
531	      if(state.verOnly && !it.ver) return false;
532	      if(q){
533	        var hay=(it.title+" "+it.company+" "+it.city+" "+it.field).toLowerCase();
534	        if(hay.indexOf(q)===-1) return false;
535	      }
536	      return true;
537	    });
538	    if(state.sort==="newest") list.sort(function(a,b){return a.posted-b.posted;});
539	    if(state.sort==="closing") list.sort(function(a,b){return (a.days<0?999:a.days)-(b.days<0?999:b.days);});
540	    if(state.sort==="az") list.sort(function(a,b){return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);});
541	    return list;
542	  }

553	      +   '<button class="save-btn'+(on?" on":"")+'" data-save="'+it.id+'" aria-label="'+(on?"Remove from saved":"Save internship")+'">'+I.bookmark+"</button>"

557	      +   "<h3>"+esc(it.title)+"</h3>"
558	      +   '<p class="ci-co">'+I.building+" "+esc(it.company)+"</p>"
559	      +   '<ul class="ci-meta"><li>'+I.tag+" "+esc(it.field)+"</li><li>"+I.clock+" "+esc(it.dur)+"</li><li>"+I.mode+" "+esc(it.mode)+"</li></ul>"

164	  function wire(mode) {
165	    const app = document.getElementById('app');
166	    const sidenav = document.getElementById('sidenav');
167	    const mq = matchMedia('(max-width: 960px)');
168	
169	    if (!mq.matches && localStorage.getItem(LS) === '1') app.classList.add('is-collapsed');
170	
171	    const toggleCollapse = () => {
172	      if (mq.matches) {
173	        const open = app.classList.toggle('nav-open');
174	        document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
175	      } else {
176	        const c = app.classList.toggle('is-collapsed');
177	        localStorage.setItem(LS, c ? '1' : '0');
178	      }
179	    };
180	    const openDrawer = () => { app.classList.add('nav-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; };
181	    const closeDrawer = () => { app.classList.remove('nav-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
182	
183	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-collapse]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', toggleCollapse));
184	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-scrim-open]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', openDrawer));
185	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-scrim]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer));
186	    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer(); });
187	    mq.addEventListener('change', () => { closeDrawer(); });
188	
189	    // Account dropdown
190	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-btn]').forEach((btn) => {
191	      const pop = btn.parentElement.querySelector('[data-menu-pop]');
192	      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
193	        e.stopPropagation();
194	        const open = pop.classList.toggle('is-open');
195	        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
196	      });
197	      document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!pop.contains(e.target)) { pop.classList.remove('is-open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); } });
198	    });
199	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-signout]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => Auth.signOut()));
200	
201	    // Page title
202	    const navKey = document.body.dataset.nav;
203	    const items = mode === 'admin' ? ADMIN_NAV : STUDENT_NAV;
204	    const titleEl = app.querySelector('[data-page-title]');
205	    const cur = items.find((i) => i.key === navKey);
206	    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = cur ? cur.label : '';
207	  }
208	
209	  async function initFooterAndReveals() {
210	    UI.initReveals(document.getElementById('view-slot') || document);
211	  }
212	
213	  async function init() {
214	    const mode = document.body.dataset.app;
215	    if (!mode) return; // landing/auth pages manage their own chrome
216	    await Auth.ready;
217	
218	    const view = document.getElementById('view');
219	    const sideBlocks = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-side]')];
220	    const active = document.body.dataset.nav || '';
221	    document.body.innerHTML = mode === 'admin' ? buildAdmin(active) : buildStudent(active);
222	    const slot = document.getElementById('view-slot');
223	    // content injected by page script into #view later is fine — the node survives the rebuild
224	    if (view && view.children.length) slot.appendChild(view);
225	    const extra = document.getElementById('sidenav-extra');
226	    if (extra) sideBlocks.forEach((el) => extra.appendChild(el));
227	
228	    wire(mode);
229	
230	    if (mode === 'student' && Auth.profile) {
231	      Notifications.load().then(() => NotifyUI.init());
232	      NotifyUI.render(Notifications.list);
233	      NotifyUI.updateBadge();
234	      if (typeof Saved !== 'undefined') {
235	        Saved.load().then(syncSavedBadge);
236	        document.addEventListener('saved:changed', syncSavedBadge);
237	      }
238	    }
239	    initFooterAndReveals();
240	    window.__shellReady = true;
241	    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shell:ready'));
242	  }
243	
244	  // Pages using the shared frame run their logic after the shell has
245	  // rebuilt the DOM. Landing/auth pages (no data-app) run immediately.
246	  window.onReady = function (cb) {
247	    if (!document.body.dataset.app || window.__shellReady) cb();
248	    else document.addEventListener('shell:ready', cb, { once: true });
249	  };
250	
251	  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
252	  return { init, STUDENT_NAV, ADMIN_NAV, syncSavedBadge, markNav };
253	})();

.hstat .lbl{font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.hstat .val{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
.hstat .pbar{width:110px;margin-top:8px;background:var(--bg2)}
.hstat .pbar i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),#1a8a54)}

.toolbar.toolbar-panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:10px;margin-top:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
.toolbar-panel .search-field .input{background:transparent;border-color:transparent}
.toolbar-panel .search-field .input:focus{background:var(--white);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(23,122,76,.15)}
.fcount{min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:700 10.5px var(--fm);display:grid;place-items:center}

.fdrawer{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;opacity:0;margin-top:0;transition:grid-template-rows .35s var(--ease),opacity .3s,margin-top .3s}
.fdrawer.is-open{grid-template-rows:1fr;opacity:1;margin-top:12px}
.fdrawer>div{overflow:hidden}
.fdrawer-in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:20px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:18px 20px}
.fgroup h4{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:10px}
.fgroup .switch{display:flex;margin-bottom:9px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink)}
.fgroup .switch:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.chk-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chk-pill{position:relative;display:inline-block;cursor:pointer}
.chk-pill input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.chk-pill span{display:inline-block;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:999px;background:var(--white);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);transition:.2s;user-select:none}
.chk-pill:hover span{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
.chk-pill input:checked+span{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
.chk-pill input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px}
.linklike{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green-ink);padding:4px 0}
.linklike:hover{text-decoration:underline}

.results-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:26px 2px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.view-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.view-note button{color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.view-note button:hover{text-decoration:underline}

.cta{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px;padding:28px 32px;border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--green-deep),var(--green));color:#eaf5ee;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -20px rgba(11,66,41,.55);overflow:hidden}
.cta::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-80px;width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(234,245,238,.16),transparent)}
.cta>*{position:relative}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,27px);margin-bottom:6px;color:#f4faf2}
.cta p{color:#bcd9c6;font-size:14px;max-width:52ch}

/* ---------- Filters (browse) ---------- */
.browse-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:248px minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px;align-items:start}
.filters{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:18px;max-height:calc(100vh - var(--nav-h) - 32px);overflow-y:auto}
.filter-group{padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.filter-group:last-child{border-bottom:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}

/* ============================================================
   INTERNSHIPS · Firestore collection "internships"
   Public read of published; admin-only writes (rules + claim).
   Students never write here directly — they submit Suggestions.
   ============================================================ */

const Internships = (() => {
  const col = () => firebaseDB.collection('internships');

  function normalize(doc) {
    const d = doc.data();
    return {
      id: doc.id,
      title: d.title || '',
      company: d.company || '',
      image: d.image || '',
      field: d.field || '',
      category: d.category || '',
      city: d.city || '',
      region: d.region || '',
      area: d.area || '',
      workMode: d.workMode || '',
      duration: d.duration || '',
      stipend: d.stipend || '',
      description: d.description || '',
      requirements: d.requirements || '',
      responsibilities: d.responsibilities || '',
      applicationUrl: d.applicationUrl || '',
      sourceUrl: d.sourceUrl || '',
      deadline: d.deadline || null,
      contactEmail: d.contactEmail || '',
      contactPhone: d.contactPhone || '',
      verified: !!d.verified,
      published: !!d.published,
      featured: !!d.featured,
      status: d.status || (d.published ? 'published' : 'draft'),
      views: d.views || 0,
      saves: d.saves || 0,
      clicks: d.clicks || 0,
      createdBy: d.createdBy || '',
      sourceSuggestionId: d.sourceSuggestionId || '',
      createdAt: UI.toDate(d.createdAt),
      publishedAt: UI.toDate(d.publishedAt),
      updatedAt: UI.toDate(d.updatedAt)
    };
  }

  const byNewest = (list) => list.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));

  async function listQuery(query) {
    const snap = await query.get();
    return snap.docs.map(normalize);
  }

  return {
    normalize,

    /** Published, newest first. Optional limit for landing/carousels.
     *  Falls back to an index-free query (sort client-side) on a fresh
     *  Firestore project whose composite index isn't deployed yet. */
    async published(limit = null) {
      let q = col().where('published', '==', true).orderBy('createdAt', 'desc');
      if (limit) q = q.limit(limit);
      try {
        const items = await listQuery(q);
        return byNewest(items);
      } catch (err) {
        if (err && /requires an index|failed-precondition/i.test(String(err.code || '') + ' ' + String(err.message || ''))) {
          try {
            let fallback = col().where('published', '==', true);
            if (limit) fallback = fallback.limit(limit * 2);
            const snap = await fallback.get();
            console.warn('Internships.published: composite index missing — using index-free fallback. Deploy firestore.indexes.json.');
            return byNewest(snap.docs.map(normalize)).slice(0, limit || undefined);
          } catch (e2) { console.error('Internships.published fallback failed:', e2); throw e2; }
        }
        console.error('Internships.published failed:', err); throw err;

<script src="../assets/js/lib/shell.js"></script>
<script>
window.onReady(async function () {
  if (!(await Auth.requireSignedIn())) return;
  Rows.initSaveHandling();

  const p = Auth.profile;
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const grid = $('grid');
  let ALL = [];
  let VOCAB = Settings.DEFAULT;
  const state = { q: '', field: 'All fields', modes: [], city: 'All cities',
    verOnly: false, incClosed: false, sort: 'newest', view: 'all' };

  DetailModal.init(() => ALL);

  // static nav links (portable paths) + icons
  const LINKS = { browse: 'student_pages/browse.html', suggest: 'student_pages/suggest.html',
    'whats-new': 'student_pages/whats-new.html', account: 'student_pages/account.html' };
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-navlink]').forEach((a) => { a.href = H(LINKS[a.dataset.navlink]); });
  $('ctaSuggest').href = H(LINKS.suggest);
  $('cvLink').href = H(LINKS.account) + '?tab=profile';
  const findBtn = document.querySelector('.dash-actions [data-navlink="browse"]');
  if (findBtn) findBtn.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', UI.icon('arrow-right', 16));
  $('searchIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('search', 16);
  $('filterIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('filter', 15);
  $('savedIco').innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 17);
  $('emptyIco').innerHTML = UI.icon('briefcase', 22);

  // greeting + date
  const first = (p.displayName || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'there';
  const now = new Date();
  const hr = now.getHours();
  $('greetLine').textContent = `${hr < 12 ? 'Good morning' : hr < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening'}, ${first}`;
  $('todayLine').textContent = now.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',
    { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }).toUpperCase();

  // profile strength · computed from the real profile, never hardcoded
  function profileStrength() {
    const prefs = p.preferences || {};
    const checks = [p.displayName, p.email, p.phone, p.institution, p.course, p.academicLevel,
      p.field || (prefs.fields || []).length, (prefs.locations || []).length, (prefs.workModes || []).length];
    const done = checks.filter((v) => v && String(v).trim()).length;
    return Math.round((done / checks.length) * 100);
  }
  function renderStrength() {
    const pct = profileStrength();
    const label = pct >= 100 ? 'Complete' : pct >= 70 ? 'Good' : pct >= 40 ? 'Getting there' : 'Getting started';
    $('pctLine').textContent = `${pct}% — ${label}`;
    $('heroPct').textContent = `${pct}%`;
    $('pctBar').style.width = `${pct}%`;
    $('heroPctBar').style.width = `${pct}%`;
  }

  // filtering + sorting
  const sortKey = (it) => { const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline); return d === null || d < 0 ? 999 : d; };

  function filtered() {
    const q = state.q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = ALL.filter((it) => {
      if (state.view === 'saved' && !Saved.has(it.id)) return false;
      const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
      if (!state.incClosed && d !== null && d < 0) return false;
      if (state.field !== 'All fields' && it.field !== state.field) return false;
      if (state.city !== 'All cities' && it.city !== state.city) return false;
      if (state.modes.length && !state.modes.includes(it.workMode)) return false;
      if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;
      if (q && !`${it.title} ${it.company} ${it.city} ${it.field}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    if (state.sort === 'closing') list.sort((a, b) => sortKey(a) - sortKey(b));
    else if (state.sort === 'az') list.sort((a, b) => (a.title || '').localeCompare(b.title || ''));
    else list.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));
    return list;
  }

  function fieldCounts() {
    const counts = {};
    ALL.forEach((it) => {
      if (!it.field || !UI.isOpen(it)) return;
      counts[it.field] = (counts[it.field] || 0) + 1;
    });
    const names = Object.keys(counts).sort((a, b) => counts[b] - counts[a] || a.localeCompare(b));
    return { names, counts };
  }

  function renderChips() {
    const { names, counts } = fieldCounts();
    const open = ALL.filter((it) => UI.isOpen(it)).length;
    const chips = [['All fields', open]].concat(names.map((n) => [n, counts[n]]));
    $('chips').innerHTML = chips.map(([name, n]) =>
      `<button type="button" class="chip${state.field === name ? ' is-on' : ''}" role="tab" aria-selected="${state.field === name}" data-chip="${UI.esc(name)}">${UI.esc(name)} <span class="n">${n}</span></button>`).join('');
  }

  function renderDiscover() {
    const { names, counts } = fieldCounts();
    const top = (names.length ? names : ['Software Engineering', 'Data & AI', 'Finance']).slice(0, 3);
    $('qLinks').innerHTML = top.map((f) =>
      `<button type="button" class="q-link" data-field="${UI.esc(f)}">${UI.esc(f)} <span>${counts[f] || 0}</span></button>`).join('');
  }

  function renderModes() {
    const modes = (VOCAB.workModes || []).length ? VOCAB.workModes : Settings.DEFAULT.workModes;
    $('modeRow').innerHTML = modes.map((m) =>
      `<label class="chk-pill"><input type="checkbox" class="modeChk" value="${UI.esc(m)}"${state.modes.includes(m) ? ' checked' : ''}><span>${UI.esc(m)}</span></label>`).join('');
  }

  function renderCities() {
    const cities = [...new Set(ALL.map((it) => it.city).filter(Boolean))].sort();
    $('citySelect').innerHTML = ['All cities'].concat(cities)
      .map((c) => `<option${c === state.city ? ' selected' : ''}>${UI.esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
  }

  function filterCount() {
    return state.modes.length + (state.verOnly ? 1 : 0) + (state.incClosed ? 1 : 0) + (state.city !== 'All cities' ? 1 : 0);
  }
  function renderFCount() {
    const n = filterCount();
    $('fCount').hidden = !n;
    $('fCount').textContent = n;
  }

  function render() {
    const list = filtered();
    grid.innerHTML = Rows.grid(list);

    const none = !list.length;
    $('empty').hidden = !none;
    if (none) {
      $('emptyTitle').textContent = state.view === 'saved' ? 'No saved internships yet' : 'No internships match';
      $('emptyText').textContent = state.view === 'saved'
        ? 'Save internships you like and this space will track their deadlines for you.'
        : 'Try adjusting your search or filters — new verified roles are added regularly.';
    }

    const q = state.q.trim();
    $('resultsLabel').textContent = state.view === 'saved'
      ? `${list.length} SAVED`
      : `${list.length} OPEN ROLE${list.length === 1 ? '' : 'S'}${q ? ` · "${q.toUpperCase()}"` : ''}`;
    $('viewNote').hidden = state.view !== 'saved';
    $('savedPanel').hidden = state.view === 'saved';

    const savedItems = ALL.filter((it) => Saved.has(it.id));
    $('savedCount').textContent = Saved.ids.size;
    const closing = savedItems.filter((it) => { const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline); return d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= 7; }).length;
    const sub = $('heroSub');
    if (!savedItems.length) sub.textContent = 'No deadlines on your radar yet — save internships to track them here.';
    else if (closing) sub.textContent = `${closing} of your saved internship${closing > 1 ? 's' : ''} close${closing > 1 ? '' : 's'} within 7 days — review them below.`;
    else sub.textContent = `You're tracking ${savedItems.length} internship${savedItems.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}. Nice pace — keep exploring.`;

    Shell.syncSavedBadge();
  }

  function setView(view) {
    state.view = view;
    Shell.markNav(view === 'saved' ? 'saved' : 'dashboard');
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    if (view === 'saved') url.searchParams.set('view', 'saved'); else url.searchParams.delete('view');
    history.replaceState(null, '', url);
    render();
  }

  function resetFilters() {
    state.q = ''; state.field = 'All fields'; state.modes = []; state.city = 'All cities';
    state.verOnly = false; state.incClosed = false;
    $('searchInput').value = ''; $('citySelect').value = 'All cities';
    $('verOnly').checked = false; $('incClosed').checked = false;
    document.querySelectorAll('.modeChk').forEach((c) => { c.checked = false; });
    renderChips(); renderFCount(); render();
  }

  // control events
  let deb;
  $('searchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    clearTimeout(deb);
    deb = setTimeout(() => { state.q = e.target.value; render(); }, 160);
  });
  $('sortSelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.sort = e.target.value; render(); });
  $('chips').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const c = e.target.closest('[data-chip]');
    if (!c) return;
    state.field = c.dataset.chip; renderChips(); render();
  });
  $('modeRow').addEventListener('change', () => {
    state.modes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.modeChk:checked')].map((c) => c.value);
    renderFCount(); render();
  });
  $('citySelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.city = e.target.value; renderFCount(); render(); });
  $('verOnly').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.verOnly = e.target.checked; renderFCount(); render(); });
  $('incClosed').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.incClosed = e.target.checked; renderFCount(); render(); });
  $('resetFilters').addEventListener('click', () => { resetFilters(); UI.toast('Filters reset'); });
  $('emptyReset').addEventListener('click', resetFilters);
  $('filterBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = $('filterPanel').classList.toggle('is-open');
    $('filterBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
  });
  $('clearView').addEventListener('click', () => setView('all'));
  $('qLinks').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-field]');
    if (!b) return;
    state.field = b.dataset.field;
    renderChips(); render();
    $('chips').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  });

  const savedBox = document.getElementById('savedBox');
  const deadlineBox = document.getElementById('deadlineBox');
  const newBox = document.getElementById('newBox');
  const prefBox = document.getElementById('prefBox');

===== internhub-homepage-white-preference.md
---
name: internhub-homepage-white-preference
description: User wants the classmate's WHITE image-rich landing as the homepage base; edit it in place, never swap whole pages back to the black build
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

The user's preferred homepage is the WHITE, image-rich landing authored by their classmate (44KB `index.html` with Unsplash photos + lime CTA), NOT my dark-ink minimal rebuild.

**Why:** After I restored my black landing, the user explicitly reversed: "I want the previous one which was white... that white, the one with the white background was my classmate that edited for me... that one is better than this one that is black." They also instructed: going forward "we just be editing" the white version — do not replace/swap the whole page again.

**How to apply:** Treat `internship universe/index.html` (the white classmate version, kept as `index.html.lime-1630` backup too) as the homepage base. Make future homepage changes as in-place edits to that file. The black rebuild remains only as a backup in `internship system/`. See [[internhub-rebuild-state]].
===== internhub-qa-verification-method.md
---
name: internhub-qa-verification-method
description: How to visually verify the InternHub "updated project" deliverable given the fixed 531px browser viewport, blocked screenshots, and auth-gated app pages
metadata:
  type: project
---

Visual QA of the InternHub deliverable (`Desktop/internship universe/updated project/`) has three recurring environment constraints that block the naive "navigate + screenshot every page" approach.

**Why:** These have bitten multiple sessions. The browser-use in-app viewport is fixed at ~531px and cannot be resized; `take_screenshot` fails with `NATIVE_BROWSER_VIEWPORT_UNAVAILABLE` when the in-app browser is not focused/visible (only `take_snapshot` and `evaluate_script` keep working); and the student/admin app pages are auth-gated — they redirect to `signin.html?next=<page>` when signed out, and credentials must never be invented.

**How to apply:**
- Verify styling with `evaluate_script` + `getComputedStyle` (returns exact rgb values) instead of screenshots. This is actually more precise for confirming token/color changes.
- Desktop and tablet widths cannot be rendered at all (viewport stuck at 531px = the `max-width:860px` mobile/drawer regime). Confirm those layouts by reading the CSS media queries, and say so explicitly rather than claiming a full responsive pass.
- To test the auth-gated app shell without logging in: `internship.html` renders the real student shell (green sidebar) while signed out — use it as a live shell sample. Or inject the shell markup plus a `<link>` to the real `assets/css/app.css` into any live page and read computed styles.
- Serve locally with `python -m http.server <port>` from the `internship universe` root (note: `python`, not `python3`, on this Windows box); the deliverable is then at `/<percent-encoded updated project>/...`. Stop stray servers when done.

Related: [[internhub-rebuild-state]], [[internhub-homepage-white-preference]].

Rules deployed ONLY to internship-274f9 (QA). **Live interpro-6f20c still admin-only-create → student publish falls back to suggestions queue until an authorized account runs `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules --project interpro-6f20c`.**

IMPORTANT: `.admin-shell` mobile rule must stay `92px minmax(0, 1fr)` (app.css ≤900px) — plain `1fr` lets wide children (chip row) stretch the page horizontally on phones. 22	  --fd:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif; --fs:"Inter",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; --fm:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;
23	  --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
24	}
25	*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
26	html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
27	body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:14.5px/1.55 var(--fs);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
28	button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
29	input,select{font:inherit}
30	img{display:block}
31	svg{display:block;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
32	::selection{background:var(--mint)}
33	:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
34	.eyebrow{font:500 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
35	.display{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em}
36	.sechead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
37	.sechead h2{font-size:21px}
38	
39	/* ============ TOPBAR ============ */
40	.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 20px;
41	  background:rgba(244,244,241,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
42	.icon-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink2);transition:.2s}
43	.icon-btn:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
44	.icon-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
45	.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:16.5px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;margin-right:6px}
46	.logo{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;flex:none}
47	.logo svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke-width:2.4}
48	.top-nav{display:flex;gap:4px}
49	.top-nav a{padding:8px 13px;border-radius:9px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);text-decoration:none;transition:.2s}
50	.top-nav a:hover{color:var(--green-ink);background:var(--mint2)}
51	.top-nav a.on{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;background:#eceee8}
52	.tb-right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
53	.bell-dot{position:relative}
54	.bell-dot::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:9px;right:10px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);border:2px solid var(--bg)}
55	.avatar-wrap{position:relative}
56	.avatar{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;display:grid;place-items:center}
57	.chev{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--muted)}
58	.menu{position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);min-width:190px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;
59	  box-shadow:var(--sh2);padding:6px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px) scale(.98);pointer-events:none;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
60	.menu.open{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
61	.menu button{display:flex;width:100%;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2);transition:.15s}
62	.menu button:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
63	.menu svg{width:15px;height:15px}
64	.menu hr{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:5px 4px}
65	
66	/* ============ SHELL / SIDEBAR ============ */
67	.shell{display:flex;min-height:calc(100vh - 64px)}
68	.sidebar{width:250px;flex:none;background:#f7f8f6;border-right:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:64px;height:calc(100vh - 64px);overflow:hidden;transition:width .35s var(--ease)}
69	body.sb-collapsed .sidebar{width:76px}
70	.sb-scroll{height:100%;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:18px 14px;scrollbar-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
71	.sb-label{padding:4px 12px 8px;transition:opacity .2s}
72	body.sb-collapsed .sb-label{opacity:0}
73	.nav-btn{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--ink2);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;transition:.2s;text-align:left}
74	.nav-btn:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
75	.nav-btn.on{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
76	.nav-btn .ico svg{width:18px;height:18px}
77	.nav-btn .txt{white-space:nowrap;max-width:160px;transition:max-width .3s var(--ease),opacity .2s}
78	body.sb-collapsed .txt{max-width:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden}
79	body.sb-collapsed .nav-btn{justify-content:center;padding:10px}
80	.nbadge{position:absolute;right:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:600 11px/20px var(--fs);text-align:center}
81	body.sb-collapsed .nbadge{right:6px;top:6px;transform:none;min-width:16px;height:16px;font-size:9.5px;line-height:16px;padding:0 4px}
82	.sb-card{margin-top:auto;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px}
83	body.sb-collapsed .sb-card{display:none}
84	.sb-card .eyebrow{display:block;margin-bottom:10px}
85	.sb-card ol{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
86	.sb-card li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
87	.sb-card li b{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);font:600 10.5px/18px var(--fm);text-align:center}
88	.backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;top:64px;background:rgba(10,20,14,.4);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s;z-index:90}
89	body.sb-open .backdrop,body.frail-open .backdrop{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
90	
91	/* ============ MAIN ============ */
92	.main{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:24px clamp(14px,2.6vw,32px) 40px}
93	
94	/* ---- DARK DISCOVERY ZONE ---- */
95	.darkzone{position:relative;border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(24px,3.2vw,36px) clamp(18px,3vw,36px) 26px;color:var(--dk-txt);overflow:hidden;
96	  background:linear-gradient(150deg,#0a3d26 0%,#0e6b3f 55%,#0a4930 100%)}
97	.darkzone::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
98	  background:radial-gradient(760px 280px at 88% -20%,rgba(140,255,190,.20),transparent 62%),
99	  radial-gradient(520px 240px at 4% 130%,rgba(140,255,190,.10),transparent 60%),
100	  repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
101	.darkzone>*{position:relative}
102	.darkzone .eyebrow{color:#9fd8b4}
103	.darkzone h1{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,38px);color:#f7fdf9;margin:10px 0 6px}
104	.darkzone .sub{color:#cfe9d8;font-size:14px;max-width:600px}
105	.searchwrap{position:relative;max-width:700px;margin-top:20px}
106	.searchbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:13px;padding:7px 7px 7px 15px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
107	.searchbar .s-ico{color:var(--muted)}
108	.searchbar .s-ico svg{width:17px;height:17px}
109	.searchbar input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink)}
110	.searchbar input::placeholder{color:#9aa5a0}
111	.s-clear{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted)}
112	.s-clear:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
113	.s-clear svg{width:14px;height:14px}
114	.s-clear[hidden]{display:none}
115	.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;padding:10px 16px;transition:.2s var(--ease);white-space:nowrap}
116	.btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
117	.btn.primary{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
118	.btn.primary:hover{background:var(--green-ink);transform:translateY(-1px)}
119	.btn.ghost{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--ink2)}
120	.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
121	.btn.sm{padding:7px 12px;font-size:12.5px;border-radius:9px}
122	.btn.dghost{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#d7f2e2;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
123	.btn.dghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
124	/* suggestions */
125	.sug{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:0;right:0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);padding:6px;z-index:60;display:none}
126	.sug.open{display:block}
127	.sug-it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2);text-align:left}
128	.sug-it svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--muted);flex:none}
129	.sug-it .st{margin-left:auto;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
130	.sug-it.on,.sug-it:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
131	.sug-head{padding:7px 11px 4px;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
132	.popular{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
133	.popular .eyebrow{color:#8fc7a6}
134	.popular button{border:1px solid rgba(234,255,243,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#d7f2e2;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 13px;font-size:12.5px;transition:.2s}
135	.popular button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
136	
137	/* ---- MARQUEE ---- */
138	.mq-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:30px 0 4px}
139	.mq-head h2{font-size:22px;color:#f7fdf9}
140	.mq-head .eyebrow{color:#8fc7a6}
141	.marquee{overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 3.5%,#000 96.5%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 3.5%,#000 96.5%,transparent)}
142	.mq-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:mq 80s linear infinite}
143	.mq-half{display:flex;gap:16px;padding-right:16px}
144	.marquee:hover .mq-track,.marquee:focus-within .mq-track{animation-play-state:paused}
145	@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
146	.dcard{width:332px;flex:none;background:var(--dk);border:1px solid var(--dk-line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--dk-txt);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
147	.dcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(140,255,190,.42);box-shadow:0 24px 48px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 0 24px -8px rgba(140,255,190,.15)}
148	.dc-media{position:relative;height:150px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
149	.dc-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
150	.dcard:hover .dc-media img{transform:scale(1.06)}
151	.dc-badges{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}
152	.badge{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:4px 8px}
153	.badge.new{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink)}
154	.badge.soon{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
155	.badge.closed{background:rgba(20,26,22,.72);color:#cfd6d1}
156	.badge.ver{background:rgba(12,20,16,.6);color:#9fe8bd;border:1px solid rgba(140,255,190,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
157	.save-btn{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.2s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
158	.save-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
159	.save-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
160	.save-btn.on svg{fill:currentColor}
161	@keyframes savepop{0%{transform:scale(1)}40%{transform:scale(1.25)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
162	.save-btn.pop{animation:savepop .35s var(--ease)}
163	.dc-media .save-btn{background:rgba(12,20,16,.55);color:#bfe8cd;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
164	.dc-media .save-btn.on{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink)}
165	.dc-body{padding:14px 15px 12px}
166	.dc-body h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#f2fbf6}
167	.dc-co{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dk-mut);margin-top:3px}
168	.dc-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 12px;margin-top:10px;list-style:none}
169	.dc-meta li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:var(--dk-mut)}
170	.dc-meta svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px}
171	.dc-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 15px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
172	.ci-dead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--dk-mut)}
173	.ci-dead svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px}
174	.ci-dead.warn{color:#f0b269;font-weight:600}
175	.ci-dead.off{color:#8a948e}
176	.mq-empty{border:1px dashed rgba(234,255,243,.25);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;text-align:center;color:#cfe9d8;font-size:13.5px}
177	
178	/* ---- LIGHT ZONE ---- */
179	.lsec{margin-top:30px}
180	/* category tiles */
181	.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(158px,1fr));gap:12px}
182	.tile{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px;text-align:left;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
183	.tile:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh1)}
184	.tile.on{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--green)}
185	.tile .t-ico{width:36px;height:36px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
186	.tile.on .t-ico{background:#fff}
187	.tile .t-ico svg{width:17px;height:17px}
188	.tile b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
189	.tile span{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
190	/* featured */
191	.feat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(240px,42%) 1fr;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
192	.feat::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(420px 200px at 100% 0,rgba(14,107,63,.06),transparent 60%)}
193	.feat-media{position:relative;min-height:230px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
194	.feat-media img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
195	.feat:hover .feat-media img{transform:scale(1.04)}
196	.feat-body{padding:24px 26px;position:relative}
197	.feat-body .eyebrow{color:var(--green-ink)}
198	.feat-body h3{font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,25px);margin:8px 0 4px}
199	.feat-co{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px}
200	.vcheck{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
201	.vcheck svg{width:9px;height:9px;stroke-width:3}
202	.feat-desc{color:var(--ink2);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:10px;max-width:560px}
203	.feat .ic-meta{margin-top:12px}
204	.feat-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
205	.feat .save-btn{position:static;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--ink2);box-shadow:none}
206	.feat .save-btn.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
207	/* browse area */
208	.browse{display:grid;grid-template-columns:248px minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px;align-items:start}
209	.frail{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;position:sticky;top:84px;max-height:calc(100vh - 102px);overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}
210	.frail-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px}
211	.linklike{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green-ink);padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px}
212	.linklike:hover{text-decoration:underline}
213	.frail-x{display:none}
214	.fsec{padding:13px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
215	.fsec:first-of-type{border-top:0}
216	.fsec>.eyebrow{display:block;margin-bottom:9px}
217	.cbx{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 4px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px}
218	.cbx:hover{background:var(--mint2)}
219	.cbx input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
220	.cbx .box{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;border:1.5px solid var(--line2);border-radius:5px;background:#fff;position:relative;transition:.15s}
221	.cbx input:checked+.box{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
222	.cbx input:checked+.box::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:4.5px;top:1.5px;width:4px;height:8px;border:solid #fff;border-width:0 2px 2px 0;transform:rotate(45deg)}
223	.cbx .txt{flex:1;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
224	.cbx .cnt{font:500 11px var(--fm);color:var(--muted)}
225	.pillrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
226	.pill{border:1px solid var(--line2);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 13px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);transition:.18s}
227	.pill:hover{border-color:var(--green)}
228	.pill.on{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
229	.select{position:relative;display:block}
230	.select select{width:100%;appearance:none;padding:9px 32px 9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
231	.select::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:13px;top:50%;width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.7px solid var(--muted);border-bottom:1.7px solid var(--muted);transform:translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg);pointer-events:none}
232	.switch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
233	.switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0}
234	.switch .track{width:34px;height:20px;flex:none;border-radius:999px;background:#d8dcd6;position:relative;transition:.25s}
235	.switch .track::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:left .25s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
236	.switch input:checked+.track{background:var(--green)}
237	.switch input:checked+.track::after{left:16px}
238	.frail-apply{display:none;width:100%;margin-top:14px}
239	/* toolbar */
240	.rtoolbar{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
241	.achips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:9px}
242	.achips:empty{display:none}
243	.achip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 6px 5px 11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;animation:pop .25s var(--ease)}
244	@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.85);opacity:0}}
245	.achip button{width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center}
246	.achip button:hover{background:rgba(10,82,50,.15)}
247	.achip svg{width:10px;height:10px;stroke-width:2.6}
248	.rt-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
249	#frailOpen{display:none}
250	.fbadge{min-width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:600 10.5px/18px var(--fs);text-align:center;padding:0 5px}
251	.fbadge[hidden]{display:none}
252	.viewtoggle{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
253	.viewtoggle button{width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted)}
254	.viewtoggle button.on{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink)}
255	.viewtoggle svg{width:16px;height:16px}
256	/* grid cards */
257	.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}

.dm-note{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px}

.sb-card ol{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.sb-card li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;font-size:12.5px;color:#c3d3c8}
.sb-card li b{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(188,226,58,.18);color:var(--lime);font:600 10.5px/18px var(--fm);text-align:center}

/* ---------- Browse · filter rail → drawer ---------- */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .browse-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .filters{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;z-index:150;width:302px;height:100vh;max-height:none;border-radius:0 16px 16px 0;transform:translateX(-105%);transition:transform .35s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .browse-layout.filters-open .filters{transform:none}
  .browse-layout.filters-open+.frail-scrim{display:block;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:140;background:rgba(18,21,17,.42);backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
  .frail-x{display:grid}
  .frail-apply{display:inline-flex}
  .frail-open-btn{display:inline-flex}
}
@media (max-width:960px){
  .feat{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .feat-media{min-height:190px}
}
@media (max-width:720px){
  .dcard,.sk-dk{width:290px}
  .rtoolbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .rt-right{justify-content:space-between}
  .rt-sort{flex:1}
  .irow{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .ir-side{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}
  .searchbar{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px}
  .searchbar input{order:2;flex-basis:100%;padding:6px 4px}
  .searchbar .s-clear{order:3;margin-left:auto}
  .searchbar .btn{order:4}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .cta-slim{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
  .tiles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}

/* ---------- Browse · reduced motion + touch ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .mq-track{animation:none}
  .marquee{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none}
  .mq-half.dup{display:none}
  .dcard:hover,.tile:hover,.ccard:hover,.irow:hover{transform:none}
  .feat:hover .feat-media img{transform:none}
}
@media (hover:none),(pointer:coarse){
  .dcard:hover,.tile:hover,.ccard:hover,.irow:hover{transform:none;box-shadow:none}
  .dcard:hover .dc-media img,.feat:hover .feat-media img{transform:none}
}

  function timeAgo(date) {
    const d = toDate(date);
    if (!d) return '';
    const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 1000);
    if (s < 60) return 'just now';
    if (s < 3600) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m ago`;
    if (s < 86400) return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)}h ago`;
    if (s < 604800) return `${Math.floor(s / 86400)}d ago`;
    return fmtDate(d);
  }

  let toastStack = null;
  function toast(message, type = 'success') {
    if (!toastStack) {
      toastStack = document.createElement('div');
      toastStack.className = 'toast-stack';
      toastStack.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
      document.body.appendChild(toastStack);
    }
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = `toast${type === 'error' ? ' toast-error' : ''}`;
    el.innerHTML = `${icon(type === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'check', 16)}<span>${esc(message)}</span>`;
    toastStack.appendChild(el);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => el.classList.add('is-shown'));
    setTimeout(() => {
      el.classList.remove('is-shown');
      setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 320);
    }, 2800);
  }

  function confirm({ title, message, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', danger = false }) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
      backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop';
      backdrop.innerHTML = `
        <div class="modal modal-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${esc(title)}">
          <h3 class="modal-title">${esc(title)}</h3>
          <p class="modal-msg">${esc(message)}</p>
          <div class="modal-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn ${danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}" data-act="ok">${esc(confirmLabel)}</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => backdrop.classList.add('is-open'));
      const close = (value) => {
        backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
        setTimeout(() => backdrop.remove(), 240);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        resolve(value);
      };
      const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(false); };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === backdrop) close(false);
        const act = e.target.closest('[data-act]')?.dataset.act;
        if (act === 'cancel') close(false);
        if (act === 'ok') close(true);
      });
    });
  }

  function initReveals(root = document) {
    const items = root.querySelectorAll('[data-rev]:not(.in)');
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window) || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('in'));
      return;
    }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((e) => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -6% 0px' });
    items.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
  }

  function skeletonRows(n = 4) {
    let html = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) html += `<div class="skel-row"><div style="flex:1"><div class="skel skel-title"></div><div class="skel skel-meta"></div></div><div class="skel skel-chip"></div></div>`;
    return `<div class="state-skeleton" aria-hidden="true">${html}</div>`;

Derived helpers:
```js
const posted = (it) => { const d = UI.daysSince(it.publishedAt || it.createdAt); return d === null ? 999 : d; };
const left = (it) => UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);           // null = rolling
const isOpen = (it) => UI.isOpen(it);
const newThisWeek = (it) => posted(it) <= 7 && isOpen(it);
const openList = () => ALL.filter(isOpen);
const vocab = (key) => [...new Set(ALL.map((i) => i[key]).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b));
```

filtered():
```js
function filtered() {
  let L = ALL.filter((it) => {
    if (!state.incClosed && !isOpen(it)) return false;
    if (state.fields.size && !state.fields.has(it.field)) return false;
    if (state.categories.size && !state.categories.has(it.category)) return false;
    if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES && it.city !== state.city) return false;
    if (state.modes.size && !state.modes.has(it.workMode)) return false;
    if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;
    if (state.newOnly && !newThisWeek(it)) return false;
    if (state.dl !== 'any') { const d = left(it); if (!(d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= +state.dl)) return false; }
    if (state.q) {
      const hay = `${it.title} ${it.company} ${it.city} ${it.field} ${it.workMode} ${it.category}`.toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(state.q)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  if (state.sort === 'new') L.sort((a,b) => posted(a) - posted(b));
  if (state.sort === 'close') L.sort((a,b) => (left(a) === null ? 999 : left(a)) - (left(b) === null ? 999 : left(b)));
  if (state.sort === 'az') L.sort((a,b) => (a.title||'').localeCompare(b.title||''));
  return L;
}
```

function afCount() {
  return state.fields.size + state.categories.size + state.modes.size +
    (state.city !== ALL_CITIES ? 1 : 0) + (state.dl !== 'any' ? 1 : 0) +
    (state.verOnly ? 1 : 0) + (state.newOnly ? 1 : 0) + (state.incClosed ? 1 : 0);
}

Let me write renderPopular:
```js
function renderPopular() {
  const picks = [];
  const tally = (key) => {
    const m = new Map();
    ALL.forEach((i) => { const v = i[key]; if (v) m.set(v, (m.get(v) || 0) + 1); });
    return [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map((e) => e[0]);
  };
  picks.push(...tally('field').slice(0, 3), ...tally('city').slice(0, 2));
  const uniq = [...new Set(picks)].slice(0, 5);
  if (!uniq.length) { el.popular.hidden = true; return; }
  el.popular.hidden = false;
  el.popular.innerHTML = '<span class="eyebrow">Popular:</span>' + uniq.map((p) => `<button type="button" data-q="${UI.esc(p)}">${UI.esc(p)}</button>`).join('');
}
```

renderMarquee:
```js
function renderMarquee() {
  const nw = ALL.filter(newThisWeek).sort((a,b) => posted(a) - posted(b));
  const track = el.mqTrack;
  if (!nw.length) {
    track.outerHTML = Rows.marqueeEmpty('No new internships this week — new verified roles are added regularly.');
    el.mqTrack = null;
    return;
  }
  track.innerHTML = Rows.darkStrip(nw);
  track.style.animationDuration = Math.max(60, nw.length * 9) + 's';
}
```

function renderTiles() {

  const fields = vocab('field');

  el.tiles.innerHTML = fields.map((f) => {
    const c = open.filter((i) => i.field === f).length;
    return `<button type="button" class="tile${state.fields.size === 1 && state.fields.has(f) ? ' is-on' : ''}" data-field="${UI.esc(f)}">
      <span class="t-ico">${UI.icon(UI.fieldIcon(f), 17)}</span>
      <span class="t-txt"><b>${UI.esc(f)}</b><span>${c} open</span></span>
    </button>`;
  }).join('');
}

}

function sugPool() {
  const out = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const add = (label, v) => { if (!v || seen.has(v.toLowerCase())) return; seen.add(v.toLowerCase()); out.push([v, label]); };
  ALL.forEach((i) => { add('Role', i.title); add('Company', i.company); });
  vocab('field').forEach((f) => add('Field', f));
  vocab('city').forEach((c) => add('City', c));
  vocab('category').forEach((c) => add('Category', c));
  modeVocab().forEach((m) => add('Mode', m));
  return out;
}

<div class=\"sechead\"><h2>Explore by field</h2><span class=\"eyebrow\">Tap to filter</span></div>\n    <div class=\"tiles\" id=\"tiles\"></div>\n  </section>\n\n  <!-- ===== FEATURED ===== -->\n </section>\n\n  <!-- ===== ALL INTERNSHIPS ===== -->\n  <section class=\"lsec\" id=\"resultsTop\">\n    <div class=\"sechead\"><h2>All internships</h2><span class=\"eyebrow\"       <div id=\"categoryList\"></div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"fsec\" id=\"citySec\" hidden>\n          <span class=\"eyebrow\">City</span>\n          <select class=\"select\"        <option value=\"any\">Any deadline</option>\n            <option value=\"7\">Closing ≤ 7 days</option>\n            <option value=\"14\">Closing ≤ 14 days</option>\n          </select>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"fsec\">\n          <span class=\"eyebrow\">Trust &amp; status</span>\n          <label class=\"switch\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"verOnly\"><span class=\"switch\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"incClosed\"><span class=\"track\"></span>Include closed</label>\n        </div>\n\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-primary frail-apply\" aria-live=\"polite\">— open roles</p>\n            <div class=\"achips\" id=\"activeChips\"></div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"rt-right\">\n            <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-ghost frail-open-btn\" id=\"frailOpen\">\n              <span id=\"frailOpenIc\"></span>Filters <span class=\"fbadge\" id=\"fBadge\" hidden>0</span>\n            </button>\n            <select class=\"select rt-sort\" id=\"sortSel\" aria-label=\"Sort\">\n              <option value=\"new\">Newest first</option>\n              <option value=\"close\">Closing soon</option>\n              <option value=\"az\">A – Z</option>\n            </select>\n            <div class=\"viewtoggle\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Result layout\">\n              <button type=\"button\" id=\"viewGrid\" class=\"on\" aria-label=\"Grid view\" aria-pressed=\"true\"></button>\n              <button type=\"button\" id=\"viewList\" aria-label=\"List view\" aria-pressed=\"false\"></button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div id=\"cards\"></div>\n\n        <div class=\"browse-more\" id=\"moreWrap\" hidden>\n          <button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-ghost\" id=\"locSec\" hidden>\n    <div class=\"sechead\"><h2>Where do you want to work?</h2><span class=\"eyebrow\">Tap a city to filter</span></div>\n    <div class=\"loc-row\" id=\"locRow\"></div>\n  </section>\n\n  <section class=\"cta-slim\">\n    <div>\n      <h3>Know an opening we're missing?</h3>\n      <p>Send it in with a link — signed-in students publish instantly.</p>\n    </div>\n    <a class=\"btn btn-primary\" href=\"suggest.html\">Suggest an internship</a>\n  </section>\n</div>\n\n<div data-side class=\"sb-card\">\n  <h5>How InternHub works</h5>\n  <ol>\n    <li><b>1</b>Discover opportunities across Cameroon</li>\n    <li><b>2</b>Save the ones that fit you</li>\n    <li><b>3</b>Apply on the company's own site</li>\n  </ol>\n</div>\n\n<script src=\"https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-app-compat.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-auth-compat.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"../assets/js/firebase-config.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"../assets/js/lib/ui.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"../assets/js/services/platform.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"../assets/js/services/auth.js\"></script>\n<script
