src=\"../assets/js/lib/rows.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"../assets/js/lib/notify-ui.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"../assets/js/lib/shell.js\"></script>\n<script>\nwindow.onReady(function () {\n  Rows.initSaveHandling();\n\n  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);\n  const el = {\n    layout: $('#browseLayout'), heroSub: $('#heroSub'),\n    q: $('#q'), qClear: $('#qClear'), qGo: $('#qGo'),\n    sug: $('#sug'), popular: $('#popular'), mqTrack: $('#mqTrack'),\n    tilesSec: $('#tilesSec'), tiles: $('#tiles'), featBox: $('#featBox'),\n    resetFilters: $('#resetFilters'), frailClose: $('#frailClose'),\n    frailScrim: $('#frailScrim'), frailOpen: $('#frailOpen'),\n    fieldSec: $('#fieldSec'), fieldList: $('#fieldList'),\n    categorySec: $('#categorySec'), categoryList: $('#categoryList'),\n    citySec: $('#citySec'), citySel: $('#citySel'), modeRow: $('#modeRow'), dlSel: $('#dlSel'),\n    verOnly: $('#verOnly'), newOnly: $('#newOnly'), incClosed: $('#incClosed'), frailApply: $('#frailApply'),\n    countLabel: $('#countLabel'), activeChips: $('#activeChips'), fBadge: $('#fBadge'),\n    sortSel: $('#sortSel'), viewGrid: $('#viewGrid'), viewList: $('#viewList'),\n    cards: $('#cards'), moreWrap: $('#moreWrap'), loadMore: $('#loadMore'),\n    emptyBox: $('#emptyBox'), emptyTitle: $('#emptyTitle'), emptyText: $('#emptyText'), emptyAction: $('#emptyAction'),\n    errorBox: $('#errorBox'),\n    closeSec: $('#closeSec'), closeRow: $('#closeRow'),\n    locSec: $('#locSec'), locRow: $('#locRow')\n  };\n\n  $('#searchIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('search', 18);\n  el.qClear.innerHTML = UI.icon('x', 15);\n  el.frailClose.innerHTML = UI.icon('x', 16);\n  $('#frailOpenIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('filter', 15);\n  el.viewGrid.innerHTML = UI.icon('grid', 16);\n  el.viewList.innerHTML = UI.icon('list', 16);\n  $('#emptyIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('briefcase', 22);\n  $('#errorIc').innerHTML = UI.icon('alert', 22);\n\n  const PAGE = 12;\n  const ALL_CITIES = 'All cities';\n  let ALL = [];\n  let shown = PAGE;\n  let recents = [];\n  let sugItems = [];\n  let sugIdx = -1;\n\n  const state = {\n    q: '', fields: new Set(), categories: new Set(), city: ALL_CITIES, modes: new Set(),\n    dl: 'any', verOnly: false, newOnly: false, incClosed: false, sort: 'new', view: 'grid'\n  };\n\n  DetailModal.init(() => ALL);\n\n  /* ---------- everything below is derived from real listings ---------- */\n  const daysLeft = (it) => UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);\n  const daysPosted = (it) => {\n    const d = UI.daysSince(it.publishedAt || it.createdAt);\n    return d === null ? Infinity : d;\n  };\n  const isOpen = (it) => UI.isOpen(it);\n  const newThisWeek = (it) => daysPosted(it) <= 7 && isOpen(it);\n  const openList = () => ALL.filter(isOpen);\n  const vocab = (key) => [...new Set(ALL.map((i) => i[key]).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));\n  const modeVocab = () => vocab('workMode').length ? vocab('workMode') : (Settings.data.workModes || []);\n\n  function filtered() {\n    const L = ALL.filter((it) => {\n      if (!state.incClosed && !isOpen(it)) return false;\n      if (state.fields.size && !state.fields.has(it.field)) return false;\n      if (state.categories.size && !state.categories.has(it.category)) return false;\n      if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES && it.city !== state.city) return false;\n      if (state.modes.size && !state.modes.has(it.workMode)) return false;\n      if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;\n      if (state.newOnly && !newThisWeek(it)) return false;\n      if (state.dl !== 'any') {\n        const d = daysLeft(it);\n        if (d === null || d < 0 || d > +state.dl) return false;\n      }\n      if (state.q) {\n        const hay = `${it.title} ${it.company} ${it.city} ${it.field} ${it.workMode} ${it.category}`.toLowerCase();\n        if (!hay.includes(state.q)) return false;\n      }\n      return true;\n    });\n    if (state.sort === 'new') L.sort((a, b) => daysPosted(a) - daysPosted(b));\n    if (state.sort === 'close') {\n      L.sort((a, b) => {\n        const da = daysLeft(a), db = daysLeft(b);\n        return (da === null ? 999 : da) - (db === null ? 999 : db);\n      });\n    }\n    if (state.sort === 'az') L.sort((a, b) => (a.title || '').localeCompare(b.title || ''));\n    return L;\n  }\n\n  function afCount() {\n    return state.fields.size + state.categories.size + state.modes.size +\n      (state.city !== ALL_CITIES ? 1 : 0) + (state.dl !== 'any' ? 1 : 0) +\n      (state.verOnly ? 1 : 0) + (state.newOnly ? 1 : 0) + (state.incClosed ? 1 : 0);\n  }\n\n  function renderHero() {\n    const open = openList();\n    const cities = new Set(open.map((i) => i.city).filter(Boolean)).size;\n    const added = open.filter(newThisWeek).length;\n    el.heroSub.textContent = `${open.length} open ${open.length === 1 ? 'role' : 'roles'} across ${cities} ${cities === 1 ? 'city' : 'cities'} · ${added} added this week · free for students, always.`;\n  }\n\n  function renderPopular() {\n    const tally = (key) => {\n      const m = new Map();\n      ALL.forEach((i) => { const v = i[key]; if (v) m.set(v, (m.get(v) || 0) + 1); });\n      return [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map((e) => e[0]);\n    };\n    const picks = [...new Set([...tally('field').slice(0, 3), ...tally('city').slice(0, 2)])].slice(0, 5);\n    el.popular.hidden = !picks.length;\n    if (!picks.length) return;\n    el.popular.innerHTML = '<span class=\"eyebrow\">Popular:</span>' +\n      picks.map((p) => `<button type=\"button\" data-q=\"${UI.esc(p)}\">${UI.esc(p)}</button>`).join('');\n  }\n\n  function renderMarquee() {\n    if (!el.mqTrack) return;\n    const nw = ALL.filter(newThisWeek).sort((a, b) => daysPosted(a) - daysPosted(b));\n    if (!nw.length) {\n      el.mqTrack.outerHTML = Rows.marqueeEmpty('No new internships this week — new verified roles are added regularly.');\n      el.mqTrack = null;\n      return;\n    }\n    el.mqTrack.innerHTML = Rows.darkStrip(nw);\n    el.mqTrack.style.animationDuration = Math.max(60, nw.length * 9) + 's';\n  }\n\n  function renderTiles() {\n    const fields = vocab('field');\n    const open = openList();\n    el.tilesSec.hidden = !fields.length;\n    el.tiles.innerHTML = fields.map((f) => {\n      const c = open.filter((i) => i.field === f).length;\n      const on = state.fields.size === 1 && state.fields.has(f);\n      return `<button type=\"button\" class=\"tile${on ? ' is-on' : ''}\" data-field=\"${UI.esc(f)}\" aria-pressed=\"${on}\">\n        <span class=\"t-ico\">${UI.icon(UI.fieldIcon(f), 17)}</span>\n        <span class=\"t-txt\"><b>${UI.esc(f)}</b><span>${c} open</span></span>\n      </button>`;\n    }).join('');\n  }\n\n  function renderFeatured(item) {\n    el.featBox.innerHTML = item\n      ? Rows.featured(item)\n      : '<p class=\"feat-none\">No featured opportunity right now — featured listings are hand-picked by the InternHub team.</p>';\n  }\n\n  function checkList(box, values, set, count) {\n    box.innerHTML = values.map((v) => `<label class=\"cbx\">\n      <input type=\"checkbox\" value=\"${UI.esc(v)}\"${set.has(v) ? ' checked' : ''}>\n      <span class=\"box\"></span><span class=\"txt\">${UI.esc(v)}</span><span class=\"cnt\">${count(v)}</span>\n    </label>`).join('');\n  }\n\n  function renderFacetLists() {\n    const open = openList();\n    const fields = vocab('field');\n    const categories = vocab('category');\n    const cities = vocab('city');\n\n    el.fieldSec.hidden = !fields.length;\n    checkList(el.fieldList, fields, state.fields, (f) => open.filter((i) => i.field === f).length);\n\n    el.categorySec.hidden = !categories.length;\n    checkList(el.categoryList, categories, state.categories, (c) => open.filter((i) => i.category === c).length);\n\n    if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES && !cities.includes(state.city)) state.city = ALL_CITIES;\n    el.citySec.hidden = !cities.length;\n    el.citySel.innerHTML = `<option value=\"${ALL_CITIES}\">${ALL_CITIES}</option>` +\n      cities.map((c) => `<option value=\"${UI.esc(c)}\"${state.city === c ? ' selected' : ''}>${UI.esc(c)}</option>`).join('');\n\n    el.modeRow.innerHTML = modeVocab().map((m) =>\n      `<button type=\"button\" class=\"pill${state.modes.has(m) ? ' is-on' : ''}\" data-mode=\"${UI.esc(m)}\" aria-pressed=\"${state.modes.has(m)}\">${UI.esc(m)}</button>`).join('');\n\n    el.locSec.hidden = !cities.length;\n    el.locRow.innerHTML = cities.map((c) => {\n      const n = open.filter((i) => i.city === c).length;\n      return `<button type=\"button\" class=\"loc${state.city === c ? ' is-on' : ''}\" data-city=\"${UI.esc(c)}\" aria-pressed=\"${state.city === c}\">\n        ${UI.icon('pin', 14)} ${UI.esc(c)}<span class=\"lc\">${n}</span></button>`;\n    }).join('');\n  }\n\n  function renderChips() {\n    const c = [];\n    state.fields.forEach((f) => c.push(['field', f, f]));\n    state.categories.forEach((k) => c.push(['category', k, k]));\n    state.modes.forEach((m) => c.push(['mode', m, m]));\n    if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES) c.push(['city', state.city, state.city]);\n    if (state.dl !== 'any') c.push(['dl', state.dl, `≤ ${state.dl} days`]);\n    if (state.verOnly) c.push(['ver', '1', 'Verified']);\n    if (state.newOnly) c.push(['new', '1', 'New only']);\n    if (state.incClosed) c.push(['closed', '1', 'Incl. closed']);\n\n    el.activeChips.innerHTML = c.map((x) =>\n      `<span class=\"achip\">${UI.esc(x[2])}<button type=\"button\" data-rm=\"${UI.esc(x[0])}:${UI.esc(x[1])}\" aria-label=\"Remove ${UI.esc(x[2])} filter\">${UI.icon('x', 10)}</button></span>`).join('') +\n      (c.length > 1 ? '<button type=\"button\" class=\"achip is-clear\" data-rm=\"*\">Clear all</button>' : '');\n\n    const n = afCount();\n    el.fBadge.textContent = n;\n    el.fBadge.hidden = !n;\n  }\n\n  function renderResults() {\n    const L = filtered();\n    const slice = L.slice(0, shown);\n\n    el.cards.hidden = !slice.length;\n    el.cards.innerHTML = slice.length ? (state.view === 'list' ? Rows.rows(slice) : Rows.grid(slice)) : '';\n    el.moreWrap.hidden = shown >= L.length;\n\n    el.countLabel.textContent = `${L.length} open ${L.length === 1 ? 'role' : 'roles'}`;\n    el.emptyBox.hidden = L.length > 0;\n    if (!L.length) {\n      if (afCount() || state.q) {\n        el.emptyTitle.textContent = 'No internships match your filters';\n        el.emptyText.textContent = 'Try removing a filter or two — or search with a broader term.';\n        el.emptyAction.textContent = 'Clear all filters';\n        el.emptyAction.dataset.act = 'clear';\n      } else {\n        el.emptyTitle.textContent = 'No open internships yet';\n        el.emptyText.textContent = 'New verified opportunities are added regularly. Check back soon — or suggest one you know about.';\n        el.emptyAction.textContent = 'Suggest an internship';\n        el.emptyAction.dataset.act = 'suggest';\n      }\n    }\n    renderChips();\n    el.frailApply.textContent = `Show ${L.length} ${L.length === 1 ? 'role' : 'roles'}`;\n  }\n\n  function renderClosing() {\n    const L = ALL.filter((i) => { const d = daysLeft(i); return d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= 14; })\n      .sort((a, b) => daysLeft(a) - daysLeft(b));\n    el.closeSec.hidden = !L.length;\n    el.closeRow.innerHTML = L.map((i) => Rows.closeCard(i)).join('');\n  }\n\n  function resetPage() { shown = PAGE; }\n\n  function resetFilters() {\n    state.fields.clear();\n    state.categories.clear();\n    state.modes.clear();\n    state.city = ALL_CITIES;\n    state.dl = 'any';\n    state.verOnly = state.newOnly = state.incClosed = false;\n    el.verOnly.checked = el.newOnly.checked = el.incClosed.checked = false;\n    el.dlSel.value = 'any';\n    renderFacetLists();\n    renderTiles();\n    resetPage();\n    renderResults();\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- search suggestions ---------- */\n  const SUG_ICON = { Role: 'search', Company: 'building', Field: 'briefcase', City: 'pin', Category: 'bookmark', Mode: 'globe', Recent: 'history' };\n\n  function sugPool() {\n    const out = [];\n    const seen = new Set();\n    const add = (type, v) => {\n      const s = String(v || '').trim();\n      if (!s || seen.has(s.toLowerCase())) return;\n      seen.add(s.toLowerCase());\n      out.push([s, type]);\n    };\n    ALL.forEach((i) => { add('Role', i.title); add('Company', i.company); });\n    vocab('field').forEach((f) => add('Field', f));\n    vocab('city').forEach((c) => add('City', c));\n    vocab('category').forEach((c) => add('Category', c));\n    modeVocab().forEach((m) => add('Mode', m));\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  function closeSug() {\n    el.sug.classList.remove('is-open');\n    el.sug.innerHTML = '';\n    sugItems = [];\n    sugIdx = -1;\n  }\n\n  function paintSug(items, head) {\n    if (!items.length) { closeSug(); return; }\n    sugItems = items;\n    sugIdx = -1;\n    el.sug.innerHTML = (head ? `<p class=\"sug-head\">${UI.esc(head)}</p>` : '') + items.map(([v, t]) =>\n      `<button type=\"button\" class=\"sug-it\" role=\"option\" aria-selected=\"false\" data-sug=\"${UI.esc(v)}\">\n        ${UI.icon(SUG_ICON[t] || 'search', 14)} ${UI.esc(v)}<span class=\"st\">${UI.esc(t)}</span>\n      </button>`).join('');\n    el.sug.classList.add('is-open');\n  }\n\n  function showSug() {\n    const v = el.q.value.trim();\n    if (!v) {\n      if (recents.length) paintSug(recents.map((r) => [r, 'Recent']), 'Recent searches');\n      else closeSug();\n      return;\n    }\n    paintSug(sugPool().filter(([s]) => s.toLowerCase().includes(v.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 7), '');\n  }\n\n  function moveSug(step) {\n    if (!sugItems.length) return;\n    sugIdx = (sugIdx + step + sugItems.length) % sugItems.length;\n    el.sug.querySelectorAll('.sug-it').forEach((b, i) => {\n      b.classList.toggle('is-on', i === sugIdx);\n      b.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(i === sugIdx));\n    });\n  }\n\n  function commitSearch(txt) {\n    const v = String(txt || '').trim();\n    el.q.value = v;\n    state.q = v.toLowerCase();\n    el.qClear.hidden = !v;\n    closeSug();\n    if (v) recents = [v, ...recents.filter((r) => r !== v)].slice(0, 4);\n    resetPage();\n    renderResults();\n  }\n\n  function goToResults() { $('#resultsTop').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); }\n\n  /* ---------- filter drawer ---------- */\n  function openDrawer() { el.layout.classList.add('filters-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }\n  function closeDrawer() { el.layout.classList.remove('filters-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }\n\n  function setView(v) {\n    state.view = v;\n    el.viewGrid.classList.toggle('on', v === 'grid');\n    el.viewList.classList.toggle('on', v === 'list');\n    el.viewGrid.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(v === 'grid'));\n    el.viewList.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(v === 'list'));\n    renderResults();\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- events ---------- */\n  el.q.addEventListener('input', () => {\n    state.q = el.q.value.trim().toLowerCase();\n    el.qClear.hidden = !el.q.value.trim();\n    resetPage();\n    renderResults();\n    showSug();\n  });\n\n  el.q.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {\n    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); Comparing my rail against the spec's:

Spec rail order: Field → City → Work mode → Deadline → Trust & status.
Mine: Field → Category → City → Work mode → Deadline → Trust & status.

I added Category (documented reconciliation #3 — the spec's mock DATA has no category property, but the real Firestore model does, and the current implementation had it). That's an addition beyond the spec. Per §07 "DO NOT INVENT THEM" — but §07 specifically named "Listing only"/"Open roles only". Category is a real data field on every listing. Hmm.

The directive §12 says only acceptable additions are: (A) missing functionality required by the mandatory design, (B) small UI/UX corrections that preserve it, (C) bug fixes, (D) responsive adaptations. A Category facet is none of those — it's an extra filter not in the mandatory design.

But §02 priority: 1. MANDATORY DESIGN, 2. Existing working functionality/backend. The Category facet IS existing working functionality (the current browse.html had `categories` in FACETS). Removing it would remove an existing feature — and §11 says "DO NOT REMOVE DESIGN ELEMENTS ... If I later want something removed, I will tell you."

These two conflict. §02 resolves it: MANDATORY DESIGN is priority 1. But §02 also says priority 2 is "Existing working functionality/backend" — meaning don't break the backend to match the design. The Category filter is a frontend filter over a real field; the mandatory design simply didn't model categories because its mock data lacks the field.

I'll keep it (it's existing working functionality over real data, rendered with the spec's own `.cbx` pattern, and removing it would delete a feature the user didn't ask to delete per §11), and flag it explicitly to the user as reconciliation #3 for their decision. That's the right call: §11 says the user decides what gets removed.

Now — the document click handler that closes suggestions on outside clicks. There's a conflict: clicking `#qClear` (inside `.searchwrap`) → fine. But the document click listener also handles `[data-q]` popular chips. And `closeSug()` runs when clicking outside `.searchwrap`. When the user clicks `#qClear`, the document listener sees `.searchwrap` ancestor → doesn't close. Then qClear's own handler runs showSug().  </section>\n</div>\n\n<div data-side class=\"sb-card\">\n  <h5>How InternHub works</h5>\n  <ol>\n    <li><b>1</b>Discover opportunities across Cameroon</li>\n    <li><b>2</b>Save the ones that fit $('#browseLayout'), heroSub: $('#heroSub'),\n    searchIc: $('#searchIc'), q: $('#q'), qClear: $('#qClear'), qGo: $('#qGo'),\n    sug: $('#sug'), popular: $('#popular'), marquee: $('#marquee'),  frailScrim: $('#frailScrim'), frailOpen: $('#frailOpen'), frailOpenIc: $('#frailOpenIc'),\n    fieldSec: $('#fieldSec'), fieldList: $('#fieldList'),\n    categorySec: $('#categorySec'), categoryList: frailApply: $('#frailApply'),\n    countLabel: $('#countLabel'), activeChips: $('#activeChips'), fBadge: $('#fBadge'),\n    sortSel: $('#sortSel'), viewGrid: $('#viewGrid'), viewList: $('#emptyAction'), emptyIc: $('#emptyIc'),\n    errorBox: $('#errorBox'), errorIc: $('#errorIc'),\n    closeSec: $('#closeSec'), closeRow: $('#closeRow'),\n    locSec: $('#locSec'), locRow: $('#locRow')\n  };\n\n  el.searchIc.innerHTML = UI.icon('search', 18);\n  el.qClear.innerHTML = UI.icon('x', 15);\n  el.frailClose.innerHTML = UI.icon('x', 16);\n  el.frailOpenIc.innerHTML = UI.icon('alert', 22);\n\n  const PAGE = 12;\n  const ALL_CITIES = 'All cities';\n  let ALL = [];\n  let shown = PAGE;\n  let recents = [];\n  let sugItems = [];\n  let sugIdx = -1;\n\n  const state = {\n    q: '', fields: new Set(), categories: new Set(), city: ALL_CITIES, modes: new Set(),\n    dl: 'any', verOnly: false, newOnly: false, incClosed: false, sort: 'new', view: 'grid'\n  };\n\n  DetailModal.init(() => ALL);\n\n  /* ---------- derived from real listings ---------- */\n  const daysLeft = (it) => UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);\n  const daysPosted = (it) => {\n    const d = fromData : (Settings.data.workModes || []);\n  };\n\n  function filtered() {\n    const L = ALL.filter((it) => {\n      if (!state.incClosed && !isOpen(it)) return false;\n      if (state.fields.size && !state.fields.has(it.field)) return false;\n      if (state.categories.size && !state.categories.has(it.category)) return false;\n      if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES && it.city !== state.city) return false;\n      if (state.modes.size && !state.modes.has(it.workMode)) return false;\n      if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;\n      if (state.newOnly && !newThisWeek(it)) return false;\n      if (state.dl !== 'any') {\n        const d = daysLeft(it);\n        if (d === null || d < 0 || d > +state.dl) return false;\n      }\n      if (state.q) {\n        const hay = `${it.title} ${it.company} ${it.city} ${it.field} ${it.workMode} ${it.category}`.toLowerCase();\n        if (!hay.includes(state.q)) return false;\n      }\n      return true;\n    });\n    if (state.sort === 'new') L.sort((a, b) => daysPosted(a) - daysPosted(b));\n    if (state.sort === 'close') {\n      L.sort((a, b) => {\n        const da = daysLeft(a), db = daysLeft(b);\n        return (da === null ? }\n\n  function resetFilters() {\n    state.fields.clear();\n    state.categories.clear();\n    state.modes.clear();\n    state.city = ALL_CITIES;\n    state.dl = 'any';\n    state.verOnly = state.newOnly = state.incClosed = false;\n    el.verOnly.checked = el.newOnly.checked = el.incClosed.checked = false;\n    el.dlSel.value = 'any';\n    renderFacetLists();\n    renderTiles();\n    resetPage();\n    renderResults();\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- search suggestions ---------- */\n  const SUG_ICON = { Role: 'search', Company: 'building', Field: 'briefcase', City: 'pin', Category: 'bookmark', Mode: 'globe' };\n\n  function sugPool() {\n    const out = [];\n    const seen = new Set();\n    const add = (type, v) => {\n      const s = String(v || '').trim();\n      if (!s || seen.has(s.toLowerCase())) return;\n      seen.add(s.toLowerCase());\n      out.push([s, type]);\n    };\n    ALL.forEach((i) => { add('Role', i.title); add('Company', i.company); });\n    vocab('field').forEach((f) => add('Field', f));\n    vocab('city').forEach((c) => add('City', c));\n    vocab('category').forEach((c) => add('Category', c));\n    modeVocab().forEach((m) => add('Mode', m));\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  function paintSug(items, head) {\n    sugItems = items;\n    sugIdx = -1;\n    if (!items.length) { closeSug(); return; }\n    el.sug.innerHTML = (head ? `<p class=\"sug-head\">${UI.esc(head)}</p>` : '') + items.map(([v, t]) =>\n      `<button type=\"button\" class=\"sug-it\" role=\"option\" aria-selected=\"false\" data-sug=\"${UI.esc(v)}\">\n        ${UI.icon(SUG_ICON[t] || 'search', 14)} ${UI.esc(v)}<span class=\"st\">${UI.esc(t)}</span>\n      </button>`).join('');\n    el.sug.classList.add('is-open');\n  }\n\n  function closeSug() {\n    el.sug.classList.remove('is-open');\n    el.sug.innerHTML = '';\n    sugItems = [];\n    sugIdx = -1;\n  }\n\n  function showSug() {\n    const v = el.q.value.trim();\n    if (!v) {\n      if (recents.length) paintSug(recents.map((r) => [r, 'Recent']), 'Recent searches');\n      else closeSug();\n      return;\n    }\n    const hits = sugPool().filter(([s]) => s.toLowerCase().includes(v.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 7);\n    paintSug(hits, '');\n  }\n\n  function moveSug(step) {\n    if (!sugItems.length) return;\n    sugIdx = (sugIdx + step + sugItems.length) % sugItems.length;\n    el.sug.querySelectorAll('.sug-it').forEach((b, i) => {\n      b.classList.toggle('is-on', i === sugIdx);\n      b.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(i === sugIdx));\n    });\n  }\n\n  function commitSearch(txt) {\n    const v = String(txt || '').trim();\n    el.q.value = v;\n    state.q = v.toLowerCase();\n    el.qClear.hidden = !v;\n    closeSug();\n    if (v) recents = [v, ...recents.filter((r) => r !== v)].slice(0, 4);\n    resetPage();\n    renderResults();\n  }\n\n  /* ---------- filter drawer ---------- */\n  function openDrawer() { el.layout.classList.add('filters-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }\n  function closeDrawer() { el.layout.classList.remove('filters-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }\n\n  /* ---------- events ---------- */\n  el.q.addEventListener('input', () => {\n    state.q = el.q.value.trim().toLowerCase();\n    el.qClear.hidden = !el.q.value.trim();\n    resetPage();\n    renderResults();\n    showSug();\n  });\n  el.q.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {\n    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); el.q.focus(); });\n  el.sug.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {\n    const it = e.target.closest('[data-sug]');\n    if (!it) return;\n    e.preventDefault();\n    commitSearch(it.dataset.sug);\n    $('#resultsTop').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });\n  });\n  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!e.target.closest('.searchwrap')) closeSug(); });\n\n  el.fieldList.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n    const box = e.target.closest('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');\n    if (!box) return;\n    box.checked ? state.fields.add(box.value) : state.fields.delete(box.value);\n    renderTiles(); resetPage(); renderResults();\n  });\n  el.categoryList.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n    const box = e.target.closest('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');\n    if (!box) return;\n    box.checked ? state.categories.add(box.value) : state.categories.delete(box.value);\n    resetPage(); renderTiles(); resetPage(); renderResults();\n    $('#resultsTop').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });\n  });\n  el.citySel.addEventListener('change', () => {\n    state.city = el.citySel.value;\n    renderFacetLists(); renderResults();\n  });\n  el.dlSel.addEventListener('change', () => { state.dl = el.dlSel.value; resetPage(); renderResults(); });\n  el.verOnly.addEventListener('change', () => { state.verOnly = el.verOnly.checked; resetPage(); renderResults(); });\n  el.newOnly.addEventListener('change', () => { state.newOnly = el.newOnly.checked; resetPage(); renderResults(); });\n  el.incClosed.addEventListener('change', () => { state.incClosed = el.incClosed.checked; resetPage(); renderResults(); renderClosing(); });\n  el.sortSel.addEventListener('change', () => { state.sort = el.sortSel.value; resetPage(); renderResults(); });\n\n  el.viewGrid.addEventListener('click', () => setView('grid'));\n  el.viewList.addEventListener('click', () => setView('list'));\n  function setView(v) {\n    state.view = v;\n    el.viewGrid.classList.toggle('on', v === 'grid');\n    el.viewList.classList.toggle('on', v === 'list');\n    el.viewGrid.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(v === 'grid'));\n    el.viewList.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(v === 'list'));\n    renderResults();\n  }\n\n  el.resetFilters.addEventListener('click', resetFilters);\n  el.activeChips.addEventListener('click', (e) => {\n    const btn = e.target.closest('[data-rm]');\n    if (!btn) return;\n    if (btn.dataset.rm === '*') { resetFilters(); }\n    else if (kind === 'city') { state.city = ALL_CITIES; renderFacetLists(); }\n    else if (kind === 'dl') { state.dl = 'any'; el.dlSel.value = 'any'; }\n    else if (kind === 'ver') { state.verOnly = false;   const SUG_ICON = { Role: 'search', Company: 'building', Field: 'briefcase', City: 'pin', Category: 'bookmark', Mode: 'globe', Recent: 'history' };

  function sugPool() {
    const out = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const add = (type, v) => {
      const s = String(v || '').trim();
      if (!s || seen.has(s.toLowerCase())) return;
      seen.add(s.toLowerCase());
      out.push([s, type]);
    };

    modeVocab().forEach((m) => add('Mode', m));

Now I have the full Page 4 spec feature inventory. Note one spec bug: `leavesLeft=h=>48-h` is declared with param `h` but called as `leavesLeft(it)` passing the object → `48 - {object}` = NaN. Then `left<=12?" late":""` → false, and `'Leaves in '+left+'h'` → "Leaves in NaNh". That's a spec bug. In my implementation I must compute it correctly (bug fix, §12(C)).

#### Thinking

The current implementation is drastically simpler than the spec — a bare `page-head` + a single grid. This is exactly the "reverted toward the OLD design" problem the user described.

Also `data-nav="whats-new"` — verify shell's nav key.

#### Thinking

The app's global svg reset matches the spec's (`fill:none;stroke:currentColor`), so the radar SVG's presentation attributes will work. `stroke-width:1.9` vs spec's `2` — negligible; and the radar's sweep has explicit `stroke-width="1.6"`. Presentation attributes are overridden by CSS though! `stroke-width` in the CSS rule (1.9) beats the `stroke-width="1.6"` attribute. Minor — the sweep will be 1.9px instead of 1.6px. And `stroke="rgba(...)"` attributes are ALSO overridden by `stroke:currentColor` in CSS!

**Critical:** `svg{fill:none;stroke:currentColor}` is a CSS rule, and CSS beats presentation attributes. So all my radar `stroke="rgba(140,255,190,.28)"` attributes would be overridden by `stroke:currentColor`, and `fill="#dcefe2"` by `fill:none`. The radar would render as monochrome currentColor rings with no filled blips.

Wait — but the spec has the SAME global rule (`svg{fill:none;stroke:currentColor}` line 30) and its radar uses presentation attributes too. So the spec has the same "problem"... unless CSS specificity: presentation attributes have lower priority than ANY CSS rule, yes. So in the spec the radar rings would also be `currentColor`. `.radar` inherits `color` from `.intro` = `#eafff3`. So the rings render near-white, and the filled blips render as unfilled (fill:none) — the spec's radar would look different from its intent but still visible.

Hmm. That means to faithfully reproduce, I should... reproduce what the spec actually renders, or what it intends? §02 says restore the design. The design intent is clearly multi-opacity green rings + filled blips.

The safe, correct fix: give the radar its own CSS with explicit `stroke`/`fill` per element so it renders as intended, since the global svg reset would otherwise flatten it. I'll add:

```css
.radar circle{fill:none;stroke:currentColor}
.radar .blip{fill:#9fe8bd;stroke:none}
.radar .core{fill:#dcefe2;stroke:none}
.radar .sweep path{stroke-width:1.6}
```

.searchbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--card);border-radius:13px;padding:7px 7px 7px 15px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.searchbar .s-ico{color:var(--mut);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.searchbar input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);padding:8px 0}
.searchbar input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
.s-clear{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--mut);flex:none;transition:.18s}
.s-clear:hover{background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink)}
.s-clear[hidden]{display:none}

.sug{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:0;right:0;z-index:60;display:none;max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:6px}
.sug.is-open{display:block}
.sug-head{padding:7px 11px 4px;font:600 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.sug-it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);text-align:left;transition:background .15s,color .15s}
.sug-it svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--dim);flex:none}
.sug-it .st{margin-left:auto;font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.sug-it.is-on,.sug-it:hover{background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink)}

.popular{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.popular[hidden]{display:none}
.popular .eyebrow,.mq-head .eyebrow{color:#8fc7a6}
.popular button{border:1px solid rgba(234,255,243,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#d7f2e2;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 13px;font-size:12.5px;transition:.2s}
.popular button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
=====336,360=====
.dead{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap}
.dead svg{width:12px;height:12px;flex:none}
.dead.warn{color:var(--amber)}
.dead.off{color:var(--dim);text-decoration:line-through}
.dcard .dead{color:#9fb3a6}
.dcard .dead.warn{color:#f0b269}
.dcard .dead.off{color:#7f8c85}

.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(158px,1fr));gap:12px}
.tile{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px;text-align:left;transition:transform .22s var(--ease),border-color .22s,box-shadow .22s,background .22s}
.tile:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
.tile.is-on{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green)}
.t-ico{width:36px;height:36px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
.tile.is-on .t-ico{background:var(--white)}
.t-txt{min-width:0}
.t-txt b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.t-txt span{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}

.feat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(240px,42%) 1fr;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.feat::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(420px 200px at 100% 0,rgba(23,122,76,.07),transparent 60%)}
.feat-media{position:relative;min-height:230px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
.feat-media img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
.feat:hover .feat-media img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.feat-body{padding:24px 26px;position:relative}
.feat-body .eyebrow{color:var(--green-ink)}
.feat-body h3{font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,25px);margin:8px 0 4px}
.feat-body h3 a:hover{color:var(--green)}
.feat-co{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.vcheck{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
.vcheck svg{width:9px;height:9px;stroke-width:3}
.feat-desc{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:10px;max-width:560px}
.feat .ic-meta{margin-top:12px}
.feat-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.feat-save{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--card);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:.2s var(--ease)}
.feat-save:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
.feat-save.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
.feat-save.on svg{fill:currentColor}
.feat-actions .dead{margin-left:auto}
.feat-none{border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:var(--bg);padding:26px 22px;text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px}

const DetailModal = (() => {
  let backdrop = null;
  let getItems = () => [];
  let currentId = null;
  let lastFocus = null;
  let wired = false;

  const q = (sel) => (backdrop ? backdrop.querySelector(sel) : null);

  function paintSave(on) {
    const btn = q('#dmSave');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = on ? 'Saved ✓' : 'Save for later';
    btn.classList.toggle('btn-primary', on);
    btn.classList.toggle('btn-ghost', !on);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
  }

  function build() {
    if (backdrop) return backdrop;
    backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop';
    backdrop.innerHTML = `
      <div class="modal modal-lg" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dmTitle">
        <button type="button" class="dm-x" data-dm-close aria-label="Close">${UI.icon('x', 16)}</button>
        <div class="dm-media" id="dmMedia"></div>
        <div class="dm-body">
          <div class="dm-badges" id="dmBadges"></div>
          <h3 class="modal-title" id="dmTitle"></h3>
          <p class="dm-company" id="dmCompany"></p>
          <div class="dm-meta" id="dmMeta"></div>
          <p class="dm-desc" id="dmDesc"></p>
          <p class="dm-note">InternHub is a discovery directory — applications happen on the company's own website.</p>
          <div class="modal-actions dm-actions">
            <a class="dm-full" id="dmFull" href="#">Full listing ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="dmSave" aria-pressed="false">Save for later</button>
            <a class="btn btn-primary" id="dmApply" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Apply</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === backdrop || e.target.closest('[data-dm-close]')) close();
    });

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('#dmSave') || !currentId) return;
      const btn = q('#dmSave');
      btn.disabled = true;
      const res = await Saved.toggle(currentId);
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (!res.ok) { UI.toast('Could not update your saved list', 'error'); return; }
      const on = res.state === 'saved';
      paintSave(on);
      document.querySelectorAll(`[data-save="${currentId}"]`).forEach((b) => {
        b.classList.toggle('on', on);
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', on ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship');
        b.innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 15, on);
        b.classList.remove('pop');
        void b.offsetWidth;
        b.classList.add('pop');
      });
      UI.toast(on ? "Saved — apply later from the company's site." : 'Removed from saved');
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saved:changed', { detail: { id: currentId, on } }));
    });

  function paintMedia(item) {
    const box = q('#dmMedia');
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="ic-fallback">${UI.esc(UI.initials(item.company || 'InternHub'))}</div>`;
    const url = UI.safeUrl(item.image);

    img.src = url;

    img.addEventListener('error', () => img.remove());

  function paintMeta(item) {
    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
    const bits = [
      item.field ? UI.icon('briefcase', 12) + UI.esc(item.field) : '',
      item.duration ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(item.duration) : '',
      item.workMode ? UI.icon('globe', 12) + UI.esc(item.workMode) : '',
      item.stipend ? UI.icon('sparkles', 12) + UI.esc(item.stipend) : '',
      dl.label ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(dl.label) : ''
    ].filter(Boolean);
    q('#dmMeta').innerHTML = bits.map((b) => `<span>${b}</span>`).join('');
  }

  function open(id) {
    const item = getItems().find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
    if (!item) return;
    currentId = item.id;
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    build();

    paintMedia(item);
    q('#dmBadges').innerHTML = Rows.badges(item);
    q('#dmTitle').textContent = item.title || 'Untitled role';
    q('#dmCompany').textContent = [item.company, item.city].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—';
    paintMeta(item);

    const desc = q('#dmDesc');
    desc.textContent = item.description || '';
    desc.hidden = !item.description;

    const full = q('#dmFull');
    const apply = q('#dmApply');
    const ext = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
    full.href = Rows.detailHref(item.id);
    full.classList.toggle('btn', !ext);
    full.classList.toggle('btn-primary', !ext);
    apply.href = ext || '#';
    apply.hidden = !ext;

    const save = q('#dmSave');
    save.hidden = !Auth.profile;
    paintSave(Saved.has(item.id));

    backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    q('[data-dm-close]')?.focus();
  }

  function close() {
    if (!backdrop || !backdrop.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    currentId = null;
    if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
  }

  function init(itemsGetter) {
    if (typeof itemsGetter === 'function') getItems = itemsGetter;
    if (wired) return;
    wired = true;
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const trigger = e.target.closest('[data-details]');
      if (!trigger) return;
      const known = getItems().some((x) => String(x.id) === String(trigger.dataset.details));
      if (!known) return;                      // nothing to show — follow the link
      e.preventDefault();
      open(trigger.dataset.details);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); });
  }

  return { init, open, close };
})();

```js
function wnCard(item, i) {
  const href = Rows.detailHref(item.id);
  const h = hoursAgo(item);
  const left = window - h;   // hours remaining in the New window
  return `<article class="icard" style="animation-delay:${Math.min(i * 45, 360)}ms">
    <div class="ic-media">${Rows.media(item)}
      <div class="ic-badges">${Rows.badges(item)}</div>
      ${Rows.saveBtn(item, 'save')}
    </div>
    <span class="mono-av">${UI.esc(UI.initials(item.company || 'InternHub'))}</span>
    <div class="ic-body">
      <h3 class="ic-title"><a href="${href}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
      <p class="ic-co">${UI.icon('building', 13)} ${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.verified ? `<span class="vcheck" title="Verified">${UI.icon('check', 9)}</span>` : ''}</p>
      <div class="ic-meta">${Rows.metaTags(item, true)}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ic-foot">
      <div class="fresh">
        <span class="added">${UI.icon('sparkles', 12)}${addedLabel(h)}</span>
        <span class="leaves${left <= 12 ? ' late' : ''}">Leaves in ${left}h</span>
      </div>
      <a class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" href="${href}" data-details="${UI.esc(item.id)}">Details</a>
    </div>
  </article>`;
}
```

The app already has a global `*{animation-duration:.001ms !important}` reduced-motion rule, which effectively kills all animations (including the radar, ping, cardin). So I don't strictly need a per-component reduced-motion block. But the spec also sets `.radar .pulse{opacity:0}` — with animation-duration .001ms, pulseR ends at opacity:0 anyway (animation-fill-mode not set → returns to base opacity 1 after finishing... actually without `both`/`forwards`, after the animation completes the element reverts to its non-animated state = opacity 1). So the pulse circles would show as static full-size rings at r=30. The spec explicitly wants `opacity:0`. Add it.

So reduced-motion block for whats-new:
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .radar .pulse{opacity:0}
}
```
That's the only meaningful addition (the global rule already handles `animation:none` for sweep/blip/live-dot/ping, and cardin — hmm, `cardin` has `both` fill mode; with duration .001ms it snaps to the end state immediately = opacity 1, translateY(0). Good, no flash.)

```js
function wnCard(item, i) {
  const href = Rows.detailHref(item.id);
  const h = hoursAgo(item);
  const left = leavesLeft(h);
  return `<article class="icard" style="animation-delay:${Math.min(i * 45, 360)}ms">
    <div class="ic-media">${Rows.media(item)}
      <div class="ic-badges">${Rows.badges(item, deadlineTxt(item))}</div>
      ${Rows.saveBtn(item, 'save')}
    </div>
    <span class="mono-av">${UI.esc(UI.initials(item.company || 'InternHub'))}</span>
    <div class="ic-body">
      <h3 class="ic-title"><a href="${href}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
      <p class="ic-co">${UI.icon('building', 13)} ${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.verified ? `<span class="vcheck">${UI.icon('check', 9)}</span>` : ''}</p>
      <div class="ic-meta">${Rows.metaTags(item, true)}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ic-foot">
      <div class="fresh">
        <span class="added"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.4 7.6L22 12l-7.6 2.4L12 22l-2.4-7.6L2 12l7.6-2.4z"/></svg>${addedLabel(h)}</span>
        <span class="leaves${left <= 12 ? ' late' : ''}">Leaves in ${left}h</span>
      </div>
      <a class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" href="${href}" data-details="${UI.esc(item.id)}">Details</a>
    </div>
  </article>`;
}
```

```js
function filtered() {
  const q = state.q.toLowerCase();
  return FRESH.filter((it) => {
    if (state.fields.size && !state.fields.has(it.field)) return false;
    if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES && it.city !== state.city) return false;
    if (state.modes.size && !state.modes.has(it.workMode)) return false;
    if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;
    if (state.dl !== 'any') { const d = daysLeft(it); if (!(d >= 0 && d <= +state.dl)) return false; }
    if (q) { const hay = [it.title, it.company, it.city, it.field, it.workMode].join(' ').toLowerCase(); if (!hay.includes(q)) return false; }
    return true;
  }).sort((a, b) => hoursAgo(a) - hoursAgo(b));
}
```

```js
  const n=afCount(); el.fBadge.textContent=n; el.fBadge.hidden=!n;
}
```

<script src="../assets/js/lib/notify-ui.js"></script>
<script src="../assets/js/lib/shell.js"></script>
<script>
window.onReady(function () {
  Rows.initSaveHandling();
  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
  const el = {
    body: document.getElementById('view'),
    stat: $('#statCount'), pill: $('#windowPill'),
    q: $('#q'), qClear: $('#qClear'), layout: $('#browseLayout'),
    fieldSec: $('#fieldSec'), fieldList: $('#fieldList'),
    citySec: $('#citySec'), citySel: $('#citySel'),
    modeSec: $('#modeSec'), modeRow: $('#modeRow'),
    dlSel: $('#dlSel'), verOnly: $('#verOnly'),
    openBtn: $('#frailOpen'), closeBtn: $('#frailClose'), scrim: $('#frailScrim'),
    apply: $('#frailApply'), reset: $('#resetFilters'),
    count: $('#countLabel'), chips: $('#activeChips'), fBadge: $('#fBadge'),
    secJust: $('#secJust'), gridJust: $('#gridJust'),
    secToday: $('#secToday'), gridToday: $('#gridToday'),
    secYday: $('#secYday'), gridYday: $('#gridYday'),
    empty: $('#emptyBox'), emptyTitle: $('#emptyTitle'), emptyText: $('#emptyText'), emptyAction: $('#emptyAction')
  };

  const ALL_CITIES = 'All cities';
  const WINDOW_H = Math.round(UI.NEW_WINDOW_MS / 3600000);
  let FRESH = [];
  const state = { q: '', fields: new Set(), city: ALL_CITIES, modes: new Set(), dl: 'any', verOnly: false };
  DetailModal.init(() => FRESH);

  const hoursAgo = (it) => {
    const t = UI.toDate(it.publishedAt || it.createdAt);
    return t ? Math.max(0, (Date.now() - t.getTime()) / 3600000) : 0;
  };
  const addedLabel = (h) => (h < 1 ? 'Added just now' : h < 24 ? `Added ${Math.floor(h)}h ago` : 'Added yesterday');
  const leavesLeft = (h) => Math.max(0, Math.ceil(WINDOW_H - h));
  const closingLabel = (it) => {
    const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
    if (d === null || d < 0) return null;
    if (d <= 1) return 'Closes tomorrow';
    if (d <= 7) return `Closes in ${d} days`;
    return null;
  };
  const vocab = (key) => [...new Set(FRESH.map((i) => i[key]).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

  function filtered() {
    const q = state.q.toLowerCase();
    return FRESH.filter((it) => {
      if (state.fields.size && !state.fields.has(it.field)) return false;
      if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES && it.city !== state.city) return false;
      if (state.modes.size && !state.modes.has(it.workMode)) return false;
      if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;
      if (state.dl !== 'any') {
        const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
        if (!(d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= +state.dl)) return false;
      }
      if (q && ![it.title, it.company, it.city, it.field, it.workMode].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      return true;
    }).sort((a, b) => hoursAgo(a) - hoursAgo(b));
  }

  function afCount() {
    return state.fields.size + state.modes.size
      + (state.city !== ALL_CITIES ? 1 : 0)
      + (state.dl !== 'any' ? 1 : 0)
      + (state.verOnly ? 1 : 0);
  }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

  function wnCard(item, i) {
    const href = Rows.detailHref(item.id);
    const h = hoursAgo(item);
    const left = leavesLeft(h);
    return `<article class="icard" style="animation-delay:${Math.min(i * 45, 360)}ms">
      <div class="ic-media">${Rows.media(item)}
        <div class="ic-badges">${Rows.badges(item, closingLabel(item))}</div>
        ${Rows.saveBtn(item, 'save')}
      </div>
      <span class="mono-av">${UI.esc(UI.initials(item.company || 'InternHub'))}</span>
      <div class="ic-body">
        <h3 class="ic-title"><a href="${href}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
        <p class="ic-co">${UI.icon('building', 13)} ${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.verified ? `<span class="vcheck">${UI.icon('check', 9)}</span>` : ''}</p>
        <div class="ic-meta">${Rows.metaTags(item, true)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ic-foot">
        <div class="fresh">
          <span class="added"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.4 7.6L22 12l-7.6 2.4L12 22l-2.4-7.6L2 12l7.6-2.4z"/></svg>${addedLabel(h)}</span>
          <span class="leaves${left <= 12 ? ' late' : ''}">Leaves in ${left}h</span>
        </div>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" href="${href}" data-details="${UI.esc(item.id)}">Details</a>
      </div>
    </article>`;
  }

  function checkRow(value, label, count, on) {
    return `<label class="cbx"><input type="checkbox" value="${UI.esc(value)}"${on ? ' checked' : ''}>`
      + `<span class="box"></span><span class="txt">${UI.esc(label)}</span><span class="cnt">${count}</span></label>`;
  }

  function renderFacets() {
    const fields = vocab('field');
    el.fieldSec.hidden = !fields.length;
    el.fieldList.innerHTML = fields.map((f) =>
      checkRow(f, f, FRESH.filter((d) => d.field === f).length, state.fields.has(f))).join('');

    const cities = vocab('city');
    el.citySec.hidden = !cities.length;
    el.citySel.innerHTML = [ALL_CITIES, ...cities].map((c) =>
      `<option value="${UI.esc(c)}"${c === state.city ? ' selected' : ''}>${UI.esc(c)}</option>`).join('');

    const modes = vocab('workMode');
    el.modeSec.hidden = !modes.length;
    el.modeRow.innerHTML = modes.map((m) =>
      `<button type="button" class="pill${state.modes.has(m) ? ' is-on' : ''}" data-mode="${UI.esc(m)}">${UI.esc(m)}</button>`).join('');
  }

  function renderChips() {
    const c = [];
    state.fields.forEach((f) => c.push(['field', f, f]));
    state.modes.forEach((m) => c.push(['mode', m, m]));
    if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES) c.push(['city', state.city, state.city]);
    if (state.dl !== 'any') c.push(['dl', state.dl, `≤ ${state.dl} days`]);
    if (state.verOnly) c.push(['ver', '1', 'Verified']);
    el.chips.innerHTML = c.map((x) => `<span class="achip">${UI.esc(x[2])}`
      + `<button type="button" data-rm="${x[0]}:${UI.esc(x[1])}" aria-label="Remove filter">${UI.icon('x', 10)}</button></span>`).join('')
      + (c.length > 1 ? '<span class="achip is-clear" data-rm="*">Clear all</span>' : '');
    const n = afCount();
    el.fBadge.textContent = n;
    el.fBadge.hidden = !n;
  }
});
</script>

```js
  function renderSections() {

      sec.hidden = !list.length;

    };

    put(el.secToday, el.gridToday, L.filter((it) => { const h = hoursAgo(it); return h >= 6 && h < 24; }));
    put(el.secYday, el.gridYday, L.filter((it) => hoursAgo(it) >= 24));
    const none = !L.length;
    el.empty.hidden = !none;
    if (none) {
      if (afCount() || state.q) {
        el.emptyTitle.textContent = 'Nothing new matches your filters';
        el.emptyText.textContent = 'No internship added in the last ' + WINDOW_H + ' hours fits this combination. Loosen a filter — or browse everything we know about.';
        el.emptyAction.textContent = 'Clear all filters';
        el.emptyAction.dataset.act = 'clear';
      } else {
        el.emptyTitle.textContent = 'No new opportunities right now';
        el.emptyText.textContent = "There aren't any internships newly added within the last " + WINDOW_H + ' hours. Every opportunity we know about is waiting for you in Browse.';
        el.emptyAction.textContent = 'Browse all internships';
        el.emptyAction.dataset.act = 'browse';
      }
    }
    el.count.textContent = `${L.length} of ${FRESH.length} fresh opportunities shown`;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-new-badge]').forEach((b) => { b.hidden = !FRESH.length; b.textContent = FRESH.length; });
    el.apply.textContent = `Show ${L.length}${L.length === 1 ? ' result' : ' results'}`;
    renderChips();
  }
```

Events:
```js
  el.q.addEventListener('input', () => {
    state.q = el.q.value.trim();
    el.qClear.hidden = !state.q;
    renderSections();
  });
  el.qClear.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.q = '';
    el.q.value = '';
    el.qClear.hidden = true;
    renderSections();
    el.q.focus();
  });
  el.fieldList.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const v = e.target.value;
    if (e.target.checked) state.fields.add(v); else state.fields.delete(v);
    renderSections();
  });
  el.citySel.addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.city = e.target.value; renderSections(); });
  el.modeRow.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const p = e.target.closest('.pill');
    if (!p) return;
    const m = p.dataset.mode;
    if (state.modes.has(m)) state.modes.delete(m); else state.modes.add(m);
    p.classList.toggle('is-on');
    renderSections();
  });
  el.dlSel.addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.dl = e.target.value; renderSections(); });
  el.verOnly.addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.verOnly = e.target.checked; renderSections(); });
  el.reset.addEventListener('click', resetFilters);
  el.chips.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const rm = e.target.closest('[data-rm]');
    if (!rm) return;
    const key = rm.dataset.rm;
    if (key === '*') { resetFilters(); return; }
    const i = key.indexOf(':');
    const kind = key.slice(0, i);
    const val = key.slice(i + 1);
    if (kind === 'field') state.fields.delete(val);
    if (kind === 'mode') state.modes.delete(val);
    if (kind === 'city') state.city = ALL_CITIES;
    if (kind === 'dl') { state.dl = 'any'; el.dlSel.value = 'any'; }
    if (kind === 'ver') { state.verOnly = false; el.verOnly.checked = false; }
    renderFacets();
    renderSections();
  });
```
Note: the spec's "Clear all" chip is a `<span class="achip">Clear all</span>` matched by textContent; I use `data-rm="*"`. Consistent with Browse.

```js
  el.emptyAction.addEventListener('click', () => {

  el.closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
```

Bug found: clicking `#emptyAction` in the "clear" branch didn't clear the search box. Why? Because `resetFilters()` clears the facet state but NOT `state.q` / the input value. In the spec:

```js
$("#emptyAction").addEventListener("click",e=>{
 if(e.target.dataset.act==="clear"){resetFilters();state.q="";$("#q").value="";$("#qClear").hidden=true;renderSections();}
 else toast("Browse prototype — separate file.");});
```

The spec explicitly clears the query too. My `resetFilters()` only does the facets, and my handler just calls `resetFilters()`. Must fix: also clear the search.

Note: Browse's `resetFilters` also only clears facets, and its emptyAction did `resetFilters(); commitSearch('')`. Same pattern — good, so fix here consistently.

Fix:
```js
  el.emptyAction.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (el.emptyAction.dataset.act === 'clear') {
      resetFilters();
      state.q = '';
      el.q.value = '';
      el.qClear.hidden = true;
      renderSections();
    } else {
      window.location.href = 'browse.html';
    }
  });
```

244	  .orbits{display:none}
245	}
246	@media (max-width:640px){
247	  .fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}

249	  .hrow{flex-wrap:wrap}

252	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{transition-duration:.01ms !important;animation-duration:.01ms !important;animation-iteration-count:1 !important}}
253	</style>

294	  <main class="main">
295	    <!-- ===== INTRO ===== -->
296	    <section class="intro">
297	      <svg class="orbits" viewBox="0 0 340 200" aria-hidden="true">
298	        <circle cx="252" cy="100" r="72" stroke="rgba(140,255,190,.22)" stroke-dasharray="3 7"/>
299	        <circle cx="252" cy="100" r="42" stroke="rgba(140,255,190,.16)"/>
300	        <path class="sig" d="M14 158 C 92 128, 148 52, 252 100" stroke="rgba(140,255,190,.5)" stroke-width="1.6"/>
301	        <circle cx="14" cy="158" r="4" fill="#9fe8bd" stroke="none"/>
302	        <circle cx="150" cy="86" r="3" fill="#9fe8bd" stroke="none" opacity=".7"/>
303	        <circle cx="252" cy="100" r="5" fill="#dcefe2" stroke="none"/>
304	      </svg>
305	      <p class="eyebrow">Community submissions</p>
306	      <h1 class="display">Know an internship? Help another student discover it.</h1>
307	      <p>Send in opportunities you've found — online or in real life. Every suggestion is reviewed, verified and published so the whole student community can benefit.</p>
308	      <p class="stat-line">132 community suggestions · 96 published · 5 cities</p>
309	    </section>

311	    <div class="suggest-grid">
312	      <!-- ===== FORM ===== -->
313	      <div class="form-col" id="formCol">
314	        <form id="suggestForm" novalidate>
315	          <div class="fcard">
316	            <div class="fhead"><span class="fstep">01</span><h3>The opportunity</h3></div>
317	            <div class="fgrid">
318	              <div class="field span2" id="wTitle">
319	                <label for="fTitle">Internship title <span class="req">*</span></label>
320	                <input id="fTitle" placeholder="e.g. Software Engineering Intern" maxlength="80">
321	                <p class="fmsg">Please add the internship title.</p>
322	              </div>
323	              <div class="field span2" id="wCompany">
324	                <label for="fCompany">Company / organisation <span class="req">*</span></label>
325	                <input id="fCompany" placeholder="e.g. Afrimax Technologies">
326	                <p class="fmsg">Please add the company or organisation name.</p>
327	              </div>
328	              <div class="field span2" id="wField">
329	                <label>Field <span class="req">*</span></label>
330	                <div class="fchips" id="fieldChips"></div>
331	                <p class="fmsg">Choose the closest field for this internship.</p>
332	              </div>
333	            </div>
334	          </div>
335	
336	          <div class="fcard">
337	            <div class="fhead"><span class="fstep">02</span><h3>Location & work mode</h3></div>
338	            <div class="fgrid">
339	              <div class="field span2" id="wCity">
340	                <label>City <span class="req">*</span></label>
341	                <div class="fchips" id="cityChips"></div>
342	                <p class="fmsg">Pick a city — or “Other” to type one in.</p>
343	              </div>
344	              <div class="field span2" id="cityOtherWrap" style="display:none">
345	                <label for="fCityOther">Your city</label>
346	                <input id="fCityOther" placeholder="e.g. Kribi">
347	              </div>
348	              <div class="field">
349	                <label for="fArea">Area <span style="color:var(--muted);font-weight:500">(optional)</span></label>
350	                <input id="fArea" placeholder="e.g. Mile 17, Bonapriso…">
351	              </div>
352	              <div class="field" id="wMode">
353	                <label>Work mode <span class="req">*</span></label>
354	                <div class="seg" id="modeSeg">
355	                  <button type="button" data-mode="On-site"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M9 7h2m2 0h2M9 11h2m2 0h2M9 15h2m2 0h2"/></svg>On-site</button>
356	                  <button type="button" data-mode="Hybrid"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3v6m0 0a4 4 0 1 0 4 4"/><circle cx="12" cy="9" r="0"/><path d="M5 21a7 7 0 0 1 14 0"/></svg>Hybrid</button>
357	                  <button type="button" data-mode="Remote"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M8 20h8M12 16v4"/></svg>Remote</button>
358	                </div>
359	                <p class="fmsg">Select how the intern will work.</p>
360	              </div>
361	            </div>
362	          </div>
363	
364	          <div class="fcard">
365	            <div class="fhead"><span class="fstep">03</span><h3>Links</h3><span class="opt">Where you found it</span></div>
366	            <div class="fgrid">
367	              <div class="field span2" id="wSource">
368	                <label for="fSource">Source link <span class="req">*</span></label>
369	                <input id="fSource" type="url" placeholder="https://… the page where you found this opportunity">
370	                <p class="hint" id="sourceHint">Paste the page where you discovered it — a company career page, LinkedIn post, flyer site…</p>
371	                <p class="fmsg">A valid source link (https://…) is required so we can review it.</p>
372	              </div>
373	              <div class="field span2" id="wApply">
374	                <label for="fApply">Application link <span style="color:var(--muted);font-weight:500">(optional, if different)</span></label>
375	                <input id="fApply" type="url" placeholder="https://… direct application URL">
376	                <p class="hint" id="applyHint">If applications happen on a different page, add it here.</p>
377	              </div>
378	            </div>
379	          </div>
380	
381	          <div class="fcard">
382	            <div class="fhead"><span class="fstep">04</span><h3>Details</h3><span class="opt">Everything helps</span></div>
383	            <div class="fgrid">
384	              <div class="field span2">
385	                <label for="fDesc">Description <span class="count" id="descCount">0 / 600</span></label>
386	                <textarea id="fDesc" maxlength="600" placeholder="What will the intern do? Requirements? Anything a student should know before applying…"></textarea>
387	              </div>
388	              <div class="field">
389	                <label for="fDur">Duration</label>
390	                <label class="select" style="position:relative"><select id="fDur">
391	                  <option value="">Not sure yet</option><option>1 – 2 months</option><option>3 months</option><option>4 – 5 months</option><option>6 months</option><option>6+ months</option>
392	                </select></label>
393	              </div>
394	              <div class="field">
395	                <label for="fDeadline">Application deadline</label>
396	                <input id="fDeadline" type="date">
397	              </div>
398	              <div class="field span2">
399	                <label for="fContact">Contact info <span style="color:var(--muted);font-weight:500">(optional)</span></label>
400	                <input id="fContact" placeholder="e.g. careers@company.cm · +237 6XX XX XX XX">
401	                <p class="hint">Only share contact details that are publicly available.</p>
402	              </div>
403	            </div>
404	          </div>
405	
406	          <div class="fcard">
407	            <div class="fhead"><span class="fstep">05</span><h3>Cover image</h3><span class="opt">Optional</span></div>
408	            <div class="field" id="wImg">
409	              <label for="fImg">Image URL</label>
410	              <input id="fImg" type="url" placeholder="https://…/image.jpg">
411	              <p class="hint" id="imgHint">Paste a direct link to a company or office image. No image? We'll generate a clean cover automatically.</p>
412	            </div>
413	          </div>
414	
415	          <div class="submit-row">
416	            <button class="btn primary big" id="submitBtn" type="submit">
417	              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg>
418	              Submit for review
419	            </button>
420	            <p class="submit-note">Required fields marked <span style="color:var(--green);font-weight:700">*</span> · Reviewed before publishing</p>
421	          </div>
422	        </form>
423	
424	        <!-- success overlay -->
425	        <div class="done" id="doneOverlay">
426	          <div class="done-card">
427	            <svg class="done-check" viewBox="0 0 64 64"><circle cx="32" cy="32" r="26.5" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5"/><path d="M21 33l8 8 15-16" fill="none"/></svg>
428	            <h3 class="display">Suggestion submitted.</h3>
429	            <p>Thank you for helping another student discover an opportunity. Our team will review it shortly — track its status in your submission history below.</p>
430	            <div class="done-actions">
431	              <button class="btn primary" id="againBtn">Suggest another</button>
432	              <button class="btn ghost" data-toast="Browse prototype — separate file.">Browse internships</button>
433	              <button class="btn ghost" data-toast="Dashboard prototype — separate file.">View dashboard</button>
434	            </div>
435	          </div>
436	        </div>
437	      </div>
438	
439	      <!-- ===== PREVIEW + WORKFLOW ===== -->
440	      <aside class="pv-col">
441	        <p class="eyebrow pv-label"><span class="dot"></span>Live preview</p>
442	        <article class="pv-card" id="pvCard"></article>
443	        <div class="wf">
444	          <h4>What happens next?</h4>
445	          <div class="wf-step"><span class="wf-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg></span><div><b>You suggest</b><span>Share the opportunity with a link and details.</span></div></div>
446	          <div class="wf-step"><span class="wf-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg></span><div><b>We review</b><span>Our team checks, edits and verifies the listing.</span></div></div>
447	          <div class="wf-step"><span class="wf-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg></span><div><b>Students discover</b><span>It goes live in Browse for the whole community.</span></div></div>
448	        </div>
449	      </aside>
450	    </div>
451	
452	    <!-- ===== HISTORY ===== -->
453	    <section class="history">
454	      <div class="sechead"><h2 class="display">Your suggestions</h2><span class="eyebrow" id="histCount"></span></div>
455	      <div id="histList"></div>
456	    </section>
457	
458	    <footer class="foot">© 2026 InternHub · Verified opportunities across Cameroon</footer>
459	  </main>
460	</div>
461	<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
462	
463	<script>
464	const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
465	const FIELDS=["Software Engineering","Data & AI","Design","Finance","Agriculture","Engineering","Health","Marketing"];
466	const CITIES=["Douala","Yaoundé","Buea","Limbe"];
467	const FICO={"Software Engineering":'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 6l-5 6 5 6M16 6l5 6-5 6"/></svg>',"Data & AI":'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-8M22 20H2"/></svg>',Design:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 19l7-7 3 3-7 7-3-3z"/><path d="M18 13l-1.5-7.5L2 2l3.5 14.5L13 18l5-5z"/></svg>',Finance:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v10M15 9.5c0-1.4-1.3-2.5-3-2.5s-3 1.1-3 2.5 1.3 2.5 3 2.5 3 1.1 3 2.5-1.3 2.5-3 2.5-3-1.1-3-2.5"/></svg>',Agriculture:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 22V8"/><path d="M12 8C12 4 9 2 5 2c0 4 3 6 7 6zM12 12c0-4 3-6 7-6 0 4-3 6-7 6z"/></svg>',Engineering:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 2L3 14h7l-1 8 10-12h-7l1-8z"/></svg>',Health:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/></svg>',Marketing:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 11l18-8v18L3 13v-2z"/><path d="M7 13v6a2 2 0 0 0 4 0v-4"/></svg>'};
468	const IC={tag:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20.6 13.4L11 3H4v7l9.6 10.4a2 2 0 0 0 2.8 0l4.2-4.2a2 2 0 0 0 0-2.8z"/></svg>',clock:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg>',pin:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12S4 16 4 10a8 8 0 0 1 16 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>',mode:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M8 20h8M12 16v4"/></svg>',send:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg>'};
469	const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");
470	const initials=n=>n.split(/\s+/).map(w=>w[0]).join("").slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
471	const F={title:"",company:"",field:"",city:"",area:"",mode:"",source:"",apply:"",desc:"",dur:"",deadline:"",contact:"",img:""};
472	let imgOk=false;
473	let history=[
474	 {t:"Sales Intern",co:"QuickSell Douala",date:"30 August 2026",st:"pending"},
475	 {t:"UI Design Intern",co:"Nkolbisson Studio",date:"26 August 2026",st:"needs"},
476	 {t:"Data Science Intern",co:"Cameroon Data Lab",date:"18 August 2026",st:"published"},
477	 {t:"Crypto Trading Intern",co:"Unknown LLC",date:"12 August 2026",st:"rejected"}
478	];
479	const ST={pending:["Pending review","st-pending"],verified:["Verified","st-verified"],published:["Published","st-published"],needs:["Needs changes","st-needs"],rejected:["Rejected","st-rejected"]};
480	
481	/* ---------- chips ---------- */
482	$("#fieldChips").innerHTML=FIELDS.map(f=>'<button type="button" class="fchip" data-f="'+esc(f)+'">'+(FICO[f]||IC.tag)+esc(f)+"</button>").join("");
483	$("#cityChips").innerHTML=CITIES.map(c=>'<button type="button" class="cchip" data-c="'+c+'">'+c+"</button>").join("")+'<button type="button" class="cchip" data-c="Other">Other</button>';
484	$("#fieldChips").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-f]");if(!b)return;F.field=F.field===b.dataset.f?"":b.dataset.f;syncChips();clearErr("wField");renderPreview();});
485	$("#cityChips").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-c]");if(!b)return;
486	 const c=b.dataset.c;
487	 if(c==="Other"){$("#cityOtherWrap").style.display="";F.city=$("#fCityOther").value.trim();}
488	 else{$("#cityOtherWrap").style.display="none";F.city=F.city===c?"":c;}
489	 syncChips();clearErr("wCity");renderPreview();});
490	$("#fCityOther").addEventListener("input",e=>{F.city=e.target.value.trim();clearErr("wCity");renderPreview();});
491	function syncChips(){
492	 document.querySelectorAll("#fieldChips .fchip").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.f===F.field));
493	 document.querySelectorAll("#cityChips .cchip").forEach(b=>{
494	   const c=b.dataset.c;
495	   b.classList.toggle("on",c==="Other"?(F.city&&!CITIES.includes(F.city)):F.city===c);});
496	}
497	$("#modeSeg").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-mode]");if(!b)return;F.mode=b.dataset.mode;
498	 document.querySelectorAll("#modeSeg button").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("on",x===b));clearErr("wMode");renderPreview();});
499	
500	/* ---------- inputs ---------- */
501	const bind=(id,key,after)=>$(id).addEventListener("input",e=>{F[key]=e.target.value;after&&after();renderPreview();});
502	bind("#fTitle","title",()=>clearErr("wTitle"));
503	bind("#fCompany","company",()=>clearErr("wCompany"));
504	bind("#fArea","area");bind("#fApply","apply",()=>urlHint("#applyHint",F.apply,"applyHint"));
505	bind("#fContact","contact");bind("#fDur","dur");bind("#fDeadline","deadline");
506	bind("#fSource","source",()=>{urlHint("#sourceHint",F.source,"sourceHint");clearErr("wSource");});
507	$("#fDesc").addEventListener("input",e=>{F.desc=e.target.value;$("#descCount").textContent=F.desc.length+" / 600";renderPreview();});
508	$("#fDeadline").min=new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
509	function urlHint(sel,val){
510	 const el=$(sel);el.classList.remove("good","bad");
511	 if(!val){el.textContent=el.dataset.orig||(el.dataset.orig=el.textContent);return;}
512	 if(/^https?:\/\/.+\..+/.test(val)){el.textContent="Link looks good.";el.classList.add("good");}
513	 else{el.textContent="Hmm — a link should start with http:// or https://";el.classList.add("bad");}
514	}
515	/* image url preview w/ debounce */
516	let imgT;$("#fImg").addEventListener("input",e=>{F.img=e.target.value.trim();clearTimeout(imgT);
517	 imgT=setTimeout(()=>{const h=$("#imgHint");h.classList.remove("good","bad");
518	  if(!F.img){imgOk=false;h.textContent=h.dataset.orig||(h.dataset.orig=h.textContent);renderPreview();return;}
519	  const t=new Image();
520	  t.onload=()=>{imgOk=true;h.textContent="Image loaded — see the preview.";h.classList.add("good");renderPreview();};
521	  t.onerror=()=>{imgOk=false;h.textContent="We couldn't load that image — we'll use a clean fallback cover instead.";h.classList.add("bad");renderPreview();};
522	  t.src=F.img;},450);
523	 renderPreview();});
524	
525	/* ---------- preview ---------- */
526	function renderPreview(){
527	 const media=(F.img&&imgOk)?'<img src="'+esc(F.img)+'" alt="">':'<div class="noimg">'+esc(initials(F.company||"InternHub"))+"</div>";
528	 const meta=[];
529	 meta.push(F.field?'<li>'+FICO[F.field]+esc(F.field)+"</li>":'<li class="ph">'+IC.tag+"Field</li>");
530	 const loc=[F.city,F.area].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
531	 meta.push(loc?'<li>'+IC.pin+esc(loc)+"</li>":'<li class="ph">'+IC.pin+"City</li>");
532	 meta.push(F.mode?'<li>'+IC.mode+esc(F.mode)+"</li>":'<li class="ph">'+IC.mode+"Work mode</li>");
533	 if(F.dur)meta.push('<li>'+IC.clock+esc(F.dur)+"</li>");
534	 const dl=F.deadline?"Closes "+new Date(F.deadline+"T00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"short"}):"Deadline —";
535	 $("#pvCard").innerHTML=
536	  '<div class="pv-media">'+media+'<span class="badge pend">Pending verification</span><span class="pv-av">'+esc(initials(F.company||"IH"))+"</span></div>"+
537	  '<div class="pv-body"><h3 class="'+(F.title?"":"ph")+'">'+esc(F.title||"Internship title")+'</h3>'+
538	  '<p class="pv-co '+(F.company?"":"ph")+'">'+esc(F.company||"Company name")+"</p>"+
539	  '<ul class="pv-meta">'+meta.join("")+"</ul></div>"+
540	  '<div class="pv-foot"><span>'+esc(dl)+'</span><span class="mono">Community suggestion</span></div>';
541	}
542	
543	/* ---------- validation ---------- */
544	function setErr(id,on){const w=$("#"+id);w.classList.toggle("err",on);if(on){w.style.animation="none";void w.offsetWidth;w.style.animation="";}}
545	function clearErr(id){$("#"+id).classList.remove("err");}
546	function validURL(v){return /^https?:\/\/.+\..+/.test(v);}
547	function validate(){
548	 const errs=[];
549	 if(!F.title.trim())errs.push("wTitle");
550	 if(!F.company.trim())errs.push("wCompany");
551	 if(!F.field)errs.push("wField");
