/* ============================================================
   SUGGEST · step cards, chips, work mode, live preview, history
   Restored from mandatory design/student_pages/suggest_internship.html
   ============================================================ */
.darkzone .orbits{position:absolute;right:8px;top:6px;width:340px;height:auto;opacity:.8;pointer-events:none}
.orbits circle,.orbits path{fill:none}
.orbits .o-ring-a{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.22);stroke-dasharray:3 7}
.orbits .o-ring-b{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.16)}
.orbits .o-sig{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.5);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-dasharray:6 8;animation:dash 16s linear infinite}
.orbits .o-dot{fill:#9fe8bd}
.orbits .o-dot2{fill:#9fe8bd;opacity:.7}
.orbits .o-core{fill:#dcefe2}
@keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-420}}

.suggest-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 378px;gap:22px;align-items:start;margin-top:24px}
.form-col{position:relative;min-width:0}

.fcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:20px}
.fcard+.fcard{margin-top:14px}
.fhead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
.fstep{font:600 11px var(--fm);color:var(--green-ink);background:var(--green-soft);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px}
.fhead h3{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600}
.fhead .opt{margin-left:auto;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.fgrid .field{margin-bottom:0}
.span2{grid-column:1/-1}
.fcard .field > label{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;font:600 13px var(--fs);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--ink)}
.fcard .field .input,.fcard .field .select,.fcard .field .textarea{font-family:var(--fs)}
.fcard .field .textarea{min-height:96px}
.req{color:var(--green)}
.opt-label{color:var(--mut);font-weight:500}
.count{margin-left:auto;font:500 11px var(--fm);color:var(--mut)}
.hint.good{color:var(--green-ink)}
.hint.bad{color:var(--red)}
.field.is-invalid{animation:nudge .3s var(--ease)}
.field.is-invalid .input,.field.is-invalid .textarea,.field.is-invalid .select{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--red-bg)}
@keyframes nudge{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}25%{transform:translateX(-4px)}75%{transform:translateX(4px)}}

.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);transition:.18s var(--ease)}
.fchip svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.fchip:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.fchip.is-on{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
.cchip{border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 15px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);transition:.18s var(--ease)}
.cchip:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
.cchip.is-on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
.mode-seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:12px;padding:4px}
.mode-seg button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:9px;padding:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);transition:.2s var(--ease)}
.mode-seg button svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.mode-seg button.is-on{background:var(--card);color:var(--green-ink);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}

.submit-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
.submit-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}

.done{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;background:rgba(251,252,248,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border-radius:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.35s var(--ease)}
.done.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.done-card{text-align:center;padding:30px;max-width:440px}
.done-card h3{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px}
.done-card p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px}
.done-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:22px}
.done-check{width:74px;height:74px;margin:0 auto 18px}
.done-check circle{stroke:var(--green);stroke-dasharray:166;stroke-dashoffset:166}
.done-check path{stroke:var(--green);stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:48;stroke-dashoffset:48}
.done.show .done-check circle{animation:draw .6s .1s var(--ease) forwards}
.done.show .done-check path{animation:draw .4s .6s var(--ease) forwards}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}

.pv-col{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 20px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.pv-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.pv-label .dot{width:7px;height:7px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);animation:ping 2s infinite}
.pv-card{--media-h:168px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
.pv-media{position:relative;height:168px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
.pv-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.pv-media .noimg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font:700 30px var(--fs)}
.pv-media .noimg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 10px,transparent 10px 20px)}
.pv-body{padding:22px 16px 14px}
.pv-body h3{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.pv-body h3.ph,.pv-co.ph{color:var(--dim);font-weight:500}
.pv-co{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px}
.pv-co svg{width:13px;height:13px;flex:none}
.pv-meta{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 12px;margin:10px 0 0;padding:0}
.pv-meta li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink)}
.pv-meta li.ph{color:var(--dim)}
.pv-meta svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.pv-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.pv-foot .mono{font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}

.wf{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:18px}
.wf h4{font-family:var(--fs);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px}
.wf-step{position:relative;display:flex;gap:12px;padding-bottom:18px}
.wf-step:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.wf-step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:15px;top:32px;bottom:0;width:1.5px;background:linear-gradient(var(--line2),var(--green-soft))}
.wf-step:last-child::before{display:none}
.wf-ico{flex:none;width:31px;height:31px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
.wf-ico svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.wf-step b{display:block;font-size:13px}
.wf-step span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}

.history{margin-top:34px}
.hrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 16px}
.hrow+.hrow{margin-top:10px}
.hrow.is-new{animation:rowin .45s var(--ease)}
@keyframes rowin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.h-ico{flex:none;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut);display:grid;place-items:center}
.h-ico svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.h-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.h-main b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.h-main span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.status{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 10px}
.status::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.st-pending{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut)}
.st-verified{background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink)}
.st-published{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
.st-needs{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
.st-rejected{background:var(--red-bg);color:var(--red)}
.h-empty{border:1.5px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:44px 24px;text-align:center;background:var(--green-soft)}
.h-empty .e-ico{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--card);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 14px}
.h-empty .e-ico svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.h-empty h3{font-size:16px}
.h-empty p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;max-width:380px;margin:7px auto 0}

@media (max-width:1100px){
  .suggest-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .pv-col{position:static}
}
@media (max-width:960px){
  .darkzone .orbits{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .mode-seg{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hrow{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .hrow .status{margin-left:52px}
}

function urlHint(hintEl, val, fallback) {
  hintEl.classList.remove('good','bad');

}

function setErr(id, on) {

  if (on) { void w.offsetWidth; w.classList.add('is-invalid'); }
}

  parts.push(`${items.length} published internship${items.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`);
  const cities = new Set(items.map((i) => i.city).filter(Boolean));
  parts.push(`${cities.size} ${cities.size === 1 ? 'city' : 'cities'}`);
  if (signed) parts.push(`${mine.length} suggestion${mine.length === 1 ? '':'s'} from you`);

}

  if (!F.field) errs.push('wField');
  if (!F.city) errs.push('wCity');

    UI.toast('A few required fields need attention.', 'error');

No global `[hidden]{display:none!important}`. The app patches it per-component. That's a systemic bug class (§16). The cleanest fix: add one global rule in ui.css near the reset:

```css
[hidden]{display:none !important}
```
Is `!important` justified? §16 says avoid "unnecessary !important" — here it IS necessary because component `display` rules out-specify the UA `[hidden]` rule. The HTML spec itself recommends `display:none!important` for the hidden attribute default. Adding a global rule is the right cleanup and fixes latent bugs on every page (`.nav-badge`, `.s-clear`, `.popular`, `.fbadge`, `.empty`, `.tsec` become redundant but harmless).

Risk: any element that relies on `hidden` + a display rule to stay visible? That would be a bug anyway. Let me check whether anything intentionally uses `hidden` with a display override... e.g. `.icard[hidden]`? Unlikely. And `.toast-stack` etc. Let me just add it and then grep for `[hidden]` usages in JS that pair with display rules. The patched ones all *want* display:none. So global is safe and strictly better.

Then I could remove the 6 now-redundant per-component rules (§16 cleanup). But "DO NOT destroy functional styles" — they become redundant, not harmful. Removing 6 lines is a safe cleanup. However `.tsec[hidden]{display:none}` — `.tsec{margin-bottom:28px}` doesn't set display, so `[hidden]` UA rule already worked... those rules were defensive.     source: '', apply: '', desc: '', dur: '', deadline: '', contact: '', img: '' };
  const MODE_ICONS = { 'On-site': 'building', 'Hybrid': 'users', 'Remote': 'globe' };
  const URL_RE = /^https?:\/\/.+\..+/;
  const REQUIRED = ['wTitle', 'wCompany', 'wField', 'wCity', 'wMode', 'wSource'];
  let KNOWN_CITIES = [];
  let imgOk = false;
  let signed = false;
  let mine = [];

  el.sourceHint.dataset.orig = el.sourceHint.textContent;
  el.applyHint.dataset.orig = el.applyHint.textContent;
  el.imgHint.dataset.orig = el.imgHint.textContent;
  el.deadline.min = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  /* ---------- live preview ---------- */
  function preview() {
    const media = (F.img && imgOk)
      ? `<img src="${UI.esc(F.img)}" alt="">`
      : `<div class="noimg">${UI.esc(UI.initials(F.company || 'InternHub'))}</div>`;
    const loc = [F.city, F.area].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    const meta = [
      F.field ? `<li>${UI.icon(UI.fieldIcon(F.field), 13)}${UI.esc(F.field)}</li>`
              : `<li class="ph">${UI.icon('briefcase', 13)}Field</li>`,
      loc ? `<li>${UI.icon('pin', 13)}${UI.esc(loc)}</li>`
          : `<li class="ph">${UI.icon('pin', 13)}City</li>`,
      F.workMode ? `<li>${UI.icon('globe', 13)}${UI.esc(F.workMode)}</li>`
                 : `<li class="ph">${UI.icon('globe', 13)}Work mode</li>`,
      F.dur ? `<li>${UI.icon('clock', 13)}${UI.esc(F.dur)}</li>` : ''
    ].filter(Boolean).join('');
    el.pv.innerHTML = `<div class="pv-media">${media}
        <div class="ic-badges"><span class="bdg bdg-pend">Pending verification</span></div>
        <span class="mono-av">${UI.esc(UI.initials(F.company || 'IH'))}</span></div>
      <div class="pv-body">
        <h3 class="${F.title ? '' : 'ph'}">${UI.esc(F.title || 'Internship title')}</h3>
        <p class="pv-co ${F.company ? '' : 'ph'}">${UI.icon('building', 13)}${UI.esc(F.company || 'Company name')}</p>
        <ul class="pv-meta">${meta}</ul>
      </div>
      <div class="pv-foot"><span>${UI.esc(F.deadline ? 'Closes ' + UI.fmtDate(F.deadline) : 'Deadline —')}</span>
        <span class="mono">Community suggestion</span></div>`;
  }

  /* ---------- controls from the live taxonomy ---------- */
  function buildControls(cfg) {
    el.fieldChips.innerHTML = (cfg.fields || []).map((f) =>
      `<button type="button" class="fchip" data-f="${UI.esc(f)}">${UI.icon(UI.fieldIcon(f), 14)}${UI.esc(f)}</button>`).join('');
    KNOWN_CITIES = (cfg.locations || []).slice();
    el.cityChips.innerHTML = KNOWN_CITIES.map((c) =>
      `<button type="button" class="cchip" data-c="${UI.esc(c)}">${UI.esc(c)}</button>`).join('')
      + '<button type="button" class="cchip" data-c="__other">Other</button>';
    el.modeSeg.innerHTML = (cfg.workModes || []).map((m) =>
      `<button type="button" data-m="${UI.esc(m)}">${UI.icon(MODE_ICONS[m] || 'briefcase', 14)}${UI.esc(m)}</button>`).join('');
  }

  function syncChips() {
    el.fieldChips.querySelectorAll('.fchip').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('is-on', b.dataset.f === F.field));
    const other = !!F.city && !KNOWN_CITIES.includes(F.city);
    el.cityChips.querySelectorAll('.cchip').forEach((b) => {
      b.classList.toggle('is-on', b.dataset.c === '__other' ? other : F.city === b.dataset.c);
    });
    el.modeSeg.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('is-on', b.dataset.m === F.workMode));
  }

  /* ---------- validation ---------- */
  function urlHint(node, val) {
    node.classList.remove('good', 'bad');
    if (!val) { node.textContent = node.dataset.orig; return; }
    if (URL_RE.test(val)) { node.textContent = 'Link looks good.'; node.classList.add('good'); }
    else { node.textContent = 'Hmm — a link should start with http:// or https://'; node.classList.add('bad'); }
  }
  function setErr(id) {
    const w = document.getElementById(id);
    w.classList.remove('is-invalid');
    void w.offsetWidth;
    w.classList.add('is-invalid');
  }
  function clearErr(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('is-invalid'); }
  function validate() {
    const errs = [];
    if (!F.title.trim()) errs.push('wTitle');
    if (!F.company.trim()) errs.push('wCompany');
    if (!F.field) errs.push('wField');
    if (!F.city) errs.push('wCity');
    if (!F.workMode) errs.push('wMode');
    if (!URL_RE.test(F.source.trim())) errs.push('wSource');
    if (!errs.length) return true;
    errs.forEach(setErr);
    UI.toast('A few required fields need attention.', 'error');
    document.getElementById(errs[0]).scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    return false;
  }

  /* ---------- submission history (real documents) ---------- */
  const ST = {
    pending: ['Pending review', 'st-pending'],
    approved: ['In review', 'st-pending'],
    'needs-changes': ['Needs changes', 'st-needs'],
    duplicate: ['Duplicate', 'st-rejected'],
    rejected: ['Rejected', 'st-rejected'],
    verified: ['Verified', 'st-verified']
  };
  const statusOf = (s) => (s.status === 'verified' && s.internshipId
    ? ['Published', 'st-published'] : (ST[s.status] || ST.pending));

  function renderHistory() {
    if (!mine.length) {
      el.histCount.innerHTML = signed ? ''
        : `<a href="${H('signin.html')}" style="color:var(--green)">Sign in</a> to track your submissions`;
      el.hist.innerHTML = `<div class="h-empty"><div class="e-ico">${UI.icon('send', 20)}</div>
        <h3>You haven't suggested an opportunity yet.</h3>
        <p>Sharing even one internship can help dozens of students discover a path they'd never find alone.</p></div>`;
      return;
    }
    el.histCount.textContent = `${mine.length} submission${mine.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    el.hist.innerHTML = mine.map((s) => {
      const st = statusOf(s);
      const when = s.createdAt ? UI.fmtDate(s.createdAt) : 'just now';
      return `<div class="hrow${s.fresh ? ' is-new' : ''}"><span class="h-ico">${UI.icon('send', 16)}</span>
        <div class="h-main"><b>${UI.esc(s.title || 'Untitled')}</b>
        <span>${UI.esc(s.company || '—')} · submitted ${UI.esc(when)}</span></div>
        <span class="status ${st[1]}">${st[0]}</span></div>`;
    }).join('');
    mine.forEach((s) => { s.fresh = false; });
  }

  /* ---------- intro stat line: counts that really exist ---------- */
  async function loadStats() {
    let items = [];
    try { items = (await Internships.published(200)) || []; } catch (_) { items = []; }
    const cities = new Set(items.map((i) => i.city).filter(Boolean));
    const bits = [`${items.length} published internship${items.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
      `${cities.size} ${cities.size === 1 ? 'city' : 'cities'}`];
    if (signed) bits.push(`${mine.length} suggestion${mine.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} from you`);
    el.stat.textContent = bits.join(' · ');
  }

  /* ---------- events ---------- */
  el.fieldChips.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-f]'); if (!b) return;
    F.field = F.field === b.dataset.f ? '' : b.dataset.f;
    clearErr('wField'); syncChips(); preview();
  });
  el.cityChips.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-c]'); if (!b) return;
    if (b.dataset.c === '__other') {
      el.cityOtherWrap.hidden = false;
      F.city = el.cityOther.value.trim();
      el.cityOther.focus();
    } else {
      el.cityOtherWrap.hidden = true;
      el.cityOther.value = '';
      F.city = F.city === b.dataset.c ? '' : b.dataset.c;
    }
    clearErr('wCity'); syncChips(); preview();
  });
  el.cityOther.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    F.city = e.target.value.trim(); clearErr('wCity'); preview();
  });
  el.modeSeg.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-m]'); if (!b) return;
    F.workMode = b.dataset.m; clearErr('wMode'); syncChips(); preview();
  });

  const bind = (node, key, after) => node.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    F[key] = e.target.value; if (after) after(); preview();
  });
  bind(el.title, 'title', () => clearErr('wTitle'));
  bind(el.company, 'company', () => clearErr('wCompany'));
  bind(el.area, 'area'); bind(el.dur, 'dur'); bind(el.deadline, 'deadline'); bind(el.contact, 'contact');
  bind(el.apply, 'apply', () => urlHint(el.applyHint, F.apply));
  bind(el.source, 'source', () => { urlHint(el.sourceHint, F.source); clearErr('wSource'); });
  el.desc.addEventListener('input', () => {
    F.desc = el.desc.value;
    el.descCount.textContent = `${F.desc.length} / 600`;
    preview();
  });

  let imgT;
  el.img.addEventListener('input', () => {
    F.img = el.img.value.trim();
    clearTimeout(imgT);
    imgT = setTimeout(() => {
      el.imgHint.classList.remove('good', 'bad');
      if (!F.img) { imgOk = false; el.imgHint.textContent = el.imgHint.dataset.orig; preview(); return; }
      const probe = new Image();
      probe.onload = () => {
        imgOk = true; el.imgHint.textContent = 'Image loaded — see the preview.';
        el.imgHint.classList.add('good'); preview();
      };
      probe.onerror = () => {
        imgOk = false; el.imgHint.textContent = "We couldn't load that image — we'll use a clean fallback cover instead.";
        el.imgHint.classList.add('bad'); preview();
      };
      probe.src = F.img;
    }, 450);
    preview();
  });

  function resetForm() {
    Object.keys(F).forEach((k) => { F[k] = ''; });
    imgOk = false;
    [el.title, el.company, el.area, el.source, el.apply, el.desc, el.contact, el.img, el.cityOther]
      .forEach((n) => { n.value = ''; });
    el.dur.value = ''; el.deadline.value = '';
    el.descCount.textContent = '0 / 600';
    el.cityOtherWrap.hidden = true;
    [el.sourceHint, el.applyHint, el.imgHint].forEach((n) => {
      n.textContent = n.dataset.orig; n.classList.remove('good', 'bad');
    });
    REQUIRED.forEach(clearErr);
    syncChips(); preview();
  }

  el.form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!validate()) return;
    el.btn.classList.add('is-loading'); el.btn.disabled = true;
    const contact = F.contact.trim();
    const isMail = contact.includes('@');
    const payload = {
      title: F.title.trim(), company: F.company.trim(), field: F.field, city: F.city,
      area: F.area.trim(), workMode: F.workMode, sourceUrl: F.source.trim(),
      applicationUrl: F.apply.trim(), notes: F.desc.trim(), duration: F.dur,
      deadline: F.deadline ? new Date(F.deadline + 'T00:00').toISOString() : '',
      image: F.img.trim(),
      contactEmail: isMail ? contact : '', contactPhone: isMail ? '' : contact
    };
    const res = await Suggestions.submit(payload);
    el.btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); el.btn.disabled = false;
    if (!res.ok) { UI.toast("We couldn't send that. Please try again.", 'error'); return; }
    mine.unshift({ title: payload.title, company: payload.company, status: 'pending', createdAt: new Date(), fresh: true });
    renderHistory();
    el.done.classList.add('show');
  });

  el.again.addEventListener('click', () => {
    el.done.classList.remove('show');
    resetForm();
    el.formCol.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  });

  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
  preview();
  try { await Auth.ready; } catch (_) {}
  signed = !!Auth.profile;
  let cfg = {};
  try { cfg = (await Settings.load()) || {}; } catch (_) {}
  buildControls(cfg);
  syncChips();
  preview();
  if (signed) { try { mine = await Suggestions.mine(); } catch (_) { mine = []; } }
  renderHistory();
  loadStats();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

441	$("#prefLocs").innerHTML=LOCATIONS.map(l=>'<button type="button" class="pref-chip'+(prefs.locs.has(l)?" on":"")+'" data-l="'+l+'">'+l+"</button>").join("");
442	$("#prefFields").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-f]");if(!b)return;const f=b.dataset.f;prefs.fields.has(f)?prefs.fields.delete(f):prefs.fields.add(f);b.classList.toggle("on");});
443	$("#prefLocs").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-l]");if(!b)return;const l=b.dataset.l;prefs.locs.has(l)?prefs.locs.delete(l):prefs.locs.add(l);b.classList.toggle("on");});
444	$("#prefMode").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-mode]");if(!b)return;prefs.mode=b.dataset.mode;document.querySelectorAll("#prefMode button").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("on",x===b));});

450	document.querySelectorAll("[data-toast]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>{closeModal();toast(b.dataset.toast);}));

466	$("#deleteAccBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{openModal("Delete account","This action cannot be undone. All your data, saved internships, and preferences will be permanently removed.","Delete my account",()=>{closeModal();toast("Account deletion requested. You'll receive a confirmation email.");});});

470	let modalConfirm=null;
471	function openModal(title,desc,confirm,cb){$("#mTitle").textContent=title;$("#mDesc").textContent=desc;$("#mConfirm").textContent=confirm;modalConfirm=cb;$("#modal").classList.add("open");$("#modal").setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");document.body.style.overflow="hidden";}
472	function closeModal(){$("#modal").classList.remove("open");$("#modal").setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");document.body.style.overflow="";}
473	document.querySelectorAll("[data-close]").forEach(el=>el.addEventListener("click",closeModal));

Now read the current deliverable account.html (306 lines).

Note: the spec's account page HAS preferences chips (fields/locations/work mode), notifications switches, bio, phone, institution, course, level. 

Important conflict: the user earlier said "create test student on simplified form" and standing feedback "we are making these things too complicated" — but that applied to the *register* form, not the account page. §06/§11 says restore. Hmm, but the earlier register simplification was the user's explicit instruction for registration. The account page is different. I'll restore per spec but stay tasteful.

Also note §18: "Application status — Updates when companies respond to your applications" — there's no application tracking feature (InternHub directs to company sites). Offering that switch would promise a non-existent feature. Similarly "Export my data" and "Delete account" have no backend. The spec has them as demo toasts ("coming soon"). Real app: 
- Delete account: no backend implementation → must not fake it. Options: implement it? Deleting a user's own account + profile is feasible client-side: `Auth.profile` → delete `users/{uid}` doc + `auth.currentUser.delete()` (works with password auth). That's real functionality but risky/irreversible. §12 forbids inventing; §11 forbids removing. Hmm.
- The spec's demo behaviors are placeholders for real features. The correct implementation is: wire what the backend supports, and for what it doesn't, be honest (a disabled/“not available yet” state or an honest message), never a fake success.

Let me first read the current account.html to see what's implemented, then decide.

#### Thinking

Now I have the design system. Let me now write the plan for account.html restoration.

Spec structure (mapped to app tokens/components):
1. `.profile-header`: avatar 88px green circle with initials; h1 name; p "…student · Institution"; `.mono` pill "Member since <Month Year>".
2. `.pcard` (Personal information) with `.pcard-head` (h3 + eyebrow "Your details"), `#personalForm`, `.field-grid` auto-fit minmax(240px,1fr): Full name, Email (disabled + hint "Email cannot be changed"), Phone, Institution, Course/field, Level select, Bio textarea full-width. `.actions`: Save changes (primary) + Reset (ghost).
3. `.pcard` (Internship preferences) eyebrow "Help us match you better": Preferred fields `.pref-chips` multi, Preferred locations multi, Preferred work mode `.seg` single-select 3-col with icons. Actions: Save preferences.
4. `.pcard` (Notifications) eyebrow "Stay updated": `.switch-group` of 4 boxed switches (New internships, Closing soon, Application status, Weekly digest). Actions: Save notifications.
5. `.pcard` (Account) eyebrow "Security & data": `.account-actions`: Change password (ghost), Export my data (ghost), Delete account (danger).
6. Modal + toast — app already has `UI.confirm` + `UI.toast`. Keep real ones.

Current deliverable's real functionality that MUST be preserved (§14: KEEP Profiles, Account functionality; and my own prior decisions):
- Auth.updateProfile for profile fields (displayName, username, phone, institution, field, course, academicLevel) + preferences + notifications
- Auth.changePassword with re-auth credential (real) — spec's "Change password" opens a modal saying "you'll receive an email" (demo). The real one needs current+new+confirm inputs. Decision: keep the real password-change form. But the spec's Account card only has buttons. Hmm. §12 says don't remove features; §14 says keep Account functionality. The spec's modal is a demo placeholder. The right resolution (like Suggest): keep the real functionality, and place it in the Account card as an inline panel/modal that the "Change password" button opens. I'll use a real modal (the app's `UI` modal helper? Let me check what UI exposes — `UI.confirm`, and maybe `UI.modal`). Let me check ui.js for a modal helper.

Also current account.html has "Change email" form (real Auth.changeEmail) — spec has no email change (email is disabled: "Email cannot be changed"). Per the spec, email cannot be changed. Per §12 "DO NOT REMOVE FEATURES"? Wait — that's about not removing spec features. The current implementation has an extra feature (change email) not in the spec. Hmm, §07 said "DO NOT INVENT THEM" about filters not in the mandatory design. But change-email is real, working functionality already shipped, and §14 says preserve "Account functionality". The spec says email cannot be changed.

This is a genuine tension. §02 priority: 1. mandatory design, 2. existing working functionality. If the design says email is disabled, I should show it disabled — that's the visible design. But removing the working "change email" would be removing existing functionality that the user might want... Actually the directive is explicit that the design wins, but also "I am the person who decides what gets removed" and "DO NOT assume a feature was intentionally removed."

Best resolution: restore the spec's look (email input disabled in Personal information with the hint) and keep the change-email capability in the Account card's security actions — the spec's Account card lists "Change password", "Export my data", "Delete account". Adding "Change email" would be inventing... but it's preserving existing functionality, which is allowed under §02 priority 2 and §14 "KEEP … Account functionality" (the current app has Change email in a Security tab; if I delete the tabs and drop it, that's removing existing working functionality).

I'll keep it: in the Account card, a modal opened by a "Change email" ghost button. Hmm, that's a 4th button vs spec's 3. Alternatively put "Change email" next to the disabled email hint. I think grouping it under Account actions is cleaner and honest. I'll note the divergence in the report.

Actually — wait. Let me reconsider. Minimizing invention: the spec's `.account-actions` has 3 buttons. 211	  }

213	  async function init() {
214	    const mode = document.body.dataset.app;
215	    if (!mode) return; // landing/auth pages manage their own chrome
216	    await Auth.ready;
217	
218	    const view = document.getElementById('view');
219	    const sideBlocks = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-side]')];
220	    const active = document.body.dataset.nav || '';
221	    document.body.innerHTML = mode === 'admin' ? buildAdmin(active) : buildStudent(active);
222	    const slot = document.getElementById('view-slot');
223	    // content injected by page script into #view later is fine — the node survives the rebuild
224	    if (view && view.children.length) slot.appendChild(view);
225	    const extra = document.getElementById('sidenav-extra');
226	    if (extra) sideBlocks.forEach((el) => extra.appendChild(el));

228	    wire(mode);

230	    if (mode === 'student' && Auth.profile) {
231	      Notifications.load().then(() => NotifyUI.init());

233	      NotifyUI.updateBadge();
234	      if (typeof Saved !== 'undefined') {
235	        Saved.load().then(syncSavedBadge);
236	        document.addEventListener('saved:changed', syncSavedBadge);
237	      }
238	    }
239	    initFooterAndReveals();
240	    window.__shellReady = true;
241	    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shell:ready'));
242	  }
243	
244	  // Pages using the shared frame run their logic after the shell has
245	  // rebuilt the DOM. Landing/auth pages (no data-app) run immediately.
246	  window.onReady = function (cb) {
247	    if (!document.body.dataset.app || window.__shellReady) cb();
248	    else document.addEventListener('shell:ready', cb, { once: true });
249	  };
250	
251	  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
252	  return { init, STUDENT_NAV, ADMIN_NAV, syncSavedBadge, markNav };
253	})();

Every opportunity we know about is waiting for you in Browse.";$("#emptyAction").textContent="Browse all internships";$("#emptyAction").dataset.act="browse";}

514	function renderChips(){
515	 const c=[];state.fields.forEach(f=>c.push(["field",f,f]));state.modes.forEach(m=>c.push(["mode",m,m]));
516	 if(state.city!=="All cities")c.push(["city",state.city,state.city]);
517	 if(state.dl!=="any")c.push(["dl",state.dl,"≤ "+state.dl+" days"]);
518	 if(state.verOnly)c.push(["ver","1","Verified"]);
519	 $("#activeChips").innerHTML=c.map(x=>'<span class="achip">'+esc(x[2])+'<button data-rm="'+x[0]+":"+esc(x[1])+'" aria-label="Remove">'+IC.x+"</button></span>").join("")+(c.length>1?'<span class="achip" style="background:transparent">Clear all</span>':"");
520	 const n=afCount(),fb=$("#fBadge");fb.textContent=n;fb.hidden=!n;
521	}
522	function renderFieldList(){
523	 $("#fieldList").innerHTML=FIELDS.map(f=>'<label class="cbx"><input type="checkbox" value="'+esc(f)+'" '+(state.fields.has(f)?"checked":"")+'><span class="box"></span><span class="txt">'+esc(f)+'</span><span class="cnt">'+DATA.filter(d=>d.f===f).length+"</span></label>").join("");
524	}
525	function updateSavedUI(){const b=$("#savedBadge");b.textContent=state.saved.size;b.hidden=!state.saved.size;}
526	
527	/* =============== SKELETONS =============== */
528	function skeletons(){
529	 const sk='<div class="sk-card"><div class="sk sk-img"></div><div class="sk-body"><div class="sk" style="height:14px;width:80%"></div><div class="sk" style="height:11px;width:55%"></div><div class="sk" style="height:11px;width:70%"></div></div></div>';
530	 ["#gridJust","#gridToday"].forEach(g=>{$(g).innerHTML=Array(4).fill(sk).join("");});
531	 $("#secJust").hidden=false;$("#secToday").hidden=false;$("#secYday").hidden=true;
532	}
533	
534	/* =============== SAVE / MODAL / TOAST =============== */
535	let toastT;function toast(m){const t=$("#toast");t.textContent=m;t.classList.add("show");clearTimeout(toastT);toastT=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("show"),2300);}
536	function toggleSave(id){
537	 const on=!state.saved.has(id);on?state.saved.add(id):state.saved.delete(id);
538	 document.querySelectorAll('[data-save="'+id+'"]').forEach(b=>{b.classList.toggle("on",on);b.classList.remove("pop");void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add("pop");});
539	 updateSavedUI();if(modalId===id)syncMSave();
540	 toast(on?"Saved — it stays saved after it leaves What's New.":"Removed from saved.");
541	}
542	let modalId=null;
543	function openModal(id){const it=DATA.find(d=>d.id===id);if(!it)return;modalId=id;
544	 $("#mMedia").innerHTML=mediaHTML(it);bindImgs($("#mMedia"));
545	 $("#mBadges").innerHTML='<span class="badge new"><i></i>New</span>'+(it.v?'<span class="badge ver">Verified</span>':'<span class="badge pend">Pending verification</span>')+(deadlineTxt(it)?'<span class="badge soon">'+deadlineTxt(it)[0]+"</span>":"");
546	 $("#mTitle").textContent=it.t;
547	 $("#mCompany").innerHTML=esc(it.co)+" · "+esc(it.city)+(it.v?' <span class="vcheck">'+IC.check+"</span>":"");
548	 $("#mMeta").innerHTML="<li>"+IC.tag+esc(it.f)+"</li><li>"+IC.clock+it.mo+" months</li><li>"+IC.mode+esc(it.mode)+"</li><li>"+IC.pin+esc(it.city)+"</li><li>"+IC.spark+addedLabel(it.h)+"</li>";
549	 $("#mDesc").textContent=it.co+" is looking for a "+it.t+" in "+it.city+". Added "+it.h+" hours ago — it will stay in What's New for "+leavesLeft(it)+" more hours, then remain available in Browse Internships.";
550	 syncMSave();$("#modal").classList.add("open");$("#modal").setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");document.body.style.overflow="hidden";}
551	function closeModal(){$("#modal").classList.remove("open");$("#modal").setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");document.body.style.overflow="";}
552	function syncMSave(){$("#mSave").textContent=state.saved.has(modalId)?"Saved ✓":"Save for later";}
553	
554	/* =============== EVENTS =============== */
555	$("#q").addEventListener("input",e=>{state.q=e.target.value.trim();$("#qClear").hidden=!state.q;renderSections();});
556	$("#qClear").addEventListener("click",()=>{state.q="";$("#q").value="";$("#qClear").hidden=true;renderSections();$("#q").focus();});
557	$("#fieldList").addEventListener("change",e=>{e.target.checked?state.fields.add(e.target.value):state.fields.delete(e.target.value);renderSections();});
558	$("#citySel").innerHTML=CITIES.map(c=>"<option>"+c+"</option>").join("");
559	$("#citySel").addEventListener("change",e=>{state.city=e.target.value;renderSections();});
560	$("#modeRow").addEventListener("click",e=>{const p=e.target.closest(".pill");if(!p)return;const m=p.dataset.mode;state.modes.has(m)?state.modes.delete(m):state.modes.add(m);p.classList.toggle("on");renderSections();});
561	$("#dlSel").addEventListener("change",e=>{state.dl=e.target.value;renderSections();});
562	$("#verOnly").addEventListener("change",e=>{state.verOnly=e.target.checked;renderSections();});
563	function resetFilters(){state.fields.clear();state.modes.clear();state.city="All cities";state.dl="any";state.verOnly=false;
564	 $("#citySel").value="All cities";$("#dlSel").value="any";$("#verOnly").checked=false;
565	 document.querySelectorAll("#modeRow .pill").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("on"));
566	 renderFieldList();renderSections();}
567	$("#resetFilters").addEventListener("click",resetFilters);
568	$("#activeChips").addEventListener("click",e=>{
569	 const rm=e.target.closest("[data-rm]");
570	 if(rm){const[k,v]=rm.dataset.rm.split(":");
571	  if(k==="field")state.fields.delete(v);
572	  if(k==="mode"){state.modes.delete(v);document.querySelectorAll("#modeRow .pill").forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle("on",state.modes.has(p.dataset.mode)));}
573	  if(k==="city"){state.city="All cities";$("#citySel").value="All cities";}
574	  if(k==="dl"){state.dl="any";$("#dlSel").value="any";}
575	  if(k==="ver"){state.verOnly=false;$("#verOnly").checked=false;}
576	  renderFieldList();renderSections();return;}
577	 if(e.target.textContent==="Clear all")resetFilters();});
578	$("#emptyAction").addEventListener("click",e=>{
579	 if(e.target.dataset.act==="clear"){resetFilters();state.q="";$("#q").value="";$("#qClear").hidden=true;renderSections();}
580	 else toast("Browse prototype — separate file.");});
581	$("#frailOpen").addEventListener("click",()=>document.body.classList.add("frail-open"));
582	$("#frailClose").addEventListener("click",()=>document.body.classList.remove("frail-open"));
583	$("#frailApply").addEventListener("click",()=>document.body.classList.remove("frail-open"));
584	/* nav / menus */
585	const mqMob=matchMedia("(max-width:960px)");
586	$("#sbToggle").addEventListener("click",()=>{mqMob.matches?document.body.classList.toggle("sb-open"):document.body.classList.toggle("sb-collapsed");});
587	$("#backdrop").addEventListener("click",()=>document.body.classList.remove("sb-open","frail-open"));
588	document.querySelectorAll("[data-toast]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>{closeMenus();toast(b.dataset.toast);}));
589	function closeMenus(){document.querySelectorAll(".menu").forEach(m=>m.classList.remove("open"));}
590	$("#avBtn").addEventListener("click",e=>{e.stopPropagation();const m=$("#avMenu"),o=m.classList.contains("open");closeMenus();m.classList.toggle("open",!o);});
591	document.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(!e.target.closest(".avatar-wrap"))closeMenus();});
592	/* cards */
593	document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
594	 const s=e.target.closest("[data-save]");if(s){toggleSave(+s.dataset.save);return;}
595	 const d=e.target.closest("[data-details]");if(d)openModal(+d.dataset.details);});
596	document.querySelectorAll("[data-close]").forEach(el=>el.addEventListener("click",closeModal));
597	$("#mSave").addEventListener("click",()=>toggleSave(modalId));
598	$("#mApply").addEventListener("click",()=>toast("Demo — this would open the company's original listing."));
599	document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape"){closeModal();closeMenus();document.body.classList.remove("sb-open","frail-open");}});
600	
601	/* =============== INIT =============== */
602	skeletons();renderFieldList();updateSavedUI();
603	setTimeout(renderSections,700);
604	</script>
605	</body>
606	</html>

  function rows(items) {
    if (!items.length) return '';
    return `<div class="irow-list">${items.map(row).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function empty(message = 'No internships found.', sub = '') {
    return `<div class="ic-empty"><b>${UI.esc(message)}</b>${sub ? `<span>${UI.esc(sub)}</span>` : ''}</div>`;
  }

  function error() {
    return `<div class="ic-empty ic-error"><b>Couldn't load internships</b>
      <span>There was a problem reaching the database.</span>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:14px">Retry</button></div>`;
  }

  function skeleton(n = 6) {
    let html = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) html += `<div class="icard icard-skel"><div class="ic-media"></div><div class="ic-body"><div class="skel skel-title"></div><div class="skel skel-meta"></div></div></div>`;
    return `<div class="icard-grid">${html}</div>`;
  }

  /** Dark card used by the "New this week" marquee. */
  function darkCard(item) {
    const href = detailHref(item.id);
    return `<article class="dcard">
      <div class="dc-media">${media(item)}
        <div class="dc-badges">${badges(item)}</div>
        ${saveBtn(item, 'save')}
      </div>
      <div class="dc-body">
        <h3><a href="${href}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
        <p class="dc-co">${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.city ? ' · ' + UI.esc(item.city) : ''}</p>
        <div class="dc-meta">${metaTags(item, true)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="dc-foot">
        ${deadlineLine(item)}
        <a class="btn btn-dghost btn-sm" href="${href}" data-details="${UI.esc(item.id)}">View opportunity</a>
      </div>
    </article>`;
  }

  /** Two identical halves so the translateX(-50%) loop is seamless. */
  function darkStrip(items) {
    const half = `<div class="mq-half">${items.map(darkCard).join('')}</div>`;
    return half + `<div class="mq-half dup" aria-hidden="true">${items.map(darkCard).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function marqueeEmpty(message) {
    return `<div class="mq-empty">${UI.esc(message)}</div>`;
  }

  function trim(text, n) {
    const s = String(text || '').trim();
    return s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…' : s;
  }

  /** Featured opportunity panel. */
  function featured(item) {
    const href = detailHref(item.id);
    return `<article class="feat">
      <div class="feat-media">${media(item)}</div>
      <div class="feat-body">
        <p class="eyebrow">${item.verified ? 'Featured · Verified' : 'Featured'}</p>
        <h3>${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</h3>
        <p class="feat-co">${UI.icon('building', 13)} ${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.city ? ' · ' + UI.esc(item.city) : ''}${item.verified ? `<span class="vcheck">${UI.icon('check', 9)}</span>` : ''}</p>

/* ============================================================
   DETAIL MODAL · quick view for an internship card.
   Pages call DetailModal.init(() => items). Card controls stay
   real links to the full listing, so pages that never init the
   modal (or ids that aren't loaded) simply navigate.
   ============================================================ */

const DetailModal = (() => {
  let backdrop = null;
  let getItems = () => [];
  let currentId = null;
  let lastFocus = null;
  let wired = false;

  const q = (sel) => (backdrop ? backdrop.querySelector(sel) : null);

  function paintSave(on) {
    const btn = q('#dmSave');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.textContent = on ? 'Saved ✓' : 'Save for later';
    btn.classList.toggle('btn-primary', on);
    btn.classList.toggle('btn-ghost', !on);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
  }

  function build() {
    if (backdrop) return backdrop;
    backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop';
    backdrop.innerHTML = `
      <div class="modal modal-lg" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dmTitle">
        <button type="button" class="dm-x" data-dm-close aria-label="Close">${UI.icon('x', 16)}</button>
        <div class="dm-media" id="dmMedia"></div>
        <div class="dm-body">
          <div class="dm-badges" id="dmBadges"></div>
          <h3 class="modal-title" id="dmTitle"></h3>
          <p class="dm-company" id="dmCompany"></p>
          <div class="dm-meta" id="dmMeta"></div>
          <p class="dm-desc" id="dmDesc"></p>
          <p class="dm-note">InternHub is a discovery directory — applications happen on the company's own website.</p>
          <div class="modal-actions dm-actions">
            <a class="dm-full" id="dmFull" href="#">Full listing ${UI.icon('arrow-right', 13)}</a>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="dmSave" aria-pressed="false">Save for later</button>
            <a class="btn btn-primary" id="dmApply" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Apply</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === backdrop || e.target.closest('[data-dm-close]')) close();
    });

    backdrop.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('#dmSave') || !currentId) return;
      const btn = q('#dmSave');
      btn.disabled = true;
      const res = await Saved.toggle(currentId);
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (!res.ok) { UI.toast('Could not update your saved list', 'error'); return; }
      const on = res.state === 'saved';
      paintSave(on);
      document.querySelectorAll(`[data-save="${currentId}"]`).forEach((b) => {
        b.classList.toggle('on', on);
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', on ? 'Remove from saved' : 'Save internship');
        b.innerHTML = UI.icon('bookmark', 15, on);
        b.classList.remove('pop');
        void b.offsetWidth;
        b.classList.add('pop');
      });
      UI.toast(on ? "Saved — apply later from the company's site." : 'Removed from saved');
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('saved:changed', { detail: { id: currentId, on } }));
    });

backdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const apply = e.target.closest('#dmApply');
      if (apply && !apply.hidden && currentId) Internships.bump(currentId, 'clicks');
    });
    return backdrop;
  }

  function paintMedia(item) {
    const box = q('#dmMedia');
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="ic-fallback">${UI.esc(UI.initials(item.company || 'InternHub'))}</div>`;
    const url = UI.safeUrl(item.image);
    if (!url) return;
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = url;
    img.alt = '';
    img.loading = 'lazy';
    img.addEventListener('error', () => img.remove());
    box.appendChild(img);
  }

  function paintMeta(item) {
    const dl = UI.deadlineInfo(item);
    const bits = [
      item.field ? UI.icon('briefcase', 12) + UI.esc(item.field) : '',
      item.duration ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(item.duration) : '',
      item.workMode ? UI.icon('globe', 12) + UI.esc(item.workMode) : '',
      item.stipend ? UI.icon('sparkles', 12) + UI.esc(item.stipend) : '',
      dl.label ? UI.icon('clock', 12) + UI.esc(dl.label) : ''
    ].filter(Boolean);
    q('#dmMeta').innerHTML = bits.map((b) => `<span>${b}</span>`).join('');
  }

  function open(id) {
    const item = getItems().find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
    if (!item) return;
    currentId = item.id;
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    build();

    paintMedia(item);
    q('#dmBadges').innerHTML = Rows.badges(item);
    q('#dmTitle').textContent = item.title || 'Untitled role';
    q('#dmCompany').textContent = [item.company, item.city].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—';
    paintMeta(item);

    const desc = q('#dmDesc');
    desc.textContent = item.description || '';
    desc.hidden = !item.description;

    const full = q('#dmFull');
    const apply = q('#dmApply');
    const ext = UI.safeUrl(item.applicationUrl);
    full.href = Rows.detailHref(item.id);
    full.classList.toggle('btn', !ext);
    full.classList.toggle('btn-primary', !ext);
    apply.href = ext || '#';
    apply.hidden = !ext;

    const save = q('#dmSave');
    save.hidden = !Auth.profile;
    paintSave(Saved.has(item.id));

    backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    q('[data-dm-close]')?.focus();
  }

  function close() {
    if (!backdrop || !backdrop.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    currentId = null;
    if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
  }

  function init(itemsGetter) {
    if (typeof itemsGetter === 'function') getItems = itemsGetter;
    if (wired) return;
    wired = true;
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const trigger = e.target.closest('[data-details]');
      if (!trigger) return;
      const known = getItems().some((x) => String(x.id) === String(trigger.dataset.details));
      if (!known) return;                      // nothing to show — follow the link
      e.preventDefault();
      open(trigger.dataset.details);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); });
  }

  return { init, open, close };
})();

.ic-meta i svg{width:11px;height:11px}
.ic-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:11px 15px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.ic-dead{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}

/* ============================================================
   WHAT'S NEW · intro radar, stat line, time buckets, freshness
   Restored from mandatory design/student_pages/what's_new.html
   ============================================================ */
.darkzone .eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.live-dot{width:7px;height:7px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:#9fe8bd;animation:ping 2.2s infinite}
@keyframes ping{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(159,232,189,.45)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(159,232,189,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(159,232,189,0)}}
.stat-line{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;font:500 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8fc7a6}
.stat-line .pill48{border:1px solid rgba(234,255,243,.3);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#d7f2e2}

/* The radar must be painted from CSS: ui.css resets inline SVG strokes/fills. */
.darkzone .radar{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;width:330px;height:auto;opacity:.9;pointer-events:none}
.radar circle,.radar path{fill:none}
.radar .ring-a{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.28)}
.radar .ring-b{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.2)}
.radar .ring-c{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.13)}
.radar .core{fill:#dcefe2;stroke:none}
.radar .blip{fill:#9fe8bd;stroke:none}
.radar .sweep{transform-origin:230px 110px;animation:rot 9s linear infinite}
.radar .sweep path{stroke:rgba(159,232,189,.55);stroke-width:1.6}
.radar .pulse{stroke:rgba(159,232,189,.5);transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:pulseR 4.5s ease-out infinite}
.radar .pulse.p2{stroke:rgba(159,232,189,.35);animation-delay:2.2s}
@keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes pulseR{0%{transform:scale(.15);opacity:.8}100%{transform:scale(3.1);opacity:0}}

.added svg{width:12px;height:12px;flex:none}
.leaves{font:500 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}
.leaves.late{color:var(--amber)}

body[data-nav="whats-new"] .bdg-new{gap:6px}
body[data-nav="whats-new"] .bdg-new::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);animation:ping 2.2s infinite}
body[data-nav="whats-new"] .cards .icard{animation:cardin .5s var(--ease) both}
@keyframes cardin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}}

<script src="../assets/js/lib/notify-ui.js"></script>
<script src="../assets/js/lib/shell.js"></script>
<script>
window.onReady(function () {
  Rows.initSaveHandling();
  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
  const el = {
    body: document.getElementById('view'),
    stat: $('#statCount'), pill: $('#windowPill'),
    q: $('#q'), qClear: $('#qClear'), layout: $('#browseLayout'),
    fieldSec: $('#fieldSec'), fieldList: $('#fieldList'),
    citySec: $('#citySec'), citySel: $('#citySel'),
    modeSec: $('#modeSec'), modeRow: $('#modeRow'),
    dlSel: $('#dlSel'), verOnly: $('#verOnly'),
    openBtn: $('#frailOpen'), closeBtn: $('#frailClose'), scrim: $('#frailScrim'),
    apply: $('#frailApply'), reset: $('#resetFilters'),
    count: $('#countLabel'), chips: $('#activeChips'), fBadge: $('#fBadge'),
    secJust: $('#secJust'), gridJust: $('#gridJust'),
    secToday: $('#secToday'), gridToday: $('#gridToday'),
    secYday: $('#secYday'), gridYday: $('#gridYday'),
    empty: $('#emptyBox'), emptyTitle: $('#emptyTitle'), emptyText: $('#emptyText'), emptyAction: $('#emptyAction')
  };

  const ALL_CITIES = 'All cities';
  const WINDOW_H = Math.round(UI.NEW_WINDOW_MS / 3600000);
  let FRESH = [];
  const state = { q: '', fields: new Set(), city: ALL_CITIES, modes: new Set(), dl: 'any', verOnly: false };
  DetailModal.init(() => FRESH);

  const hoursAgo = (it) => {
    const t = UI.toDate(it.publishedAt || it.createdAt);
    return t ? Math.max(0, (Date.now() - t.getTime()) / 3600000) : 0;
  };
  const addedLabel = (h) => (h < 1 ? 'Added just now' : h < 24 ? `Added ${Math.floor(h)}h ago` : 'Added yesterday');
  const leavesLeft = (h) => Math.max(0, Math.ceil(WINDOW_H - h));
  const closingLabel = (it) => {
    const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
    if (d === null || d < 0) return null;
    if (d <= 1) return 'Closes tomorrow';
    if (d <= 7) return `Closes in ${d} days`;
    return null;
  };
  const vocab = (key) => [...new Set(FRESH.map((i) => i[key]).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

  function filtered() {
    const q = state.q.toLowerCase();
    return FRESH.filter((it) => {
      if (state.fields.size && !state.fields.has(it.field)) return false;
      if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES && it.city !== state.city) return false;
      if (state.modes.size && !state.modes.has(it.workMode)) return false;
      if (state.verOnly && !it.verified) return false;
      if (state.dl !== 'any') {
        const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline);
        if (!(d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= +state.dl)) return false;
      }
      if (q && ![it.title, it.company, it.city, it.field, it.workMode].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      return true;
    }).sort((a, b) => hoursAgo(a) - hoursAgo(b));
  }

  function afCount() {
    return state.fields.size + state.modes.size
      + (state.city !== ALL_CITIES ? 1 : 0)
      + (state.dl !== 'any' ? 1 : 0)
      + (state.verOnly ? 1 : 0);
  }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

  function wnCard(item, i) {
    const href = Rows.detailHref(item.id);
    const h = hoursAgo(item);
    const left = leavesLeft(h);
    return `<article class="icard" style="animation-delay:${Math.min(i * 45, 360)}ms">
      <div class="ic-media">${Rows.media(item)}
        <div class="ic-badges">${Rows.badges(item, closingLabel(item))}</div>
        ${Rows.saveBtn(item, 'save')}
      </div>
      <span class="mono-av">${UI.esc(UI.initials(item.company || 'InternHub'))}</span>
      <div class="ic-body">
        <h3 class="ic-title"><a href="${href}">${UI.esc(item.title || 'Untitled role')}</a></h3>
        <p class="ic-co">${UI.icon('building', 13)} ${UI.esc(item.company || '—')}${item.verified ? `<span class="vcheck">${UI.icon('check', 9)}</span>` : ''}</p>
        <div class="ic-meta">${Rows.metaTags(item, true)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ic-foot">
        <div class="fresh">
          <span class="added"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.4 7.6L22 12l-7.6 2.4L12 22l-2.4-7.6L2 12l7.6-2.4z"/></svg>${addedLabel(h)}</span>
          <span class="leaves${left <= 12 ? ' late' : ''}">Leaves in ${left}h</span>
        </div>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" href="${href}" data-details="${UI.esc(item.id)}">Details</a>
      </div>
    </article>`;
  }

  function checkRow(value, label, count, on) {
    return `<label class="cbx"><input type="checkbox" value="${UI.esc(value)}"${on ? ' checked' : ''}>`
      + `<span class="box"></span><span class="txt">${UI.esc(label)}</span><span class="cnt">${count}</span></label>`;
  }

  function renderFacets() {
    const fields = vocab('field');
    el.fieldSec.hidden = !fields.length;
    el.fieldList.innerHTML = fields.map((f) =>
      checkRow(f, f, FRESH.filter((d) => d.field === f).length, state.fields.has(f))).join('');

    const cities = vocab('city');
    el.citySec.hidden = !cities.length;
    el.citySel.innerHTML = [ALL_CITIES, ...cities].map((c) =>
      `<option value="${UI.esc(c)}"${c === state.city ? ' selected' : ''}>${UI.esc(c)}</option>`).join('');

    const modes = vocab('workMode');
    el.modeSec.hidden = !modes.length;
    el.modeRow.innerHTML = modes.map((m) =>
      `<button type="button" class="pill${state.modes.has(m) ? ' is-on' : ''}" data-mode="${UI.esc(m)}">${UI.esc(m)}</button>`).join('');
  }

  function renderChips() {
    const c = [];
    state.fields.forEach((f) => c.push(['field', f, f]));
    state.modes.forEach((m) => c.push(['mode', m, m]));
    if (state.city !== ALL_CITIES) c.push(['city', state.city, state.city]);
    if (state.dl !== 'any') c.push(['dl', state.dl, `≤ ${state.dl} days`]);
    if (state.verOnly) c.push(['ver', '1', 'Verified']);
    el.chips.innerHTML = c.map((x) => `<span class="achip">${UI.esc(x[2])}`
      + `<button type="button" data-rm="${x[0]}:${UI.esc(x[1])}" aria-label="Remove filter">${UI.icon('x', 10)}</button></span>`).join('')
      + (c.length > 1 ? '<span class="achip is-clear" data-rm="*">Clear all</span>' : '');
    const n = afCount();
    el.fBadge.textContent = n;
    el.fBadge.hidden = !n;
  }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

  function renderSections() {
    const L = filtered();
    const put = (sec, grid, list) => {
      sec.hidden = !list.length;
      grid.innerHTML = list.map(wnCard).join('');
    };
    put(el.secJust, el.gridJust, L.filter((it) => hoursAgo(it) < 6));
    put(el.secToday, el.gridToday, L.filter((it) => { const h = hoursAgo(it); return h >= 6 && h < 24; }));
    put(el.secYday, el.gridYday, L.filter((it) => hoursAgo(it) >= 24));

    const none = !L.length;
    el.empty.hidden = !none;
    if (none) {
      if (afCount() || state.q) {
        el.emptyTitle.textContent = 'Nothing new matches your filters';
        el.emptyText.textContent = `No internship added in the last ${WINDOW_H} hours fits this combination. Loosen a filter — or browse everything we know about.`;
        el.emptyAction.textContent = 'Clear all filters';
        el.emptyAction.dataset.act = 'clear';
      } else {
        el.emptyTitle.textContent = 'No new opportunities right now';
        el.emptyText.textContent = `There aren't any internships newly added within the last ${WINDOW_H} hours. Every opportunity we know about is waiting for you in Browse.`;
        el.emptyAction.textContent = 'Browse all internships';
        el.emptyAction.dataset.act = 'browse';
      }
    }

    el.count.textContent = `${L.length} of ${FRESH.length} fresh opportunities shown`;
    el.stat.textContent = `${FRESH.length} new ${FRESH.length === 1 ? 'opportunity' : 'opportunities'}`;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-new-badge]').forEach((b) => {
      b.hidden = !FRESH.length;
      b.textContent = FRESH.length;
    });
    el.apply.textContent = `Show ${L.length}${L.length === 1 ? ' result' : ' results'}`;
    renderChips();
  }

  function showSkeletons() {
    const cells = Rows.skeletonCells(4);
    el.gridJust.innerHTML = cells;
    el.gridToday.innerHTML = cells;
    el.secJust.hidden = false;
    el.secToday.hidden = false;
    el.secYday.hidden = true;
  }

  function openDrawer() {
    el.layout.classList.add('filters-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeDrawer() {
    el.layout.classList.remove('filters-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }
});

    state.dl = 'any';
    state.verOnly = false;
    el.dlSel.value = 'any';
    el.verOnly.checked = false;
    renderFacets();
    renderSections();
  }

  el.q.addEventListener('input', () => {
    state.q = el.q.value.trim();
    el.qClear.hidden = !state.q;
    renderSections();
  });

  el.qClear.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.q = '';
    el.q.value = '';
    el.qClear.hidden = true;
    renderSections();
    el.q.focus();
  });

  el.fieldList.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    if (e.target.checked) state.fields.add(e.target.value);
    else state.fields.delete(e.target.value);
    renderSections();
  });

  el.citySel.addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.city = e.target.value; renderSections(); });
  el.dlSel.addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.dl = e.target.value; renderSections(); });
  el.verOnly.addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.verOnly = e.target.checked; renderSections(); });
  el.reset.addEventListener('click', resetFilters);

  el.modeRow.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const p = e.target.closest('.pill');
    if (!p) return;
    const m = p.dataset.mode;
    if (state.modes.has(m)) state.modes.delete(m);
    else state.modes.add(m);
    p.classList.toggle('is-on');
    renderSections();
  });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

153	  const errBox = document.getElementById('formErr');
154	  const btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
155	  const anon = document.getElementById('anonBlock');
156	  const signed = !!Auth.profile;
157	
158	  document.getElementById('signedHint').innerHTML = signed
159	    ? `We'll notify you in your bell when it's reviewed.`
160	    : `<a href="${H('signin.html')}" style="color:var(--green)">Sign in</a> to track this suggestion in your account.`;
161	  if (!signed) anon.hidden = false;
162	
163	  // populate selects from live taxonomy
164	  let cfg = {};
165	  try { cfg = (await Settings.load()) || {}; } catch (_) {}
166	  function fill(id, arr) {
167	    const sel = document.getElementById(id);
168	    arr.forEach((v) => { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = v; o.textContent = v; sel.appendChild(o); });
169	  }
170	  fill('field', cfg.fields || []); fill('category', cfg.categories || []);
171	  fill('city', cfg.locations || []); fill('workMode', cfg.workModes || []);
172	
173	  function setInvalid(name, on) { const el = form[name] && form[name].closest('.field'); if (el) el.classList.toggle('is-invalid', on); }
174	
175	  function readForm() {
176	    const g = (n) => (form[n] && form[n].value || '').trim();
177	    return {
178	      title: g('title'), company: g('company'), field: g('field'), category: g('category'),
179	      city: g('city'), workMode: g('workMode'), duration: g('duration'), stipend: g('stipend'),
180	      deadline: g('deadline') ? new Date(g('deadline')).toISOString() : '',
181	      applicationUrl: g('applicationUrl'), sourceUrl: g('applicationUrl'), notes: g('notes'),
182	      whereFound: g('whereFound'),
183	      contactName: g('contactName'), contactEmail: g('contactEmail')
184	    };
185	  }
186	
187	  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
188	    e.preventDefault();
189	    errBox.hidden = true;
190	    const d = readForm();
191	    let bad = false;
192	    if (!d.title) { setInvalid('title', true); bad = true; } else setInvalid('title', false);
193	    if (!d.company) { setInvalid('company', true); bad = true; } else setInvalid('company', false);
194	    if (d.applicationUrl && !UI.safeUrl(d.applicationUrl)) { setInvalid('applicationUrl', true); bad = true; } else setInvalid('applicationUrl', false);
195	    if (!signed && d.contactEmail && !/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(d.contactEmail)) { setInvalid('contactEmail', true); bad = true; } else setInvalid('contactEmail', false);
196	    if (!signed && !d.contactEmail) { setInvalid('contactEmail', true); bad = true; }
197	    if (bad) return;
198	
199	    btn.classList.add('is-loading'); btn.disabled = true;
200	    const res = await Suggestions.submit(d);
201	    btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); btn.disabled = false;
202	    if (!res.ok) { errBox.textContent = `We couldn't send that. Please try again.`; errBox.hidden = false; return; }
203	    form.reset();
204	    UI.toast('Suggestion sent — thank you for helping students.');
205	    if (signed) loadMine();
206	  });
207

209	    'needs-changes': ['Needs changes', 'status-pending'], verified: ['Verified', 'status-verified'],
210	    rejected: ['Declined', 'status-rejected'], duplicate: ['Duplicate', 'status-rejected'] };
211	
212	  async function loadMine() {
213	    const panel = document.getElementById('minePanel');
214	    const box = document.getElementById('mineBox');
215	    panel.hidden = false; box.innerHTML = UI.skeletonRows(2);
216	    let mine = [];
217	    try { mine = await Suggestions.mine(); } catch (_) { mine = []; }
218	    if (!mine.length) { box.innerHTML = `<p class="muted">You haven't suggested anything yet.</p>`; return; }
219	    box.innerHTML = mine.slice(0, 6).map((s) => {
220	      const st = STATUS[s.status] || ['Pending', 'status-pending'];
221	      return `<div class="my-sug"><div class="ms-main"><div class="ms-title">${UI.esc(s.title || 'Untitled')}</div>
222	        <div class="ms-meta">${UI.esc(s.company || '—')}${s.city ? ' · ' + UI.esc(s.city) : ''} · ${UI.timeAgo(s.createdAt)}</div></div>
223	        <span class="status-dot ${st[1]}">${st[0]}</span></div>`;
224	    }).join('');
225	  }
226
