9	<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
10	<style>
11	:root{
12	  --bg:#f4f4f1; --surface:#fbfbfa; --ink:#0d1b12; --ink2:#3f4a44; --muted:#6b7570;
13	  --line:#e3e5df; --line2:#d6dad2;
14	  --green:#0e6b3f; --green-ink:#0a5232; --green-deep:#0a3d26;
15	  --mint:#dcefe2; --mint2:#eaf5ee;
16	  --amber:#b45309; --amber-bg:#fdf3e3;
17	  --coral:#b3543f; --coral-bg:#f6ded9;
18	  --lime:#e0f2d6; --lime-ink:#46711c;
19	  --sage:#eceee8; --sage-ink:#5c6660;
20	  --r:14px;
21	  --sh1:0 1px 2px rgba(13,27,18,.05),0 8px 24px -12px rgba(13,27,18,.12);
22	  --sh2:0 2px 6px rgba(13,27,18,.06),0 18px 36px -18px rgba(13,27,18,.20);
23	  --fd:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif; --fs:"Inter",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; --fm:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;
24	  --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
25	}
26	*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
27	html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
28	body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:14.5px/1.55 var(--fs);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
29	button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
30	input,select,textarea{font:inherit}
31	img{display:block}
32	svg{display:block;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
33	::selection{background:var(--mint)}
34	:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
35	.eyebrow{font:500 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
36	.display{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em}
37	.sechead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
38	.sechead h2{font-size:21px}
39	
40	/* ============ TOPBAR ============ */
41	.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 20px;background:rgba(244,244,241,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
42	.icon-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink2);transition:.2s}
43	.icon-btn:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
44	.icon-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
45	.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:16.5px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;margin-right:6px}
46	.logo{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;flex:none}
47	.logo svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke-width:2.4}
48	.top-nav{display:flex;gap:4px}
49	.top-nav a{padding:8px 13px;border-radius:9px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);text-decoration:none;transition:.2s}
50	.top-nav a:hover{color:var(--green-ink);background:var(--mint2)}
51	.top-nav a.on{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;background:#eceee8}
52	.tb-right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
53	.avatar-wrap{position:relative}
54	.avatar{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;display:grid;place-items:center}
55	.chev{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--muted)}
56	.menu{position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);min-width:190px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);padding:6px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px) scale(.98);pointer-events:none;transition:.22s var(--ease)}
57	.menu.open{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
58	.menu button{display:flex;width:100%;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2);transition:.15s}
59	.menu button:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
60	.menu svg{width:15px;height:15px}
61	.menu hr{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:5px 4px}
62	
63	/* ============ SIDEBAR ============ */
64	.shell{display:flex;min-height:calc(100vh - 64px)}
65	.sidebar{width:250px;flex:none;background:#f7f8f6;border-right:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:64px;height:calc(100vh - 64px);overflow:hidden;transition:width .35s var(--ease)}
66	body.sb-collapsed .sidebar{width:76px}
67	.sb-scroll{height:100%;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:18px 14px;scrollbar-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
68	.sb-label{padding:4px 12px 8px;transition:opacity .2s}
69	body.sb-collapsed .sb-label{opacity:0}
70	.nav-btn{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--ink2);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;transition:.2s;text-align:left}
71	.nav-btn:hover{background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink)}
72	.nav-btn.on{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
73	.nav-btn .ico svg{width:18px;height:18px}
74	.nav-btn .txt{white-space:nowrap;max-width:160px;transition:max-width .3s var(--ease),opacity .2s}
75	body.sb-collapsed .txt{max-width:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden}
76	body.sb-collapsed .nav-btn{justify-content:center;padding:10px}
77	.nbadge{position:absolute;right:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font:600 11px/20px var(--fs);text-align:center}
78	body.sb-collapsed .nbadge{right:6px;top:6px;transform:none;min-width:16px;height:16px;font-size:9.5px;line-height:16px;padding:0 4px}
79	.sb-card{margin-top:auto;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px}
80	body.sb-collapsed .sb-card{display:none}
81	.sb-card .eyebrow{display:block;margin-bottom:10px}
82	.sb-card ol{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
83	.sb-card li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
84	.sb-card li b{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);font:600 10.5px/18px var(--fm);text-align:center}
85	.backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;top:64px;background:rgba(10,20,14,.4);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s;z-index:90}
86	body.sb-open .backdrop{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
87	
88	/* ============ MAIN ============ */
89	.main{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:24px clamp(14px,2.6vw,32px) 40px}
90	
91	/* ---- intro band ---- */
92	.intro{position:relative;border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(24px,3vw,34px) clamp(18px,3vw,36px);color:#eafff3;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#0a3d26 0%,#0e6b3f 55%,#0a4930 100%)}
93	.intro::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(680px 240px at 90% -20%,rgba(140,255,190,.20),transparent 62%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0 1px,transparent 1px 90px)}
94	.intro>*{position:relative}
95	.intro .eyebrow{color:#9fd8b4}
96	.intro h1{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,34px);color:#f7fdf9;margin:10px 0 6px;max-width:560px}
97	.intro p{color:#cfe9d8;font-size:14px;max-width:560px}
98	.intro .stat-line{margin-top:14px;font:500 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8fc7a6;text-transform:uppercase}
99	.orbits{position:absolute;right:8px;top:6px;width:340px;opacity:.8;pointer-events:none}
100	.orbits .sig{stroke-dasharray:6 8;animation:dash 16s linear infinite}
101	@keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-420}}
102	
103	/* ---- layout ---- */
104	.suggest-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 378px;gap:22px;align-items:start;margin-top:24px}
105	.form-col{position:relative;min-width:0}
106	
107	/* ---- form cards ---- */
108	.fcard{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:20px}
109	.fcard+.fcard{margin-top:14px}
110	.fhead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
111	.fstep{font:600 11px var(--fm);color:var(--green-ink);background:var(--mint);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px}
112	.fhead h3{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600}
113	.fhead .opt{margin-left:auto;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
114	.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
115	.span2{grid-column:1/-1}
116	.field label{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:7px;color:var(--ink)}
117	.req{color:var(--green)}
118	.count{margin-left:auto;font:500 11px var(--fm);color:var(--muted)}
119	.field input,.field textarea,.field select{width:100%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 13px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;outline:none}
120	.field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:96px}
121	.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus,.field select:focus{border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--mint)}
122	.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:#a8b2ac}
123	.hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
124	.hint.good{color:var(--green-ink)}
125	.hint.bad{color:var(--coral)}
126	.fmsg{display:none;font-size:12px;color:var(--coral);margin-top:6px}
127	.field.err input,.field.err textarea{border-color:var(--coral);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--coral-bg)}
128	.field.err .fmsg{display:block}
129	@keyframes nudge{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}25%{transform:translateX(-4px)}75%{transform:translateX(4px)}}
130	.field.err{animation:nudge .3s var(--ease)}
131	/* chips */
132	.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
133	.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);transition:.18s var(--ease)}
134	.fchip svg{width:14px;height:14px}
135	.fchip:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);transform:translateY(-1px)}
136	.fchip.on{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
137	.cchip{border:1px solid var(--line2);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 15px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);transition:.18s}
138	.cchip:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
139	.cchip.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
140	/* segmented work mode */
141	.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;background:var(--sage);border-radius:12px;padding:4px}
142	.seg button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:9px;padding:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2);transition:.2s var(--ease)}
143	.seg button svg{width:14px;height:14px}
144	.seg button.on{background:var(--surface);color:var(--green-ink);box-shadow:var(--sh1)}
145	/* submit */
146	.submit-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
147	.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;padding:10px 16px;transition:.2s var(--ease);white-space:nowrap}
148	.btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
149	.btn.primary{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
150	.btn.primary:hover{background:var(--green-ink);transform:translateY(-1px)}
151	.btn.primary:disabled{opacity:.65;transform:none;cursor:default}
152	.btn.ghost{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--ink2)}
153	.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
154	.btn.big{padding:13px 22px;font-size:14.5px;border-radius:12px}
155	.spin{width:15px;height:15px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:rot .7s linear infinite}
156	@keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
157	.submit-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
158	
159	/* ---- success overlay ---- */
160	.done{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;background:rgba(251,251,250,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border-radius:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.35s var(--ease)}
161	.done.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
162	.done-card{text-align:center;padding:30px;max-width:440px}
163	.done-check{width:74px;height:74px;margin:0 auto 18px}
164	.done-check circle{stroke:var(--green);stroke-dasharray:166;stroke-dashoffset:166}
165	.done-check path{stroke:var(--green);stroke-dasharray:48;stroke-dashoffset:48;stroke-width:3}
166	.done.show circle{animation:draw .6s .1s var(--ease) forwards}
167	.done.show path{animation:draw .4s .6s var(--ease) forwards}
168	@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
169	.done-card h3{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px}
170	.done-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px}
171	.done-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:22px}
172	
173	/* ---- preview column ---- */
174	.pv-col{position:sticky;top:84px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
175	.pv-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
176	.pv-label .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);animation:pulse 2s infinite}
177	@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(14,107,63,.35)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(14,107,63,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(14,107,63,0)}}
178	.pv-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh1)}
179	.pv-media{position:relative;height:168px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--green),var(--green-deep))}
180	.pv-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
181	.pv-media .noimg{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font:700 30px var(--fs)}
182	.pv-media .noimg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 10px,transparent 10px 20px)}
183	.badge{font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:4px 8px}
184	.badge.pend{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;background:rgba(236,238,232,.92);color:var(--sage-ink);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
185	.pv-av{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:-15px;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green-deep);color:#bfe8cd;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 11.5px var(--fs);border:2px solid var(--surface)}
186	.pv-body{padding:22px 16px 14px}
187	.pv-body h3{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600}
188	.pv-body h3.ph,.pv-co.ph{color:#a8b2ac;font-weight:500}
189	.pv-co{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
190	.pv-meta{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 12px;margin-top:10px}
191	.pv-meta li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2)}
192	.pv-meta li.ph{color:#b6bfb9}
193	.pv-meta svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
194	.pv-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
195	.pv-foot .mono{font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
196	/* workflow */
197	.wf{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:18px}
198	.wf h4{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px}
199	.wf-step{position:relative;display:flex;gap:12px;padding-bottom:18px}
200	.wf-step:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
201	.wf-step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:15px;top:32px;bottom:0;width:1.5px;background:linear-gradient(var(--line2),var(--mint))}
202	.wf-step:last-child::before{display:none}
203	.wf-ico{flex:none;width:31px;height:31px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--mint2);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--mint)}
204	.wf-ico svg{width:14px;height:14px}
205	.wf-step b{display:block;font-size:13px}
206	.wf-step span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
207	
208	/* ---- history ---- */
209	.history{margin-top:34px}
210	.hrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 16px}
211	.hrow+.hrow{margin-top:10px}
212	@keyframes rowin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}}
213	.hrow.new{animation:rowin .45s var(--ease)}
214	.h-ico{flex:none;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--sage);color:var(--sage-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
215	.h-ico svg{width:16px;height:16px}
216	.h-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
217	.h-main b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
218	.h-main span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
219	.status{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 10px}
220	.status::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
221	.st-pending{background:var(--sage);color:var(--sage-ink)}
222	.st-verified{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink)}
223	.st-published{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
224	.st-needs{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
225	.st-rejected{background:var(--coral-bg);color:var(--coral)}
226	.h-empty{border:1.5px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:44px 24px;text-align:center;background:var(--mint2)}
227	.h-empty .e-ico{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 14px}
228	.h-empty .e-ico svg{width:20px;height:20px}
229	.h-empty h3{font-size:16px}
230	.h-empty p{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;max-width:380px;margin:7px auto 0}
231	.foot{margin-top:34px;text-align:center;font:500 11px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
232	.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:300;background:rgba(13,27,18,.94);color:#eafff3;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;font-size:13px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
233	.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
234	
235	/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
236	@media (max-width:1100px){.suggest-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pv-col{position:static}}
237	@media (max-width:960px){
238	  .top-nav{display:none}
239	  .sidebar{position:fixed;left:0;top:64px;z-index:140;width:278px !important;transform:translateX(-105%);transition:transform .35s var(--ease);box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
240	  body.sb-open .sidebar{transform:none}
241	  body.sb-collapsed .txt{max-width:160px;opacity:1}
242	  body.sb-collapsed .sb-card{display:block}
243	  body.sb-collapsed .sb-label{opacity:1}
244	  .orbits{display:none}
245	}
246	@media (max-width:640px){
247	  .fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
248	  .seg{grid-template-columns:1fr}
249	  .hrow{flex-wrap:wrap}
250	  .status{margin-left:52px}
251	}
252	@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{transition-duration:.01ms !important;animation-duration:.01ms !important;animation-iteration-count:1 !important}}
253	</style>
254	</head>
255	<body>
256	
257	<header class="topbar">
258	  <button class="icon-btn" id="sbToggle" aria-label="Toggle navigation"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M9 4v16"/></svg></button>
259	  <a class="brand" href="#"><span class="logo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 21l-7-5-7 5V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg></span>InternHub</a>

368	                <label for="fSource">Source link <span class="req">*</span></label>
369	                <input id="fSource" type="url" placeholder="https://… the page where you found this opportunity">
370	                <p class="hint" id="sourceHint">Paste the page where you discovered it — a company career page, LinkedIn post, flyer site…</p>
371	                <p class="fmsg">A valid source link (https://…) is required so we can review it.</p>

375	                <input id="fApply" type="url" placeholder="https://… direct application URL">
376	                <p class="hint" id="applyHint">If applications happen on a different page, add it here.</p>

379	          </div>

382	            <div class="fhead"><span class="fstep">04</span><h3>Details</h3><span class="opt">Everything helps</span></div>
383	            <div class="fgrid">
384	              <div class="field span2">
385	                <label for="fDesc">Description <span class="count" id="descCount">0 / 600</span></label>
386	                <textarea id="fDesc" maxlength="600" placeholder="What will the intern do? Requirements? Anything a student should know before applying…"></textarea>
387	              </div>

391	                  <option value="">Not sure yet</option><option>1 – 2 months</option><option>3 months</option><option>4 – 5 months</option><option>6 months</option><option>6+ months</option>
392	                </select></label>

397	              </div>

400	                <input id="fContact" placeholder="e.g. careers@company.cm · +237 6XX XX XX XX">
401	                <p class="hint">Only share contact details that are publicly available.</p>

418	              Submit for review

446	          <div class="wf-step"><span class="wf-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg></span><div><b>We review</b><span>Our team checks, edits and verifies the listing.</span></div></div>

463	<script>
464	const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
465	const FIELDS=["Software Engineering","Data & AI","Design","Finance","Agriculture","Engineering","Health","Marketing"];
466	const CITIES=["Douala","Yaoundé","Buea","Limbe"];
467	const FICO={"Software Engineering":'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 6l-5 6 5 6M16 6l5 6-5 6"/></svg>',"Data & AI":'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-8M22 20H2"/></svg>',Design:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 19l7-7 3 3-7 7-3-3z"/><path d="M18 13l-1.5-7.5L2 2l3.5 14.5L13 18l5-5z"/></svg>',Finance:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v10M15 9.5c0-1.4-1.3-2.5-3-2.5s-3 1.1-3 2.5 1.3 2.5 3 2.5 3 1.1 3 2.5-1.3 2.5-3 2.5-3-1.1-3-2.5"/></svg>',Agriculture:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 22V8"/><path d="M12 8C12 4 9 2 5 2c0 4 3 6 7 6zM12 12c0-4 3-6 7-6 0 4-3 6-7 6z"/></svg>',Engineering:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 2L3 14h7l-1 8 10-12h-7l1-8z"/></svg>',Health:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/></svg>',Marketing:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 11l18-8v18L3 13v-2z"/><path d="M7 13v6a2 2 0 0 0 4 0v-4"/></svg>'};
468	const IC={tag:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20.6 13.4L11 3H4v7l9.6 10.4a2 2 0 0 0 2.8 0l4.2-4.2a2 2 0 0 0 0-2.8z"/></svg>',clock:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg>',pin:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12S4 16 4 10a8 8 0 0 1 16 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>',mode:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M8 20h8M12 16v4"/></svg>',send:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg>'};
469	const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");
470	const initials=n=>n.split(/\s+/).map(w=>w[0]).join("").slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
471	const F={title:"",company:"",field:"",city:"",area:"",mode:"",source:"",apply:"",desc:"",dur:"",deadline:"",contact:"",img:""};
472	let imgOk=false;
473	let history=[
474	 {t:"Sales Intern",co:"QuickSell Douala",date:"30 August 2026",st:"pending"},
475	 {t:"UI Design Intern",co:"Nkolbisson Studio",date:"26 August 2026",st:"needs"},
476	 {t:"Data Science Intern",co:"Cameroon Data Lab",date:"18 August 2026",st:"published"},
477	 {t:"Crypto Trading Intern",co:"Unknown LLC",date:"12 August 2026",st:"rejected"}
478	];
479	const ST={pending:["Pending review","st-pending"],verified:["Verified","st-verified"],published:["Published","st-published"],needs:["Needs changes","st-needs"],rejected:["Rejected","st-rejected"]};
480	
481	/* ---------- chips ---------- */
482	$("#fieldChips").innerHTML=FIELDS.map(f=>'<button type="button" class="fchip" data-f="'+esc(f)+'">'+(FICO[f]||IC.tag)+esc(f)+"</button>").join("");
483	$("#cityChips").innerHTML=CITIES.map(c=>'<button type="button" class="cchip" data-c="'+c+'">'+c+"</button>").join("")+'<button type="button" class="cchip" data-c="Other">Other</button>';
484	$("#fieldChips").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-f]");if(!b)return;F.field=F.field===b.dataset.f?"":b.dataset.f;syncChips();clearErr("wField");renderPreview();});
485	$("#cityChips").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-c]");if(!b)return;
486	 const c=b.dataset.c;
487	 if(c==="Other"){$("#cityOtherWrap").style.display="";F.city=$("#fCityOther").value.trim();}
488	 else{$("#cityOtherWrap").style.display="none";F.city=F.city===c?"":c;}
489	 syncChips();clearErr("wCity");renderPreview();});
490	$("#fCityOther").addEventListener("input",e=>{F.city=e.target.value.trim();clearErr("wCity");renderPreview();});
491	function syncChips(){
492	 document.querySelectorAll("#fieldChips .fchip").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.f===F.field));
493	 document.querySelectorAll("#cityChips .cchip").forEach(b=>{
494	   const c=b.dataset.c;
495	   b.classList.toggle("on",c==="Other"?(F.city&&!CITIES.includes(F.city)):F.city===c);});
496	}
497	$("#modeSeg").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-mode]");if(!b)return;F.mode=b.dataset.mode;
498	 document.querySelectorAll("#modeSeg button").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("on",x===b));clearErr("wMode");renderPreview();});
499	
500	/* ---------- inputs ---------- */
501	const bind=(id,key,after)=>$(id).addEventListener("input",e=>{F[key]=e.target.value;after&&after();renderPreview();});
502	bind("#fTitle","title",()=>clearErr("wTitle"));
503	bind("#fCompany","company",()=>clearErr("wCompany"));
504	bind("#fArea","area");bind("#fApply","apply",()=>urlHint("#applyHint",F.apply,"applyHint"));
505	bind("#fContact","contact");bind("#fDur","dur");bind("#fDeadline","deadline");
506	bind("#fSource","source",()=>{urlHint("#sourceHint",F.source,"sourceHint");clearErr("wSource");});
507	$("#fDesc").addEventListener("input",e=>{F.desc=e.target.value;$("#descCount").textContent=F.desc.length+" / 600";renderPreview();});
508	$("#fDeadline").min=new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
509	function urlHint(sel,val){
510	 const el=$(sel);el.classList.remove("good","bad");
511	 if(!val){el.textContent=el.dataset.orig||(el.dataset.orig=el.textContent);return;}
512	 if(/^https?:\/\/.+\..+/.test(val)){el.textContent="Link looks good.";el.classList.add("good");}
513	 else{el.textContent="Hmm — a link should start with http:// or https://";el.classList.add("bad");}
514	}
515	/* image url preview w/ debounce */
516	let imgT;$("#fImg").addEventListener("input",e=>{F.img=e.target.value.trim();clearTimeout(imgT);
517	 imgT=setTimeout(()=>{const h=$("#imgHint");h.classList.remove("good","bad");
518	  if(!F.img){imgOk=false;h.textContent=h.dataset.orig||(h.dataset.orig=h.textContent);renderPreview();return;}
519	  const t=new Image();
520	  t.onload=()=>{imgOk=true;h.textContent="Image loaded — see the preview.";h.classList.add("good");renderPreview();};
521	  t.onerror=()=>{imgOk=false;h.textContent="We couldn't load that image — we'll use a clean fallback cover instead.";h.classList.add("bad");renderPreview();};
522	  t.src=F.img;},450);
523	 renderPreview();});
524	
525	/* ---------- preview ---------- */
526	function renderPreview(){
527	 const media=(F.img&&imgOk)?'<img src="'+esc(F.img)+'" alt="">':'<div class="noimg">'+esc(initials(F.company||"InternHub"))+"</div>";
528	 const meta=[];
529	 meta.push(F.field?'<li>'+FICO[F.field]+esc(F.field)+"</li>":'<li class="ph">'+IC.tag+"Field</li>");
530	 const loc=[F.city,F.area].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
531	 meta.push(loc?'<li>'+IC.pin+esc(loc)+"</li>":'<li class="ph">'+IC.pin+"City</li>");
532	 meta.push(F.mode?'<li>'+IC.mode+esc(F.mode)+"</li>":'<li class="ph">'+IC.mode+"Work mode</li>");
533	 if(F.dur)meta.push('<li>'+IC.clock+esc(F.dur)+"</li>");
534	 const dl=F.deadline?"Closes "+new Date(F.deadline+"T00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"short"}):"Deadline —";
535	 $("#pvCard").innerHTML=
536	  '<div class="pv-media">'+media+'<span class="badge pend">Pending verification</span><span class="pv-av">'+esc(initials(F.company||"IH"))+"</span></div>"+
537	  '<div class="pv-body"><h3 class="'+(F.title?"":"ph")+'">'+esc(F.title||"Internship title")+'</h3>'+
538	  '<p class="pv-co '+(F.company?"":"ph")+'">'+esc(F.company||"Company name")+"</p>"+
539	  '<ul class="pv-meta">'+meta.join("")+"</ul></div>"+
540	  '<div class="pv-foot"><span>'+esc(dl)+'</span><span class="mono">Community suggestion</span></div>';
541	}
542	
543	/* ---------- validation ---------- */
544	function setErr(id,on){const w=$("#"+id);w.classList.toggle("err",on);if(on){w.style.animation="none";void w.offsetWidth;w.style.animation="";}}
545	function clearErr(id){$("#"+id).classList.remove("err");}
546	function validURL(v){return /^https?:\/\/.+\..+/.test(v);}
547	function validate(){
548	 const errs=[];
549	 if(!F.title.trim())errs.push("wTitle");
550	 if(!F.company.trim())errs.push("wCompany");
551	 if(!F.field)errs.push("wField");
552	 if(!F.city)errs.push("wCity");
553	 if(!F.mode)errs.push("wMode");
554	 if(!F.source.trim()||!validURL(F.source.trim()))errs.push("wSource");
555	 ["wTitle","wCompany","wField","wCity","wMode","wSource"].forEach(id=>setErr(id,errs.includes(id)));
556	 if(errs.length){toast("A few required fields need attention.");$("#"+errs[0]).scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"center"});return false;}
557	 return true;
558	}
559	
560	/* ---------- submit ---------- */
561	$("#suggestForm").addEventListener("submit",e=>{
562	 e.preventDefault();
563	 if(!validate())return;
564	 const btn=$("#submitBtn");btn.disabled=true;
565	 btn.innerHTML='<span class="spin"></span>Submitting…';
566	 setTimeout(()=>{
567	  history.unshift({t:F.title.trim(),co:F.company.trim(),date:new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric"}),st:"pending",fresh:true});
568	  renderHistory();
569	  $("#doneOverlay").classList.add("show");
570	  btn.disabled=false;btn.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 2L11 13"/><path d="M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg>Submit for review';
571	 },900);
572	});
573	$("#againBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{
574	 $("#doneOverlay").classList.remove("show");
575	 resetForm();
576	 $("#formCol").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"});
577	});
578	function resetForm(){
579	 Object.keys(F).forEach(k=>F[k]="");imgOk=false;
580	 ["#fTitle","#fCompany","#fArea","#fSource","#fApply","#fDesc","#fContact","#fImg","#fCityOther"].forEach(s=>$(s).value="");
581	 $("#fDur").value="";$("#fDeadline").value="";$("#descCount").textContent="0 / 600";
582	 document.querySelectorAll("#modeSeg button").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("on"));
583	 $("#cityOtherWrap").style.display="none";
584	 syncChips();renderPreview();
585	}
586	
587	/* ---------- history ---------- */
588	function renderHistory(){
589	 const box=$("#histList");
590	 $("#histCount").textContent=history.length+" submissions";
591	 if(!history.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="h-empty"><div class="e-ico">'+IC.send+'</div><h3 class="display">You haven\'t suggested an opportunity yet.</h3><p>Sharing even one internship can help dozens of students discover a path they'd never find alone.</p></div>';return;}
592	 box.innerHTML=history.map(h=>{const[txt,cls]=ST[h.st];
593	  return '<div class="hrow'+(h.fresh?" new":"")+'"><span class="h-ico">'+IC.send+'</span><div class="h-main"><b>'+esc(h.t)+'</b><span>'+esc(h.co)+" · submitted "+esc(h.date)+'</span></div><span class="status '+cls+'">'+txt+"</span></div>";}).join("");
594	 history.forEach(h=>h.fresh=false);
595	}
596	
597	/* ---------- toast / nav ---------- */
598	let toastT;function toast(m){const t=$("#toast");t.textContent=m;t.classList.add("show");clearTimeout(toastT);toastT=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("show"),2300);}
599	document.querySelectorAll("[data-toast]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>{closeMenus();toast(b.dataset.toast);}));
600	function closeMenus(){document.querySelectorAll(".menu").forEach(m=>m.classList.remove("open"));}
601	$("#avBtn").addEventListener("click",e=>{e.stopPropagation();const m=$("#avMenu"),o=m.classList.contains("open");closeMenus();m.classList.toggle("open",!o);});
602	document.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(!e.target.closest(".avatar-wrap"))closeMenus();});
603	const mqMob=matchMedia("(max-width:960px)");
604	$("#sbToggle").addEventListener("click",()=>{mqMob.matches?document.body.classList.toggle("sb-open"):document.body.classList.toggle("sb-collapsed");});
605	$("#backdrop").addEventListener("click",()=>document.body.classList.remove("sb-open"));
606	
607	/* ---------- init ---------- */
608	renderPreview();renderHistory();
609	</script>

// ============================================================
// InternHub · Firestore security
// One shared database for the student and admin experiences.
// Privilege comes ONLY from the Firebase Auth custom claim
// `token.admin == true` (granted server-side via tools/setAdminClaim.js).
// A student can never reach admin writes by guessing a URL.
// ============================================================
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {

    function signedIn()   { return request.auth != null; }
    function isAdmin()    { return signedIn() && request.auth.token.admin == true; }
    function owner(uid)   { return signedIn() && request.auth.uid == uid; }

    // ---------- Internships: public read of published, admin-only writes ----------
    match /internships/{id} {
      allow read: if isAdmin() || resource.data.published == true;
      allow create, update, delete: if isAdmin();
    }

    // ---------- Suggestions: student/anonymous submit (pending), owner or admin read ----------
    match /suggestions/{id} {
      allow get, list: if isAdmin()
                     || (signedIn() && resource.data.submittedBy == request.auth.uid)
                     || resource.data.submittedBy == 'anonymous';
      // New submissions are always pending and attributed honestly.
      allow create: if request.resource.data.status == 'pending'
                    && request.resource.data.submittedBy == (signedIn() ? request.auth.uid : 'anonymous');
      // Only staff edits/declines/verifies/removes a suggestion.
      allow update, delete: if isAdmin();
    }

    // ---------- Users: owner-scoped profile; admin may moderate ----------
    match /users/{uid} {
      allow read:  if owner(uid) || isAdmin();
      // A new student creates only a plain, non-privileged profile.
      allow create: if owner(uid)

/* ============================================================
   SUGGEST · step cards, chips, work mode, live preview, history
   Restored from mandatory design/student_pages/suggest_internship.html
   ============================================================ */
.darkzone .orbits{position:absolute;right:8px;top:6px;width:340px;height:auto;opacity:.8;pointer-events:none}
.orbits circle,.orbits path{fill:none}
.orbits .o-ring-a{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.22);stroke-dasharray:3 7}
.orbits .o-ring-b{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.16)}
.orbits .o-sig{stroke:rgba(140,255,190,.5);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-dasharray:6 8;animation:dash 16s linear infinite}
.orbits .o-dot{fill:#9fe8bd}
.orbits .o-dot2{fill:#9fe8bd;opacity:.7}
.orbits .o-core{fill:#dcefe2}
@keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-420}}

.suggest-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 378px;gap:22px;align-items:start;margin-top:24px}
.form-col{position:relative;min-width:0}

.fcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:20px}
.fcard+.fcard{margin-top:14px}
.fhead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
.fstep{font:600 11px var(--fm);color:var(--green-ink);background:var(--green-soft);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px}
.fhead h3{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600}
.fhead .opt{margin-left:auto;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.fgrid .field{margin-bottom:0}
.span2{grid-column:1/-1}
.fcard .field > label{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;font:600 13px var(--fs);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--ink)}
.fcard .field .input,.fcard .field .select,.fcard .field .textarea{font-family:var(--fs)}
.fcard .field .textarea{min-height:96px}
.req{color:var(--green)}
.opt-label{color:var(--mut);font-weight:500}
.count{margin-left:auto;font:500 11px var(--fm);color:var(--mut)}
.hint.good{color:var(--green-ink)}
.hint.bad{color:var(--red)}
.field.is-invalid{animation:nudge .3s var(--ease)}
.field.is-invalid .input,.field.is-invalid .textarea,.field.is-invalid .select{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--red-bg)}
@keyframes nudge{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}25%{transform:translateX(-4px)}75%{transform:translateX(4px)}}

.fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.fchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);transition:.18s var(--ease)}
.fchip svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.fchip:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.fchip.is-on{background:var(--green-soft);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink);font-weight:600}
.cchip{border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 15px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);transition:.18s var(--ease)}
.cchip:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green-ink)}
.cchip.is-on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
.mode-seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:12px;padding:4px}
.mode-seg button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:9px;padding:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);transition:.2s var(--ease)}
.mode-seg button svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.mode-seg button.is-on{background:var(--card);color:var(--green-ink);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}

.submit-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
.submit-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}

.done{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;background:rgba(251,252,248,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border-radius:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.35s var(--ease)}
.done.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.done-card{text-align:center;padding:30px;max-width:440px}
.done-card h3{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px}
.done-card p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px}
.done-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:22px}
.done-check{width:74px;height:74px;margin:0 auto 18px}
.done-check circle{stroke:var(--green);stroke-dasharray:166;stroke-dashoffset:166}
.done-check path{stroke:var(--green);stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:48;stroke-dashoffset:48}
.done.show .done-check circle{animation:draw .6s .1s var(--ease) forwards}
.done.show .done-check path{animation:draw .4s .6s var(--ease) forwards}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}

.pv-col{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 20px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.pv-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.pv-label .dot{width:7px;height:7px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);animation:ping 2s infinite}
.pv-card{--media-h:168px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}

.pv-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

.pv-media .noimg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 10px,transparent 10px 20px)}
.pv-body{padding:22px 16px 14px}
.pv-body h3{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.pv-body h3.ph,.pv-co.ph{color:var(--dim);font-weight:500}
.pv-co{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px}
.pv-co svg{width:13px;height:13px;flex:none}
.pv-meta{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 12px;margin:10px 0 0;padding:0}
.pv-meta li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink)}
.pv-meta li.ph{color:var(--dim)}
.pv-meta svg{width:12.5px;height:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.pv-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.pv-foot .mono{font:500 10px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}

.wf{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:18px}
.wf h4{font-family:var(--fs);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px}
.wf-step{position:relative;display:flex;gap:12px;padding-bottom:18px}
.wf-step:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.wf-step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:15px;top:32px;bottom:0;width:1.5px;background:linear-gradient(var(--line2),var(--green-soft))}
.wf-step:last-child::before{display:none}
.wf-ico{flex:none;width:31px;height:31px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
.wf-ico svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.wf-step b{display:block;font-size:13px}
.wf-step span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}

.history{margin-top:34px}
.hrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 16px}
.hrow+.hrow{margin-top:10px}
.hrow.is-new{animation:rowin .45s var(--ease)}
@keyframes rowin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.h-ico{flex:none;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut);display:grid;place-items:center}
.h-ico svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.h-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.h-main b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.h-main span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.status{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font:600 10.5px var(--fm);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 10px}
.status::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.st-pending{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--mut)}
.st-verified{background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink)}
.st-published{background:var(--lime);color:var(--lime-ink)}
.st-needs{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber)}
.st-rejected{background:var(--red-bg);color:var(--red)}
.h-empty{border:1.5px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:44px 24px;text-align:center;background:var(--green-soft)}
.h-empty .e-ico{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--card);color:var(--green-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 14px}
.h-empty .e-ico svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.h-empty h3{font-size:16px}
.h-empty p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;max-width:380px;margin:7px auto 0}

@media (max-width:1100px){
  .suggest-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .pv-col{position:static}
}
@media (max-width:960px){
  .darkzone .orbits{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .mode-seg{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hrow{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .hrow .status{margin-left:52px}
}

    const loc = [F.city, F.area].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    const meta = [
      F.field ? `<li>${UI.icon(UI.fieldIcon(F.field), 13)}${UI.esc(F.field)}</li>`
              : `<li class="ph">${UI.icon('briefcase', 13)}Field</li>`,
      loc ? `<li>${UI.icon('pin', 13)}${UI.esc(loc)}</li>`
          : `<li class="ph">${UI.icon('pin', 13)}City</li>`,
      F.workMode ? `<li>${UI.icon('globe', 13)}${UI.esc(F.workMode)}</li>`
                 : `<li class="ph">${UI.icon('globe', 13)}Work mode</li>`,
      F.dur ? `<li>${UI.icon('clock', 13)}${UI.esc(F.dur)}</li>` : ''
    ].filter(Boolean).join('');
    el.pv.innerHTML = `<div class="pv-media">${media}
        <div class="ic-badges"><span class="bdg bdg-pend">Pending verification</span></div>
        <span class="mono-av">${UI.esc(UI.initials(F.company || 'IH'))}</span></div>
      <div class="pv-body">
        <h3 class="${F.title ? '' : 'ph'}">${UI.esc(F.title || 'Internship title')}</h3>
        <p class="pv-co ${F.company ? '' : 'ph'}">${UI.icon('building', 13)}${UI.esc(F.company || 'Company name')}</p>
        <ul class="pv-meta">${meta}</ul>
      </div>
      <div class="pv-foot"><span>${UI.esc(F.deadline ? 'Closes ' + UI.fmtDate(F.deadline) : 'Deadline —')}</span>
        <span class="mono">Community suggestion</span></div>`;
  }

  /* ---------- controls from the live taxonomy ---------- */
  function buildControls(cfg) {
    el.fieldChips.innerHTML = (cfg.fields || []).map((f) =>
      `<button type="button" class="fchip" data-f="${UI.esc(f)}">${UI.icon(UI.fieldIcon(f), 14)}${UI.esc(f)}</button>`).join('');
    KNOWN_CITIES = (cfg.locations || []).slice();
    el.cityChips.innerHTML = KNOWN_CITIES.map((c) =>
      `<button type="button" class="cchip" data-c="${UI.esc(c)}">${UI.esc(c)}</button>`).join('')
      + '<button type="button" class="cchip" data-c="__other">Other</button>';
    el.modeSeg.innerHTML = (cfg.workModes || []).map((m) =>
      `<button type="button" data-m="${UI.esc(m)}">${UI.icon(MODE_ICONS[m] || 'briefcase', 14)}${UI.esc(m)}</button>`).join('');
  }

  function syncChips() {
    el.fieldChips.querySelectorAll('.fchip').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('is-on', b.dataset.f === F.field));
    const other = !!F.city && !KNOWN_CITIES.includes(F.city);
    el.cityChips.querySelectorAll('.cchip').forEach((b) => {
      b.classList.toggle('is-on', b.dataset.c === '__other' ? other : F.city === b.dataset.c);
    });
    el.modeSeg.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('is-on', b.dataset.m === F.workMode));
  }

  /* ---------- validation ---------- */
  function urlHint(node, val) {
    node.classList.remove('good', 'bad');
    if (!val) { node.textContent = node.dataset.orig; return; }
    if (URL_RE.test(val)) { node.textContent = 'Link looks good.'; node.classList.add('good'); }
    else { node.textContent = 'Hmm — a link should start with http:// or https://'; node.classList.add('bad'); }
  }
  function setErr(id) {
    const w = document.getElementById(id);
    w.classList.remove('is-invalid');
    void w.offsetWidth;
    w.classList.add('is-invalid');
  }
  function clearErr(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('is-invalid'); }
  function validate() {
    const errs = [];
    if (!F.title.trim()) errs.push('wTitle');
    if (!F.company.trim()) errs.push('wCompany');
    if (!F.field) errs.push('wField');
    if (!F.city) errs.push('wCity');
    if (!F.workMode) errs.push('wMode');
    if (!URL_RE.test(F.source.trim())) errs.push('wSource');
    if (!errs.length) return true;
    errs.forEach(setErr);
    UI.toast('A few required fields need attention.', 'error');
    document.getElementById(errs[0]).scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    return false;
  }

  /* ---------- submission history (real documents) ---------- */
  const ST = {
    pending: ['Pending review', 'st-pending'],
    approved: ['In review', 'st-pending'],
    'needs-changes': ['Needs changes', 'st-needs'],
    duplicate: ['Duplicate', 'st-rejected'],
    rejected: ['Rejected', 'st-rejected'],
    verified: ['Verified', 'st-verified']
  };
  const statusOf = (s) => (s.status === 'verified' && s.internshipId
    ? ['Published', 'st-published'] : (ST[s.status] || ST.pending));

  function renderHistory() {
    if (!mine.length) {
      el.histCount.innerHTML = signed ? ''
        : `<a href="${H('signin.html')}" style="color:var(--green)">Sign in</a> to track your submissions`;
      el.hist.innerHTML = `<div class="h-empty"><div class="e-ico">${UI.icon('send', 20)}</div>
        <h3>You haven't suggested an opportunity yet.</h3>
        <p>Sharing even one internship can help dozens of students discover a path they'd never find alone.</p></div>`;
      return;
    }
    el.histCount.textContent = `${mine.length} submission${mine.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
    el.hist.innerHTML = mine.map((s) => {
      const st = statusOf(s);
      const when = s.createdAt ? UI.fmtDate(s.createdAt) : 'just now';
      return `<div class="hrow${s.fresh ? ' is-new' : ''}"><span class="h-ico">${UI.icon('send', 16)}</span>
        <div class="h-main"><b>${UI.esc(s.title || 'Untitled')}</b>
        <span>${UI.esc(s.company || '—')} · submitted ${UI.esc(when)}</span></div>
        <span class="status ${st[1]}">${st[0]}</span></div>`;
    }).join('');
    mine.forEach((s) => { s.fresh = false; });
  }

  /* ---------- intro stat line: counts that really exist ---------- */
  async function loadStats() {
    let items = [];
    try { items = (await Internships.published(200)) || []; } catch (_) { items = []; }
    const cities = new Set(items.map((i) => i.city).filter(Boolean));
    const bits = [`${items.length} published internship${items.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
      `${cities.size} ${cities.size === 1 ? 'city' : 'cities'}`];
    if (signed) bits.push(`${mine.length} suggestion${mine.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} from you`);
    el.stat.textContent = bits.join(' · ');
  }

  /* ---------- events ---------- */
  el.fieldChips.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-f]'); if (!b) return;
    F.field = F.field === b.dataset.f ? '' : b.dataset.f;
    clearErr('wField'); syncChips(); preview();
  });
  el.cityChips.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-c]'); if (!b) return;
    if (b.dataset.c === '__other') {
      el.cityOtherWrap.hidden = false;
      F.city = el.cityOther.value.trim();
      el.cityOther.focus();
    } else {
      el.cityOtherWrap.hidden = true;
      el.cityOther.value = '';
      F.city = F.city === b.dataset.c ? '' : b.dataset.c;
    }
    clearErr('wCity'); syncChips(); preview();
  });
  el.cityOther.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    F.city = e.target.value.trim(); clearErr('wCity'); preview();
  });
  el.modeSeg.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-m]'); if (!b) return;
    F.workMode = b.dataset.m; clearErr('wMode'); syncChips(); preview();
  });

  const bind = (node, key, after) => node.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    F[key] = e.target.value; if (after) after(); preview();
  });
  bind(el.title, 'title', () => clearErr('wTitle'));
  bind(el.company, 'company', () => clearErr('wCompany'));
  bind(el.area, 'area'); bind(el.dur, 'dur'); bind(el.deadline, 'deadline'); bind(el.contact, 'contact');
  bind(el.apply, 'apply', () => urlHint(el.applyHint, F.apply));
  bind(el.source, 'source', () => { urlHint(el.sourceHint, F.source); clearErr('wSource'); });
  el.desc.addEventListener('input', () => {
    F.desc = el.desc.value;
    el.descCount.textContent = `${F.desc.length} / 600`;
    preview();
  });

  let imgT;
  el.img.addEventListener('input', () => {
    F.img = el.img.value.trim();
    clearTimeout(imgT);
    imgT = setTimeout(() => {
      el.imgHint.classList.remove('good', 'bad');
      if (!F.img) { imgOk = false; el.imgHint.textContent = el.imgHint.dataset.orig; preview(); return; }
      const probe = new Image();
      probe.onload = () => {
        imgOk = true; el.imgHint.textContent = 'Image loaded — see the preview.';
        el.imgHint.classList.add('good'); preview();
      };
      probe.onerror = () => {
        imgOk = false; el.imgHint.textContent = "We couldn't load that image — we'll use a clean fallback cover instead.";
        el.imgHint.classList.add('bad'); preview();
      };
      probe.src = F.img;
    }, 450);
    preview();
  });

  function resetForm() {
    Object.keys(F).forEach((k) => { F[k] = ''; });
    imgOk = false;
    [el.title, el.company, el.area, el.source, el.apply, el.desc, el.contact, el.img, el.cityOther]
      .forEach((n) => { n.value = ''; });
    el.dur.value = ''; el.deadline.value = '';
    el.descCount.textContent = '0 / 600';
    el.cityOtherWrap.hidden = true;
    [el.sourceHint, el.applyHint, el.imgHint].forEach((n) => {
      n.textContent = n.dataset.orig; n.classList.remove('good', 'bad');
    });
    REQUIRED.forEach(clearErr);
    syncChips(); preview();
  }

  el.form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!validate()) return;
    el.btn.classList.add('is-loading'); el.btn.disabled = true;
    const contact = F.contact.trim();
    const isMail = contact.includes('@');
    const payload = {
      title: F.title.trim(), company: F.company.trim(), field: F.field, city: F.city,
      area: F.area.trim(), workMode: F.workMode, sourceUrl: F.source.trim(),
      applicationUrl: F.apply.trim(), notes: F.desc.trim(), duration: F.dur,
      deadline: F.deadline ? new Date(F.deadline + 'T00:00').toISOString() : '',
      image: F.img.trim(),
      contactEmail: isMail ? contact : '', contactPhone: isMail ? '' : contact
    };
    const res = await Suggestions.submit(payload);
    el.btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); el.btn.disabled = false;
    if (!res.ok) { UI.toast("We couldn't send that. Please try again.", 'error'); return; }
    mine.unshift({ title: payload.title, company: payload.company, status: 'pending', createdAt: new Date(), fresh: true });
    renderHistory();
    el.done.classList.add('show');
  });

  el.again.addEventListener('click', () => {
    el.done.classList.remove('show');
    resetForm();
    el.formCol.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  });

  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
  preview();
  try { await Auth.ready; } catch (_) {}
  signed = !!Auth.profile;
  let cfg = {};
  try { cfg = (await Settings.load()) || {}; } catch (_) {}
  buildControls(cfg);
  syncChips();
  preview();
  if (signed) { try { mine = await Suggestions.mine(); } catch (_) { mine = []; } }
  renderHistory();
  loadStats();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

187	.drawer-backdrop.is-open{opacity:1}

189	.drawer.is-open{transform:none}

156	        <footer class="app-footer admin-footer">
157	          <span>© ${new Date().getFullYear()} InternHub Admin</span>
158	          <span>Signed in as ${UI.esc(p ? p.email : '—')}</span>
159	        </footer>
160	      </div>
161	    </div>`;
162	  }
163	
164	  function wire(mode) {
165	    const app = document.getElementById('app');
166	    const sidenav = document.getElementById('sidenav');
167	    const mq = matchMedia('(max-width: 960px)');
168	
169	    if (!mq.matches && localStorage.getItem(LS) === '1') app.classList.add('is-collapsed');
170	
171	    const toggleCollapse = () => {
172	      if (mq.matches) {
173	        const open = app.classList.toggle('nav-open');
174	        document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
175	      } else {
176	        const c = app.classList.toggle('is-collapsed');
177	        localStorage.setItem(LS, c ? '1' : '0');
178	      }
179	    };
180	    const openDrawer = () => { app.classList.add('nav-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; };
181	    const closeDrawer = () => { app.classList.remove('nav-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
182	
183	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-collapse]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', toggleCollapse));
184	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-scrim-open]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', openDrawer));
185	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-scrim]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer));
186	    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer(); });
187	    mq.addEventListener('change', () => { closeDrawer(); });
188	
189	    // Account dropdown
190	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-btn]').forEach((btn) => {
191	      const pop = btn.parentElement.querySelector('[data-menu-pop]');
192	      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
193	        e.stopPropagation();
194	        const open = pop.classList.toggle('is-open');
195	        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
196	      });
197	      document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!pop.contains(e.target)) { pop.classList.remove('is-open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); } });
198	    });
199	    app.querySelectorAll('[data-signout]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => Auth.signOut()));
200	
201	    // Page title
202	    const navKey = document.body.dataset.nav;
203	    const items = mode === 'admin' ? ADMIN_NAV : STUDENT_NAV;
204	    const titleEl = app.querySelector('[data-page-title]');
205	    const cur = items.find((i) => i.key === navKey);
206	    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = cur ? cur.label : '';
207	  }
208	
209	  async function initFooterAndReveals() {
210	    UI.initReveals(document.getElementById('view-slot') || document);
211	  }
212	
213	  async function init() {
214	    const mode = document.body.dataset.app;
215	    if (!mode) return; // landing/auth pages manage their own chrome
216	    await Auth.ready;
217	
218	    const view = document.getElementById('view');
219	    const sideBlocks = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-side]')];
220	    const active = document.body.dataset.nav || '';
221	    document.body.innerHTML = mode === 'admin' ? buildAdmin(active) : buildStudent(active);
222	    const slot = document.getElementById('view-slot');
223	    // content injected by page script into #view later is fine — the node survives the rebuild
224	    if (view && view.children.length) slot.appendChild(view);
225	    const extra = document.getElementById('sidenav-extra');
226	    if (extra) sideBlocks.forEach((el) => extra.appendChild(el));
227	
228	    wire(mode);
229	
230	    if (mode === 'student' && Auth.profile) {
231	      Notifications.load().then(() => NotifyUI.init());
232	      NotifyUI.render(Notifications.list);
233	      NotifyUI.updateBadge();
234	      if (typeof Saved !== 'undefined') {
235	        Saved.load().then(syncSavedBadge);
236	        document.addEventListener('saved:changed', syncSavedBadge);
237	      }
238	    }
239	    initFooterAndReveals();
240	    window.__shellReady = true;
241	    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shell:ready'));
242	  }
243	
244	  // Pages using the shared frame run their logic after the shell has
245	  // rebuilt the DOM. Landing/auth pages (no data-app) run immediately.
246	  window.onReady = function (cb) {
247	    if (!document.body.dataset.app || window.__shellReady) cb();
248	    else document.addEventListener('shell:ready', cb, { once: true });
249	  };
250	
251	  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
252	  return { init, STUDENT_NAV, ADMIN_NAV, syncSavedBadge, markNav };
253	})();

/* ============================================================
   ACCOUNT · profile header, stacked pcard sections, field grid,
   boxed notification switches, account actions.
   Restored from mandatory design/student_pages/account(profile).html
   Preference chips reuse .fchips/.fchip and the work-mode control
   reuses .mode-seg so one component serves both pages.
   ============================================================ */
.profile-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:28px}
.profile-avatar{width:88px;height:88px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 32px var(--fs);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
.profile-info{flex:1;min-width:200px}
.profile-info h1{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,30px);margin-bottom:4px}
.profile-info p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.profile-info .member{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em}

.pcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:22px;margin-bottom:16px;scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px)}
.pcard-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.pcard-head h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}
.pcard-head .eyebrow{margin-left:auto;color:var(--mut)}
.field-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}
.field-grid .field{margin-bottom:0}
.field-grid .span-full{grid-column:1/-1}
.pcard .field > label{font:600 12.5px var(--fs);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--ink)}
.input:disabled,.select:disabled,.textarea:disabled{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--dim);cursor:not-allowed}

.switch-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.switch-group .switch{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 13px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:10px;transition:border-color .2s}
.switch-group .switch:hover{border-color:var(--green)}
.switch-group .sw-label{flex:1;min-width:0}
.switch-group .sw-label b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px}
.switch-group .sw-label span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}

.actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.account-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

@media (max-width:640px){
  .profile-header{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
  .profile-avatar{margin:0 auto}
  .field-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

window.onReady(async function () {
  const p = await Auth.requireSignedIn();
  if (!p) return;

  let cfg = {}; try { cfg = (await Settings.load()) || {}; } catch (_) {}

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  const MODE_ICONS = { 'On-site': 'building', 'Hybrid': 'users', 'Remote': 'globe' };

  // ---- profile header ----
  $('pfAvatar').textContent = UI.initials(p.displayName);
  $('pfName').textContent = p.displayName || 'Your profile';
  const sub = [p.course ? p.course + ' student' : '', p.institution].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  if (sub) $('pfSub').textContent = sub;
  if (p.createdAt) {
    $('pfSince').textContent = 'Member since ' + p.createdAt.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
    $('pfSince').hidden = false;
  }

  // ---- personal information ----
  const form = $('personalForm');
  // keep a stored level that the design's list doesn't offer, so saving never erases it
  const savedLevel = p.academicLevel || '';
  const levelOpts = savedLevel && !LEVELS.includes(savedLevel) ? [savedLevel, ...LEVELS] : LEVELS;
  $('fLevel').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', levelOpts.map((v) => `<option>${UI.esc(v)}</option>`).join(''));
  function fill() {
    $('fName').value = p.displayName || '';
    $('fEmail').value = p.email || '';
    $('fPhone').value = p.phone || '';
    $('fInst').value = p.institution || '';
    $('fCourse').value = p.course || '';
    $('fLevel').value = savedLevel;
    $('fBio').value = p.bio || '';
  }
  fill();
  form.addEventListener('reset', () => requestAnimationFrame(fill));   // restore saved values, not blanks
  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const name = $('fName').value.trim();
    $('fName').closest('.field').classList.toggle('is-invalid', !name);
    if (!name) return;
    const saved = $('profileSaved'); saved.textContent = 'Saving…';
    const res = await Auth.updateProfile({
      displayName: name, phone: $('fPhone').value.trim(), institution: $('fInst').value.trim(),
      course: $('fCourse').value.trim(), academicLevel: $('fLevel').value, bio: $('fBio').value.trim()
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      saved.textContent = 'Saved'; setTimeout(() => { saved.textContent = ''; }, 2500);
      $('pfAvatar').textContent = UI.initials(name);
      $('pfName').textContent = name;
      const sub2 = [$('fCourse').value.trim() ? $('fCourse').value.trim() + ' student' : '', $('fInst').value.trim()].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      if (sub2) $('pfSub').textContent = sub2;
      UI.toast('Profile updated');
    } else { saved.textContent = ''; UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not save', 'error'); }
  });

Modal implementation (reuses ui.css `.modal-backdrop/.modal/.modal-title/.modal-msg/.modal-actions/.field/.input/.field-err`):

```js
  function formModal(opts) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const bd = document.createElement('div');
      bd.className = 'modal-backdrop';
      bd.innerHTML = `<div class="modal modal-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${UI.esc(opts.title)}">
        <h3 class="modal-title">${UI.esc(opts.title)}</h3>
        <p class="modal-msg">${UI.esc(opts.message || '')}</p>
        <form novalidate>${opts.fields.map((f, i) => `
          <div class="field"><label for="fm${i}">${UI.esc(f.label)}</label>
            <input class="input" id="fm${i}" type="${f.type}" autocomplete="${f.auto}"${f.required ? ' required' : ''}>
            <span class="field-err">${UI.esc(f.err)}</span></div>`).join('')}
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn ${opts.danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}">${UI.esc(opts.confirmLabel)}</button>
        </div></form></div>`;
      document.body.appendChild(bd);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { bd.classList.add('is-open'); bd.querySelector('input')?.focus(); });
      const inputs = [...bd.querySelectorAll('input')];
      const close = (v) => { bd.classList.remove('is-open'); setTimeout(() => bd.remove(), 240); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); resolve(v); };
      const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(null); };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      bd.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === bd || e.target.closest('[data-act="cancel"]')) close(null); });
      bd.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        let ok = true;
        opts.fields.forEach((f, i) => {
          const good = f.validate ? f.validate(inputs[i].value, inputs) : !!inputs[i].value.trim();
          inputs[i].closest('.field').classList.toggle('is-invalid', !good);
          if (!good) ok = false;
        });
        if (!ok) return;
        close(inputs.map((i) => i.value));
      });
    });
  }
```

    if (res.ok) { notifState = next; msg.textContent = 'Saved'; setTimeout(() => { msg.textContent = ''; }, 2500); UI.toast('Notification settings saved'); }
    else { msg.textContent = ''; UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not save', 'error'); }

  // ---- account · confirmation modals ----
  function formModal(o) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const bd = document.createElement('div');
      bd.className = 'modal-backdrop';
      bd.innerHTML = `<div class="modal modal-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${UI.esc(o.title)}">
        <h3 class="modal-title">${UI.esc(o.title)}</h3>
        <p class="modal-msg">${UI.esc(o.message || '')}</p>
        <form novalidate>${o.fields.map((f, i) => `
          <div class="field"><label for="fm${i}">${UI.esc(f.label)}</label>
            <input class="input" id="fm${i}" type="${f.type}" autocomplete="${f.auto}">
            <span class="field-err">${UI.esc(f.err)}</span></div>`).join('')}
          <div class="modal-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>
            <button type="submit" class="btn ${o.danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}">${UI.esc(o.confirmLabel)}</button>
          </div></form></div>`;
      document.body.appendChild(bd);
      const inputs = [...bd.querySelectorAll('input')];
      const close = (v) => {
        bd.classList.remove('is-open');
        setTimeout(() => bd.remove(), 240);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        resolve(v);
      };
      const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(null); };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { bd.classList.add('is-open'); if (inputs[0]) inputs[0].focus(); });
      bd.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === bd || (e.target.closest('[data-act="cancel"]'))) close(null);
      });
      bd.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        let ok = true;
        o.fields.forEach((f, i) => {
          const good = f.validate ? f.validate(inputs[i].value, inputs) : !!inputs[i].value.trim();
          inputs[i].closest('.field').classList.toggle('is-invalid', !good);
          if (!good) ok = false;
        });
        if (ok) close(inputs.map((i) => i.value));
      });
    });
  }
  const isEmail = (v) => /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(v.trim());
  function emailCredential(pw) { return firebase.auth.EmailAuthProvider.credential(firebase.auth.currentUser.email, pw); }

  $('changePwBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const v = await formModal({
      title: 'Change password', confirmLabel: 'Update password',
      message: "Confirm your current password, then choose a new one. You'll stay signed in on this device.",
      fields: [
        { label: 'Current password', type: 'password', auto: 'current-password', err: 'Enter your current password.' },
        { label: 'New password', type: 'password', auto: 'new-password', err: 'Use at least 6 characters.', validate: (x) => x.length >= 6 },
        { label: 'Confirm new password', type: 'password', auto: 'new-password', err: "Passwords don't match.", validate: (x, all) => !!x && x === all[1].value }
      ]
    });
    if (!v) return;
    const res = await Auth.changePassword(emailCredential(v[0]), v[1]);
    if (res.ok) UI.toast('Password updated');
    else UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not update password', 'error');
  });

  $('changeEmailBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const v = await formModal({
      title: 'Change email', confirmLabel: 'Update email',
      message: 'Your sign-in address changes immediately — confirm it with your current password.',
      fields: [
        { label: 'New email', type: 'email', auto: 'email', err: 'Enter a valid email.', validate: isEmail },
        { label: 'Your password', type: 'password', auto: 'current-password', err: 'Confirm with your password.' }
      ]
    });
    if (!v) return;
    const res = await Auth.changeEmail(emailCredential(v[1]), v[0].trim());
    if (res.ok) { $('fEmail').value = v[0].trim(); UI.toast('Email updated — check your inbox to verify.'); }
    else UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not update email', 'error');
  });

  $('exportBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    UI.toast('Preparing your export…');
    const data = await Auth.exportData();
    if (!data) { UI.toast('Nothing to export yet.', 'error'); return; }
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'internhub-my-data.json';
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  });

  $('deleteAccBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const v = await formModal({
      title: 'Delete account', confirmLabel: 'Delete my account', danger: true,
      message: 'This action cannot be undone. All your data, saved internships and preferences will be permanently removed.',
      fields: [{ label: 'Your password', type: 'password', auto: 'current-password', err: 'Confirm with your password.' }]
    });
    if (!v) return;
    const res = await Auth.deleteAccount(v[0]);
    if (res.ok) window.location.href = H('index.html') + '?deleted=1';
    else UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not delete account', 'error');
  });

  if (location.hash.length > 1) {
    const target = document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));
    if (target) target.scrollIntoView();
  }
});

#### Thinking

Found it: **line 13** — a 2500 ms timeout force-settles `ready` even if the auth state hasn't resolved. If Firestore's `users/{uid}.get()` + `getIdTokenResult()` take longer than 2.5 s on a cold load, `ready` resolves while `profile` is still null → `requireSignedIn()` redirects. That's a pre-existing latent bug in the auth gate (not something I introduced), and it explains why account.html bounced while signin.html (which polls later) showed a profile.

But actually there's something more subtle: on a cold load, `onAuthStateChanged` fires quickly with the persisted user; then `await loadProfile(...)` needs a Firestore round-trip (cold = can exceed 2.5s). So yes — likely the 2.5s force-settle.

Is this a real user-facing bug? Yes: a signed-in student on a slow connection gets bounced to the sign-in page even though they're authenticated. That's a §14 "preserve the functional system" concern and a genuine bug worth fixing (bug fixes are explicitly allowed). But careful: the fix must not break the "file:// origins can lag" intent or hang forever.

Minimal robust fix: make `requireSignedIn` wait for the auth state to actually settle, not just the force-settled timer. Options:
(a) Track a separate `authResolved` promise that only settles when `onAuthStateChanged` has run its first callback (either profile or explicit null). The 2500ms timeout keeps `ready` non-blocking for UI purposes, but the gate needs certainty.
(b) In `requireSignedIn`, if `!profile && firebase.auth().currentUser` → wait for the current user's profile to load.

Cleanest minimal fix: add a `resolved` promise (settle only in onAuthStateChanged) and have `requireSignedIn`/`requireAdmin` await `resolved` with a bounded fallback. But `loadProfile` is async inside the callback; `settle()` is called at the end, so `resolved` settling means profile is loaded (or genuinely signed out). The only unbounded case: `onAuthStateChanged` never fires (file:// weirdness). Guard with a longer timeout inside the gate (e.g. 10 s) then treat as signed out.

Hmm — but is this in scope right now? It's a blocking issue for verifying every auth-gated page (account, dashboard, browse, saved, and all admin pages). Fixing it is a bug fix with clear value and low blast radius. Let me implement it carefully:

Then:

  const forceSettle = (ms) => setTimeout(() => { if (!settled) { settled = true; settle(); } }, ms);

Simplest correct approach: make the timeout check for a live user:

```js
  // Never let a slow first read treat a signed-in session as signed-out:
  // anonymous loads settle early, real sessions get a long backstop.
  const backstop = (delay) => setTimeout(() => { if (!settled) { settled = true; settle(); } }, delay);
  firebaseAuth.onAuthStateChanged((u) => { if (u) backstop(15000); });
  backstop(2500);
```
Both timers armed; for a signed-in user the 2500 fires first → still broken.

OK, do it properly: don't settle early if there is a current user *or if the auth callback has already told us there is one*:

```js
  setTimeout(() => {
    // A live session must not be misread as signed-out because the first
    // Firestore read is slow; anonymous loads can settle early.
    if (!settled && !firebaseAuth.currentUser) { settled = true; settle(); }
  }, 2500);
```
Plus keep the natural settle at the end of onAuthStateChanged (which does settle after loadProfile). If a signed-in user's loadProfile hangs forever, `ready` never resolves — worst case the page never renders. Acceptable? Firestore reads have their own timeouts and `loadProfile` catches errors, so `onAuthStateChanged` will settle it in practice. The 2500 ms early-settle only matters if the auth callback never fires at all — in which case `firebaseAuth.currentUser` would also be null (it's populated synchronously from persistence, before the callback...). Hmm, actually `firebase.auth().currentUser` IS populated synchronously from storage shortly after init; if it's non-null, the callback will fire. So: if `currentUser` is non-null → the callback will fire and settle → waiting is safe. 

So the minimal fix is exactly that one-line change, no extra timers. And for the pathological case (currentUser non-null but callback never fires — essentially impossible with compat SDK), pages would hang; the previous code would have bounced them to signin anyway.
