Now I have both. Let me build the page-by-page comparison checklist (§01) for the Dashboard.

**Spec structure (`.main`):**
1. `.hero` — eyebrow date line, `h1.display` greeting, `.hero-sub`, and `.hero-aside` with TWO `.stat` cards: (a) bookmark icon + "SAVED" lbl + "<n> saved" val; (b) "PROFILE STRENGTH" lbl + `.bar` progress (no percentage text, just a bar with 70% width).
   - Current: hero has `.dash-actions` (two buttons "Find internships" / "Suggest a role") inside the left column, `.hero-aside` with `.hstat` × 2 (Saved w/ icon; Profile strength with `%` val + `.pbar`). The hero-sub default text differs (fine, overwritten at runtime).
   - **Difference:** current adds `.dash-actions` buttons in the hero — the spec has NO buttons there. §11 says don't remove elements... but §12 says don't invent new layouts. The spec's hero has no action buttons. Hmm, careful: these are functional conveniences. The directive: "If the current implementation is different from the corresponding page inside MANDATORY DESIGN, the MANDATORY DESIGN version wins." So remove `.dash-actions` from the hero. But wait — is there a risk of losing functionality? The CTA section at the bottom links to suggest; the sidebar/topbar link to browse. So no functionality is lost. And earlier in this project (per the summary) similar removals were made on other pages and logged as "reconciliations owed". I'll do the same and report it.

   Actually hold on. Let me check what the app's shared `.hero` CSS in app.css looks like vs the spec's `.hero`. The spec hero: gradient surface→#f5f8f4, border, radius 16, padding 28px 30px, radial `::before` glow top-right. Also `.stat` cards with `.ico` mint square. Need to compare with app.css `.hero`/`.hstat`. Let me look at app.css for hero.

2. `.chips` (field tablist, horizontally scrollable) — spec `.chips` with `.chip.on` = solid green + white text + count in mono. Current: `.chips is-scroll` + `.chip.is-on` — need to verify app.css `.chip.is-on` is solid green (I believe `.chip` in app.css is the fchip mint style!). Careful: In app.css, `.fchip` is mint; `.chip` (the filter chip row) may be different. Need to check.

3. `.toolbar` — search + sort select + Filters button with `.fcount`. Current matches (uses `.toolbar toolbar-panel`, `.search-field`, `.select`, `#filterBtn`, `#fCount`). Need CSS comparison: spec `.toolbar` has `background:var(--surface)` + border + radius 14 + padding 10 + shadow sh-1, and `.search` is borderless inline (the input has no border — the toolbar itself is the container). Current uses `.search-field` which in app.css probably has its own border/padding. Visual difference to check.

4. `.filters` panel — spec uses grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr animated drawer with `.f-inner` grid `repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr))`, gap 20, `.fgroup h4` mono uppercase, `.chk-row` with `.chk` pill checkboxes, `.select` for city (with the CSS chevron), `.switch` toggles (34×20 track), `.linklike` reset. Current: `.fdrawer`/`.fdrawer-in`/`.fgroup`/`.chk-pill`/`.switch` — likely equivalent. Verify computed styles.

5. `.results-head` — eyebrow `#resultsLabel` + `.view-note`. Current matches.

6. `.grid` of `.card-int` cards — spec's card: `.ci-media` 150px with img, `.ci-badges` (top-left), `.save-btn` (top-right circle), `.ci-city` (bottom-left pill over image), `.ci-body` (h3, `.ci-co`, `.ci-meta` list of 3 pills), `.ci-foot` (`.ci-dead` + Details ghost button).

/* ============================================================
   ACCOUNT · profile header, stacked pcard sections, field grid,
   boxed notification switches, account actions.
   Restored from mandatory design/student_pages/account(profile).html
   Preference chips reuse .fchips/.fchip and the work-mode control
   reuses .mode-seg so one component serves both pages.
   ============================================================ */
.profile-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:28px}
.profile-avatar{width:88px;height:88px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 32px var(--fs);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
.profile-info{flex:1;min-width:200px}
.profile-info h1{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,30px);margin-bottom:4px}
.profile-info p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.profile-info .member{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--green-soft);color:var(--green-ink);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em}

.pcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:22px;margin-bottom:16px;scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px)}
.pcard-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.pcard-head h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}
.pcard-head .eyebrow{margin-left:auto;color:var(--mut)}
.field-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}
.field-grid .field{margin-bottom:0}
.field-grid .span-full{grid-column:1/-1}
.pcard .field > label{font:600 12.5px var(--fs);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--ink)}
.input:disabled,.select:disabled,.textarea:disabled{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--dim);cursor:not-allowed}

.switch-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.switch-group .switch{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 13px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:10px;transition:border-color .2s}
.switch-group .switch:hover{border-color:var(--green)}
.switch-group .sw-label{flex:1;min-width:0}
.switch-group .sw-label b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px}
.switch-group .sw-label span{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}

.actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.account-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

@media (max-width:640px){
  .profile-header{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
  .profile-avatar{margin:0 auto}
  .field-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

186	  function initReveals(root = document) {
187	    const items = root.querySelectorAll('[data-rev]:not(.in)');
188	    if (!items.length) return;
189	    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window) || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
190	      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('in'));
191	      return;
192	    }
193	    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
194	      entries.forEach((e) => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
195	    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -6% 0px' });
196	    items.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
197	  }

  const p = await Auth.requireSignedIn();
  if (!p) return;

  let cfg = {}; try { cfg = (await Settings.load()) || {}; } catch (_) {}

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const LEVELS = ['Year 1', 'Year 2', 'Year 3', 'Year 4', "Master's", 'Graduate'];
  const MODE_ICONS = { 'On-site': 'building', 'Hybrid': 'users', 'Remote': 'globe' };
  const savedLevel = p.academicLevel || '';

  // ---- profile header ----
  $('pfAvatar').textContent = UI.initials(p.displayName);
  $('pfName').textContent = p.displayName || 'Your profile';
  const since = p.createdAt instanceof Date && !isNaN(p.createdAt)
    ? p.createdAt.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }) : '';
  if (since) { $('pfSince').textContent = 'Member since ' + since; $('pfSince').hidden = false; }

  // ---- personal information ----
  const form = $('personalForm');
  // a level saved before this design stays selectable, so saving can't silently erase it
  const opts = savedLevel && !LEVELS.includes(savedLevel) ? [savedLevel].concat(LEVELS) : LEVELS;
  $('fLevel').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', opts.map((v) => `<option>${UI.esc(v)}</option>`).join(''));
  function fill() {
    $('fName').value = p.displayName || '';
    $('fEmail').value = p.email || '';
    $('fPhone').value = p.phone || '';
    $('fInst').value = p.institution || '';
    $('fCourse').value = p.course || '';
    $('fLevel').value = savedLevel;
    $('fBio').value = p.bio || '';
  }
  fill();
  // native reset blanks every field — return to the saved values instead
  form.addEventListener('reset', () => requestAnimationFrame(fill));
  $('fName').addEventListener('input', () => $('fName').closest('.field').classList.remove('is-invalid'));
  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const name = $('fName').value.trim();
    $('fName').closest('.field').classList.toggle('is-invalid', !name);
    if (!name) return;
    const saved = $('profileSaved');
    saved.textContent = 'Saving…';
    const res = await Auth.updateProfile({
      displayName: name, phone: $('fPhone').value.trim(), institution: $('fInst').value.trim(),
      course: $('fCourse').value.trim(), academicLevel: $('fLevel').value, bio: $('fBio').value.trim()
    });
    if (!res.ok) { saved.textContent = ''; UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not save', 'error'); return; }
    saved.textContent = 'Saved'; setTimeout(() => { saved.textContent = ''; }, 2500);
    $('pfAvatar').textContent = UI.initials(name);
    $('pfName').textContent = name;
    const sub = [p.course ? p.course + ' student' : '', p.institution].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    if (sub) $('pfSub').textContent = sub;
    UI.toast('Profile updated');
  });

  // ---- internship preferences ----
  const pref = {
    fields: new Set(p.preferences && p.preferences.fields || []),
    locations: new Set(p.preferences && p.preferences.locations || []),
    mode: (p.preferences && p.preferences.workModes || [])[0] || ''
  };
  function chipSet(el, values, isOn) {
    el.innerHTML = values.length
      ? values.map((v) => `<button type="button" class="fchip${isOn(v) ? ' is-on' : ''}" data-v="${UI.esc(v)}" aria-pressed="${isOn(v)}">${UI.esc(v)}</button>`).join('')
      : '<p class="hint">No options available yet.</p>';
  }
  function drawPrefs() {
    chipSet($('prefFields'), cfg.fields || [], (v) => pref.fields.has(v));
    chipSet($('prefLocs'), cfg.locations || [], (v) => pref.locations.has(v));
    const modes = cfg.workModes || [];
    $('prefMode').innerHTML = modes.length
      ? modes.map((m) => `<button type="button" data-m="${UI.esc(m)}"${pref.mode === m ? ' class="is-on"' : ''}>${UI.icon(MODE_ICONS[m] || 'briefcase', 14)}${UI.esc(m)}</button>`).join('')
      : '';
  }
  drawPrefs();
  function toggleSet(set, elId, cls) {
    $(elId).addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const c = e.target.closest('.' + cls); if (!c) return;
      const v = c.dataset.v;
      set.has(v) ? set.delete(v) : set.add(v);
      drawPrefs();
    });
  }
  toggleSet(pref.fields, 'prefFields', 'fchip');
  toggleSet(pref.locations, 'prefLocs', 'fchip');
  $('prefMode').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
    pref.mode = pref.mode === b.dataset.m ? '' : b.dataset.m;
    drawPrefs();
  });
  $('savePrefs').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const msg = $('prefsSaved'); msg.textContent = 'Saving…';
    const res = await Auth.updateProfile({ preferences: {
      ...(p.preferences || {}), fields: [...pref.fields], locations: [...pref.locations],
      workModes: pref.mode ? [pref.mode] : [] } });
    if (res.ok) { msg.textContent = 'Saved'; setTimeout(() => { msg.textContent = ''; }, 2500); UI.toast('Preferences saved'); }
    else { msg.textContent = ''; UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not save', 'error'); }
  });

  // ---- notifications ----
  let notifState = { ...(p.notifications || {}) };
  const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.switch-group input[data-n]')];
  boxes.forEach((b) => { b.checked = !!notifState[b.dataset.n]; });
  $('saveNotifs').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const msg = $('notifsSaved'); msg.textContent = 'Saving…';
    const next = { ...notifState };
    boxes.forEach((b) => { next[b.dataset.n] = b.checked; });
    const res = await Auth.updateProfile({ notifications: next });
    if (res.ok) { notifState = next; msg.textContent = 'Saved'; setTimeout(() => { msg.textContent = ''; }, 2500); UI.toast('Notification settings saved'); }
    else { msg.textContent = ''; UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not save', 'error'); }
  });

  // ---- account · confirmation modals ----
  function formModal(o) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const bd = document.createElement('div');
      bd.className = 'modal-backdrop';
      bd.innerHTML = `<div class="modal modal-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${UI.esc(o.title)}">
        <h3 class="modal-title">${UI.esc(o.title)}</h3>
        <p class="modal-msg">${UI.esc(o.message || '')}</p>
        <form novalidate>${o.fields.map((f, i) => `
          <div class="field"><label for="fm${i}">${UI.esc(f.label)}</label>
            <input class="input" id="fm${i}" type="${f.type}" autocomplete="${f.auto}">
            <span class="field-err">${UI.esc(f.err)}</span></div>`).join('')}
          <div class="modal-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button>
            <button type="submit" class="btn ${o.danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}">${UI.esc(o.confirmLabel)}</button>
          </div></form></div>`;
      document.body.appendChild(bd);
      const inputs = [...bd.querySelectorAll('input')];
      const close = (v) => {
        bd.classList.remove('is-open');
        setTimeout(() => bd.remove(), 240);
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        resolve(v);
      };
      const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(null); };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { bd.classList.add('is-open'); if (inputs[0]) inputs[0].focus(); });
      bd.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === bd || (e.target.closest('[data-act="cancel"]'))) close(null);
      });
      bd.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        let ok = true;
        o.fields.forEach((f, i) => {
          const good = f.validate ? f.validate(inputs[i].value, inputs) : !!inputs[i].value.trim();
          inputs[i].closest('.field').classList.toggle('is-invalid', !good);
          if (!good) ok = false;
        });
        if (ok) close(inputs.map((i) => i.value));
      });
    });
  }
  const isEmail = (v) => /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(v.trim());
  function emailCredential(pw) { return firebase.auth.EmailAuthProvider.credential(firebase.auth.currentUser.email, pw); }

  $('changePwBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const v = await formModal({
      title: 'Change password', confirmLabel: 'Update password',
      message: "Confirm your current password, then choose a new one. You'll stay signed in on this device.",
      fields: [
        { label: 'Current password', type: 'password', auto: 'current-password', err: 'Enter your current password.' },
        { label: 'New password', type: 'password', auto: 'new-password', err: 'Use at least 6 characters.', validate: (x) => x.length >= 6 },
        { label: 'Confirm new password', type: 'password', auto: 'new-password', err: "Passwords don't match.", validate: (x, all) => !!x && x === all[1].value }
      ]
    });
    if (!v) return;
    const res = await Auth.changePassword(emailCredential(v[0]), v[1]);
    if (res.ok) UI.toast('Password updated');
    else UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not update password', 'error');
  });

  $('changeEmailBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const v = await formModal({
      title: 'Change email', confirmLabel: 'Update email',
      message: 'Your sign-in address changes immediately — confirm it with your current password.',
      fields: [
        { label: 'New email', type: 'email', auto: 'email', err: 'Enter a valid email.', validate: isEmail },
        { label: 'Your password', type: 'password', auto: 'current-password', err: 'Confirm with your password.' }
      ]
    });
    if (!v) return;
    const res = await Auth.changeEmail(emailCredential(v[1]), v[0].trim());
    if (res.ok) { $('fEmail').value = v[0].trim(); UI.toast('Email updated — check your inbox to verify.'); }
    else UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not update email', 'error');
  });

  $('exportBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    UI.toast('Preparing your export…');
    const data = await Auth.exportData();
    if (!data) { UI.toast('Nothing to export yet.', 'error'); return; }
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'internhub-my-data.json';
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  });

  $('deleteAccBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const v = await formModal({
      title: 'Delete account', confirmLabel: 'Delete my account', danger: true,
      message: 'This action cannot be undone. All your data, saved internships and preferences will be permanently removed.',
      fields: [{ label: 'Your password', type: 'password', auto: 'current-password', err: 'Confirm with your password.' }]
    });
    if (!v) return;
    const res = await Auth.deleteAccount(v[0]);
    if (res.ok) window.location.href = H('index.html') + '?deleted=1';
    else UI.toast(res.error || 'Could not delete account', 'error');
  });

  if (location.hash.length > 1) {
    const target = document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));
    if (target) target.scrollIntoView();
  }
});

4	metadata:
5	  type: project
6	---
7	
8	Visual QA of the InternHub deliverable (`Desktop/internship universe/updated project/`) has three recurring environment constraints that block the naive "navigate + screenshot every page" approach.
9	
10	**Why:** These have bitten multiple sessions. The browser-use in-app viewport is fixed at ~531px and cannot be resized; `take_screenshot` fails with `NATIVE_BROWSER_VIEWPORT_UNAVAILABLE` when the in-app browser is not focused/visible (only `take_snapshot` and `evaluate_script` keep working); and the student/admin app pages are auth-gated — they redirect to `signin.html?next=<page>` when signed out, and credentials must never be invented.
11	
12	**How to apply:**
13	- Verify styling with `evaluate_script` + `getComputedStyle` (returns exact rgb values) instead of screenshots. This is actually more precise for confirming token/color changes.
14	- Desktop and tablet widths cannot be rendered at all (viewport stuck at 531px = the `max-width:860px` mobile/drawer regime). Confirm those layouts by reading the CSS media queries, and say so explicitly rather than claiming a full responsive pass.
15	- To test the auth-gated app shell without logging in: `internship.html` renders the real student shell (green sidebar) while signed out — use it as a live shell sample. Or inject the shell markup plus a `<link>` to the real `assets/css/app.css` into any live page and read computed styles.
16	- Serve locally with `python -m http.server <port>` from the `internship universe` root (note: `python`, not `python3`, on this Windows box); the deliverable is then at `/<percent-encoded updated project>/...`. Stop stray servers when done.
17	
18	Related: [[internhub-rebuild-state]], [[internhub-homepage-white-preference]].

278	    const cities = [...new Set(ALL.map((it) => it.city).filter(Boolean))].sort();
279	    $('citySelect').innerHTML = ['All cities'].concat(cities)
280	      .map((c) => `<option${c === state.city ? ' selected' : ''}>${UI.esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
281	  }
282	
283	  function filterCount() {
284	    return state.modes.length + (state.verOnly ? 1 : 0) + (state.incClosed ? 1 : 0) + (state.city !== 'All cities' ? 1 : 0);
285	  }
286	  function renderFCount() {
287	    const n = filterCount();
288	    $('fCount').hidden = !n;
289	    $('fCount').textContent = n;
290	  }
291	
292	  function render() {
293	    const list = filtered();
294	    grid.innerHTML = Rows.grid(list);
295	
296	    const none = !list.length;
297	    $('empty').hidden = !none;
298	    if (none) {
299	      $('emptyTitle').textContent = state.view === 'saved' ? 'No saved internships yet' : 'No internships match';
300	      $('emptyText').textContent = state.view === 'saved'
301	        ? 'Save internships you like and this space will track their deadlines for you.'
302	        : 'Try adjusting your search or filters — new verified roles are added regularly.';
303	    }
304	
305	    const q = state.q.trim();
306	    $('resultsLabel').textContent = state.view === 'saved'
307	      ? `${list.length} SAVED`
308	      : `${list.length} OPEN ROLE${list.length === 1 ? '' : 'S'}${q ? ` · "${q.toUpperCase()}"` : ''}`;
309	    $('viewNote').hidden = state.view !== 'saved';
310	    $('savedPanel').hidden = state.view === 'saved';
311	
312	    const savedItems = ALL.filter((it) => Saved.has(it.id));
313	    $('savedCount').textContent = Saved.ids.size;
314	    const closing = savedItems.filter((it) => { const d = UI.daysUntil(it.deadline); return d !== null && d >= 0 && d <= 7; }).length;
315	    const sub = $('heroSub');
316	    if (!savedItems.length) sub.textContent = 'No deadlines on your radar yet — save internships to track them here.';
317	    else if (closing) sub.textContent = `${closing} of your saved internship${closing > 1 ? 's' : ''} close${closing > 1 ? '' : 's'} within 7 days — review them below.`;
318	    else sub.textContent = `You're tracking ${savedItems.length} internship${savedItems.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}. Nice pace — keep exploring.`;
319	
320	    Shell.syncSavedBadge();
321	  }
322	
323	  function setView(view) {
324	    state.view = view;
325	    Shell.markNav(view === 'saved' ? 'saved' : 'dashboard');
326	    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
327	    if (view === 'saved') url.searchParams.set('view', 'saved'); else url.searchParams.delete('view');
328	    history.replaceState(null, '', url);
329	    render();
330	  }
331	
332	  function resetFilters() {
333	    state.q = ''; state.field = 'All fields'; state.modes = []; state.city = 'All cities';
334	    state.verOnly = false; state.incClosed = false;
335	    $('searchInput').value = ''; $('citySelect').value = 'All cities';
336	    $('verOnly').checked = false; $('incClosed').checked = false;
337	    document.querySelectorAll('.modeChk').forEach((c) => { c.checked = false; });
338	    renderChips(); renderFCount(); render();
339	  }
340	
341	  // control events
342	  let deb;
343	  $('searchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
344	    clearTimeout(deb);
345	    deb = setTimeout(() => { state.q = e.target.value; render(); }, 160);
346	  });
347	  $('sortSelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.sort = e.target.value; render(); });
348	  $('chips').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
349	    const c = e.target.closest('[data-chip]');
350	    if (!c) return;
351	    state.field = c.dataset.chip; renderChips(); render();
352	  });
353	  $('modeRow').addEventListener('change', () => {
354	    state.modes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.modeChk:checked')].map((c) => c.value);
355	    renderFCount(); render();
356	  });
357	  $('citySelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.city = e.target.value; renderFCount(); render(); });
358	  $('verOnly').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.verOnly = e.target.checked; renderFCount(); render(); });
359	  $('incClosed').addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.incClosed = e.target.checked; renderFCount(); render(); });
360	  $('resetFilters').addEventListener('click', () => { resetFilters(); UI.toast('Filters reset'); });
361	  $('emptyReset').addEventListener('click', resetFilters);
362	  $('filterBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
363	    const open = $('filterPanel').classList.toggle('is-open');
364	    $('filterBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
365	  });
366	  $('clearView').addEventListener('click', () => setView('all'));
367	  $('qLinks').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
368	    const b = e.target.closest('[data-field]');
369	    if (!b) return;
370	    state.field = b.dataset.field;
371	    renderChips(); render();
372	    $('chips').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
373	  });
374	
375	  const savedBox = document.getElementById('savedBox');
376	  const deadlineBox = document.getElementById('deadlineBox');
377	  const newBox = document.getElementById('newBox');
378	  const prefBox = document.getElementById('prefBox');
379	
380	  function renderSavedPanel(saved) {
381	    if (!saved.length) {
382	      savedBox.innerHTML = `${Rows.empty('You haven\'t saved any internships yet.', 'Tap the bookmark on any role to track it here.')}
383	        <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:-24px"><a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="${H('student_pages/browse.html')}">Browse internships</a></div>`;
384	      return;
385	    }
386	    savedBox.innerHTML = Rows.grid(saved.slice(0, 6));
387	    if (saved.length > 6) savedBox.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
388	      `<p class="muted" style="margin-top:14px">Showing 6 of ${saved.length} saved. Bookmark changes save instantly.</p>`);
389	  }
390	
391	  function renderDeadlines(saved) {
392	    const soon = saved
393	      .map((it) => ({ it, days: UI.daysUntil(it.deadline) }))
394	      .filter((x) => x.days !== null && x.days >= 0 && x.days <= 14)
395	      .sort((a, b) => a.days - b.days);
396	    if (!soon.length) {
397	      deadlineBox.innerHTML = `<p class="muted">No saved role closes in the next two weeks. Deadline alerts appear on your bell.</p>`;
398	      return;
399	    }
400	    deadlineBox.innerHTML = soon.map(({ it, days }) => {
401	      const cls = days <= 3 ? 'is-urgent' : '';
402	      const label = days === 0 ? 'Closes today' : `${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'} left`;
403	      return `<a class="deadline-item" href="${Rows.detailHref(it.id)}">
404	        <span class="dl-main"><span class="dl-title">${UI.esc(it.title)}</span>
405	        <span class="dl-co">${UI.esc(it.company)}</span></span>
406	        <span class="dl-days ${cls}">${label}</span></a>`;
407	    }).join('');
408	  }
409	
410	  function renderPrefs() {
411	    const prefs = p.preferences || {};
412	    const fields = prefs.fields || [], locs = prefs.locations || [], modes = prefs.workModes || [];
413	    const empty = !fields.length && !locs.length && !modes.length;
414	    if (empty) {
415	      prefBox.innerHTML = `<p class="muted">Set your field and location to personalise what you see.</p>
416	        <a class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" style="margin-top:12px" href="${H('student_pages/account.html')}#preferences">Set preferences</a>`;
417	      return;
418	    }
419	    const block = (title, arr) => arr.length
420	      ? `<div class="lbl" style="margin-top:10px">${title}</div><div class="pref-line">${arr.map((v) => `<span class="pill">${UI.esc(v)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : '';
421	    prefBox.innerHTML = block('Fields', fields) + block('Locations', locs) + block('Work mode', modes);
422	  }
423	
424	  async function renderNew() {
425	    let items = [];
426	    try { items = await Internships.whatsNew(6); } catch (_) { items = []; }
427	    newBox.innerHTML = items.length ? Rows.grid(items)
428	      : `<p class="muted">No new verified listings in the last 48 hours. Check Browse for everything open now.</p>`;
429	  }
430	
431	  async function loadPanels() {
432	    let saved = [];
433	    try { saved = await Saved.list(); } catch (_) { saved = []; }
434	    renderSavedPanel(saved);
435	    renderDeadlines(saved);
436	  }
437	
438	  document.addEventListener('saved:changed', () => { render(); loadPanels(); });
439	
440	  async function boot() {
441	    grid.innerHTML = Rows.skeleton(6);
442	    savedBox.innerHTML = Rows.skeleton(3);
443	    deadlineBox.innerHTML = UI.skeletonRows(2);
444	    newBox.innerHTML = Rows.skeleton(3);
445	    renderStrength();
446	    renderPrefs();
447	
448	    if (!Saved.loaded) { try { await Saved.load(); } catch (_) {} }
449	    try { VOCAB = (await Settings.load()) || Settings.DEFAULT; } catch (_) { VOCAB = Settings.DEFAULT; }
450	    renderModes();
451	
452	    try { ALL = (await Internships.published(200)) || []; }
453	    catch (err) { console.error(err); grid.innerHTML = Rows.error(); return; }
454	
455	    renderCities(); renderChips(); renderDiscover(); renderFCount(); render();
456	    if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('view') === 'saved') setView('saved');
457	    loadPanels();
458	    renderNew();
459	  }
460	  boot();
461	});
462	</script>
463	</body>
464	</html>
